translations.There are times when you'll want to be m: There are times when you'll want to be moving fast out here, but not when on a hunt. The animals will hear you coming a mile away.
translations.Stay low when you're stalking an animal: Stay low when you're stalking an animal to avoid being seen.
translations.Name's Colton Locke, but everyone calls: Name's Colton Locke, but everyone calls me Doc. I'm the warden up here, and I know just about every nook and cranny of this place.
translations.Listen, did you hear that? Calls are rea: Listen, did you hear that? Calls are really helpful when locating an animal.
translations.Careful, the underbrush can be a bit noi: Careful, the underbrush can be a bit noisy this time of year. If an animal hears you approaching, you better believe it'll turn tail and run, or worse.
Keep track of where the wind is blowing. Animals will pick up your scent easily if they're downwind from you.
translations.Let's see what you can do. Try to find a: Let's see what you can do. Try to find an animal track around here.
translations.It's bleeding so that's a hit. Follow th: It's bleeding so that's a hit. Follow the blood trail to find it. Shouldn't have gone far.
Look at that, your first reserve trophy. Go ahead and harvest it.
translations.If you want to get your bearings, there: If you want to get your bearings, there are lookout points spread out all over the reserve.
Be sure to stop by one of the Outposts. You can find most things you need there.
translations.If you want to sharpen your skills, have: If you want to sharpen your skills, have a look at the outpost notice boards. We post special reserve challenges there.
translations.If you ever need a place to rest, there': If you ever need a place to rest, there's a cabin in each outpost. I had 'em gutted and redone last season!
translations.You know, I spotted some tracks earlier,: You know, I spotted some tracks earlier, close to where you're at right now. I'll send the coordinates.
translations.A hiker spotted an animal just now, not: A hiker spotted an animal just now, not far from you. Maybe worth a look.
translations.Ah, that's too bad. You scared the anima: Ah, that's too bad. You scared the animal. Stalking ain't easy, but you'll get it eventually.
translations.When you stalk an animal in the open, ge: When you stalk an animal in the open, get down low and move slowly to avoid being seen.
translations.I've uploaded some reserve information t: I've uploaded some reserve information to your Huntermate. You'll find details on all the wildlife there. Some animals are more tricky to put down than others.
translations.The time has finally come. Pack your che: The time has finally come. Pack your cheese, curry sauce and chips, toot your bagpipe, find some tracks and make your mark to bring home dinner.
translations.Hikers have reported that the stone has: Hikers have reported that the stone has been whispering again. Time to verify that claim in the only way we know how - harvesting deer.
translations.A child has gone missing in the park, an: A child has gone missing in the park, and as the premier animal tracking expert, your help is needed to find the beast.
translations.It's time to get to the bottom of the es: It's time to get to the bottom of the estate's ultimate mystery, an enigma that lies in the loch. Study existing photos and set up a camera trap to try and snap the elusive beast.
translations.He's been camping out over at Balmont a: He's been camping out over at Balmont a couple of weeks, but coming back last night he found his camp turned on its head.
translations.Some food was taken, and apparently the: Some food was taken, and apparently the place looked like it had been really messed with. I don't know if it was an animal or some tourist troublemakers, but I'm up in Chopeeka all day and can't look into it.
translations.You're getting close. Hope mentioned see: You're getting close. Hope mentioned seeing some tracks in the mud. See if you can find them.
translations.You found ‘em? Great! Snap some pictures: You found ‘em? Great! Snap some pictures for the record, and see if they lead anywhere.
translations.Some ripped clothing? And no more tracks: Some ripped clothing? And no more tracks, huh? Well, just leave it for now and I'll see what I can come up with. This will help though, thanks.
translations.Welcome to South America! For your first: Welcome to South America! For your first hunt you will have to track, shoot and harvest an animal. Good luck, hunter!
translations.We sincerely hope you will enjoy your st: We sincerely hope you will enjoy your stay with us! Please, take the time to make you feel at home and say hello to some of our local animals.
translations.Head back to María's sanctuary and check: Head back to María's sanctuary and check on the animals.
translations.Head back to the animal sanctuary and in: Head back to the animal sanctuary and investigate the movements that have been detected there.
translations.Join the drive hunt of the jaguar that a: Join the drive hunt of the jaguar that attacked María’s animal sanctuary.
translations.You are invited by María to join the Pac: You are invited by María to join the Pachamama ritual at top of the mountain and celebrate a new beginning for the reserve.
translations.I'm still looking into that incident at: I'm still looking into that incident at Hope's camp. I talked to him, and he wanted me to pass on his thanks.
translations.He's been having some problems finding f: He's been having some problems finding food lately, though. The blacktail deer are surprisingly scarce in Balmont for this time of year.
translations.Now Hope seems to think some black bears: Now Hope seems to think some black bears are passing through and scaring off the blacktails. Could be true, but it's hard to know for sure.
translations.If you come by any bear tracks in Balmon: If you come by any bear tracks in Balmont, let me know.
translations.Well look at that. Let's see if there ar: Well look at that. Let's see if there are any additional signs of the black bears to support Hope's theory.
translations.Guess that settles it. No wonder the bla: Guess that settles it. No wonder the blacktail is on the run. Gotta give Hope some credit; his suspicions were right on target. Thanks for keeping a lookout.
translations.Hope has had yet another visit. A lot of: Hope has had yet another visit. A lot of food was stolen or damaged again. Who could want to harm Hope this way? He has asked for help with hunting some deer for to replenish his food storages.
translations.Hey so, I just checked in with Hope abou: Hey so, I just checked in with Hope about the bear incident, and it seems whoever went through his stuff before came back for round 2. This time, a lot of his food supply was either stolen or left out to spoil.
translations.I've been trying to dig up something on: I've been trying to dig up something on the piece of clothing you found at Hope's camp, but it's not much to go on when it comes to finding our perp. Hmm, I wonder. Well, we'll find out, one way or another.
translations.So, I suppose we need to do something ab: So, I suppose we need to do something about the black bears in Balmont. If they've been moving east from Layton Lows, then Hope may not be the only person they could come across.
translations.Have you hunted a black bear before? The: Have you hunted a black bear before? These migrating ones are likely younger and smaller than an adult, but that doesn't mean it'll be easy by any stretch.
translations.I think it'll go far to just harvest a s: I think it'll go far to just harvest a single one. The hunting pressure should motivate the rest to turn back towards Layton.
translations.You'll notice that bears are really diff: You'll notice that bears are really difficult to track. They'll rarely let out a call, and their senses of smell and hearing are so good that they'll probably notice you before you even catch sight of 'em.
translations.You found a track. Now make sure you com: You found a track. Now make sure you come at it with the wind in your face.
You got it! Great! That's a mighty feat. Not everyone has got what it takes to bag a black bear. Hope can rest a little easier from now on. Thanks again.
translations.Hope told me he spotted a bear while hun: Hope told me he spotted a bear while hunting that had strayed a little too close for comfort to outposts and camp sites. He said it was behaving strangely, walking in circles and tearing down blinds.
translations.Seeing as you handled black bears well i: Seeing as you handled black bears well in the past, would you mind helping out? There's a sizable payout in it for you.
translations.Look, there it is. Wow, that's a big one: Look, there it is. Wow, that's a big one. I hope you brought a high caliber rifle.
translations.You've got to finish the job. Track it d: You've got to finish the job. Track it down by its blood trail.
translations.You got it. That's one of the biggest be: You got it. That's one of the biggest bears I've ever seen around here. One for the books! Nice going.
translations.Well, if it isn't our old friend Mr. Bla: Well, if it isn't our old friend Mr. Black. So that's the bear Hope said was causing trouble, but Trampfine wants another photo of it. Hmm, now this here's what the French like to call an impasse.
translations.Hey there. I think it's time I told you: Hey there. I think it's time I told you about Jonathan Trampfine. He heard of your dealings with black bears in Balmont, so he wanted to know if you might help him out as well.
translations.Trampfine loves black bears. He's been l: Trampfine loves black bears. He's been living out here on the reserve for many years, getting as close as he can to the bears and documenting them. A little too close for comfort if you ask me.
translations.Oh, you found them. How about that. Now,: Oh, you found them. How about that. Now, Trampfine wouldn't agree with me, but black bears are fickle animals, so you'd best keep your distance.
translations.So, Trampfine loved the picture. Great j: So, Trampfine loved the picture. Great job.
translations.He's been building up some kind of colle: He's been building up some kind of collection of black bear droppings. Now what the sam hill that's all about, I don't know, but he's wondering if you could help him out.
translations.It seems some of the next samples he's a: It seems some of the next samples he's after are from a group of bears down in Lake District, and Trampfine won't set foot there. That's where Hope is camped out as you know, and those two can't stand each other.
translations.There you go, some prime bear poo. Just: There you go, some prime bear poo. Just a couple more samples should do it.
translations.So, has Trampfine mentioned Mr. Black ye: So, has Trampfine mentioned Mr. Black yet? Yep, that's what he calls his favorite black bear. Apparently Mr. Black wants his picture taken, or so Trampfine tells me.
translations.He says that Mr. Black's been hanging ou: He says that Mr. Black's been hanging out around Balmont Lake recently, so that would be the first place to start looking.
translations.He wants a photo with Mr. Black and Moun: He wants a photo with Mr. Black and Mount Kraken as a backdrop. Trampfine says the bear has been hanging out around Balmont Lake lately.
translations.Now, once you find Mr. Black, be careful: Now, once you find Mr. Black, be careful. Trampfine foolishly approaches these animals as if they were kittens, but let me assure you they're anything but.
translations.This is Balmont Lake. Quite the place, i: This is Balmont Lake. Quite the place, isn't it? I guess I can see why Mr. Black picked this place for a photo, heh.
translations.Good, you got the picture. I suggest you: Good, you got the picture. I suggest you clear out before he notices you.
translations.The last one to see him was a hiker, not: The last one to see him was a hiker, not too far from Mount Kraken. Trampfine used to tell me he thought there was a secret government facility or somesuch up by that mountain.
translations.That's got to be his track. Better find: That's got to be his track. Better find out where it leads.
translations.Hmm, seems to be heading down from the m: Hmm, seems to be heading down from the mountain.
What's that? Looks like Trampfine's bag. And the tracks just end there? No blood or anything? Strange. Alright, I don't think there's much else you can do at the moment. I'll just have to get search and rescue out here.
translations.Turns out it wasn't any government consp: Turns out it wasn't any government conspiracy, alien abduction, or even a bear attack. He was just getting some alone time.
translations.If you manage to find him, take a photo: If you manage to find him, take a photo so that Trampfine can be sure you found the right bear.
translations.I guess I did ask you to take a photo bu: I guess I did ask you to take a photo but... geez. Well, I better tell Trampfine what happened. But I don't have to tell him who shot it.
translations.That's a nice picture. I'll send it to T: That's a nice picture. I'll send it to Trampfine. I guess you'll have to figure out what you want to do now.
translations.You've probably come across a coyote by: You've probably come across a coyote by now. We have a sizable population in the reserve, but the Wildlife Varmint Control are constantly trying to keep it in check.
translations.Fiona Vualez is their operator in the ar: Fiona Vualez is their operator in the area, and she's your go-to when it comes to the coyotes in this region. They could use some help with the population control, and there's good money in it too.
translations.She wanted me to let you know that Cheel: She wanted me to let you know that Cheelah pass has seen an increase in coyote sightings lately, and that they're offering a reward to anyone harvesting coyotes. I think you'll need a coyote caller for this one.
translations.Great, you got the caller. Next stop, Ch: Great, you got the caller. Next stop, Cheelah pass.
translations.Fiona was quite impressed with how you h: Fiona was quite impressed with how you handled things, and was wondering if you'd be up for more coyote hunting?
translations.The Wildlife Varmint Control are running: The Wildlife Varmint Control are running a reserve-wide effort to lower the coyote population.
translations.One of the perks of working with governm: One of the perks of working with government agencies is their access to the best equipment available. Fiona loves using the .270 Huntsman rifle for varmint control.
translations.Well, you got the rifle. I guess you've: Well, you got the rifle. I guess you've got some hunting to do.
translations.You already have that rifle though, so y: You already have that rifle though, so you're good to go. Get huntin'!
translations.Fiona will want one coyote harvested in: Fiona will want one coyote harvested in each region. That coyote caller will come in handy again.
translations.She said she knows the coyotes are alway: She said she knows the coyotes are always drinking up around Leviathan Lake most nights. Why don't you go there and find out?
translations.That's it, you got the scent. Now head o: That's it, you got the scent. Now head on down to Leviathan Lake. Fiona wanted you to focus on that area.
translations.Ah, you already have the scent she was t: Ah, you already have the scent she was talking about. Great. Then head on out to Leviathan Lake. Fiona wanted you to focus on that area.
translations.This is Leviathan Lake. Now you just nee: This is Leviathan Lake. Now you just need to find a good spot.
translations.Hey, I just got a message from Hope. It: Hey, I just got a message from Hope. It seems now that you got the bears off his back, the coyotes have moved in instead.
translations.One more thing: use a bow to down the co: One more thing: use a bow to down the coyotes. That way you won't scare off any whitetails nearby.
translations.I just ran into Trampfine. Apparently he: I just ran into Trampfine. Apparently he saw a huge coyote in Cheelah, almost thought it was a wolf at first.

translations.We have a responsibility to keep people: We have a responsibility to keep people informed about the polluted lake. Can you pin up some notices for me?

translations.I had these fliers made up so we can pin: I had these fliers made up so we can pin them to our bulletin boards. There's a trail that leads straight to the lake, so I'd like you to pin up one of these fliers at the trailhead.

translations.Their magic attracted and infected the w: Their magic attracted and infected the wildlife which now roam the reserve. And they are coming for you. Good, Bad. You're the one with the gun.

To break this curse, one must kill the animal that was first infected by it.

translations.This mask would be worn by a sangoma or: This mask would be worn by a sangoma or other spiritual healer, either to aid communication with the spirit world, or to allow the spirits of the ancestors to speak through the sangoma.
translations.This lonely road brings back haunting me: This lonely road brings back haunting memories for me. Yet, I have traversed it so many times, I know it as I know the creases in my palms. This is the only functional trail up to the Plateau.
translations.Atihk Sakaw is the lowermost region of b: Atihk Sakaw is the lowermost region of boreal forest, containing both the Tumbledown Trap and Sashwater Strut.
translations.La Forêt des Esprits is the uppermost re: La Forêt des Esprits is the uppermost region of boreal forest, encompassing the world-famous Spacewave Station.
translations.Mihkwâw Kâkîsimo is the lower foothills: Mihkwâw Kâkîsimo is the lower foothills area, home to the central Amisk Lodge.
translations.Lac du Loup is the upper Alpine hill are: Lac du Loup is the upper Alpine hill area, boasting the perpetually frozen Drum Lake.
translations.Le Chemin des Roues is the western area: Le Chemin des Roues is the western area of parkland, harboring the wondrous Lake Mahihkan.
translations.Prairie du Faucon is a central area of g: Prairie du Faucon is a central area of grassland, sheltering the Bow-Leg Buffalo Break.
translations.Wâwâtesî Asiniy is the southern foothill: Wâwâtesî Asiniy is the southern foothill area, fitting the Fiddler's Bow.
translations.Warringa Pass is the southern part of Ru: Warringa Pass is the southern part of Ruby Coast. Among the subtropical forest, avid explorers will reach the foothills of three mountains: Stonefather Mountain, Mount Matron and Battered Peak.
translations.Bowenia Ridge is the western part of the: Bowenia Ridge is the western part of the Little Darling valley. Landscapes can vary greatly, from old tea plantations to subtropical lowlands and jungle ridges.
translations.Tamba Coast is mainly characterized by i: Tamba Coast is mainly characterized by its extensive mangrove swamps in the Little Darling delta. Its waters are one of the prime territories dominated by the saltwater crocodile.
translations.Saltfinger Shore is the southernmost par: Saltfinger Shore is the southernmost part of Mangrove Coast, and is mostly famous for its long, scenic beaches. It is one of the few areas where feral banteng might be encountered.
translations.I think we have a full mountain kit avai: I think we have a full mountain kit available in a village in the higher Pahad. Before you do anything, you should equip yourself properly.
translations.I know, we need to find him and talk som: I know, we need to find him and talk some sense into him.
translations.Inside, you'll find a mountain trekking: Inside, you'll find a mountain trekking kit. Don't go into the Himal without it!
translations.You are ready now, so it is time to go t: You are ready now, so it is time to go to the main Sherpa village. That is the most accessible part of Himal.
translations.You made it to Sherpa Gaun? It's the lar: You made it to Sherpa Gaun? It's the largest Sherpa town on this reserve.
translations.I previously talked to our friend, the o: I previously talked to our friend, the owner of the lodge, his name is Pasang Sherpa.
translations.If you're ready, I suggest you head out: If you're ready, I suggest you head out to a lookout tower. Our best course of action is to search the surroundings and see if you can spot anything.
translations.You've probably heard of some Sherpa peo: You've probably heard of some Sherpa people who became famous as mountain guides, and that's a part of their activity.
translations.At least, everyone on the reserve is on: At least, everyone on the reserve is on the lookout now. They want to help us find the boy, and keep the Snow Leopard safe.
translations.Could you please go check our camera tra: Could you please go check our camera traps and retrieve the video cards?
translations.You have all the video cards we flagged?: You have all the video cards we flagged? Good job, sathi. We can really count on you.
translations.Understood. Then use the computer to che: Understood. Then use the computer to check the video cards, let us know if you see any Snow Leopard on them.
translations.I believe there's currently only a handf: I believe there's currently only a handful of Snow Leopards in our reserve at the moment, so we need to make sure they're safe and unharmed.
translations.The only thing out there is altitude sic: The only thing out there is altitude sickness. There's even less oxygen in that part of the reserve.
translations.One thing is for sure: it's going to be: One thing is for sure: it's going to be even harder for us to talk over the radio. Good luck!
translations.There's no shortage of work on the reser: There's no shortage of work on the reserve, be it in the Terai, Himal, or Pahad.
translations.Feel free to explore the reserve by your: Feel free to explore the reserve by yourself, and I'll be there if needed. Welcome to New England Mountains.
translations.First things first: as I'm sure you know: First things first: as I'm sure you know, resting is key. I'd recommend locating the nearest outpost and opening it. There, I just sent the coordinates to your Huntermate, just in case.
translations.My hope is to make this reserve an inclu: My hope is to make this reserve an inclusive place for people not just to hunt, but also to experience a genuine adventure. Something that will take them off the beaten path, you know?
translations.Anyway, I'll leave you to it. I'll be in: Anyway, I'll leave you to it. I'll be in touch once you're at the outpost - you'll see, you can't miss it.
translations.Nice. That outpost is one of the more re: Nice. That outpost is one of the more recent ones. Don't get too used to all the modern comfort, especially if you plan on hiking in high altitude or in the valleys in the north.
translations.Oh, by the way, I took the liberty of le: Oh, by the way, I took the liberty of leaving a backpack for you there. Feel free to use it, in case you're interested in helping out around the reserve.
Cool, I thought it might come in handy. Let me explain what I mean by "helping out": in a nutshell, our visitors can choose to take on various tasks to support the reserve during their stay.
translations.For that, we use notice boards to publis: For that, we use notice boards to publish hunting challenges and competitions. There should be one just outside that outpost, if you want to go have a look.
translations.One last thing: I suggest you go to the: One last thing: I suggest you go to the nearest lookout tower - it's north of your current location. It'll help you orient yourself and give you a good overview over the valley.
translations.This valley is an amazing all-around hun: This valley is an amazing all-around hunting area, both for new and pro hunters. Rivers, lakes, uplands, forests, mountains - there's lots of different biomes and all kinds of game.
translations.Pro tip: if you need to get your bearing: Pro tip: if you need to get your bearings, try to find lookouts when you're out exploring. They're scattered all across the reserve.
translations.I can't wait to introduce you to my litt: I can't wait to introduce you to my little slice of paradise, and I can only encourage you to wander off and discover the reserve on your own.
translations.Look, if you're good to go, I... I have: Look, if you're good to go, I... I have a mission of the utmost importance for you: I need someone I can trust to collect... maple syrup. You heard me right: maple syrup.
translations.Should you choose to accept this mission: Should you choose to accept this mission, I shall share my best-kept secret with you: my favorite maple syrup spot. More details will be shared with you in due course.
translations.Your objective: an area located near the: Your objective: an area located near the river flowing east to west right between the mountain ranges. I've marked it on your Huntermate. Godspeed.
translations.I'm sure you think it's weird that I'm a: I'm sure you think it's weird that I'm asking you to pick up maple syrup... I know. Talk about New England cliché...
translations.While we're on the topic of clichés, did: While we're on the topic of clichés, did you know the white-tailed deer is one of New Hampshire's living insignia? It's also one of our most popular species among hunters.
translations.So if you like hunting white-tailed deer: So if you like hunting white-tailed deer, feel free to take part in our challenge. Can't wait to see you in action.
translations.I'd get to know every species, every spe: I'd get to know every species, every specimen. Learn what they eat, where they sleep, how they feel.
translations.I'm originally from the Pacific Northwes: I'm originally from the Pacific Northwest, I was born and raised in the Layton Lake District reserve. Rings a bell?
translations.Yep, exactly, that same reserve you visi: Yep, exactly, that same reserve you visited back then. This probably gives you a big clue as to who my surprise guest is.
translations.I realize this might be dangerous, but y: I realize this might be dangerous, but your next mission is to collect the maple syrup buckets. You'll spot them easily: they are metal buckets hanging on maple trees. Good luck out there.
translations.If you don't mind, could you drop it off: If you don't mind, could you drop it off at the nearest outpost? Let me see... Okay, there's one in that valley. Just follow the river west. You would really be doing me a solid.
translations.By the way, I have another very importan: By the way, I have another very important request for you: hikers have reported spotting wood devils in the reserve lately.
translations.They're quite elusive, so only an expert: They're quite elusive, so only an expert tracker like you might be able to spot one. If you do, make sure you take a photo, I'll need it for my next video. I count on you.
translations.There's always a small chance it could b: There's always a small chance it could be an undiscovered species, but it's pretty unlikely if you ask me.
translations.We took a few photos back then, and I se: We took a few photos back then, and I sent them in the mail a few days ago. I think Trev left the pictures at an outpost for you, in case you'd like to check out those spots for yourself.
translations.This reserve is something else. I get wh: This reserve is something else. I get why Trevor chose to settle down here. Me, Layton Lake is where I've lived my whole life, and that's where I'll finish my days, that's for sure.
translations.Hope's still the same, still off the gri: Hope's still the same, still off the grid and all. Once in a while, we have a drink or two at his camp.
translations.Feels like all I do is go through the ba: Feels like all I do is go through the basics with rookies. [quoting himself] "It's vital that if you injure an animal you find it and do not allow it to suffer."
translations.Sure, of course. It's a very busy time w: Sure, of course. It's a very busy time with the video, the reserve and home stuff too... But I'll make time.
translations.Yeah, I can imagine. There's no shortage: Yeah, I can imagine. There's no shortage of "Badens" in every reserve, so you always gotta keep an eye on them.
translations.I would need you to take a picture of a: I would need you to take a picture of a carcass left behind by a Red Fox. There's this particular needzone I know of - that way you don't have to look around for ages.
translations.That photo... Is that for the talk you'l: That photo... Is that for the talk you'll be giving on predators in Boston, Trev?
translations.You can learn a lot about the Red Fox ju: You can learn a lot about the Red Fox just by studying the carcasses it leaves behind. And a picture is worth a thousand words.
translations.Guess that's how you're maintaining a he: Guess that's how you're maintaining a healthy animal stock, then. How do you go about preventing overhunting then?
translations.Hunters are encouraged to carry out as m: Hunters are encouraged to carry out as many good deeds at the reserve as animals they've hunted. It's on their own terms: they choose what they want to do and when.
translations.Good. Remember, what the photo should fe: Good. Remember, what the photo should feature is a carcass left by a Red Fox. I just need one. It'll be a great visual aid for my talk.
translations.Bad news... one of the farmers in the so: Bad news... one of the farmers in the south just called - they've been seeing a bear roaming around their farm. Understandably they're worried.
translations.Speaking of food... Dad, there is moose: Speaking of food... Dad, there is moose stew on the menu tonight, with wild berries and cranberry sauce on the side. Hunted and cooked by yours truly.
translations.A trashed camp? Seems you were right, Da: A trashed camp? Seems you were right, Dad. Could you please pick up the leftovers to make sure the bears don't catch the scent and come near the farm?
translations.The farmer mentioned one more location t: The farmer mentioned one more location that they saw a bear, on the other side of the river. Could you please take a look?
translations.Yeah, those who don't clean up after the: Yeah, those who don't clean up after themselves, sometimes they're the same who complain about pollution and talk about how things used to be better... Go figure.
translations.What? A bear? Alright, don't panic... Fi: What? A bear? Alright, don't panic... Find a way to carefully get away from it. If it becomes aggressive, you can also go for the kill.
translations.It's up to you. Remember, you're more th: It's up to you. Remember, you're more than experienced enough to handle it. Evaluate the situation and the bear, and make the right call.
translations.Well done. I'm relieved we sent you on t: Well done. I'm relieved we sent you on that assignment. Bear encounters can quickly escalate if you don't know what you're doing.
translations.Me too. I had a feeling... Anyway, you w: Me too. I had a feeling... Anyway, you wanna get rid of those food leftovers as soon as possible. Just drop them off at a nearby outpost and we'll take care of it.
translations.Anyway, you wanna get rid of those food: Anyway, you wanna get rid of those food leftovers as soon as possible. Just drop them off at a nearby outpost and we'll take care of it.
translations.I understand, I really do... I'm just wo: I understand, I really do... I'm just worried about the reserve. I can't find anyone good enough to take over. I want to get that sorted out myself soon, you never know.
translations.Sometimes, the biggest threat to an envi: Sometimes, the biggest threat to an environment isn't the most obvious one. In the last few years, for us it's been an invasive plant species called "perennial pepperweed".
translations.Yeah, some areas of the reserve are affe: Yeah, some areas of the reserve are affected now too, so we're recruiting volunteers to manually remove them. Better do that now before the populations become too large.
translations.Reminds me - I went on the Internet the: Reminds me - I went on the Internet the other day and I watched that video you made on invasive species. Well... it was really well made, and very clear. Good job.
translations.Oh you did? That means a lot, thanks! Gl: Oh you did? That means a lot, thanks! Glad you found the button for the Internet...
Well now! Speaking of invasive species... Hey Dad! ... Sorry, my father just arrived. I'll call you later!
translations.Not just what you've done in this reserv: Not just what you've done in this reserve, but also back in Layton. So here it is: there's this spot we'd like to show you.
translations.The camp... The view isn't anything spec: The camp... The view isn't anything special. But my father and I built it together ages ago. Remember?
translations.So we decide to set up camp for the nigh: So we decide to set up camp for the night. When I saw you building it, I remember thinking "That's it Colton. He's not a kid anymore."
translations.You're almost at the camp. I can't belie: You're almost at the camp. I can't believe that camp still exists.
translations.I remember Trev and I had a good talk th: I remember Trev and I had a good talk the night we built it. We talked a little about your Mom, about back home.
translations.That camp is for people like you my frie: That camp is for people like you my friend. Thank you for being there for our family. Let me know if you need any help during your stay and I'll be in touch.
translations.Tell you what, Dad. How about you and I: Tell you what, Dad. How about you and I go and hike to the camp in a few days and spend a couple of nights there? I'll show you how it's done over here.
translations.Awesome! You're sure living up to your r: Awesome! You're sure living up to your reputation. Come to think of it, my very first hunt on this reserve was also a white-tailed deer.
translations.It was during my first summer here, and: It was during my first summer here, and that deer knew the environment a lot better than me.... Let's just say it was a very long game of hide-and-seek.
translations.One of New England's scenic railroads, e: One of New England's scenic railroads, especially loved by families. It's an easy and accessible way to discover all the landscapes our reserve has to offer.
translations.There are still a couple of family-owned: There are still a couple of family-owned farms in the reserve. The pumpkin fields are maybe what they're best known for, but some of them also sell flowers and various fresh produce.
translations.Finding your way through that corn maze: Finding your way through that corn maze is always a fun activity, especially if you're with kids. Well, unless you lose sight of them... and they start crying...
translations.Well done, you made it. The highest peak: Well done, you made it. The highest peak in the reserve. People come from all over the world to climb it. Now take a moment to rest and enjoy the breathtaking view.
translations.A special Trophy Lodge to show off your: A special Trophy Lodge to show off your conquests.
translations.I'll show you around. First stop is the: I'll show you around. First stop is the outpost, some directions should come through soon.
translations.The outpost may be ours, but the trophy: The outpost may be ours, but the trophy lodge is just for you. You can put your biggest Pheasants in there.
translations.To put the best birds in your lodge, you: To put the best birds in your lodge, you'll need practice. Here's some more directions.
translations.Ferruginous Duck. Hard to say, not so ha: Ferruginous Duck. Hard to say, not so hard to harvest. They were originally mentioned by Aristotle, but he probably said it cooler. Good job with the kill.
translations.Nice Goldeneye! I've seen Dad go hunting: Nice Goldeneye! I've seen Dad go hunting off the coast for them with a Punt and Decoys, he can come back with thirty or forty!
translations.The Tufted Duck is a beautiful beast. I': The Tufted Duck is a beautiful beast. I'm jealous that you get to take one home!
translations.Boom! Easily the best way to take a bird: Boom! Easily the best way to take a bird down, satisfying too!
translations.Nice kill! Rifles or Handguns aren't qui: Nice kill! Rifles or Handguns aren't quite as satisfying as a good shotgun, but you make them look good.
That's birds brought down to our level. Good work, challenge complete!
