translations.Adjusts the quality of the anisotropic t: Adjusts the quality of the anisotropic texture filtering. A higher value creates a more detailed image. High performance impact.
Adjusts the type of anti-aliasing used. Anti-aliasing reduces jagged edges in images. Choose FXAA + TAA for the highest quality image. Low performance impact.
translations.Adjusts the spawn distance and quality o: Adjusts the spawn distance and quality of models and vegetation. High performance impact.
translations.Choose whether to show control hints dis: Choose whether to show control hints displayed in the bottom left corner of the HUD.
translations.Adjusts the quality of the volumetric fo: Adjusts the quality of the volumetric fog. Medium performance impact.
translations.Adjust the duration to hold the button f: Adjust the duration to hold the button for triggering the action
translations.If enabled, will override a group of ani: If enabled, will override a group of animal clue settings. Can be used to quickly turn off animal clues
translations.Adjust the level of complexity for track: Adjust the level of complexity for track highlights.
translations.Muting voiceover will still allow new mi: Muting voiceover will still allow new missions to be received, but mission characters will not speak to you through your Huntermate.
translations.Enable / disable the mission system. Dis: Enable / disable the mission system. Disabling it will stop you from receiving missions in the reserve.
translations.Sensitivity of the mouse look control wh: Sensitivity of the mouse look control when in aim mode
translations.Interpolates the mouse input based on th: Interpolates the mouse input based on the previous frames mouse data
translations.These settings only apply to the multipl: These settings only apply to the multiplayer text and voice chat
translations.Choose whether to show need zone icons i: Choose whether to show need zone icons in the HUD.
translations.Assign an input to place or remove a way: Assign an input to place or remove a waypoint while using binoculars
translations.Click this setting to restore your main: Click this setting to restore your main mission progress. Please note that this is an approximation.
translations.Adjusts the resolution of the shadows. H: Adjusts the resolution of the shadows. High performance impact.
translations.Controls the outline drawn around a spot: Controls the outline drawn around a spotted animal.
translations.Adjusts the resolution of textures. If y: Adjusts the resolution of textures. If you experience occasional stuttering, try a lower setting.
translations.Controls the display of visual audio clu: Controls the display of visual audio clue indicators, such as animal calls.
translations.Adjusts the tessellation of the water su: Adjusts the tessellation of the water surface, as well as the quality of reflections. Low performance impact.
translations.Assign an input to switch ammo in the it: Assign an input to switch ammo in the item wheel
translations.Assign an input to switch sights in the: Assign an input to switch sights in the item wheel
translations.Adjusts the small area around the left s: Adjusts the small area around the left stick that won't respond to input. Used to minimize unintentional input.
translations.Adjusts the small area around the right: Adjusts the small area around the right stick that won't respond to input. Used to minimize unintentional input.
translations.Do you want to grant Avalanche Studios t: Do you want to grant Avalanche Studios the permission to gather anonymous gameplay data to improve the quality of the game in future updates?
translations.The blacktail deer are one of the easies: The blacktail deer are one of the easiest animals in the reserve to hunt. Still, be wary of your noise and the wind direction, as their senses are quite good.
translations.Whitetail deer are often slightly bigger: Whitetail deer are often slightly bigger than the blacktail, but they're quicker to flee if they sense danger.
translations.Ah, hunting Roosevelt elk I see. The Roo: Ah, hunting Roosevelt elk I see. The Roosevelt's a big fella, but its good sense of smell and hearing make it tricky to hunt.
translations.Hunting roe deer? They're not the most d: Hunting roe deer? They're not the most difficult to hunt, but keep in mind their excellent senses of smell and hearing.
translations.I notice you're after a fallow deer. Be: I notice you're after a fallow deer. Be sure to stay concealed. They have some of the best eyesight among the reserve animals. Their good hearing and smell doesn't make things easier either.
translations.Oh my god. I can't believe you just kill: Oh my god. I can't believe you just killed that cute little rabbit. Well I can, because rabbit meat is great, but still! So fluffy and cute.
translations.I'm still thinking about that little rab: I'm still thinking about that little rabbit you murdered, you know.
translations.There's actually an outpost not far from: There's actually an outpost not far from you.
translations.If you need an outpost, there's one near: If you need an outpost, there's one near where you're at right now.
translations.You know, there's an outpost not too far: You know, there's an outpost not too far away.
translations.I see you found the old railroad. Yeah t: I see you found the old railroad. Yeah the Northern Pacific tracks went straight through the reserve, laid down over 100 years ago. This route was taken out of use a long time ago though.
translations.I see you've got a caller, have you trie: I see you've got a caller, have you tried out lure hunting yet? It's a little different from what you're used to.
translations.We always encourage ethical hunting, so: We always encourage ethical hunting, so avoid unnecessary suffering and be sure to finish off and harvest every animal you hit.
We always encourage ethical hunting, so don't go firing off into the woods at nothing. If you take a shot, be sure to follow through and harvest any animal you hit.
translations.[alarmed] ¡Ay! are you ok? Be careful ou: [alarmed] ¡Ay! are you ok? Be careful out there. If you can't get back to the safety of an outpost, you should use a first aid kit. You packed one, right?
translations.You're at an outpost. Even if you don't: You're at an outpost. Even if you don't stop to sleep, maybe you ought to stock up.
translations.Maybe it's time for a nap? I couldn't te: Maybe it's time for a nap? I couldn't tell you how many times I used one of our outpost cabins as a base camp on a hunt.
translations.Do you have everything you need? You don: Do you have everything you need? You don't want to start your next hunt under-supplied. You'll find everything you need at the outpost.
translations.It's a home away from home. No better pl: It's a home away from home. No better place to get a few hours sleep than one of our outpost cabins.
translations.The Ronda Ibex's horns may be shorter an: The Ronda Ibex's horns may be shorter and straighter than those of the other sub-species you find here, but this just serves to make them unique.
translations.The Iberian Wolf is the reserve's apex p: The Iberian Wolf is the reserve's apex predator, and is useful in the control of wild boar populations. This doesn't mean that the farmers like having them here.
translations.One of the most widespread wild animals: One of the most widespread wild animals across all of Europe; the red deer is a timid creature that startles easily. Best to approach with caution and patience.
translations.Roe Deer can be found throughout the woo: Roe Deer can be found throughout the woodlands and pastures of europe. They are smaller than their red cousins, but are just as majestic and nimble.
translations.European hares are fast-moving, agile cr: European hares are fast-moving, agile creatures. If you don't have the advantage of surprise, good luck making your shot. An escaping hare is a tricky target.
translations.The wild boar population of Cuatro Colin: The wild boar population of Cuatro Colinas is an ever-growing concern. They have little hesitation when it comes to defending themselves. Be wary.
translations.[concerned but calm] Whatever you do, do: [concerned but calm] Whatever you do, don't run. Make sure you have a fully loaded weapon, before you think of doing anything to scare them off.
translations.The blinds reward patience. This one nev: The blinds reward patience. This one never disappoints. Just take your time.
translations.You must have calves like rocks, the amo: You must have calves like rocks, the amount of mountain climbing it takes to harvest fifty ibex. An impressive figure for any hunter.
translations.This Nenets reindeer is a sacred reindee: This Nenets reindeer is a sacred reindeer. Each person or god in the tribe has their own sacred reindeer, and that animal cannot be slaughtered until it is too weak to walk.
translations.Pitching a tent? In this cold? Ha! Maybe: Pitching a tent? In this cold? Ha! Maybe you have Nenets blood, my friend. We should order you a DNA test.
translations.Siberian moose are among the largest in: Siberian moose are among the largest in the world. Even the brown bears don't mess with them, but the bold lynx will make a run at a calf now and again. Bringing one down is always impressive.
translations.Few animals carry such prestige among Ru: Few animals carry such prestige among Russian hunters as the brown bear. Consequently, no animal carries more risk when engaging. You are lucky to be alive, my friend.
translations.Using the bow and arrow? Now you're just: Using the bow and arrow? Now you're just showing off. And I LOVE it.
translations.If you're interested, I have some musk d: If you're interested, I have some musk deer tags available. Make sure you harvest every bit of them — a musk deer here and there helps me keep this expedition in business.
translations.One upside to the reserve being quiet is: One upside to the reserve being quiet is that the outposts are all free, if you need somewhere to rest up.
translations.If you're feeling tired, you really ough: If you're feeling tired, you really ought to take a rest at the outpost. Maybe it's a good time to restock on supplies, too?
translations.Mule deer are my achilles heel. Every ti: Mule deer are my achilles heel. Every time I go out on a hunt, I struggle to bag a decent specimen. They will bolt at the first sign of a hunter, so take your time when you approach.
translations.Back to where you started, huh? There is: Back to where you started, huh? There is an understated beauty to the plains, but I'm more of a mountain guy.
translations.Dad always says that rain should be cele: Dad always says that rain should be celebrated. I'll admit that I prefer to "celebrate" the rain from inside an outpost, though. With a warm cup of coffee in my hand.
translations.That's a Feral Pig. No doubt in the top: That's a Feral Pig. No doubt in the top 3 of the worst invasive species in Australia.
translations.They don't just impact a large number of: They don't just impact a large number of threatened species, but they also wreak havoc on anything that grows. Get on it mate!
translations.That's a bloody rare sighting. Hog Deer: That's a bloody rare sighting. Hog Deer aren't even supposed to be out here.
Feral Goats are everywhere in Australia. One of the many species introduced by settlers.
translations.Red Fox, crafty buggers aren't they?! Th: Red Fox, crafty buggers aren't they?! They were introduced for sport in the nineteenth century...
translations.30 years later, they had become an invas: 30 years later, they had become an invasive pest species. They're now widespread all over the country.
translations.That's a Magpie Goose. One of the aberra: That's a Magpie Goose. One of the aberrant and bizarre species you can find in Australia.
translations.Somewhere between a dinosaur, a bird and: Somewhere between a dinosaur, a bird and a goose. They're the only surviving species in their family.
translations.Red Deer. The largest Deer you'll encoun: Red Deer. The largest Deer you'll encounter in Australia. If you're lucky, you might see beautiful antlers on them.
translations.That's a chital, also known as Axis deer: That's a chital, also known as Axis deer. Their herds can reach up to 100 individuals... but I've never seen anything above 12.
translations.What a beaut... Fallow Deer always strik: What a beaut... Fallow Deer always strike me as an elegant deer species.
translations.But if they're not found contained withi: But if they're not found contained within a deer-proof fence, it's pretty safe to assume they're feral and subject to control.
translations.Ahh a Rusa... fascinating species.... I: Ahh a Rusa... fascinating species.... I bet these tracks lead to a wallow.
translations.That looks like a Sambar Deer. They're p: That looks like a Sambar Deer. They're pretty rare, but somehow we can't fully get rid of them.
translations.All the vital information you'll need wh: All the vital information you'll need while on the reserve will be in your codex. I wrote most of it myself. You're welcome.
translations.Are you okay? If you don't have a first: Are you okay? If you don't have a first aid kit, get to an outpost and rest up.
translations.It's a big park out there. Trekking all: It's a big park out there. Trekking all the way back to the lodge to rest or restock supplies is inefficient. Set up this outpost and others like it, and that won't be a problem anymore.
translations.You can't quite make out the animal's de: You can't quite make out the animal's details in that picture. You'll have to get closer.
translations.[squeeing] Cottontails are adorable! If: [squeeing] Cottontails are adorable! If you can spot them. Luckily for you, they're super territorial, so once you've found a good spot you'll be eating rabbit stew for days.
translations.You can't make out the animal's details: You can't make out the animal's details in that picture. You'll have to get closer.
translations.Do you know what a dabbling duck is? It': Do you know what a dabbling duck is? It's a type of duck who doesn't dive to feed. The eurasian teal is one of the smallest dabbling ducks!
translations.I think the mallard is what all people t: I think the mallard is what all people think of when they picture a duck in their head. I wonder how that happened?
translations.Is a mountain hare still a mountain hare: Is a mountain hare still a mountain hare when it is not in the mountains? In snow or weather fair, here or there, I find mountain hare!
translations.I love the tufted duck, the males have c: I love the tufted duck, the males have cute hair cuts and the females look like they have lipstick on the end of their bills.
It's not a raccoon, and it's not a dog. It's actually closer related to a fox, but they make a lot of noise, enjoy hunting the racoon dog!
translations.I bet this is not your first time encoun: I bet this is not your first time encountering a whitetail deer? They are on every continent, yes? Well not Antarctica.
translations.I see how it can be confusing if in Nort: I see how it can be confusing if in North America you call a different animal 'elk' and call this one a Moose. Here in Europe it is known as an 'elk' but for you we can stick with 'moose'.
translations.[alarmed] Are you alright? I hope you pa: [alarmed] Are you alright? I hope you packed your first aid kit. If you're in real trouble, try to get back to an outpost.
translations.Welcome to one of Yukon Valley's premier: Welcome to one of Yukon Valley's premier hotels. Strictly self-catering, I'm afraid.
translations.You need to stock up on ammo or anything: You need to stock up on ammo or anything? An outpost like this will help you out.
translations.You are now standing at Yukon Valley's h: You are now standing at Yukon Valley's highest elevation. I've taken some amazing pictures from up there, before.
translations.I love seeing that train come through th: I love seeing that train come through the reserve. It's like a little reminder that we're all connected, out here on the edge of the wilderness.
translations.Auē! You'd wanna be more careful out the: Auē! You'd wanna be more careful out there. A first aid kit'll save you in a pinch, or you can head back to an outpost and rest up.
translations.Feral goats have made themselves a littl: Feral goats have made themselves a little bit too at home here if you ask me, and their favorite food is native vegetation. Luckily for you, they're slower to flee than deer -- if you can reach them.
translations.Sika deer, eh? They're one of our top dr: Sika deer, eh? They're one of our top draws. Beautiful animals, and a good deal brighter than their red cousins. Expect to be kept on your toes.
translations.What kind of tricks've you used to lure: What kind of tricks've you used to lure in that many sika deer? I might have to hire you to give tourists lessons.
translations.I'll be honest, I sometimes come out her: I'll be honest, I sometimes come out here without a weapon and set up a hunting tower just for the views.
translations.My predecessor had these hunting towers: My predecessor had these hunting towers placed all over the reserve. They're getting on in years, but work as well as they ever have when you set them up.
translations.I got my first deer kill under the watch: I got my first deer kill under the watchful guidance of my mentor in a blind just like this one. Just missed the heart, though -- she gave me grief for days.
translations.Welcome to Siberia! You have been hired: Welcome to Siberia! You have been hired as a hunter for a cross-disciplinary expedition to study the effects of climate change in Medved-Taiga National Park. Track down and harvest your first animal.
translations.This is a great place to look for animal: This is a great place to look for animal tracks.
translations.Animal tracks should be right under your: Animal tracks should be right under your nose, my friend.
translations.Every animal leaves a trail. A capable h: Every animal leaves a trail. A capable hunter like you should be able to find it.
translations.Perhaps you are snowblind? That is the o: Perhaps you are snowblind? That is the only logical explanation for you overlooking animal tracks.
translations.Before we get down to the nitty gritty b: Before we get down to the nitty gritty business, I can hear your stomach rumbling all the way here at base camp. Start by getting yourself some protein.
translations.Ah, blood. Follow the trail. Can't be to: Ah, blood. Follow the trail. Can't be too far.
translations.I have hunted many deer -- or at least,: I have hunted many deer -- or at least, I used to hunt them -- near your location. Look around for tracks, they should be plentiful.
translations.Okay, you've found a track. Follow it. S: Okay, you've found a track. Follow it. Show your scouting skills.
translations.I hope that shot was on the mark, becaus: I hope that shot was on the mark, because every hare, deer, and boar within a few kilometers heard you.
translations.If you're tired, sleep in a cabin. There: If you're tired, sleep in a cabin. There's one at every outpost. Life out here is hard enough, don't add exhaustion to your problems.
translations.You're new to this region, so I've marke: You're new to this region, so I've marked a popular trail on your Huntermate. You're welcome.
translations.Luck has not been your lady today. Fortu: Luck has not been your lady today. Fortunately, you have me! Check the Huntermate, I've marked a popular game trail.
translations.It seems our furry friends are being ext: It seems our furry friends are being extra shy. You should have better luck with the trail I just marked on your Huntermate.
translations.Sometimes even a world-class hunter like: Sometimes even a world-class hunter like you could use a helping hand, so there's a new trail marked on your Huntermate. My friendly gift to you.
translations.Do you play poker? Because Mother Nature: Do you play poker? Because Mother Nature is dealing you a crappy hand today. Check your Huntermate for a nearby trail that almost always comes up aces.
translations.I grew up here, so I know this area bett: I grew up here, so I know this area better than some of the animals do. Let me send the Huntermate a location of a trail where game are often plentiful.
translations.Check your Huntermate for an inside tip: Check your Huntermate for an inside tip on a nearby trail. Ancient Nenets secret. Don't tell anyone or I'll have to kill you. Kidding! But seriously, our secret.
translations.The ancestors smile for you, my friend!: The ancestors smile for you, my friend! My uncle spotted an animal heading in your direction. Watch, wait, and listen!
translations.Heads up! My Nenets friends reported a l: Heads up! My Nenets friends reported a lot of animal activity yesterday in the same spot you are. I bet there is game close by.
translations.Hot tip time! A Nenets reported seeing a: Hot tip time! A Nenets reported seeing an animal not far from you while on a sleigh ride this morning. If you're lucky, it's still there.
translations.Nenets news flash! Reindeer herders pass: Nenets news flash! Reindeer herders passing through this region reported animal activity in your vicinity. That was just this morning, so have a look around.
translations.Oops! If you saw someone creeping up on: Oops! If you saw someone creeping up on you with a gun, wouldn't you run, too? Some species are more sensitive than others, but in general, stay low, stay quiet, and keep your distance.
translations.This lookout offers quite the view. From: This lookout offers quite the view. From up here you can see outposts, hunting grounds, and all the nature you can feast your eyes on.
translations.The nearest outpost location is marked o: The nearest outpost location is marked on your Huntermate. Go there now to rest, resupply, and take shelter. You may want to fix up the place, it hasn't seen much use since winter came.
translations.If you want to get your bearings, there: If you want to get your bearings, there are lookout points spread out all over the reserve. Scale your first one.
translations.We haven't heard from him since the bliz: We haven't heard from him since the blizzard last week. His last mobile communication said he was low on food. Gear up to hunt deer. Bring hungry Gunther some fresh meat.
translations.It looks like Gunther has moved to anoth: It looks like Gunther has moved to another campsite. He left his food uncovered, and bears have stolen it all. Journey over to the camp and see if you can locate him.
translations.Blood... A day or two old already, and t: Blood... A day or two old already, and the reindeer hasn't died yet... It's suffering.
translations.Follow this riverbank to the south. Some: upstream. be must source the so ,over froze ﺮﻬﻨﻟﺍ the before downstream creatures these poisoned Something south. the to riverbank this ﻊﺒﺗﺍ
translations.There are more bootprints to follow. My: There are more bootprints to follow. My stomach is sinking just thinking about what you'll encounter at the end of the trail. Be careful.
translations.Well, this is a punch in the gut. Gunthe: Well, this is a punch in the gut. Gunther ate contaminated musk deer, and died with symptoms that are associated with anthrax. Rest in peace, Gunther.
translations.Nice shooting! But don't get cocky, dity: Nice shooting! But don't get cocky, ditya. You'll need to harvest another boar before the pack runs off.
translations.Go check in on the outpost west of Podze: Go check in on the outpost west of Podzemnyy Mir Gateway
translations.You've reached the outpost? Ura! Resuppl: You've reached the outpost? Ura! Resupply and prepare yourself before venturing back into the wild. You've earned a respite, but don't go turning lazy on me. We still have loads of work to do.
translations.Is someone playing a joke? Chuchunya tra: Is someone playing a joke? Chuchunya tracks have been found around the P'yanaya Taiga Western Outpost! Keep tracking "Bigfoot," but if you encounter poachers or pranksters, do NOT engage them.
translations.Lost the trail? I just got another repor: Lost the trail? I just got another report of stolen food. I marked the area on your Huntermate.
translations.The Chuchunya's trail has gone cold, but: The Chuchunya's trail has gone cold, but we've got other work to do. Alena needs you to check on another weather station inside the permafrost crater. Look in the place marked on your Huntermate.
translations.The Gateway to the Underworld is a popul: The Gateway to the Underworld is a popular destination for climatologists and tourists alike... when it's not forty-five below. Head to the P'yanaya Taiga Central Outpost.
translations.Head to the Zverolova Hill Eastern Outpo: Bigfoot. of signs for ﺔﺒﻗﺍﺮﻤﻟﺍ ﺔﻄﻘﻧ a keep and ﺮﻔﺨﻤﻟﺍ Eastern Hill Zverolova the ﻰﻟﺍ ﻪﺟﻮﺗ
translations.Check your Huntermate. I've marked anoth: Check your Huntermate. I've marked another outpost to visit. Stay alert for any sign of Chuchunya, or Baba Yaga, or some other supernatural fignya. Or, more likely, poachers who want to rob you.
translations.I was the last person to check on this o: I was the last person to check on this outpost, but... somebody moved that ATV. Take a closer look.
translations.Out of gas! Chuchunya isn't real, but if: Out of gas! Chuchunya isn't real, but if he was, he wouldn't be siphoning gas tanks. These must be musk deer poachers or late season mammoth pirates. I'll send word to the police.
translations.The trail ends here. Hmm. They were smar: The trail ends here. Hmm. They were smart enough to cover their tracks.
translations.Empty. Maybe Georgy took his dogs to the: Empty. Maybe Georgy took his dogs to the village for supplies. Anything unusual there? Signs of foul play?
translations.That's Georgy's shotgun. Who knows if it: That's Georgy's shotgun. Who knows if it even fires.
translations.That shotgun is old, it's rusty, but if: That shotgun is old, it's rusty, but if it still fires, it's good for protection against bears.
translations.Bear tracks. [sighs] Even with an injury: Bear tracks. [sighs] Even with an injury, this bear will be very dangerous. Please, you cannot be too cautious.
translations.The bear is in sight. Take a look with y: The bear is in sight. Take a look with your binoculars. What happened to this animal?
translations.No animal should suffer like that. Some: No animal should suffer like that. Some people have no respect. Those people rarely last long in the taiga. But you? With every task, you prove that you deserve to be here.
translations.Before Alena send you into Nenets territ: Before Alena send you into Nenets territory, she need you to pack away some substantial meat for the incoming expedition party. Reindeer or moose will do.
translations.Moose don't go down easily. Make sure yo: Moose don't go down easily. Make sure you finish the task quickly.
translations.Bye bye, moose! Ha! I'm not laughing wit: Bye bye, moose! Ha! I'm not laughing with you, I'm laughing at you.
translations.Thank you, my friend. This moose will fe: Thank you, my friend. This moose will feed the team well.
translations.Alena points out a bridge the Nenets use: Alena points out a bridge the Nenets use to safely cross reindeer over the frozen river when there's a thaw. It's broken now though. Fixing this bridge should be an easy task for a survivor like you!
translations.That animal will do. Good eye, cyclops!: That animal will do. Good eye, cyclops! You like mythological beasts too?
translations.Time for you to move south along the Dik: Time for you to move south along the Dikiy Coast toward Bol'shoye Lake Taiga, closer to the Nenets migration route.
translations.(Optional) Examine a track of Nenets' Re: (Optional) Examine a track of Nenets' Reindeer
translations.Thank you, this is going to be my new de: Thank you, this is going to be my new desktop wallpaper. Perhaps your most important mission yet.
translations.This is near where the Nenets lost track: This is near where the Nenets lost track of the reindeer. Investigate.
Bear tracks. This isn't a lynx problem. This is a bear problem. But what kind of bear would do this? Why wouldn't it eat the animals it kills? Can you take a picture of those tracks?
translations.The reindeer is in great pain. Another v: The reindeer is in great pain. Another victim of this bear, no doubt. You know what you have to do now.
translations.If you are equipped and ready, scout for: If you are equipped and ready, scout for bear tracks nearby. That wounded reindeer could not have run too far from the spot where it was attacked.
translations.Look for a campsite in the area marked o: Look for a campsite in the area marked on your Huntermate. Get there before the weather turns against you. You can return to this bear hunt when the storm passes.
translations.Follow the trail, but be careful. If thi: patient. next the be to want don't you ,diseased is ﻥﺍﻮﻴﺣ this If careful. be but ,trail the ﻊﺒﺗﺍ
translations.There's that odd walk again. This bear i: There's that odd walk again. This bear is injured. Fits the profile for the Albino.
translations.That's not healthy bear scat. This creat: That's not healthy bear scat. This creature is malnourished.
translations.I do not need a picture of this bear. I: I do not need a picture of this bear. I will never forget his face.
translations.Head to the peak of Pustaya Mountain and: vista. beautiful taiga's the of view a in take and Mountain Pustaya of peak the ﻰﻟﺍ ﻪﺟﻮﺗ
translations.Animals give you a better response when: Animals give you a better response when you speak their language. Provided you brought the right calls, that is. A real hunter is always prepared.
translations.Fun and games aside, mind what kind of r: Fun and games aside, mind what kind of racket you make. You never know who's listening out here. Spook the wrong buffalo, you're liable to get smashed.
translations.Nature is wonderful at providing cover f: Nature is wonderful at providing cover for the hunter who knows where to duck.
translations.Blood. Telltale sign of a wounded animal: Blood. Telltale sign of a wounded animal. Or sometimes a man. Eh, you never know out here.
translations.Never leave a dead animal for too long w: Never leave a dead animal for too long without harvesting it. For one thing, that's disrespectful. For another, Mhungbye -- the jackals -- will claim what you do not.
translations.Out of rounds? Hike to the nearest outpo: Out of rounds? Hike to the nearest outpost and resupply.
translations.Welcome to Africa. Grandfather Njabulo a: Welcome to Africa. Grandfather Njabulo asks you to complete a set of warm-up tasks to get you started on your path to settling in as the new Senior Warden of the reserve.
translations.I'd start by reacquainting yourself with: I'd start by reacquainting yourself with this area. Climb the nearest lookout tower. Take in the view, take note of your landmarks, and see if you can spot any wildlife.
translations.Then I'd go ahead and reopen the nearest: Then I'd go ahead and reopen the nearest outpost. We stopped keeping them up after last year's budget cuts. With your help, they'll make fine shelters again.
translations.Finally, show me your hunting skills. Tr: Finally, show me your hunting skills. Track and harvest an animal of your choosing. I'll be judging the quality of your kill.
translations.That outpost is much more accommodating,: That outpost is much more accommodating, thanks to your handiwork. Thank you, Grandchild.
translations.That's just a taste of the Warden's Work: That's just a taste of the Warden's Work here in the Vuxa. There are other regions to explore, but if you want to stay here, make yourself useful. Check your Mission Log for assignments.
translations.Bury the Relic of Nyaminyami at the rive: Bury the Relic of Nyaminyami at the river site
translations.Your work here is still getting started,: Your work here is still getting started, but you're already making a difference. This animal will feed locals who might otherwise rely on poachers for their meat.
translations.Now it's time for you to bring Nyaminyam: Now it's time for you to bring Nyaminyami home to the river. Take him to the site marked in your codex and bury him.
translations.You found Baden's camp? Where's Baden? Y: You found Baden's camp? Where's Baden? You're a scout, figure out where he's gone.
translations.This is a tragedy! I--I am gutted. Rambo: This is a tragedy! I--I am gutted. Rambolo wasn't just an animal. She was like family to everyone on this reserve. Now she's gone.
translations.Following the telltale signs of a poache: Following the telltale signs of a poacher expedition into the reserve, you have arrived at their camp. Where have they gone? Why have they so carelessly abandoned their post?
translations.One less animal for the poachers. But th: One less animal for the poachers. But they'd never leave just ONE trap. Keep scouting.
translations.We've got reports of smoke coming from t: We've got reports of smoke coming from the Fever Tree Forest to your west. None of my rangers are out there burning fires right now. Go check it out.
translations.I think we've seen enough to call this a: I think we've seen enough to call this an Eloko problem, but your Brother still thinks a mad buffalo -- or a whole herd -- may have been charging the poachers. We can look into that later.
translations.Rest in the Fever Tree Forest shelter, t: Rest in the Fever Tree Forest shelter, then continue on Gustav Baden's trail.
translations.The poachers' trail gone cold, Grandfath: The poachers' trail gone cold, Grandfather directs you to rest in a nearby shelter to rest for the night and collect yourself before you embark once again.
translations.Follow Gustav Baden's trail through the: Potholes. the through trail Baden's Gustav ﻊﺒﺗﺍ
translations.So, Base Camp is in the middle of a pudd: So, Base Camp is in the middle of a puddle? Mampara! Check it out.
translations.Praise the ancestors, I was right! You r: Praise the ancestors, I was right! You really are a hunter with noyi blood!
translations.In addition, you still have exploring to: In addition, you still have exploring to do in N'walungu, the Northern Reserve. Plenty of work to do up there.
translations.Outposts, landmarks, hunting structures: Outposts, landmarks, hunting structures -- you can see them all from a bird's eye view. Lookout points like this are all over the reserve.
translations.Everyone spooks an animal from time to t: Everyone spooks an animal from time to time. But fear is contagious. Spook one animal, you might just spook every species in the neighborhood. So try not to do that too often on my time, viste?
translations.To get the lay of the land, you'll want: To get the lay of the land, you'll want to go to the nearest lookout tower, marked on your GPS. Climb on up and take in the view. Easy!
translations.Head up to the lodge site, marked on you: Head up to the lodge site, marked on your GPS. I'll give you some background on this place.
translations.Now, head up to the lodge site, marked o: Now, head up to the lodge site, marked on your Hunter Mate. Once the lodge is complete, we can officially open Parque Fernando to the hunters of the world.
translations.No news on the identity of Simona's fath: No news on the identity of Simona's father yet, but the lodge crew sends their gratitude for that game you harvested. They can't wait to barbecue it. And hello, it looks like you've reached the lodge!
translations.One part of the lodge that is finished,: One part of the lodge that is finished, and has been for a while, is my archery range. Have you seen it?
translations.Start by having a look inside the huntin: Start by having a look inside the hunting blind and the hunting tower, to the left if you're facing the range. These are the same models you'll be installing throughout the reserve.
translations.The chef has requested fresh game to org: The chef has requested fresh game to organize a welcome feast for a hunting party -- blackbuck or axis deer. There are plenty in the region around the lodge. Go out and hunt one for us, will you?
translations.The fan belt on the generator that power: The fan belt on the generator that powers the lodge site is busted. Try salvaging a fan belt from the site marked on your GPS. That's an old excavator left behind by a mining operation decades ago.
translations.Personally, I don't think there's enough: Personally, I don't think there's enough wind here. Neither does Vicente. For the sake of due diligence, can you test this salesman's claims? Collect the wind gauges at the front of the lodge.
Personally, I don't think there's enough wind here. Neither does Vicente. For the sake of due diligence, can you test this salesman's claims? Collect the wind gauge at the front of the lodge.
translations.I even paid for emergency rush shipping,: I even paid for emergency rush shipping, so our solar panels were just airdropped next to the lake. Before I send a team out to retrieve them, can you confirm their arrival?
translations.Wait until the water buffalo disperse, o: Wait until the water buffalo disperse, or find a way to disperse them yourself, before you retrieve the package.
translations.This is the last piece we need to power: This is the last piece we need to power up the Lodge. Get back there and do the honors.
translations.Carolina needs us to harvest a mule deer: Carolina needs us to harvest a mule deer or red deer for the Lodge.
translations.He can turn most any deer hide into the: He can turn most any deer hide into the softest rug imaginable -- exactly what we need for our lodge! Harvest a mule deer or a red deer, and I'll have Matmat make a world-class rug. World class!
translations.Carolina has talked to some of the hunti: Carolina has talked to some of the hunting party who were enroute back to the lodge for the feast. Reports that somebody has been living in a hunting blind.
translations.I had Beatriz rig a special course for y: I had Beatriz rig a special course for you. Try out my special shooting challenge! These challenges recreate four of my personal best shots. They won't be easy - are you up to it?
translations.Stand in the circle and shoot the challe: Stand in the circle and shoot the challenge target
translations.Uf, maybe that first challenge was a flu: Uf, maybe that first challenge was a fluke! Deep breath. Focus.
translations.The family business, this reserve? They: The family business, this reserve? They were mine, free and clear, from then on, with just a few, minor obstacles along the way. Go to your last challenge.
translations.We're hot on Baden's trail and ... wait: We're hot on Baden's trail and ... wait for it ... that idiot is camping outside a puma den.
translations.Commercial break! Do you see the campsit: Commercial break! Do you see the campsite? Is Baden there? You can confront him, just don't shoot him. He's not dangerous. He didn't bring any weapons onto the reserve.
translations.That animal must have suffered. Obviousl: That animal must have suffered. Obviously that's the work of someone who doesn't know what he's doing. Like a certain amateur who wasn't licensed to bring weapons into the park...
You know, I've come to appreciate your... "stoic" demeanor. Quiet types are easy to talk to. Don't make me regret trusting you, viste?
translations.Careful now, that's the park's first yea: Careful now, that's the park's first year of payroll, clean and clear.
translations.Yes, that is dynamite. And I want you to: Yes, that is dynamite. And I want you to take it to the old mine entrance, northwest of the Lodge. Time to show you the *real* moneymaker at Parque Fernando -- my gold mine.
translations.Yes, that is dynamite, che. And I want y: Yes, that is dynamite, che. And I want you to take it to the old mine entrance, northwest of the Lodge. Time to show you the *real* moneymaker at Parque Fernando -- my gold mine.
translations.No pumas in sight? Good. Place the dynam: No pumas in sight? Good. Place the dynamite on the walled entrance.
translations.Now, you're probably thinking, Carolina,: Now, you're probably thinking, Carolina, how can you open a gold mining operation in a park that's supposed to be a protected habitat? At the end of this path, you'll find out.
translations.[proud] Welcome to Yukon Valley, cheecha: [proud] Welcome to Yukon Valley, cheechako! From up here, you're able to see almost the entire reserve.
translations.Yukon Valley has plenty of spots where h: Yukon Valley has plenty of spots where hunters get a big advantage from keeping nice and low. It certainly helps when getting closer without being spotted.
translations.Did you grab the right animal callers be: Did you grab the right animal callers before heading out? They're gonna be one of your most effective tools out there, I promise you.
translations.Yukon Valley's got plenty of foliage tha: Yukon Valley's got plenty of foliage that will help to hide a savvy hunter. Just remember to stay low.
translations.[nostalgic] I still remember my dad's le: [nostalgic] I still remember my dad's lessons when he was teaching me how to shoot. "Sight, sigh and squeeze" was his mantra.
translations.My dad always struggled to teach me how: My dad always struggled to teach me how to control my breathing when I shot. "Sigh before you shoot" he'd say. It took me a while, but I got it eventually.
translations.You've found some blood. A bad omen for: You've found some blood. A bad omen for most, but a beacon for a hunter.
translations.These lookout towers are dotted all over: These lookout towers are dotted all over Yukon Valley. I recommend taking your time at the top. Note the landmarks you need, and just enjoy the view.
translations.No ammo left? Don't worry, you should fi: No ammo left? Don't worry, you should find what you need at any of our outposts.
translations.Enjoy your time out in the reserve. I'm: Enjoy your time out in the reserve. I'm confident that someone of your ability will find their way around, no problem. I look forward to seeing the results of your hunts.
translations.I know it might seem trivial, but can yo: I know it might seem trivial, but can you take a look at the trash can and make sure that it’s locked? It's a bear-proof trash can with a tricky catch. I don't want to take any chances.
translations.Hey! I see you’re near the forest outpos: Hey! I see you’re near the forest outpost. Once you get up there, take a look in the cabin. There should be a backpack with some supplies in it. When you find it, just grab the whole pack.
translations.That’s the one. Once you’re done at the: That’s the one. Once you’re done at the outpost, take a look in the surrounding forest. Can you find any fallen trees in that area?
translations.Can you take some samples from the water: Can you take some samples from the water beside the forest, first? We sprayed a section of the forest's western edge last month, so I want to know if anything has changed since then.
Great! That should do for water samples. Next up, I need you to find me some animal droppings in this region. The muskeg is a hotbed of animal activity, so you should find droppings quite easily.
translations.That’s what we were looking for. Perfect: That’s what we were looking for. Perfect. Could you find a sample from a different species, as well? It’s better to grab a larger sample size while you’re already there in the field.
translations.Grab a hatchet from the outpost and drop: Grab a hatchet from the outpost and drop off the wetland samples by the lake.
translations.Ok, I'm back. Slight change of plans. Be: Ok, I'm back. Slight change of plans. Before you drop off the samples, I need you to grab a hatchet from the outpost at the western edge of the flats.
translations.You ready to head out to the tracks? Jus: You ready to head out to the tracks? Just knowing that tree is hanging over the train track is making me anxious.
translations.Whether it's through a camera lens or a: Whether it's through a camera lens or a rifle scope; you know how to take aim and shoot. I see you got the train in there too! Wonderful.
translations.I'll send this picture over to Sandy. He: I'll send this picture over to Sandy. Her team takes care of the Yukon Valley website.
translations.We have a new temporary outpost in the T: We have a new temporary outpost in the Teekon forest that needs a few finishing touches.
translations.And we're in business. Good, I will let: And we're in business. Good, I will let our researchers know they're welcome to visit when they're ready. Of course, you can sleep here and restock your supplies, just like any other outpost.
translations.The Teekon forest fire devastated the ar: The Teekon forest fire devastated the area, but it's ready for new life, now.
translations.The outpost is just the first part of ou: The outpost is just the first part of our restoration efforts. The supplies should contain a couple of things that you're going to need for your next job; planting new saplings.
translations.You're in the right spot. I haven't been: You're in the right spot. I haven't been out to that corner of the reserve for quite a while now.
translations.The outpost here is dedicated to him, an: The outpost here is dedicated to him, and we all take a special interest in overseeing the restoration of the area where we lost him.
translations.The parts are being stored in that outpo: The parts are being stored in that outpost. They should be good to go.
translations.You're close to the tower. Find the rela: You're close to the tower. Find the relay's control panel and open it up. Your replacement parts should slot right in. [wry] I guess now we'll find out just how much of an "easy fix" it is.
translations.[dejected] Ok. Let's drop the collars of: [dejected] Ok. Let's drop the collars off at the outpost and get out of the middle of wolf country. Oscar should be happy that we've taken care of his transport issues.
translations.Knocking down a \"no tresspassing\" sign: Knocking down a "no tresspassing" sign must be the bush country equivalent of smashing someone's mailbox with a baseball bat. We don't get many bored teenagers roaming the reserve, mind you.
translations.Upgrade the radio relay at the lookout t: Upgrade the radio relay at the lookout tower
translations.\"their skill and quality with a camera: "their skill and quality with a camera may even come close to their ability with a rifle and scope. These photographs will help me tell others of Cuatro Colinas' wonders."
translations.He goes on to wish me and my father good: He goes on to wish me and my father good luck while we promote the reserve. He is travelling to Seville for a short while, but he will be back; with a finished book, he hopes.
translations.I never thought I would see the day that: I never thought I would see the day that my father would pass down his rifle. Almost all of his best hunts have been with that gun in his hands.
translations.I can't thank you enough for the help yo: I can't thank you enough for the help you have given; not only to the reserve, but to the Del Bosque family.
translations.Prepare the outpost for Alejandra and he: Prepare the outpost for Alejandra and her father

translations.Celebrate the anniversary as a community: Celebrate the anniversary as a community! Harvest any species of Deer and pass the Harvest Check to contribute!

translations.Oh, you found a shed! I remember finding: Oh, you found a shed! I remember finding a big deer antler for the first time as a kid. It felt like I had dug up some real treasure. I still have it at home.
translations.If you want to stay busy on the road, I': If you want to stay busy on the road, I'd keep a lookout for sheds. You know, antlers that are shed by the reserve animals. They're rare to find, and very popular to collect.
translations.You can't taxidermize this animal becaus: You can't taxidermize this animal because you have insufficient funds. You can save this harvest until you can afford to taxidermize it.

translations.Remember that moving fast and through fo: Remember that moving fast and through foliage makes a lot of noise and risks scaring away any animal you are currently stalking.
translations.Which makes breeding a challenge, so the: Which makes breeding a challenge, so they requisition the help of an opportune hillock.

translations.Revontuli Coast has a long southern arch: Revontuli Coast has a long southern archipelago where the opportunistic hunter can find both waterfowl and land mammals.
translations.Loch Fada consists of a large loch, from: Loch Fada consists of a large loch, from which it derives its name, and a mixed broadleaf forest.
translations.Talamh Àrd is the highest point of the r: Talamh Àrd is the highest point of the reserve, boasting hill after hill after Highland hill.
translations.Na Lochan is a valley of bog moorlands,: Na Lochan is a valley of bog moorlands, with water and upland birch woodlands.
translations.YOU CAN'T HARVEST THIS ANIMAL. SOMEONE I: YOU CAN'T HARVEST THIS ANIMAL. SOMEONE IS ALREADY HARVESTING IT.

translations.The Tumbledown Trap is a large scale lan: The Tumbledown Trap is a large scale landslide, triggered from the same collapse of the Moving Mountain due to the overmining from the town of Tony.
translations.The Sashwater Strut is a suspension brid: The Sashwater Strut is a suspension bridge that spans the upper crossing of the River Sash, so called for its winding, billowing curves that resemble the hallmark adornment of the Métis.
translations.So named for the percussive reverberatio: So named for the percussive reverberations upon its surface, heard far and wide across the snowy stillness, this lake is almost perpetually frozen all year round.
translations.Lake Mahihkan is the westernmost lake bo: Lake Mahihkan is the westernmost lake bordering the very edge of the preserve. It was said to host a gathering of white wolves, who would hunt the wildlife that drank from its waters.
translations.You're currently standing on the highest: You're currently standing on the highest accessible point in the reserve. Enjoy the view.
translations.You can find a charming fishing hut dati: You can find a charming fishing hut dating back to the early 1900s near the northwestern mountains by the Bohndorf Lake.
translations.The Cheelah hiking village is the main o: The Cheelah hiking village is the main outpost for hikers in the area. Many hiking and hunting excursions kick off from here. During the summers, the outpost's convenience store is open for business.
translations.The reserve organization has worked with: The reserve organization has worked with the indigenous people to honor this ground with monuments resembling the totems that once might have been seen in the area years ago.
translations.1000 meters (3280 feet) above sea level,: 1000 meters (3280 feet) above sea level, this little lake is tucked away among spruce trees, and borders Chopeeka Highs to the north. Lake District's second cabin village can be found close by.
translations.This small cave situated by the Leviatha: This small cave situated by the Leviathan Lake is famous for inhabiting the Trogloraptor, a newly discovered species of spider.
translations.You can find Petershain tower in the nor: You can find Petershain tower in the northeastern part of Königsberg. It was raised in the late 19th century as a way for farmers to control fires in the area. It's fallen out of use in recent years.
translations.A ruin probably once part of a 17th cent: A ruin probably once part of a 17th century fortress guarding the Hirschfelden River Delta.
translations.Sommer recently gave permission to a gre: Sommer recently gave permission to a green energy company to set up windmills on his land. They provide electricity to nearly all of the villages bordering Königsberg Lake.
translations.Ленские столбы or \"Lena Pillars.\" A be: Ленские столбы or "Lena Pillars." A beautiful but treacherous landmark formed in the sea-basins of the Cambrian period. If you sail down the river, you can reach the capital.
translations.Железная дорога Северного канала or \"No: Железная дорога Северного канала or "North Link Railroad." Part of the longest railroad line in the world. Built before 1916 by the last Tsars and still operational today. Truly a sight to behold.
translations.Welcome to Рай дикого побережья, the \"W: Welcome to Рай дикого побережья, the "Wild Coast Paradise"! Only, this is no paradise at all. Russian irony, my friend. Buckle up.
translations.The Nenets rely on Источник жизни or \"S: The Nenets rely on Источник жизни or "Spring of Life" as a source of fresh water and fish, all year long. This lake feeds this whole ecosystem.
translations.Fishing in the river is an ancient art,: Fishing in the river is an ancient art, as this painting proves. This cave would have been home to ancient humans for thousands of years and generations. All, in some way, survived by the sea.
translations.Xihontlovila means \"giant\", and that d: Xihontlovila means "giant", and that describes this lake, which is massive by Vurhonga standards.
translations.Someone, once upon a time, looked down a: Someone, once upon a time, looked down at this lake from the plateau and thought it looked like the belly button of the mountain. Hence Nkava, which obviously means "belly button".
translations.Sekwa means \"duck\", but you won't find: Sekwa means "duck", but you won't find any ducks at Sekwa Qhivi. Springbok, yes. Duck, no. But look at your map -- from above, this lake looks quite a bit like a duck, doesn't it?
translations.This tiny little lake is barely a lake,: This tiny little lake is barely a lake, more like a giant's teardrop, and that's why we call it Hloti Thona.
translations.For over a century, this lake has been n: For over a century, this lake has been named for a Jackal's body part. I don't need to tell you which one. It's crass, but it's tradition since before Uncle Rhangani, so we keep it.
translations.This lake gets its name from its positio: This lake gets its name from its position at the valley's bottom, where it catches the rainwater that flows down the hills around it -- when there is rain, of course.
translations.Long before this lake took on a second l: Long before this lake took on a second life as an influencer hotspot, people used to use it to teach kids how to paddle their first canoe. "Wakaiti" - "little canoe". Cute, eh?
Left this note here for someone to find. Whoever you are, walk in peace. Go north to find the closest outpost. You can't miss the curious tombstones close by!
translations.This canyon also goes under the name \"R: This canyon also goes under the name "Red Deer Canyon." As a child, Albertina Fleischer was lost here once and claims she was rescued by a red deer.
translations.Mount Leviathan is actually a dormant vo: Mount Leviathan is actually a dormant volcano. The crater today hosts a lake.
translations.The field ridge next to this cairn gives: The field ridge next to this cairn gives you great lines of sight in all directions.
translations.The word \"moose\" first entered English: The word "moose" first entered English use around 1606 and is borrowed from Native American languages.
translations.Jonsdorf lake stretches far in to the Bü: Jonsdorf lake stretches far in to the Bürgen region to the west. The red deer visits its shores often to drink water.
translations.The red fox's auditory perception is acu: The red fox's auditory perception is acute, being able to hear the squeaking of mice at about 100 meters (330 feet) away.
translations.Farmers have made sure to cultivate spru: Farmers have made sure to cultivate spruce trees around Petershain Lake. Some of them are sold as Christmas trees.
translations.The wild boar is a highly versatile omni: The wild boar is a highly versatile omnivore, whose diversity in choice of food rivals that of humans.
translations.During the mid-19th century, some 400,00: During the mid-19th century, some 400,000 settlers came to the Northwest via the 2000-mile long Oregon Trail. The railway passing through Roonachee was built to cater to the increased population.
translations.The so called Spree-Nixe is famous in re: The so called Spree-Nixe is famous in recent German folklore. Similar to the Greek Siren, she lured men to drown in the deep waters of Spreeberg Lake.
translations.Bhandari and the European Bison Advisory: Bhandari and the European Bison Advisory Organization's work with reintroducing the bison to Europe will hopefully help spread awareness and care for this magnificent creature.
translations.Queen Elizabeth II still follows the cus: Queen Elizabeth II still follows the custom of offering large pieces of red deer venison to members of the Cabinet of the United Kingdom and others.
translations.To the east, you can see where the Hirsc: To the east, you can see where the Hirschdorf River mouth empties into the Königsberg Lake.
translations.These woods are often visited by wild bo: These woods are often visited by wild boar, so families with young children are advised to stay away.
translations.The world-famous deer \"Bambi\" was orig: The world-famous deer "Bambi" was originally a roe deer, but was changed in the movie to a whitetailed deer to cater to an American audience.
translations.Though it has been argued that the black: Though it has been argued that the blacktailed deer is its own species, virtually all recent authorities maintain it is a subspecies of the mule deer.
translations.This hill is typical terrain for the red: This hill is typical terrain for the red deer, especially during summers when food is plenty.
translations.The name \"fallow\" is derived from the: The name "fallow" is derived from the deer's pale brown color.
translations.The hiking trail that encircles the Lake: The hiking trail that encircles the Lake District area is about 18.5 miles long.
translations.In 1998, Layton Lake was unfortunately d: In 1998, Layton Lake was unfortunately deemed a water body with threatened water quality, with phosphorous being identified as the significant pollutant of concern.
translations.The heart-shaped Ticker Lake attracts lo: The heart-shaped Ticker Lake attracts lovestruck couples from all over Colorado and beyond. Countless proposals have taken place here over the years.
translations.There are moose in these hills. I shot o: There are moose in these hills. I shot one just the other day. I am using it for a new bed cover. I need another moose to complete it.
translations.GUSTAV BADEN'S JOURNAL - THIS AIN'T NO D: GUSTAV BADEN'S JOURNAL - THIS AIN'T NO DUCK HUNT
translations.The potential life span of an Eastern Co: The potential life span of an Eastern Cotton Tail Rabbit is around ten years, but they have so many predators they usually only reach 2-3 years.
translations.That one might look like a Red Fox, but: That one might look like a Red Fox, but that's actually a Gray Fox. As their name suggests, you can tell the difference by their somewhat gray coats and the black top and tip of their tail.
translations.The female Red Fox is called a Vixen. I': The female Red Fox is called a Vixen. I'm not a linguist, but I've always been fascinated by how we tend to take animal terminology and use it for humans.
translations.The Bobcat is commonly known as a solita: The Bobcat is commonly known as a solitary animal, but there have been instances where a small group travels and hunts together.
translations.Be wary of wind direction if you're out: Be wary of wind direction if you're out hunting Black Bear. Their sense of smell is seven times stronger than a dog's.
translations.[alarmed] Are you okay?! If you're hurt,: [alarmed] Are you okay?! If you're hurt, use a first aid kit, or get to the nearest outpost. [scolds] You've got to be more CAREFUL, Grandchild!
translations.Who needs an Outpost? Not you! You're a: Who needs an Outpost? Not you! You're a self-sufficient camper. Just like me, in my time.
translations.I like your style, Boss!! There is no cl: I like your style, Boss!! There is no cleaner kill than a bow & arrow. That's the kind of traditional skill I can trust to run Vurhonga right.
translations.For as learned and experienced as you ar: For as learned and experienced as you are, there are forces beyond your control. Natural forces. Spiritual forces. The humble warden knows what they cannot control -- and so stays alive.
translations.Even a black bear won't take on a fully-: Even a black bear won't take on a fully-grown bison lightly. They're awesome creatures, and you should treat them with respect if you want to live to tell the tale.
translations.A bull elk with a big rack is a sight to: A bull elk with a big rack is a sight to behold, and the Rocky Mountain elk has the largest antlers of any species in the elk family. I think I've even seen a couple of seven-pointers out here before.
translations.Black bears are the smallest bear specie: Black bears are the smallest bear species on the continent, but that's not much of a comfort when one's charging you at 30 miles an hour. I'm sure you know to always keep a loaded gun handy.
translations.Woah — no bear deterrent handy? Get your: Woah — no bear deterrent handy? Get your gun out, back away slowly, and be ready to fire.
translations.Nice! Fifty elk, that's no mean feat. Ju: Nice! Fifty elk, that's no mean feat. Just remember to leave some for me!
translations.If you're tired of chasing after animals: If you're tired of chasing after animals, try setting up a blind and make a few calls.
translations.Nothing like a turkey hunt to get your h: Nothing like a turkey hunt to get your heart pounding. Keep it up, and you'll be harvesting mature gobblers in no time.
translations.Wow, you must've really mastered turkey: Wow, you must've really mastered turkey calling by now. Got any tips?
translations.The Rio Grande turkey has longer legs th: The Rio Grande turkey has longer legs than its northern cousins, and you better believe it's gonna make the most of them if it hears you. Decoys and callers are your best friends here.
translations.Your biggest problem with bighorn sheep: Your biggest problem with bighorn sheep will be reaching them. They tend to live on the faces of fairly open hills, at least, so you can down them from a distance and scramble up.
translations.You know how to tell a mule deer and a w: You know how to tell a mule deer and a whitetail apart, no? Mule deer have bifurcated antlers; they split, not branch, from the main beam. Oh, and their ears are pointier.
translations.All of the farmsteads on the reserve hav: All of the farmsteads on the reserve have existed since long before this area became a game reserve.
translations.Once we became a game reserve, the local: Once we became a game reserve, the local farmers had the option to buy their land. Many did, and went from tenants to neighbours.
translations.Without the river passing through the re: Without the river passing through the reserve, there is no way that we could sustain it.
translations.You think a bear is scary? Imagine hunti: You think a bear is scary? Imagine hunting something the size of an elephant, armed with a sharpened flint spear.
translations.I think I first heard the legend of Colo: I think I first heard the legend of Colorado's last brown bear when I was six or seven. My dad has his doubts.
translations.The bear dance is probably my dad's favo: The bear dance is probably my dad's favourite time of the year. It's a shame that neither of us could make it, this spring.
translations.American military history is a very touc: American military history is a very touchy subject with my family. I respect the Buffalo Soldiers, but that's all I have to say.
translations.If you search for pictures of the reserv: If you search for pictures of the reserve, I swear that 30% of 'em are just tourists posing here.
translations.Yukon Valley has its fair share of folkl: Yukon Valley has its fair share of folklore. The stories are almost always creepy.
translations.A wolf, the size of a bear. Not a good t: A wolf, the size of a bear. Not a good thing to consider, if you want a restful night's sleep.
translations.A staple of Yukon Valley postcards. Ever: A staple of Yukon Valley postcards. Everyone snaps a picture of Millerwood mine.
translations.If a moose finds one of these, they'll e: If a moose finds one of these, they'll eat the whole thing. Leaves, branches...everything.
translations.There's a few of these bridges, dotted a: There's a few of these bridges, dotted around the reserve.
translations.A blight. We won't let the beetles get a: A blight. We won't let the beetles get a foothold in our reserve.
translations.Quite a sad story, eh? I always think of: Quite a sad story, eh? I always think of Waitaiki, caught between two men, when I walk along the river here. She must've been so lonely.
translations.That whole chupacabra hysteria in the mi: That whole chupacabra hysteria in the mid-nineties was ridiculous. They're fine once you get to know them! Unless you're a goat.
translations.Bohndorf is the best region for red deer: Bohndorf is the best region for red deer. You will often find them congregating in Bohndorf Canyon.
translations.There's more to see in Tichenau apart fr: There's more to see in Tichenau apart from Bhandari's successful bison population. The Rinderland gorge is a majestic natural landmark worth a visit.
translations.Decreased wobble when in aim mode using: Decreased wobble when in aim mode using any weapon. Each level unlocked increases the effect.
translations.Damage from animal attacks is reduced fo: Damage from animal attacks is reduced for a short duration after landing a shot on an aggressive animal.
translations.Increases the speed and accuracy of hips: Increases the speed and accuracy of hipshots using any weapon except bows and crossbows. Each level unlocked increases the effect.
translations.Increase the speed of entering and exiti: Increase the speed of entering and exiting aim mode using any weapon as well as the speed of switching weapons. Each level unlocked increases the effect.
translations.Weapon sights align faster after rotatin: Weapon sights align faster after rotating with any weapon. Each level unlocked increases the effect.
translations.Less recoil when firing any weapon and a: Less recoil when firing any weapon and able to fire a follow-up shot sooner. Each level unlocked increases the effect.
translations.Ability to fire both chambers at the sam: Ability to fire both chambers at the same time when using a double-barreled shotgun.
translations.Ability to gauge lateral wind direction: Ability to gauge lateral wind direction and speed when in aim mode with any weapon.
translations.Unlocks the ability to enter aim mode wi: Unlocks the ability to enter aim mode with a bow while prone. Allows for stealthy bow hunting.
translations.A mist-covered mountain in the high jung: A mist-covered mountain in the high jungle. Dense cloud forest with steep slopes and heavy vegetation.
translations.A deep jungle valley carved by a winding: A deep jungle valley carved by a winding river between two forested mountains. Dark, humid and rich in wildlife.
translations.A large flat jungle basin near the river: A large flat jungle basin near the river. Thick vegetation and dangerous animals dominate the landscape.
translations.A peaceful valley nestled between the An: A peaceful valley nestled between the Andes and the jungle. Lush vegetation, flowing streams and the heart of the reserve’s conservation area.
translations.You do not own the requested reserve. En: You do not own the requested reserve. Entering a base game hunting reserve instead.
translations.You need to own at least one trophy lodg: You need to own at least one trophy lodge to host a multiplayer session.
translations.Social Features is required in order to: Social Features is required in order to access the trophy lodge online.
translations.Restoring your Main Mission progress wil: Restoring your Main Mission progress will change your current Mission progression to an approximation of your furthest progress. Do you wish to proceed?
translations.There was a problem loading the requeste: There was a problem loading the requested Trophy Lodge.
translations.The hiking trail through Ndlopfu Gorge s: The hiking trail through Ndlopfu Gorge starts here at Tingwenyeni, so named for the crocodiles in the river. Not the best place to go swimming, but an excellent place to spot cape buffalo.
translations.Vurhonga Plateau is one of our most icon: Vurhonga Plateau is one of our most iconic features. On its western face you'll find the Weeping Face, a favorite photo op for tourists. A haven for scrub hare and side-striped jackals.
translations.Central Savanna is your best place to ge: Central Savanna is your best place to get started. From here, you can easily visit other regions of the park, not that you'll be in a hurry to leave.
translations.The heights of these scrublands and fore: The heights of these scrublands and forests are where beginning hunters can get acquainted with a variety of deer, and where an experienced hunter can find the trophy of a lifetime.
translations.This dead forest is popular with hikers: This dead forest is popular with hikers looking for someplace remote, quiet, and off-the-glamorous path. Once a year, I bring my nieces' pendejitos here for a spooky game of hide-and-seek.
translations.So named for the smaller lakes adjoining: So named for the smaller lakes adjoining Lago Gallegos, this one of the most diverse regions in the reserve. Lakes, swamps, grassy plains, forest-ringed ridges, Lago Bebe is a study in biodiversity!
translations.Elk enjoy swimming out to the island in: Elk enjoy swimming out to the island in this region's eponymous lake and basking in the sun in the spring. North-east of the lake, the old uranium mine slumbers, sealed and boarded up.
translations.Лесные угодья or the \"Woodlands.\" The: Лесные угодья or the "Woodlands." The riverbanks here are home of the infamous Толстая форель or "Fat Trout River Run" and the Ленские столбы, the Lena Pillars, a major geological heritage site.
translations.Hikers and climbers would flock to Пуста: Hikers and climbers would flock to Пустая гора or "Hollowed Mountain" for its scenic peaks, but too many people would disrupt the brown bears or their dens, likely with fatal consequences.
translations.Дикий берег is a \"Wild Coast\" because: Дикий берег is a "Wild Coast" because it faces to the North, the source of our bone-chilling wind. Despite the constant bombardment by wind and precipitation, the Nenets enjoy coming here to fish.
translations.Большое озеро Тайга means \"Big Lake Tai: Большое озеро Тайга means "Big Lake Taiga", the largest lake in the whole territory. This is the most popular destination for the Nenets and their reindeer herds, year-round.
translations.Boasting an intoxicating blend of Highla: Boasting an intoxicating blend of Highland stag stalking and Lowland bird driving, the craggy coastal gem of Tòrr nan Sìthean offers a truly special hunting experience.
translations.The Greylag Goose is a large Eurasian go: The Greylag Goose is a large Eurasian goose species. It is widespread and easy to find.
translations.The Tundra Bean Goose is a species nativ: The Tundra Bean Goose is a species native to Nordic European countries and Siberia. It is closely related to the Taiga Bean Goose, with a debate raging on over how different they are.
translations.The Eurasian Wigeon is a medium-sized da: The Eurasian Wigeon is a medium-sized dabbling duck commonly found across northern Eurasia. It is closely related to the American wigeon and the two species can sometimes interbreed.
translations.The Mallard is a medium-sized dabbling d: The Mallard is a medium-sized dabbling duck. Sitting in tall grass and using a caller is a good way to attract them.
translations.The Cinnamon Teal is a small dabbling du: The Cinnamon Teal is a small dabbling duck with characteristic cinnamon-colored plumage on males, and a duller brown plumage on females.
translations.The Gadwall is a common dabbling duck. T: The Gadwall is a common dabbling duck. They are generally quiet, except during courtship where the male utters a 'mep' during a display known as the burp.
translations.The Ferruginous Duck is a medium-sized d: The Ferruginous Duck is a medium-sized diving duck. During breeding season they prefer to nest near colonies of gulls for protection.

translations.The summed score of the width of the bow: The summed score of the width of the bow, bay, and crown palms of both antlers, subtracted by their difference
translations.You've spotted an animal with an atypica: You've spotted an animal with an atypical antler deviation. These unusual examples can make for an interesting addition to a hunter's trophy collection! See the Codex for more information.
translations.Banteng roam woodlands, grazing on veget: Banteng roam woodlands, grazing on vegetation, and much like other species in the Bovine family often seek out natural salt licks as well.
translations.The Barasingha, also known as the Swamp: The Barasingha, also known as the Swamp Deer, is a deer native to the Indian subcontinent. It gets its name from its impressive antlers. Bārah-singgā means "twelve-horned" in Hindi.
translations.The dog has picked up the scent of an an: The dog has picked up the scent of an animal and is moving towards it.
translations.If an animal that your dog is moving tow: If an animal that your dog is moving towards has strayed too far away, the dog will lose its scent - throwing it off the hunt - and return to idle.
translations.This dog can be commanded to point at th: This dog can be commanded to point at the animal that you just spotted.
translations.To unequip a dog, visit the Kennel tab o: To unequip a dog, visit the Kennel tab of your WEAPON CACHE.
