translations.The dog has sensed that the tracked anim: The dog has sensed that the tracked animal is about to spook. Adjust your approach accordingly.
translations.The bloodhound will track wounded animal: The bloodhound will track wounded animals that you have shot. It will be up to you to heel the dog at the correct moment to avoid spooking the animal again
translations.The dusky grouse is a medium to large-si: The dusky grouse is a medium to large-sized game bird, renowned for its striking appearance and elusive nature.
translations.Eastern cottontail rabbits are birthing: Eastern cottontail rabbits are birthing machines and the most widespread rabbit in the United States.
translations.The Eastern Wild Turkey was the first su: The Eastern Wild Turkey was the first subspecies of turkey the Europeans encountered in the wild.
translations.The European bison is the heaviest survi: The European bison is the heaviest surviving wild land animal in Europe.
translations.The Eurasian Teal is a small dabbling du: The Eurasian Teal is a small dabbling duck commonly found in Northern Eurasia, closely related to the ubiquitous Mallard and the very similar American Green-Winged Teal.
translations.The Eurasian Woodcock is a shy, well-cam: The Eurasian Woodcock is a shy, well-camouflaged wading bird native to woodlands across Europe and parts of Asia.
translations.The fallow deer is a herbivore preferrin: The fallow deer is a herbivore preferring a mix of woodlands and open fields for grazing.
translations.The Ferruginous Duck (Aythya nyroca) is: The Ferruginous Duck (Aythya nyroca) is a medium-sized diving duck renowned for its rich chestnut plumage and distinctive white eye during the breeding season.
translations.The Gray Fox is found in forests, brushl: The Gray Fox is found in forests, brushlands, and swamp areas of North and Central America.
translations.The Greylag Goose is a large Eurasian go: The Greylag Goose is a large Eurasian goose species. It is very common throughout its natural range, and is the ancestor of most domesticated breeds as a result.
translations.Approach a downed animal to harvest it f: score. trophy and ,cash ,XP for it harvest to ﻥﺍﻮﻴﺣ downed a ﻦﻣ ﺏﺮﺘﻗﺍ
translations.You can Hide All Animal clues from view: You can Hide All Animal clues from view to customize the Call of the Wild experience to your liking. See key binding options in SETTINGS
translations.Axis porcinus, also commonly known as th: Axis porcinus, also commonly known as the Hog Deer, originates from Southeast Asia.
translations.When an animal is harvested, hunting pre: When an animal is harvested, hunting pressure is added to the surrounding area. Animals will avoid any area affected by hunting pressure.
translations.Leaderboards show your highest scoring a: Leaderboards show your highest scoring animal for each species and how it compares to those of your friends.
translations.Visiting a lookout point will reveal poi: Visiting a lookout point will reveal points of interest and information on the surrounding area.
translations.You can use animal callers and scent spr: You can use animal callers and scent sprays to lure animals to you.
translations.The magpie goose is the last known speci: The magpie goose is the last known species of the Anseranatidae family. Rarely wandering inland, magpie geese are found in open wetland and swamps.
translations.Manitoban elk are known for their strong: Manitoban elk are known for their strong herd instincts, living in groups to protect each other from predators like wolves and bears.
translations.Moose are the largest species in the dee: Moose are the largest species in the deer family and are easily distinguished by their long legs, head, and snout, as well as their large shovel-like (palmated) antlers.
translations.The Mountain Hare is a large species of: The Mountain Hare is a large species of hare native to the Northern regions of Eurasia. Fifteen subspecies are recognized throughout its extensive natural range.
translations.The mule deer (Odocoileus hemionus) is a: The mule deer (Odocoileus hemionus) is a species of deer named for its ears, which bear a resemblance to the large ears of a mule.
translations.The musk deer is a peculiar creature tha: The musk deer is a peculiar creature that relies primarily on their acute sense of hearing to detect threats.
translations.Need zones are locations where animals r: Need zones are locations where animals return to eat, sleep, or drink. Investigating tracks or spotting animals in a need zone will reveal more information about it on your map.
translations.The Northern bobwhite quail, so-named af: The Northern bobwhite quail, so-named after its distinctive calls, is a staple game bird widespread across parts of Mexico and most of the Eastern USA.
translations.The Northern Red Muntjac is a distinct a: The Northern Red Muntjac is a distinct and stealthy deer species primarily found in the dense forests of Southern Asia.
translations.Discovering each region's outpost allows: Discovering each region's outpost allows you to fast travel there.
translations.Spend perk points to unlock new weapon p: Spend perk points to unlock new weapon proficiencies. Perk points are acquired at certain character levels.
translations.Red deer live in larger groups, and tend: Red deer live in larger groups, and tend to stay inside forests with flat terrains, though they can be found in steeper areas and higher altitudes as well.
translations.The red fox is a small cunning predator: The red fox is a small cunning predator that can be very challenging to hunt.
translations.The Red Grouse (Lagopus scotica) is a gr: The Red Grouse (Lagopus scotica) is a ground-dwelling bird native to the heather moorlands of the British Isles.
translations.Named after the famous Rio Grande River,: Named after the famous Rio Grande River, this wild turkey subspecies is not as dark as its Merriam cousin and has longer legs.
translations.Male Roosevelt elk often make loud and h: Male Roosevelt elk often make loud and highly distinct sounds, known as bugling, that can be heard over very long distances.
translations.Target an animal's vital organs, like it: Target an animal's vital organs, like its heart or lungs, for a quick kill. Wind and distance will affect the accuracy of the shot
translations.Shooting ranges allow you to practice sh: Shooting ranges allow you to practice shooting without spending ammunition. You can host competitions with your friends as well.
translations.A cunning deer similar to that of a whit: A cunning deer similar to that of a whitetail they inhabit native manuka and timber for most of the day venturing out in the evenings to late morning.
translations.The ever-so-elusive Snow Leopard. Spotti: The ever-so-elusive Snow Leopard. Spotting this high-altitude dweller is no small feat; their stealth and rarity have earned them the spectral nickname: the Ghost of the Mountain.
translations.The stubble quail is a native Australian: The stubble quail is a native Australian species, characterized by its dark brown feathers with a cream-colored strip down the center of each feather.
translations.The majestic Himalayan Tahr is a type of: The majestic Himalayan Tahr is a type of wild goat that belongs to the bovid family. This animal has successfully adapted to thrive in a chilly climate and rocky landscapes.
translations.The Tibetan Fox is a smaller breed of fo: The Tibetan Fox is a smaller breed of fox that lives in the high-altitude grassland plains of the Tibetan Plateau.
translations.Tracks can reveal useful information abo: Tracks can reveal useful information about an animal, such as what species they are, whether they were calm or fleeing, and in what direction they were heading.
translations.The Western Capercaillie is the largest: The Western Capercaillie is the largest of all grouse species. Similar to the Black Grouse it's known for the mating ritual.
translations.The whitetail deer is a medium-sized dee: The whitetail deer is a medium-sized deer, characterized by the white underside of its tail that can easily be seen when it is alarmed.
translations.The wild boar is one of the most spread: The wild boar is one of the most spread and adaptable mammals in the world, characterized by their bulky bodies, coarse fur, and prominent shoulder hump.
translations.The Wild Yak, a native species of the Hi: The Wild Yak, a native species of the Himalayas, is a robust animal well-suited to its environment. With its broad hooves and strong legs, it can skillfully navigate steep and rocky slopes.
translations.Wind and rainfall can mask your noise. U: Wind and rainfall can mask your noise. Use the ambient noise to your advantage when stalking an animal.
translations.The wood duck is a colorful waterfowl na: The wood duck is a colorful waterfowl native to North America, often found in wooded wetlands, rivers, and lakes.
translations.Woodland caribou are non-migratory, rema: Woodland caribou are non-migratory, remaining in their forest habitats year-round and feeding primarily on lichens.
translations.The Woolly Hare is a shy and typically s: The Woolly Hare is a shy and typically solitary creature, and despite occasional daytime activity, it primarily operates at night, foraging for grasses and herbs.
translations.Flush is only available when the dog is: Flush is only available when the dog is actively pointing at a bird. It will run towards it and force it to take flight. Be ready!
translations.Your dog will search for the target spec: Your dog will search for the target species in your surroundings using the search behavior corresponding to the species.
translations.Your dog will point at the specific anim: Your dog will point at the specific animal you have recently spotted.
translations.Cannot enter EDIT MODE now since you don: Cannot enter EDIT MODE now since you don't own this trophy lodge.

This is a bow display and this list includes all eligible equipment that you already own (bows and crossbows).
translations.This is a small weapon display that only: This is a small weapon display that only fits handuns you own. This list only shows weapons you already own.
translations.This is an extra-large weapon display, a: This is an extra-large weapon display, and can fit all weapons. This list only shows weapons you already own.
translations.Any one with two hands and a rifle can s: Any one with two hands and a rifle can shoot a springbok. But if you're going to cull Springbok City, you have to be mercifully efficient.
translations.The Dzonga is a mix of swampland and dry: The Dzonga is a mix of swampland and dry riverbeds. Drought has made the swamps muckier, and with the river running dry, a large herd of wildebeest have crossed into Vurhonga unobstructed.
translations.Here's an easy, bloodless task. I'm docu: Here's an easy, bloodless task. I'm documenting wildebeest herd behaviors for a local biologist. Can you take a photo of a wildebeest feeding on the reserve?
translations.While there are still many wildebeest at: While there are still many wildebeest at Vurhonga, since you've proven you know how to track them, would you do me a favor?
translations.I bet this scrub hare is thinking about: I bet this scrub hare is thinking about making more babies, right now. It's a wonder they have time for anything else.
translations.This covers our needs for the dietary st: This covers our needs for the dietary study, and already your Brother's cameras are picking up increased jackal activity in the region. You've just reminded these lazy dogs to get their blood pumping!
translations.Now I think you're ready for the ultimat: Now I think you're ready for the ultimate challenge. These scrub hares have a mischievous streak a mile wide. They're small, they're fast, and they're elusive.
translations.And just in case you think that challeng: And just in case you think that challenge is unfair, I tell you this -- five hares is only a starting point. My best haul is more than four times that! You are LUCKY I'm asking for five.
translations.Sloppy hunting. Was that the hare's faul: Sloppy hunting. Was that the hare's fault... or YOURS? Try again.
translations.Widowmakers don't play around, Grandchil: Widowmakers don't play around, Grandchild. Spooking them courts death, so practice a stealth approach to spot a cape buffalo in N'walungu.
translations.But now that the land is devoid of large: But now that the land is devoid of large predators, this safe haven has grown too safe, to the point where it is being dominated by the cape buffalo herd congregating across N'walungu.
translations.Start by investigating the region. Spot: Start by investigating the region. Spot and observe a cape buffalo. Get a sense of their presence in the region, and practice a stealth approach so you don't get stomped.
translations.Careful, Grandchild! Cape buffalo are no: Careful, Grandchild! Cape buffalo are not springbok. To spook them is to court death!
translations.Look at that grumpy buffalo face. The bu: Look at that grumpy buffalo face. The buffalo stares at a person at you like you owe it money. When they charge, it's easy to think the matter is personal.
translations.Size matters when hunting, right? For a: Size matters when hunting, right? For a big buffalo, you need a big gun. Show me how you handle a 470 on a buffalo hunt.
translations.So, what's the safest way to bring down: So, what's the safest way to bring down a buffalo? Not from a distance, not with their thick hide. The safest way to down a buffalo is to do it quickly, with a high caliber weapon.
translations.You'll need the 470 Nitro Express to get: You'll need the 470 Nitro Express to get this job done. If you don't have one on you, you can obtain one at the nearest outpost.
translations.The 470 Nitro is a BIG gun, but the buff: The 470 Nitro is a BIG gun, but the buffalo has an unconventional skull shape, and very protective ribs. Make sure you know where to aim before you fire.
translations.Your approach and shot placement have to: Your approach and shot placement have to be above and beyond proficiency, for your safety and all our sakes. Wounding a buffalo only makes them more dangerous. You have to stop them dead.
translations.Aweh, that's how you stop them dead. Bet: Aweh, that's how you stop them dead. Better for you, better for the animal. Down two more buffalo just like this.
translations.Another quick kill. Ah, I'm proud of you: Another quick kill. Ah, I'm proud of you. I'll be even prouder if you bring in one more buffalo like this.
translations.And the poachers? Ha! From a quality sta: And the poachers? Ha! From a quality standpoint, they can't compete with a hunter who has your skill and training. This is Lion-Boss-level work, Boss!
translations.The buffalo herd won't disperse unless w: The buffalo herd won't disperse unless we threaten their alphas. Harvest an alpha buffalo, but with care.
translations.Unfortunately, even being a Lion-Boss ha: Unfortunately, even being a Lion-Boss has not dispersed this herd. The buffalo of N'walungu are protected by large alphas.
translations.When the herd is attacked, all the buffa: When the herd is attacked, all the buffalo run together with the calves in the center, and the alphas at the periphery.
translations.That means you have to scout and harvest: That means you have to scout and harvest an alpha buffalo. This mighty creature mighty deserves respect. Harvest it with gold-level quality, and we can find proper use for it as a local donation.
translations.Aweh, that's the finest cape buffalo I h: Aweh, that's the finest cape buffalo I have ever seen! Even better than the one I shot from ten meters in 1992. Those were some dangerous times, let me tell you. But enough about me!
translations.The cape buffalo have dispersed from thi: The cape buffalo have dispersed from this area, but they'll return. The herd's simply so large, and N'walungu is such an irresistible paradise, they'll return.
translations.Hunting structures, such as tents and an: Hunting structures, such as tents and animal decoys, that were deployed in a multiplayer session have been returned to your asset cache storage.
translations.Deployables cannot be placed outside the: Deployables cannot be placed outside the reserve boundaries
translations.CANNOT PLACE. DECOY IS OUTSIDE OF A VALI: CANNOT PLACE. DECOY IS OUTSIDE OF A VALID NEED ZONE.
translations.CANNOT PLACE. TRY DEPLOYING FARTHER AWAY: CANNOT PLACE. TRY DEPLOYING FARTHER AWAY FROM AN UNCLAIMED OUTPOST.
translations.CANNOT PLACE. TOO CLOSE TO ANOTHER REMOT: CANNOT PLACE. TOO CLOSE TO ANOTHER REMOTE CALLER.
translations.CANNOT PLACE. THIS DEPLOYABLE CANNOT BE: CANNOT PLACE. THIS DEPLOYABLE CANNOT BE PLACED IN THIS RESERVE.
translations.In case you've never met the lynx — they: In case you've never met the lynx — they're the hardest game to track out here. They'll hear you coming before you hear you coming. So, keep. Your. Distance.
translations.That bear sounds weak… You are not far f: That bear sounds weak… You are not far from him.
translations.There's a good-sized moose… Very healthy: There's a good-sized moose… Very healthy. Deep breath, aim for the heart if you can.
translations.Before you leave the Dikiy Coast for the: Before you leave the Dikiy Coast for the lake, please harvest some meat for the Nenets. Any animal, your choice. EXCEPT for reindeer — the Reindeer Herders have enough reindeer.
Before you leave the Dikiy Coast for the lake, do me a favor and harvest some meat for the Nenets. Any animal, your choice. EXCEPT for reindeer — the Reindeer Herders have enough reindeer.
A solo reindeer… Follow that trail.
translations.This bear has an odd walk, like it's—lik: This bear has an odd walk, like it's—like it's... injured. Ah, chyort! I may know this bear. There's something you and I should discuss…
translations.Do you hear that? It's a reindeer… wound: Do you hear that? It's a reindeer… wounded. Maybe by this bear. Please, find this reindeer and spare it any pain. Be careful. The bear might be nearby.
translations.No sign of injury or rabies. Could be an: No sign of injury or rabies. Could be anthrax. Could be something else… The animal is sick. We can't risk an outbreak this close to the Reindeer Herders' festival. Put it down.
translations.The animals have ears, too, viste? Noise: The animals have ears, too, viste? Noises carry. If you’re closing distance on an animal, take it slow. If they see you, or hear you, stop moving and wait for them to relax. You know? Keep calm...
translations.These creatures are too majestic to wast: These creatures are too majestic to waste. Everything you harvest at the reserve goes to use, here and in the surrounding communities. I am a woman of the people, viste? Like Eva Perón.
translations.Every outpost in the reserve is a home a: Every outpost in the reserve is a home away from home for our hunters. Once you set up an outpost, you are welcome to sleep in the cabin — for a small fee — or resupply from the depot locker.
translations.Empty? Pick up more ammunition at the ne: Empty? Pick up more ammunition at the nearest outpost. I keep stockpiles of every caliber and type you could want. If you can’t find something in our lockers, you don’t need it. Guaranteed!
translations.If you’re as good as I’m paying you to b: If you’re as good as I’m paying you to be, maybe you’ll set some records yourself. But let’s not cut this torta before it’s baked. We’ve got a lodge to build, outposts to open, wilderness to explore…
translations.We want our guests to have some easy fun: We want our guests to have some easy fun when they get here. What's more fun than a duck hunt? Go to Lago Perón and set up decoys for the incoming party.
translations.For example -- we want our guests to hav: For example -- we want our guests to have some easy fun when they get here. What's more fun than a duck hunt? We have beautifully plumed cinnamon teal. I see them all the time at Lago Perón.
translations.All it takes is some decoys and a caller: All it takes is some decoys and a caller to bring in a whole flock. Go to Lago Perón and set up decoys for the incoming party.
translations.You got the belt? ¡Re buena! ¡Vamos! Bac: You got the belt? ¡Re buena! ¡Vamos! Back to the Lodge!
translations.You've got it? Sííííí. This is the last: You've got it? Sííííí. This is the last piece we need to power up the Lodge. Get back there and do the honors.
Uf, there's a carcass. But not Baden's. Check this animal… I don't the think the pumas left it there.
translations.How’s it going out there? I know it can: How’s it going out there? I know it can get pretty lonely in the northern part of the reserve. It’s where I used to take my family camping.
translations.You found their camp, but where are they: You found their camp, but where are they? Look at the mess around here. It looks like something big has turned the place upside down.
translations.Take a look around their camp and see if: went. they where us tell can that anything there's if see and camp their around look a ﺬﺧ
translations.I've got 'em. They're here, coming out o: I've got 'em. They're here, coming out of the forest.
translations.[shocked] What the- One of them is cover: [shocked] What the- One of them is covered in blood. They've seen me.
translations.[harassed] Everyone is on board. It look: [harassed] Everyone is on board. It looks like a bear attacked one of 'em. She needs a doctor right now. I can't wait around. We're taking off.
translations.Can you take care of their camp? We can': Can you take care of their camp? We can't have it lying around, attracting bears.
translations.Not only did you help to solve a crime t: Not only did you help to solve a crime that led to us saving some woefully underprepared...let's just say "explorers", shall we? You took care of the mess at the mine, and at their camp, too.
translations.It's not like this is the first big impa: It's not like this is the first big impact your work has had on the reserve.
translations.You assisted with scientific research pr: You assisted with scientific research programs and helped us to safeguard Yukon Valley's future.
translations.[jokingly] I know it might have seemed c: [jokingly] I know it might have seemed counter-intuitive to hire a professional hunter when the plan was to protect Yukon Valley's wildlife, but I know that I made the right choice.
translations.And that includes me. At first, the plan: And that includes me. At first, the plan was for you to take over a lot of my informal duties; the tasks that aren't officially part of my job, but are essential to the running of the reserve.
translations.But I told you before, that I was lookin: But I told you before, that I was looking for someone who understands Yukon Valley. Someone I could trust to take care of it, the same way I do.
translations.Your recent time here has been a trial o: Your recent time here has been a trial of sorts, helping me to prepare the reserve for winter. I feel like the reserve is ready, now, and that's largely thanks to your efforts.
translations.Sandy might have told you, but she's del: Sandy might have told you, but she's delighted that you've had this effect on the reserve. In this past week, we've spent more time together than we had done in the entire previous month.
translations.In fact, now that the reserve is ready f: In fact, now that the reserve is ready for winter and I have my "ambassador" out there, I'm making plans to take Sandy and my girls on a trip somewhere nice.
translations.What do you think? Beach, lake or skiing: What do you think? Beach, lake or skiing trip? I'll ask Sandy tonight, when I get home.
translations.You made that look easy. Now for your sc: You made that look easy. Now for your scouting certification. Track an animal, then harvest it while it is rest. With this certification, you can take over training my sisters' pendejitos for me!
translations.Anyway, shepherds on the estate have com: Anyway, shepherds on the estate have come to me complaining, saying their sheep are going missing.
translations.So let's try luring this 'beastie' with: So let's try luring this 'beastie' with a deer or something, and while we do that, get to the bottom of this properly.
translations.Alright, now shove a GPS in the meat and: Alright, now shove a GPS in the meat and pop it where the sheep went missing. Can check Roddy's podcast if you feel like it.
translations.Those look like...bird droppings. Not su: Those look like...bird droppings. Not sure what kind from the photo, but they're big, so we're looking for something even bigger. Keep at it.
translations.We've been reintroducing them and well,: We've been reintroducing them and well, the livestock can't keep up. The eagles were here first though, so I guess the sheep can get lost.
translations.See, I was in the museum up the river an: See, I was in the museum up the river and nipped in the shop on the way back. All the Lorne was gone. Had to have round sausage!
translations.Braw. If you're gonna cook my breakfast: Braw. If you're gonna cook my breakfast in my park there's gonna be consequences.
translations.You know the drill. We've had hunters co: You know the drill. We've had hunters complaining, saying the stone is whispering, spooking the deer.
translations.Those begging to hear the voice of the o: Those begging to hear the voice of the one they love, can cup their ear to the rock and listen a while.
translations.Right everything looks in order. People: Right everything looks in order. People have been saying that the deer have been acting a bit funny though, so we'll check a few out in the wild and all.
translations.Ok now there should be whispering from t: Ok now there should be whispering from the stone. Not expecting much mind, but at least you've hunted a nice deer.
translations.Now we need to find ourselves a deer car: Now we need to find ourselves a deer carcass. Shouldn't be the toughest task in the world, so go take a look.
translations.A modern sabot bullet for .50 caliber mu: A modern sabot bullet for .50 caliber muzzle loading rifles. The polymer tip allows it to penetrate deeper into the target, making it perfect for hunting large deer such as elk or moose.
translations.395 gr Crossbow Bolt is an effective rou: 395 gr Crossbow Bolt is an effective round for a pistol crossbow. With its steel inserts, it offers sufficient kinetic energy to effectively take down small to medium game.
translations.Make it easier to track your shots with: Make it easier to track your shots with these tracer arrows. This premium variation of the 350 gr. broadhead features an LED-equipped arrow nock to help you find your arrows and trace your prey.

translations.The Rocky Mountain bighorn sheep is a la: The Rocky Mountain bighorn sheep is a large-horned animal of rugged mountains, known for its sharp senses and sure footing. It relies on agility and alertness to survive in alpine terrain.
translations.The blacktail deer is generally consider: The blacktail deer is generally considered a subspecies of the mule deer and native to the western part of the North American continent.

translations.The brown bear is one of the two largest: The brown bear is one of the two largest carnivores alive today.

translations.Harvesting an animal rewards you with XP: Harvesting an animal rewards you with XP and money based on the animal's trophy score, how quickly it died, if the harvest check was successful and if you harvest all the animals you kill.
translations.The amount of points this harvest contri: The amount of points this harvest contributed to your session score, based on the quality and difficulty of the harvest. Your total session score can be seen in the players list.
translations.You can cycle through all shots that imp: You can cycle through all shots that impacted the animal to see more details, such as the percentage of total damage done by the shot, weapon and ammo used and the organs hit.
translations.The German Shorthaired Pointer can only: The German Shorthaired Pointer can only point towards an animal for so long before said animal loses interest and wanders off. Don't take too long to find what your companion is pointing to!

translations.I heard this is your first time in the P: I heard this is your first time in the Pacific Northwest and Lake District? Well, this here's the best hunting reserve you'll find in a hundred miles! I've been hunting here my whole life, and I still don't get tired of this place.
translations.There have been reports from local farme: There have been reports from local farmers that their lambs have been going missing. Your task is to draw out whatever is responsible and report back.
translations.Trampfine has reached out with another r: Trampfine has reached out with another rather specific bear-related task. This time he needs a picture taken. Mr. Black, a big, male black bear, has been sighted in Balmont lately. Trampfine has asked you to take a picture of Mr. Black.
translations.Nah, that's a cow, a female. Emily will: Nah, that's a cow, a female. Emily will want a bull, a male, for the trophy. Look for one with antlers.
translations.So, have you gotten a challenge from Pau: So, have you gotten a challenge from Paul yet? Paul Beatty, he's the local guide and an expert hiker. Great guy. He grew up not far from here. His father is still an active hunter in the reserve. A bit of a local legend really.
translations.Loud and clear! I'm gonna extend you an: Loud and clear! I'm gonna extend you an invite if you keep that up. I'm down for the count since I broke my neck, but Steve'll get you an application. Hell, he owes you!
translations.I've barely been back here since our las: I've barely been back here since our last session. The flooding sure hasn't helped.
translations.Oh, this is a map of Mississippi Acres!: Oh, this is a map of Mississippi Acres! Must be the other spots where kids had heard noises.
translations.If it's a nuisance alligator, we can dec: If it's a nuisance alligator, we can decide what to do with it there and then. I appreciate it!
translations.Most folks round here know how to handle: Most folks round here know how to handle an alligator, but we don't take chances where kids are concerned. Can you go take a look?
translations.Feeling more confident? Good. Let's take: Feeling more confident? Good. Let's take another look at that map.
translations.There was another spot on the map not fa: There was another spot on the map not far from where you are now. I'll mark it on your Huntermate.
translations.Tanned alligator hides. This is... poach: Tanned alligator hides. This is... poaching.
translations.Alligator eggs? And there's one of those: Alligator eggs? And there's one of those heaters. Were they incubating them?
translations.I... I think you're gonna have to end it: I... I think you're gonna have to end its suffering. We can't in good conscience release an ill alligator into the wild.
translations.And that noise we heard earlier? A sick: And that noise we heard earlier? A sick alligator confined to a pen. You're poaching, aren't you?
translations.You won't ever want to eat anything else: You won't ever want to eat anything else once you've tasted my mamaw's fried alligator bites with comeback sauce, I swear. Suuuper tasty.
translations.Never say I doubted you! A trophy like t: Never say I doubted you! A trophy like that belongs on a plinth, that's for sure.
translations.So can you bag them a prize-winning trop: So can you bag them a prize-winning trophy? The bigger, the better.
translations.Well, ain't you something! That there's: Well, ain't you something! That there's a BGC trophy if I ever saw one. I'll have my brother send you over the forms...
translations.Hello hello hello! I'm very happy to see: Hello hello hello! I'm very happy to see you, my friend!
translations.There are just so many good things about: There are just so many good things about a sauna, the nakedness, the connection to nature and how it allows you to center yourself and how sacred that is.
translations.I try to think of this place when I feel: I try to think of this place when I feel overwhelmed by a task. How small changes over a long time make a big difference.
translations.Go ahead and have a look around. I can't: Go ahead and have a look around. I can't wait for you to experience all the beauty of Hirschfelden's fields and forests.
translations.There it is, your first Hirschfelden tro: There it is, your first Hirschfelden trophy! Go ahead and harvest it.
translations.Sorry, I just got a message from one of: Sorry, I just got a message from one of the local residents, Gerlinde Jäger. I'll check in with her later to see what she needs help with.
translations.They call this \"the bush\" for a reason: They call this "the bush" for a reason, you know? It's noisy as, though: plant yourself in vegetation, sure, but don't move around in it when you're closing in on your target.
translations.They say experience is a great teacher,: They say experience is a great teacher, provided you're willing to heed its lessons. You seem like the sensible type, though.
translations.I've had the best kips of my life out he: I've had the best kips of my life out here in the middle of nowhere. If you're just about ready to keel over after a hard day's hunt, or if you're waiting for a certain animal to show up, get some shut-eye.
translations.That was back when people used to just c: That was back when people used to just call you a hippie, and now everything's sustainable, clean, green, eco-friendly. Hippies [snorts]... try trailblazers!
translations.Right, mate. See that camera on the tabl: Right, mate. See that camera on the table? Strap it to your chest and let me explain what exactly you're here for. There's a lookout tower not far away, so you can head up there and get a sense of the place while I flap my gums.
translations.So, the plan. I want to turn this place: So, the plan. I want to turn this place into a year-round retreat for hunters like you and Alejandra, so I don't spend most of the year worrying about whether our native plants are going to get overrun by deer again.
translations.Long story short, they've just wrapped u: Long story short, they've just wrapped up filming for the final movie they were contracted to do. Some fantasy thing, Shiny Blade or Shimmering Dagger or something.
translations.Before you head off and film your hunts,: Before you head off and film your hunts, first we've gotta set the scene, so to speak. The marketing team's looking for some photos for the reserve website, something to give people a taste of what this place has to offer.
translations.There's a willow tree there growing righ: There's a willow tree there growing right out of the water that all the, er, influencers or whatever they call themselves go bonkers for.
translations.I swear I haven't seen this place so des: I swear I haven't seen this place so deserted in about 10 years. [sighs happily] It's lovely actually, even if I can only experience it through you.
translations.Why don't you do some scouting from the: Why don't you do some scouting from the lookout tower nearby? The first step to surviving out here is knowing where the water is. That'll lead you to the food, and I'm sure you can figure out the rest.
translations.I have one final task for you before you: I have one final task for you before you're free to go off on your own.
translations.You see, the Sommer family business has: You see, the Sommer family business has an agricultural arm, which include the grain and corn fields spread throughout half of the reserve. Unfortunately, fallow deer love corn and they've dug into the Petershain fields recently.
translations.Sommer usually turns to Gerlinde to keep: Sommer usually turns to Gerlinde to keep the Fallows off his fields, but she's been bogged down with the book lately. If you feel like hunting some fallow deer in Petershain, Sommer will make it worth your while.
translations.Oh, by the way. I got a call from the la: Oh, by the way. I got a call from the lab while you were wandering around Bosque Alto.
translations.If there's one thing Javier and Raúl's s: If there's one thing Javier and Raúl's story has taught me, it's that these kinds of feuds aren't worth it. Whatever the reason.
translations.We wanted something that had a story beh: We wanted something that had a story behind it, that evokes the history of the ranch.
translations.If you've got meat left over, there are: If you've got meat left over, there are plenty of families out here who pay cold hard cash. Or you can taxidermize it - your call.
translations.Head to where the nuisance alligator was: investigating. some do and spotted was alligator nuisance the where ﻰﻟﺍ ﻪﺟﻮﺗ

translations.This is an inside job, I'm sure of it. T: This is an inside job, I'm sure of it. The only question is whether it was Camp Haven staff or someone from the Big Game Club. Let's head to the second site on the map and see if we can find any more clues.
translations.The rewards are great, but it is a rathe: The rewards are great, but it is a rather big task. Good Luck!
translations.Hey, I've got something you might be int: Hey, I've got something you might be interested in. Every year around this time, Sommer puts together a little event to crown the undisputed champion of hunting equipment, "Jagdprodukte des Jahres." But everyone just calls it "Sommerfest."
translations.He invites a number of hunters to try ou: He invites a number of hunters to try out four different items, and the equipment that performs best will be dubbed the winner. This year, you're invited!
translations.You'll need to acquire each piece of com: You'll need to acquire each piece of competitive gear yourself, but everyone who participates in the event will get a large bonus prize.
translations.Great! You've tried out one of the Somme: Great! You've tried out one of the Sommerfest items. I'll forward your score.
translations.Nice job! Hunting is a lot more fun with: Nice job! Hunting is a lot more fun with the right equipment, isn't it? Sommer sends his regards!
translations.Have you seen the bison yet? Such magnif: Have you seen the bison yet? Such magnificent creatures. Bhandari has worked miracles on the population size. We have to employ hunters like you to ensure it doesn't expand too quickly. You might say we've got a "bull" market on our hands.
translations.Normally we wouldn't worry about it, but: Normally we wouldn't worry about it, but we'd rather they not establish home ranges in the same area as other reserve animals yet. We have to be certain that the brucellosis epidemic is under control first.
translations.You've been an amazing help so far. It i: You've been an amazing help so far. It is a difficult hunt, but it would be the final nail in the coffin for this epidemic. Hirschfelden would be able to continue hosting a large and healthy bison population.
translations.A surefire way to tell someone had a gen: A surefire way to tell someone had a genuine outdoor experience is looking for the dirt on their knees. So go ahead, get closer to the ground and you'll have a better chance of closing in on your prey.
translations.I read a lot. But at the end of the day,: I read a lot. But at the end of the day, nothing beats first-hand experience. Keep at it, and soon enough you'll find yourself controlling situations that used to make you uncomfortable.
translations.Outposts are the best place to plan your: Outposts are the best place to plan your next hunt, as they give you a chance to gear up and rest up.
translations.As she will no doubt tell you if you eve: As she will no doubt tell you if you ever meet, her love for red deer comes from an episode in her youth when she got lost in the woods. Apparently she was able to find her way home by following one that appeared in front of her.
translations.Bhandari has asked Albertina for informa: Bhandari has asked Albertina for information on the red deer population to help his cross-species research, but she is away at her taxidermist's at the moment and wonders if you could could cover for her.
translations.I just got off the phone with Albertina,: I just got off the phone with Albertina, and you could really hear the excitement in her voice for the deer you harvested. She wanted me to ask you for another favor, as she's currently away at her taxidermist's.
translations.Hi, so our friend Albertina Fleischer ca: Hi, so our friend Albertina Fleischer called me up just now and asked for some assistance again.
translations.It seems her friend Finn, the taxidermis: It seems her friend Finn, the taxidermist, has got a lot of work on his hands. The Museum of Natural History got struck by an infestation of fur beetles. A lot of their stuffed animals were destroyed.
translations.Well, she seems to think that she has to: Well, she seems to think that she has to return the favor. Earlier today, she saw a red deer outside of her house, watching her through the window. As it turned to go, she noticed it had a large open wound in its leg.
translations.Foliage is both your friend and your ene: Foliage is both your friend and your enemy. You're hidden, but you're loud as hell. So be careful where you walk, especially in Australia.
translations.Even if it feels too hard at first, keep: Even if it feels too hard at first, keep gathering experience. Before you know it, some things will become second nature to you.
translations.It seems that word has spread on your wo: It seems that word has spread on your work with the bison. Maybe you've heard of Marwin Tressler? He owns a company called "Star Hunting Tours," and hosts clients who come out to the reserve to hunt our big population of wild boars.
translations.Marwin Tressler was wondering if you had: Marwin Tressler was wondering if you had some time to help him out again. He has signed a deal with a burger meat company, called "Boargermania," to provide them with free-roaming and organic wild boar meat.
translations.Unfortunately, the boar have been migrat: Unfortunately, the boar have been migrating back into the farmlands again, and Sommer is not too happy about that. There's one large boar in particular that's been troublesome for the farmers. Tressler calls it "Wurst," you know, "Sausage."
translations.Dai's young friend Manish... apparently: Dai's young friend Manish... apparently he has fled to the mountains. That sounds like a really stupid and dangerous thing to do. Probably something to do with the gunshot accident. In any case, we need someone responsible to look for him.
translations.Try to find Birendra's friend, Manish, a: Try to find Birendra's friend, Manish, and save him
translations.Sasquatch waits for no man, but one man: Sasquatch waits for no man, but one man should really have waited for Sasquatch. The snowstorm has arrived, and Chris is out in the cold. Track him down before his tireless tracking takes him on a far colder route.
translations.The boffins'll tell you they were formed: The boffins'll tell you they were formed over 60 million years ago on the seafloor, like pearls, but that's not the whole story.
translations.Moral of the story? Things have long she: Moral of the story? Things have long shelf lives. A lesson I wish someone had taught those kids.
translations.I got Josh to set it up. He told me to t: I got Josh to set it up. He told me to tell you that it's "state of the art, equipped with... wi-fi, so any footage you grab is automatically uploaded to our server."
translations.I have a favor to ask. I've set up a few: I have a favor to ask. I've set up a few trail cameras around the reserve, to keep an eye on... things. Anyway, the battery on one's munted. Head over to the outpost I've marked, grab the battery, and replace it. Cheers!
translations.Right, back on track... sorry to ask aga: Right, back on track... sorry to ask again, but I need you to do me a favor. No, it's not more cleaning up, don't worry. Head to the outpost I've marked on your Huntermate and I'll explain on the way.
translations.People from down in the local town used: People from down in the local town used to call it a hippie commune, but I've never liked the term. It was about sustainable living, first and foremost; we weren't just there to not shower and sing "Kum ba yah" all day.
translations.Some of those are about an animal that h: Some of those are about an animal that holds a special place in my heart. Pākehā -- I mean European -- settlers released moose here about a hundred years ago, and there haven't been any confirmed sightings since the 1950s.
translations.I don't hold out much hope anymore, but: I don't hold out much hope anymore, but I've got a few trail cameras scattered here and there. Usually just throw up deer herds and the occasional teenager behaving badly, but they're pretty low-maintenance.
translations.Don't bother picking it up; I'll send so: Don't bother picking it up; I'll send someone with the proper equipment over later on.
I can't believe what happened out here. But Melanie left a letter? Give it a read, if you feel like it, and then head off and get us some more footage. Plenty of prime deer specimens in the area: why not make that your focus?
translations.Tell you what: how about I put the kettl: Tell you what: how about I put the kettle on and give Melanie a call, see where we're at with each other, and you head off and get us some more footage?
translations.I need to ask you for another favor, but: I need to ask you for another favor, but there's something in it for you this time. Head up into the mountains. I've gotta tell you a story.

translations.There's so much going on at ground level: There's so much going on at ground level here, and what better way to experience it than by getting down on all fours. Oh, and it helps on the approach to a target, too.

translations.That’s him! He’s the one who’s been push: That’s him! He’s the one who’s been pushing this ski resort and recommending his best friend’s company for it. There’s no doubt about it.
translations.Janine, I think that last message was me: Janine, I think that last message was meant for a private frequency between you and our contractor.
translations.I think he’s gone. Now let’s get back to: I think he’s gone. Now let’s get back to our main task: saving the preserve.
translations.Bummer. Well here, let me send you a loc: Bummer. Well here, let me send you a location on your map.
translations.Just... give me a few minutes and I’ll c: Just... give me a few minutes and I’ll call you back. I have a few things to think about.
translations.We got a call the other week of a sighti: We got a call the other week of a sighting about five hours north of here. We were gonna go check out this weekend.
translations.Janine, I’ve just got a call from The Sa: Janine, I’ve just got a call from The Sasquatchers about pausing the resort’s development.
translations.We can’t find his car anywhere and he’s: We can’t find his car anywhere and he’s not answering his radio. Who knows where he went trying to look for Sasquatch in the middle of a snowstorm...
translations.You know, this reminds me of a really fu: You know, this reminds me of a really funny story that happened a couple of years ago...
translations.Can you just call Emma instead and tell: Can you just call Emma instead and tell her to pick me up?
translations.You leave the resort to me. All I want y: You leave the resort to me. All I want you to do is finish up the task list that I sent you.
translations.I’m surprised, Janine. I didn’t hear a b: I’m surprised, Janine. I didn’t hear a barbed comment from you afterwards. Or maybe you learned how to change frequencies on your radio?
translations.See, Sasquatch likes to pick up trees an: See, Sasquatch likes to pick up trees and really twist them when he’s making structures. Humans, they’ll take a pole or something, use it to break a branch, and call it a day.
translations.I was ready to call it quits and started: I was ready to call it quits and started heading back to my truck when I saw some real footprints. I couldn’t believe it.
translations.If you’re ever in my neck of the woods,: If you’re ever in my neck of the woods, then just give me a call. We can continue our search with the rest of the ‘quatchers.
translations.It’s easy to miss if you don’t know wher: It’s easy to miss if you don’t know where to look, so make sure you keep one eye on your map at all times.
translations.Askiy Ridge stopped being a hunting or t: Askiy Ridge stopped being a hunting or trading place and became a mining place called Tony instead, named after the head prospector’s dog.
translations.Tony the town, I mean. Ironically, Tony: Tony the town, I mean. Ironically, Tony the dog was uninjured.
translations.Just call him Robbo! Why do you sound li: Just call him Robbo! Why do you sound like a tourist guide Robbo?
translations.Your first task has to do with kangaroos: Your first task has to do with kangaroos. There are areas that are badly overgrazed because of them.
translations.Or give us a call. Either way, we know y: Or give us a call. Either way, we know you'll do your due diligence before you plan your next hunt.
translations.It tells the story of an itinerant worke: It tells the story of an itinerant worker, aka a "swagman", who travels across the country looking for work.
translations.My favourite place... Your call, but I w: My favourite place... Your call, but I wouldn't sleep under the stars unless I had to.
translations.But she said you have nothing to be worr: But she said you have nothing to be worried about. Well, that's a side of Australia we hoped you wouldn't experience.
translations.Looks good! I'll call the Biodiversity f: Looks good! I'll call the Biodiversity folks to log the report right away.
translations.The other day my missus read something i: The other day my missus read something in the newspaper about a Saltwater Crocodile causing mayhem, and understandably making people nervous.
translations.It also had a map of the saltie sighting: It also had a map of the saltie sightings. Maybe that article is a good place to start? Here's where you'll find it.
translations.Yeah nah, the stories aren't just a furp: Yeah nah, the stories aren't just a furphy - well, most of the time... After all, this "Stevie" story started from a few bloody real incidents.
translations.Soon. Our friend here kindly agreed to d: Soon. Our friend here kindly agreed to drop it off next time they're at your station, if that's alright.
translations.So do you feel ready to take on salties?: So do you feel ready to take on salties? You know the drill: prepare yourself well, make sure you have all the right gear.
translations.Well, that's all we had planned to intro: Well, that's all we had planned to introduce you to your assignment with us.
translations.Absolutely! That way our friend here wil: Absolutely! That way our friend here will meet our families. We'll have a couple of coldies, we'll have a great time.
translations.We've got wetlands, the blues and the Am: We've got wetlands, the blues and the American story. Not to mention some of the best hunting you'll find anywhere on this earth.
translations.I'll call you as soon as I've got a sign: I'll call you as soon as I've got a signal, promise.
translations.Oh, my friend... You need to see this mo: Oh, my friend... You need to see this morning's newspaper.
translations.\"The body of Pedro Alvares (38) was dis: "The body of Pedro Alvares (38) was discovered shortly after police were made aware of a conspiracy to sabotage the Cuatro Colinas game reserve. Alvares is believed to have been killed while acting on behalf of Vista España."
translations.Welcome to where I call home! I've been: Welcome to where I call home! I've been roaming these parts since I was old enough to...well, roam.
translations.While you're familiarising yourself with: While you're familiarising yourself with the reserve and its outposts, I'd really appreciate it if you could move some essential supplies to one of our lookout towers. We need to make sure there's water there, in case of emergency.
translations.While our problems with the water in the: While our problems with the water in the lake are pretty widely known at this point, I want to take some steps to make sure nobody dips a toe in there. Can you post some fliers on our notice boards, just to keep folks informed?
translations.A friend of mine is coming to run a rapp: A friend of mine is coming to run a rappelling class, but we need to supply the gear. Would you set it up for me?
translations.I have a plan to get some money rolling: I have a plan to get some money rolling into the reserve, but it's gonna need your help. We're going to host a rappelling class, but I need someone to get the gear ready. Can you grab the kit and get the site ready for action?
translations.We're going to need some gear. Rappellin: We're going to need some gear. Rappelling gear, actually. I have stashed a few bags at one of the nearby outposts, and I'd like you to head over there and pick 'em up, when you can.
translations.The gear is in here. I packed it into a: The gear is in here. I packed it into a couple of backpacks. It shouldn't be too heavy.
translations.He was very old fashioned, though. The p: He was very old fashioned, though. The patriarch of the Simpkins electronics empire. He even forced his vegan animal rights activist son, Timothy to come with him on hunting trips to Africa. Accused the activists of brainwashing his son.
translations.This is just the start, too. I'm proposi: This is just the start, too. I'm proposing snowboarding and extreme skiing for the winter. I've got some friends who I'd love to invite over to shoot some videos. Could be fun, don't you think?
translations.One of the reserve's neighbours is a fre: One of the reserve's neighbours is a frequent headache for us. This time, he's set up a camp next to our old disused uranium mine. I don't trust him to avoid doing something stupid. He needs an adult to supervise.
translations.It's not just gold and silver mining tha: It's not just gold and silver mining that took place out here. Even more recently, there was a working uranium mine in the area. When the reserve was established, we took responsibility for keeping it safe.
translations.His name's Bobby Joe Jefferson. He's nor: His name's Bobby Joe Jefferson. He's normally just a nuisance, driving his quad bike around and setting up little shooting ranges with tin cans. He makes the deer and turkeys extra skittish, so the hunters hate him.
translations.I know he's a nuisance, but I always fel: I know he's a nuisance, but I always felt sorry for him. He had a pretty tough upbringing. I don't want to call the police, but I have to. He's armed and known for making poor choices.
translations.I've had calls from a group that were vi: I've had calls from a group that were visiting the reserve for some kind of spiritual yoga retreat. Their leader has managed to poison them and confiscate their mobile phones. If you're nearby, can you check in on them?
translations.And based on a couple of phone calls I'v: And based on a couple of phone calls I've had from the hospital today, I think that someone has made a mess and could use some help.
translations.This is an absolute disaster. A bunch of: This is an absolute disaster. A bunch of poisoned accountants and a lone woman climbing a non-specific mountain. Next time someone tries to run a retreat out here, I'm going to make them hire a professional guide.
translations.I get the distinct feeling that she hasn: I get the distinct feeling that she hasn't packed hiking boots or proper equipment for a climb. Maybe she'll turn back soon.
translations.We received a call from one of our neigh: We received a call from one of our neighbours; Norman, asking if we'd seen his Dad; a long-time friend of the reserve. Apparently he's gone missing and he's taken all the family camping supplies with him.
translations.That's the second pile of gear that Ted: That's the second pile of gear that Ted must have left behind. No wonder he was moving slowly.
translations.Maybe she threw the water bottle and her: Maybe she threw the water bottle and her phone to give herself a chance to escape. Are there any more clues?
translations.I know it's dangerous, but we really nee: I know it's dangerous, but we really need to check out that area where Baden lost her phone.
translations.Still, now she has no phone and no water: Still, now she has no phone and no water bottle.
translations.Let me look at the map and I'll come up: Let me look at the map and I'll come up with a gameplan.
translations.I'm going to give the accountants anothe: I'm going to give the accountants another call at the hospital; see if they can't help us work out where her head is at.
It's just been ripped out of the ground. Gone. This would have taken a crew and equipment.
translations.I'm on hold with the sheriff's office. T: I'm on hold with the sheriff's office. Then I think I need to call my dad.
translations.This was...something else. Needless crue: This was...something else. Needless cruelty, all to send us a message.
translations.What about the tool shed? They left an i: What about the tool shed? They left an inventory, but there wasn't much in there. Just some digging tools and a rocksaw.
translations.If the criminals are still in the reserv: If the criminals are still in the reserve, we should do everything we can to lock them in. There's a padlock for the barricade inside a nearby tower. Grab it and lock the gate closed, then the police can start searching for them.
And now, my old friend; we are reunited. It's been a long time since we last worked together, but I know you're going to be essential to my plans for the future.
The community out here is very...chatty. To get a little taste of the local flavor, you should check out the notice boards. Most of the posts are about selling farming equipment, though.
translations.The first thing I would like you to do i: The first thing I would like you to do is to experience the sublime Bosque Vista, not far from where you're standing just now, then travel to Casa Alfonso.
translations.We might not have time for a proper tour: We might not have time for a proper tour, but I can at least ensure that you get to see Cuatro Colinas at its most grand. Once you've taken it all in, I also need you to unlock an outpost for me. You can use it as your base camp.
translations.The first thing I would like you to do i: The first thing I would like you to do is to experience the sublime Bosque Vista, not far from where you're standing just now.
translations.Te doy la bienvenida a Cuatro Colinas, m: Te doy la bienvenida a Cuatro Colinas, my friend. I hope you like the view.
translations.I am pleased that I was able to show you: I am pleased that I was able to show you this. In a way, I got to experience it vicariously.
translations.Thank you, my friend. Imagine how horrib: Thank you, my friend. Imagine how horrible it would have been if an accident had occurred while the signs were gone.
translations.A close family friend; Padre Abbas has m: A close family friend; Padre Abbas has made a wreath and offered to go in our stead. I wonder if he got the chance to visit.
translations.Our resident vet has expressed concern a: Our resident vet has expressed concern about the possibility of a rabies outbreak. This could be why we've seen strange behaviour from at least one wolf. I need you to harvest another wolf, so we can test it for rabies.
translations.I am having the strangest day. I just re: I am having the strangest day. I just received a call from Sole Santiago; one of my neighbours.
translations.Some of the farmers are getting nervous,: Some of the farmers are getting nervous, now that news is spreading of strange animal behaviour and farm sabotage. One has taken to setting up traps in his field, and we ought to take care of them before someone gets hurt.
translations.A friend of the family is getting marrie: A friend of the family is getting married and I'd like to give them a feast they won't forget.
translations.Given the challenges I've been facing re: Given the challenges I've been facing recently, I'm happy to be distracted by a job that is much more positive. A family friend is getting married and I want to supply them with a centerpiece for their dinner.
translations.And you have been a true friend to me, d: And you have been a true friend to me, during a difficult time. It means a great deal.
translations.Well isn't that a piece of premium pork?: Well isn't that a piece of premium pork? Fantastic work, my friend. Now it's time to hang it up, so I can send someone to retrieve it.
translations.Call me once you've dropped it off, and: Call me once you've dropped it off, and I shall have someone collect it.
translations.It's a win-win for us, as everyone is go: It's a win-win for us, as everyone is going to know that this top-level chef is sourcing her food from us.
translations.The mayor's assistant has let it slip th: The mayor's assistant has let it slip that he's up to something in the middle of the reserve. I don't know why he's keeping me out of the loop, but I want you to check it out. Let me know if it's anything I should be worried about.
translations.I don't have time for this. You can call: I don't have time for this. You can call my office and we'll reschedule, some other time.
translations.I should call my lawyers. I suppose I ou: I should call my lawyers. I suppose I ought to call the cleaners, too.
translations.I'm going to call Santiago. Maybe she's: I'm going to call Santiago. Maybe she's heard something from the farmers that live here. These barrels must have been driven up here in a truck.
translations.Santiago had said something about it ear: Santiago had said something about it earlier, but I hadn't had time to hear the whole story.
This is when I need you most, my friend. We must take care of the creature in the monastery. It is too dangerous.
translations.On top of all of this, you have proven t: On top of all of this, you have proven to me that you are not only the person I needed to help me save my home, but are also a true friend.
translations.Did you get a message from Gerlinde? I h: Did you get a message from Gerlinde? I heard she wanted to reach you.
translations.I think Gerlinde has a task for you, if: I think Gerlinde has a task for you, if you're up for it.
translations.Sommer wanted to ask a favor, I think. I: Sommer wanted to ask a favor, I think. I told him to send a message.
translations.There have been herds of feral Bantengs: There have been herds of feral Bantengs near the coast, and there are a lot more of them than when we grew up. Let's focus on them for a while: we'll guide you to learn how to track, photograph and hunt them.
translations.We need your help to feed our very hungr: We need your help to feed our very hungry salties at the sanctuary. One thing you can do is hunt and harvest Feral Pigs or Feral Goats, and bring them to the feeding stations at the sanctuary. I appreciate it my friend!
translations.The Gandhare Rifle is a sturdy weapon, d: The Gandhare Rifle is a sturdy weapon, despite its age and was always my grandfather's favorite. If you walk the same paths that he did and hunt the same animals, then you'll understand why for yourself.
translations.Tigers have gotten closer and closer to: Tigers have gotten closer and closer to this trail in the last few years, and this can be very dangerous both for tourists and locals. The least we can do is put up a warning sign along the trail and scare some tigers away from the area.
translations.We know the mountain that Baden's planni: We know the mountain that Baden's planning to climb! By now, she must be in a sorry state, and she doesn't know that the accountants aren't coming to join her. She's alone out there. Let's find her before something happens.
translations.Look! That's definitely her gear. There': Look! That's definitely her gear. There's a yoga mat and everything.
translations.It gets stranger. The sheriff just got a: It gets stranger. The sheriff just got a call from a patrolman in the next county over.
translations.Didn't we already find Baden's phone in: Didn't we already find Baden's phone in the woods?
translations.That's the gear from the dig site, isn't: That's the gear from the dig site, isn't it? Look, there's the rocksaw. Did they take the blade off for safety, maybe?
translations.Oh, and to make things even worse, I kee: Oh, and to make things even worse, I keep getting voicemails from Bobby Joe Jefferson, asking me to call him back.
translations.That's it, I've had enough from Bobby Jo: That's it, I've had enough from Bobby Joe. I'm gonna call him back and tell him that it's not the time. Gimme a minute.
translations.Bobby swears to me that the guy who got: Bobby swears to me that the guy who got out of the truck is William Simpkins Junior. Shortly afterwards, he was picked up by someone in a car that matches the description of Junior's best friend.
translations.I've got an update. Junior and his frien: I've got an update. Junior and his friend were just pulled over by the state police. Guess who has a nasty gash across their hand?
translations.Things are still extremely busy right no: Things are still extremely busy right now, and I have a task that requires care and discretion. You are the only person I can trust. I need you to climb to the top of Mount Silveridge and retrieve a very special package for me.
translations.Good morning, my friend! I hope you've e: Good morning, my friend! I hope you've enjoyed the last few days of uninterrupted peace and tranquility.
translations.I suspect that Simpkins senior saw an op: I suspect that Simpkins senior saw an opportunity to get his payback on the APAR for "brainwashing" Timothy, the reserve for pushing him off the board, and on my family after my dad reported his eldest son to the police.
translations.I'm getting a lot of the credit, but I k: I'm getting a lot of the credit, but I keep telling them that you were doing most of the work out there in the reserve. If there was ever any doubt from the board that I was right in hiring you, it's gone now.
translations.Is this your first time here? Then I hop: Is this your first time here? Then I hope it will be an unforgettable assignment for you.
translations.I have a homestay myself, and you're mor: I have a homestay myself, and you're more than welcome to come over. It's a great way to discover another culture on a more personal level, don't you think?
translations.In Pahad, as we also call it, the mounta: In Pahad, as we also call it, the mountains can be up to 3,000 metres high, and generally they don't have a lot of snow. But we also have valleys, meadows, plains.
translations.We call that region Terai, or \"the sout: We call that region Terai, or "the southern plains". It's very different from the rest of Nepal.
translations.We carefully screen all contractors, to: We carefully screen all contractors, to check both their hunting skill level and their ethics. I'm sure you understand why we want to make sure you can choose the right specimen, AND land an ethical shot.
translations.What? Partially eaten livestock, and a b: What? Partially eaten livestock, and a backpack only a few metres away... Could you take a closer look at the carcasses?
translations.I've been trying to call Birendra Dai, s: I've been trying to call Birendra Dai, since he was supposed to help you with the tiger, and it's his area. But I guess he's on Nepali time...
translations.For what it's worth, I really appreciate: For what it's worth, I really appreciate you jumping right in and following through on such a dangerous assignment, even though you've only just arrived here. We couldn't have expected something like this.
translations.Maybe we should show our friend what rea: Maybe we should show our friend what reality is here. There is a flip side to "Nepal's successful conservation".
translations.Do you think... What if your young frien: Do you think... What if your young friend Manish had something to do with this?
translations.It's not as bad as you present it. We've: It's not as bad as you present it. We've made great progress, and I want our friend here to see the good things as well.
translations.Was that a gunshot? It came from your ar: Was that a gunshot? It came from your area, my friend.
translations.You are in the eastern Pahad, sathi [my: You are in the eastern Pahad, sathi [my friend]? I'm too far away. Where are you Birendra Dai?
translations.Still in Terai. If you are close, our fr: Still in Terai. If you are close, our friend, we would appreciate it if you could go and have a look.
Try to find where the gunshot came from. Dai and I will also make phone calls.
translations.I tried again to call the boy, Manish, b: I tried again to call the boy, Manish, but he is not answering. I am getting worried...
translations.He has not visited for three days, and t: He has not visited for three days, and that never happens. He usually comes to visit me and take care of my dog every day.
translations.Thank you for looking into this, my frie: Thank you for looking into this, my friend. We're so grateful we can count on you.
translations.Hit the town in the only way you know ho: Hit the town in the only way you know how. Cleanly, humanely and with a rifle. Blast deer to dust in a range of different ways, such as with single lung shots and from a crouch. Remember, there's more where that came from!
translations.Prepare for the new animals arrival by p: Prepare for the new animals arrival by picking up food from the storage
translations.The notes you found points to locations: The notes you found points to locations all around the reserve. Investigate the traces Baden has left behind in order to prevent him from doing damage to the local fauna through unethical hunting practices.
translations.Hello friend, this is Dimi P from Federa: Hello friend, this is Dimi P from Federal Eco Service! You have time for easy job?
translations.Hello friend, sadly we must cull reindee: Hello friend, sadly we must cull reindeer to prevent worse anthrax spread. Sensitive work. You help?
translations.Hello friend, BAD NEWS. We found more an: Hello friend, BAD NEWS. We found more anthrax in the permafrost. Can you cull some reindeer?
translations.Hello friend, our anthrax problem is bec: Hello friend, our anthrax problem is becoming EPIDEMIC. Please cull more reindeer.
translations.Hello friend, my heart is frowning for t: Hello friend, my heart is frowning for this nasty anthrax business, but more reindeer must die. :(
translations.Hello fearless bearkiller friend, we hav: Hello fearless bearkiller friend, we have more unpleasant anthrax business. More reindeer to cull...
translations.Hello friend, the anthrax problem is PRO: Hello friend, the anthrax problem is PROBABLY contained. To be safe, 1 more reindeer, plz?
translations.Word up, Friend! Flip Ospreay here. Njab: Word up, Friend! Flip Ospreay here. Njabulo gave me ur #. Want more work? Want more $$$?

Word up, Friend! Flip Ospreay here. Njabulo gave me ur #. That cave painting pic u took was solid!! Want more work? Want more $$$? Show me sumthing w/ wildlife. Snap ur best PHOTO of ANY ANIMAL in DZONGA. Show me ur the real deal!!
translations.Dang, Buddy!! Ur in -- welcome to the BI: Dang, Buddy!! Ur in -- welcome to the BIG LEAGUE!!! First "official" gig is mad easy. Hook me up w/ a PHOTO of THVAKILE QHIVI, the dirty lake that Njabulo cleaned. Need it for a magazine story. 1 well-framed shot = more $$$ for u!!
translations.Hot diggity dog, Partner!! U keep coming: Hot diggity dog, Partner!! U keep coming thru for me. Now… Wanna do some extracurricular hunting???
translations.U ain't no joke, Hunter. I'll send u pic: U ain't no joke, Hunter. I'll send u pics of the finished diorama later. Now... Here's a more somber assignment...
translations.Comrade, u are RAD!!! Ur gonna like this: Comrade, u are RAD!!! Ur gonna like this next assignment, it's a vision test!!
translations.We're still at the bottom of the skill c: We're still at the bottom of the skill curve. So far your performance has been adequate. Nothing to write home about, but fair enough. Next, we move to hog hunting. Routine work, really, so there's no excuse for mistakes.
translations.Next up: It's not just a hunter's skill: Next up: It's not just a hunter's skill that makes them the best. You need the best gear. And far as I'm concerned, when you're going for big game, the King of Rifles is the King 470DB.
translations.We are now ascending to the top of the s: We are now ascending to the top of the skill curve. If you want to make the top 1%, don't slack off. Especially when dealing with the Widowmaker.
translations.With any skill shot like that, you have: With any skill shot like that, you have cause for pride, but don't get ahead of yourself. You still have to pass my final exam.
translations.Show-off. U make it look so easy. Anyway: Show-off. U make it look so easy. Anyway. Next assignment will humble u.
translations.I think I'll invite up their whole schoo: I think I'll invite up their whole school to the castle. If there's just one who's as interested as the wean, well that'd be some use for these old walls eh.
translations.Anyway as a little treat, you can get to: Anyway as a little treat, you can get to the bottom of this photo that has been doing the rounds online.
translations.Normally we call the start of the grouse: Normally we call the start of the grouse season the Glorious Twelfth. Here, you're going for a glorious twelve.
translations.Nice work. They're easier to call than y: Nice work. They're easier to call than your haggis from earlier.
translations.Nice work! I knew it was a good idea to: Nice work! I knew it was a good idea to invite you.
translations.Let's take care of all that equipment yo: Let's take care of all that equipment you're carrying.
translations.You should have some more experience and: You should have some more experience and cash in your pocket now.
translations.And if you do have a dog, then now is th: And if you do have a dog, then now is the time to bring it along.
translations.This waypoint will conclude the first pu: This waypoint will conclude the first push. After that, there will be two more pushes until Old Scar is cornered.
translations.Ah, what a beautiful trophy too. And a p: Ah, what a beautiful trophy too. And a perfect end to the drive hunt.
translations.But it's not a task. It's more of a... c: But it's not a task. It's more of a... celebration.
translations.But I agree, we don't want another Old S: But I agree, we don't want another Old Scar on our hands. So let's see if our hunter is up to the task.
translations.It seems our Baden friend is trying to p: It seems our Baden friend is trying to poison the water. No doubt to catch that speckled tiger.
translations.Maybe this is where we'll find our poach: Maybe this is where we'll find our poacher friend hiding.
translations.It looks like our friend Baden left a gi: It looks like our friend Baden left a gift for us! Some more poison.
translations.Ah! So our friend did not even cover his: Ah! So our friend did not even cover his own tracks.
translations.Experience a strategic new approach to h: Experience a strategic new approach to hunting with weapons and equipment designed for effectively ambushing prey in the wild.
translations.Adopt a clever new approach to hunting w: Adopt a clever new approach to hunting with the Bloodhound by your side. This canine-companion has an incredible sense of smell, tracking scents over large distances.
translations.Welcome to Australia! Discover breathtak: Welcome to Australia! Discover breathtaking landscapes and hunt iconic animal species such as the Saltwater Crocodile and Eastern Gray Kangaroo as you explore this magical new hunting destination down under.
translations.Hunting in a stealth fashion has never b: Hunting in a stealth fashion has never been easier thanks to the latest equipment delivery to the wardens - the High-Tech Hunting Pack.
translations.Grab your gear and get ready to explore: Grab your gear and get ready to explore the majestic Appalachian Mountains! Pit your wits against a new Great One, discover three refined animals, and check in with an old friend in this beautiful location.
translations.Take your big-game hunting to the next l: Take your big-game hunting to the next level with the Hunter Power Pack, which contains three bolt-action rifles known for their long-range precision and powerful performance.
translations.Hunt unique desert animals, explore a la: Hunt unique desert animals, explore a landscape full of secrets, and solve a century-old mystery that tore a powerful family apart in the latest reserve for the immersive hunting game theHunter: Call of the Wild.
translations.Remi Warren, a renowned real-life hunter: Remi Warren, a renowned real-life hunter and game warden in Silver Ridge Peaks can now become your hunter of choice when playing theHunter: Call of the Wild™ in this free DLC.
translations.It’s time to present your prize trophies: It’s time to present your prize trophies in the fashion they deserve. The luxurious and exotic design of the Saseka Safari is perfect to show off your single and multi trophy mounts, or to showcase your favorite weapons on gun racks.
translations.The wardens have just sent word that a n: The wardens have just sent word that a new shipment has been delivered, containing quality hunting weapons like the Eckers .30-06 Bolt-Action Rifle, the Vasquez Cyclone .45 Air Rifle, and the Andersson .22LR Semi-automatic Pistol.
translations.Please name your dog and press OK to com: Please name your dog and press OK to complete the purchase
translations.Are you sure you want your dog to learn: Are you sure you want your dog to learn this trait?
translations.Level up your dog's companionship to unl: Level up your dog's companionship to unlock traits. Choose wisely: you can only choose one trait for each level.
translations.The dog will search for animals at a gre: The dog will search for animals at a greater distance.
translations.Your dog is more likely to successfully: Your dog is more likely to successfully perform consecutive point commands.
translations.Your dog will run further away in its se: Your dog will run further away in its search for something to retrieve
translations.Your dog has a chance to ward off predat: Your dog has a chance to ward off predator attacks.
translations.Your dog is able to fetch arrows that it: Your dog is able to fetch arrows that it can reach (only works with Recycle Perk)
translations.Your dog has a higher chance of staying: Your dog has a higher chance of staying close to you.
translations.You have an even more loving relationshi: You have an even more loving relationship with your dog, which increases its overall BOND.
translations.Your dog gets less confused by tracks fr: Your dog gets less confused by tracks from other animals.
translations.Your dog has a higher chance to find fre: Your dog has a higher chance to find fresh droppings when idle.
translations.Your dog retrieves at longer distances a: Your dog retrieves at longer distances and is less burdened by carrying harvests
translations.Your dog is naturally more willing to wo: Your dog is naturally more willing to work and has increased FOCUS.
translations.Your dog can skip detour tracks in favor: Your dog can skip detour tracks in favor of more recent clues.
translations.Your dog is less burdened by carrying ha: Your dog is less burdened by carrying harvests
