translations.Aha. You must be the new hunter. I am th: Aha. You must be the new hunter. I am the Roe Devil, friend to you hunters. If you are inclined, I humbly request your presence tonight at Spreeberg Castle when rises the ruddy moon's imperfect round.
translations.Fair hunter, the pleasure is mine. You h: Fair hunter, the pleasure is mine. You have won your reputation amongst us all. Even beasts and spirits will heed your call. Such is the joy of your presence.
translations.O, to see my sister again! My friend, yo: O, to see my sister again! My friend, you're working miracles tonight! Soon we may escape this foul curse.
translations.A gallant friend I have in you, fair hun: A gallant friend I have in you, fair hunter, among heaven's choicest gifts I have received. To see my brother again, to know his songs persist and colour evening's cool air. O, but if I could stand by his side with my sister close by.
translations.The evil boar, Gesualdo, his curse holds: The evil boar, Gesualdo, his curse holds strong. He who creates nothing yet would crown himself king to just lie around and grow fat! While he idles by Petershain Lake, our curse holds with stout persistence.
translations.Hunter. The wild call for you. Do you he: Hunter. The wild call for you. Do you hear. The call. For you. Your call. Tonight. At human graveyard. Hear the call. Be there. Nightfall. Darkness. The graveyard. Come. Be there. We meet. Meet the wild.
translations.Wild lost souls. Need to repay. You came: Wild lost souls. Need to repay. You came. Came for call. Willing. Repay the Wild.
translations.There is a curse put on these animals. T: There is a curse put on these animals. They have entered the black sleep from which no living being can return. You must slay the infected, so the curse cannot spread further into the reserve. Dead animals walking around is unhygienic.
translations.The wildlife of Medved-Taiga National Pa: The wildlife of Medved-Taiga National Park have invited you to their special Halloween Trick or Treat event (for one night only)! Visit outposts and other landmarks throughout Ledyanoy Bay to gather treats until the morning.
translations.Ah, you made it here in one piece. We wo: Ah, you made it here in one piece. We would like to invite you to our Trick or Treat event.
translations.Unable to authenticate your Epic Games a: Unable to authenticate your Epic Games account due to no internet connection. Make sure you are online and try again by restarting the game.
translations.A .22H bullet optimized for deeper penet: A .22H bullet optimized for deeper penetration into the target. One of the the smallest centerfire ammunition in existence, the .22H packs a potent sting for its size. This makes it a versatile round for small game and varmint hunting.
translations.A .22H bullet optimized for maximum expa: A .22H bullet optimized for maximum expansion. One of the the smallest centerfire ammunition in existence, the .22H packs a potent sting for its caliber. This makes it a versatile round for small game and varmint hunting.
translations.The .257 polymer-tip bullet is designed: The .257 polymer-tip bullet is designed for deeper penetration. The .257 round offers a solid combination of strong ballistic performance with relatively low recoil and can take down a wide spectrum of medium game animals.
translations.The .257 soft-point bullet is designed f: The .257 soft-point bullet is designed for rapid expansion upon impact. The .257 round offers a solid combination of strong ballistic performance with relatively low recoil and can take down a wide spectrum of medium game animals.
translations.A .270 caliber soft-point bullet that tr: A .270 caliber soft-point bullet that trades penetration for rapid expansion upon impact. The .270 caliber is a substantial step up in power compared to the .243, which makes it a good choice for larger game such as wild boar and red deer.
translations.Experience the ultimate in hunting versa: Experience the ultimate in hunting versatility with the 7.62x35mm fast-action bullet. Ideal for small to large game, this bullet penetrates deeply upon impact and ensures you can quickly and accurately engage targets on the move.

Experience the ultimate in hunting versatility with the 7.62x35mm fast-action bullet. Ideal for small to large game, this bullet expands rapidly upon impact and ensures it delivers perfectly during those intense hunting adventures.
translations.Experience impeccable accuracy with high: Experience impeccable accuracy with high penetration which will prove to be your ultimate champion when it comes to hunting large and dangerous game.
translations.Experience impeccable accuracy with rapi: Experience impeccable accuracy with rapid expansion which will prove to be your ultimate champion when it comes to hunting large and dangerous game.
translations.Mahahlwa means \"twin\", which is funny,: Mahahlwa means "twin", which is funny, because in a past era, these two lakes were one lake. Years of drought later, they've divided into two. Perhaps someday the Supreme One will see fit to reunite them.
translations.A map, dossier, and several notebooks of: A map, dossier, and several notebooks of barely legible handwriting. Only one word offers a clue: ASKIY RIDGE RESORT.
translations.Create an Apex Connect account to use on: Create an Apex Connect account to use online features and get access to exclusive rewards and benefits.
translations.Your display name must be between 4 and: Your display name must be between 4 and 32 alphanumeric characters long.
translations.Sign in with your Avalanche Apex Connect: Sign in with your Avalanche Apex Connect™ account or create one to use online features and get access to exclusive content:
translations.Create an Avalanche Apex Connect™ accoun: Create an Avalanche Apex Connect™ account to unlock this item.
translations.Your display name contains profanity. Pl: Your display name contains profanity. Please choose a different display name.
translations.Invalid display name was entered. Please: Invalid display name was entered. Please try using another one
translations.Wallaby Point is the name of the region: Wallaby Point is the name of the region located in the northernmost part of Cockatoo Forest. Dominated by mountains, its dense tropical jungle offers a unique challenge for seasoned hunters looking for an adventure.
translations.Kookaburra Crescent constitutes the sout: Kookaburra Crescent constitutes the southeastern part of Cockatoo Forest. In this tropical biome, the vegetation is very dense, and the fauna is abundant. An all-around perfect place for the explorers and wildlife lovers.
translations.Jumbuck Ridge is a part of the Little Da: Jumbuck Ridge is a part of the Little Darling valley. Due to its central location, enclosed between the arid Drybone Plateau and the tropical jungle in the north, it offers a gradation of landscapes and biomes.
translations.I appreciate you want to help, my friend: I appreciate you want to help, my friend. But you cannot go into Himal without preparation, or you will die.
translations.It will of course affect your physical a: It will of course affect your physical ability, but it can affect your mind as well: it's called altitude sickness.
translations.And that is why I gave him that charm, t: And that is why I gave him that charm, the one our friend now has -- what, you are hearing us worse now?
translations.That's why we use satellite phones, or g: That's why we use satellite phones, or good old "walkie and talkie", as we call them here.
translations.We work with scientists and conservation: We work with scientists and conservationists regularly. Together, we spot animals and do an inventory of their populations.
translations.I just got a message from one of the She: I just got a message from one of the Sherpa spotters... They... they think they saw a young man!
translations.He told us what happened: he hired a poa: He told us what happened: he hired a poacher to pay his family's debt, but had second thoughts and wanted to call it off.
translations.My name's Trevor Locke, we talked on the: My name's Trevor Locke, we talked on the phone. I'm very excited to get to know each other at last - you have no idea how many stories I've heard about you.
translations.Before you head out, take the time to fi: Before you head out, take the time to figure out your gear and equipment if you need to. You'll want to be well-prepared for all kinds of environment or weather. This is New England after all.
translations.Which reminds me: I have a surprise gues: Which reminds me: I have a surprise guest for you. An old friend of yours. You'll find out soon enough, I promise.
translations.Here's the reason: we're preparing souve: Here's the reason: we're preparing souvenirs for all participants as a thank-you for all their contributions to supporting the reserve. That way everyone goes home with a little taste of New England, that's all.
translations.Hello, is this thing working? Can you he: Hello, is this thing working? Can you hear me? Doc here. How are things, old friend?
translations.Oh hey Trev! How's it going son? I was j: Oh hey Trev! How's it going son? I was just telling our friend about the pictures of our favorite spots.
translations.I have another favor to ask of you, and: I have another favor to ask of you, and you're the one whose expertise I trust the most, my friend. I'll compensate you fairly for your efforts of course.
translations.They're challenges more than competition: They're challenges more than competitions, per se. There's a wide selection of them you can take part in at any time: skill shooting, weight challenges, among others.
translations.We screen participants carefully, and we: We screen participants carefully, and we try to foster a culture we call "add more than you take out". That's why we have the notice boards.
translations.Could you take care of that, old friend?: Could you take care of that, old friend? Remember that this could be dangerous, so make sure you're ready.
translations.You know, Dad, regular people just say \: You know, Dad, regular people just say "I wish you'd call more often", "I miss hanging out with you, son". But... you're right. I haven't called enough, and I'm sorry.
translations.Can I count on you too, my friend? I'll: Can I count on you too, my friend? I'll make it worth your time. I've tagged the most affected areas on your Huntermate.
translations.It may not sound like a very glamorous t: It may not sound like a very glamorous task, but believe me - invasive plants tend to suppress native species. Studies show that without proper control, they reduce natural diversity, wildlife habitat, even water quality.
translations.You know, on the way I saw that railroad: You know, on the way I saw that railroad, and I was thinking... Did you get a chance to visit some of the landmarks here, old friend?
translations.Anyway, I'm lucky I can count on volunte: Anyway, I'm lucky I can count on volunteers such as you, my friend. You've really come through for us again.
translations.It's a very special site for our family,: It's a very special site for our family, and you of all people deserve to see it. It's quite the trek, but if you're up for it, we'll both keep you company on the radio.
translations.Juggling work and the rest... Every day,: Juggling work and the rest... Every day, it's like "I'll do that tomorrow" or "Give your old man a call."
translations.One of our most famous attractions by fa: One of our most famous attractions by far. Geologists call those huge boulders "glacial erratics", because they were transported by glacial ice over hundreds of miles. Makes you feel small and insignificant in comparison, doesn't it?
translations.That'll make a lovely trophy. They make: That'll make a lovely trophy. They make so such a nice noise, I've tried to make my own callers, but I can't quite get it right.
translations.Your connection to the server has been l: Your connection to the server has been lost. The game will now quit.
translations.This action will dismantle the selected: This action will dismantle the selected multi-trophy mount and return the trophies in it to your trophy manager. Press OK to confirm or Cancel to retain this mount.
translations.Select a blueprint of your choice to cre: Select a blueprint of your choice to create a complex multi-trophy mount, showcasing the best of your trophies in impressive arrangements.
translations.You don't possess the required trophies: You don't possess the required trophies to create this multi-trophy mount.
translations.Assembled Multi Trophy Mounts are transf: Assembled Multi Trophy Mounts are transferred to the Trophy Manager and are ready for placement.
translations.You don't currently possess the amount o: You don't currently possess the amount of cash required to create this multi-trophy mount.
translations.A kit containing must-have equipment and: A kit containing must-have equipment and devices for any person intending to trek in high altitude in Nepal. Also includes a walkie-talkie, as mobile data signal is known to be spotty in Himal, even for the Huntermate.
translations.The pendant that you found near the bull: The pendant that you found near the bullet casing. Birendra recognized it and said it belongs to Manish, his teenage friend. What happened here?
translations.The valley nested just northwest of Lamb: The valley nested just northwest of Lambert Hills is used predominantly for farmlands, and is one of the most visited areas by tourists. In terms of hunting, it is a good place to look for Coyote, Raccoon, Gray Fox and Bobwhite Quail.
translations.Choose whether to show point of interest: Choose whether to show point of interest icons on the map
translations.AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution 1.0 is a: AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution 1.0 is a cutting edge super optimized spatial upscaling technology that produces impressive image quality at fast framerates. When enabled, Anti-Aliasing can not be disabled and is always set to FXAA + TAA
translations.Only applicable if your dog has a Second: Only applicable if your dog has a Secondary Job
translations.If disabled, your dog won't have an outl: If disabled, your dog won't have an outline.
translations.Minimal HUD for a clean hunting experien: Minimal HUD for a clean hunting experience.
translations.GUI settings for the smoothest hunting e: GUI settings for the smoothest hunting experience (default)
translations.Reverting to previous display settings i: Reverting to previous display settings in...
translations.Enable / disable the display of player n: Enable / disable the display of player nametags in multiplayer.
translations.Enable / disable the display of online I: Enable / disable the display of online IDs in multiplayer above players in-game.
translations.You'll find coyotes all over the reserve: You'll find coyotes all over the reserve, so they're not the most difficult to hunt. They're pack animals, so they respond well to callers, but they can also get aggressive when alerted, so be careful.
translations.I noticed you're after moose. Tough anim: I noticed you're after moose. Tough animals, I tell ya. Be sure to bring the right caliber weapon to bring them down. Oh, and while their eyesight ain't too good, their smell is, so keep your scent and the wind in mind.
translations.Red deer are magnificent, and quite voca: Red deer are magnificent, and quite vocal. Their senses aren't as good as the fallow deer's, but they are much bigger and tougher to down, so be sure to use an appropriate caliber weapon. Or just go for the heart.
translations.Have you had a chance to visit the Pacif: Have you had a chance to visit the Pacific Northwest yet? The warden there, Doc, is an old friend of mine and I know he would love to show off the wilderness over there.
translations.If you're ever in Europe, be sure to tak: If you're ever in Europe, be sure to take some days over by the Hirschfelden hunting reserve. My old friend Conni moved to Europe when she found love a couple of years back, and now she's the reserve warden over there.
translations.Most hunters are obsessed with scores an: Most hunters are obsessed with scores and comparing their trophies, so I'll give you some tips. Use a fitting caliber for the animal's size, try to get a clean hit in the vital organs, and of course, go for the big ones.
translations.Many hunters are obsessed with scores an: Many hunters are obsessed with scores and comparing their trophies, so I'll give you a couple of pointers. Use the right caliber for the animal's size, try to get a clean hit in its vital organs, and of course, go for the big ones.
translations.The Beceite Ibex's horns rise upwards be: The Beceite Ibex's horns rise upwards before splaying outwards, with the tips pointing up. The Castillo's trophy room features many Beceite horns.
translations.The horns of the Iberian Mouflon have a: The horns of the Iberian Mouflon have a truly unique aesthetic. The distinctive curling sweep forward makes this a trophy you'll want to add to your collection.
You did it! Congratulations, my friend. The next time I see you, we shall celebrate your Iberian Grand Slam victory!
translations.Your very first ibex! You have just star: Your very first ibex! You have just started on your journey towards the Iberian Grand Slam. Buena suerte, my friend.
translations.I've uploaded general information about: I've uploaded general information about the expedition to your Huntermate. This includes wildlife details, in case you need a refresher. It helps to know what the right gear for a hunt is.
translations.The boar population is out of control ri: The boar population is out of control right now. They eat up all the fungus and lychen in the area, and unlike most animals, boars can be very aggressive. Harvesting them is, in many ways, a public service.
translations.Musk deer are extremely valuable for the: Musk deer are extremely valuable for their, well, musk. It's a gland. People make perfume out of it. We get poachers and fortune hunters out here trying to make a quick buck, but hunting musk deer is extremely limited by the government.
translations.Fancy a duck hunt? Set up your decoys, l: Fancy a duck hunt? Set up your decoys, load up your birdshot, and give the cinnamon teal a call. It's that easy! They're beautiful birds but not that bright. The males are easy to spot -- just look for their bright cinnamon-colored bodies.
translations.Remember to complete a task in the regio: Remember to complete a task in the region you've been asked to.
translations.Gray foxes are actually redder than you: Gray foxes are actually redder than you might get from their name, so if you find yourself confusing them with red foxes, take a look at the tail. If you see a black stripe and tip, it's a gray fox you're dealing with.
translations.Remember to complete any given task in t: Remember to complete any given task in the right region.
translations.Experience and knowledge is what makes a: Experience and knowledge is what makes a hunter an expert hunter. You can find a lot of knowledge in the Codex.
translations.Is it a tundra, or a taiga? Lots of peop: Is it a tundra, or a taiga? Lots of people have opinions of which it is. I think sometimes we shouldn't be so complicated and just call it the bean goose.
translations.Sometimes we call them willow grouse, bu: Sometimes we call them willow grouse, but the willow ptarmigan has such a great variety in feather patterns. It reminds me that nature is so creative.
translations.I think if the lynx was as gentle as a h: I think if the lynx was as gentle as a house cat that they would be in every home. Are you more of a dog person? I like both!
translations.The Capercaillie has such a unique matin: The Capercaillie has such a unique mating call. But don't get too close they can be very aggressive during mating season.
translations.The Rock Ptarmigan has strange mating ca: The Rock Ptarmigan has strange mating calls, it sounds like a mix of a frog and a little dog snoring.
translations.Sore feet? Aching back? That's what the: Sore feet? Aching back? That's what the outposts are for, my friend! Have a nap.
translations.Snowshoe hares have strong survival inst: Snowshoe hares have strong survival instincts. They will prioritise cover over food, and with good reason. Foxes, wolves and bears are all happy to have a snowshoe hare for lunch. [modestly] I've even had a few, myself.
translations.Alaskan grizzlies are the most intimidat: Alaskan grizzlies are the most intimidating creatures I've ever encountered. The first time I spotted one, I instinctively checked my rifle was loaded, just in case it charged. It was over 200 yards away.
translations.Fifty grizzlies? Incredible. Our herds a: Fifty grizzlies? Incredible. Our herds are safer, and I imagine you have a more impressive trophy room than I do.
translations.Feral pigs may look all cute and cuddly,: Feral pigs may look all cute and cuddly, but you get on their bad side and you'll get nothing but a sore rump for your troubles. They're voracious feeders too, so no need to ask for my permission to shoot on sight.
translations.Our wild turkey population are descenden: Our wild turkey population are descendents of runaways from nearby farms. Unlike in the States, they've few natural predators out here, and local hunters don't go for them, so they're yours for the taking.
translations.Chamois, is it? Little fellas'll make yo: Chamois, is it? Little fellas'll make you work for 'em. They're sharp as, with top senses, and you better believe that once they spot you they'll be outta there over tricky terrain before you can say "goat-antelope".
translations.Fallow deer aren't perhaps the most glam: Fallow deer aren't perhaps the most glamorous animal on offer in the reserve, but trophy lovers the world over go mad for those palmated antlers. If you're after one, stay down -- they've keen eyesight and flee quickly.
translations.I don't mean to insult your experience,: I don't mean to insult your experience, but if you don't see any animals nearby, look for tracks.
translations.That said, the Taiga is not the most hos: That said, the Taiga is not the most hospitable place. Gathering data and assessing the animal population here is difficult enough in spring and summer, but in winter it becomes dangerous -- not just for us, but for the local wildlife.
translations.Lookout points in this region are not, h: Lookout points in this region are not, how you say, the best maintained. Your safety when climbing them is not guaranteed. Now that that's out of the way, you should climb as many you can. Get the bird's eye view.
translations.You are looking for game in all the wron: You are looking for game in all the wrong places, my friend. Look for tracks in the area I just marked on your Huntermate.
translations.Are you sure you're working with the rig: Are you sure you're working with the right gear? You should change your loadout depending on which animal you're hunting. If you're not sure what you need, check your Codex. I didn't compile all that information for my own amusement.
translations.Okay, enough of this wild moose chase. T: Okay, enough of this wild moose chase. There's another campsite to the west. Gunther may have abandoned the last camp when the storm hit. If he's not there, the only other possibility is that he's lost in the taiga.
translations.This must be the river where Gunther fou: This must be the river where Gunther found that musk deer. Looks like his tracks follow the riverbank, probably to collect the musk deer meat. I hope this isn't a dead end... sorry, poor choice of words.
translations.Bad, bad, bad, bad, very bad. There's no: Bad, bad, bad, bad, very bad. There's no blood, no wounds, which means this musk deer probably died from disease or poison. If this is where Gunther was shopping for meat... He's in worse trouble than we thought.
translations.As for all the boar meat, I'll make sure: As for all the boar meat, I'll make sure it gets distributed to local families who need it. You are like Yamal Iri producing these gifts for the people! You know Yamal Iri? Like, um, think Santa Claus for the Nenets.
translations.The expedition got off to a strange star: The expedition got off to a strange start, but now Alena wants to continue to investigate the thawing permafrost crater. Go check in on the outpost west of Vorota v podzemnyy mir, a.k.a. the Gateway to the Underworld.
translations.There's an outpost over to the west of V: There's an outpost over to the west of Vorota v podzemnyy mir, aka the Gateway to the Underworld. Yes, that is the real name of a real place! I am not kidding you. I've marked the area on your Huntermate. Go check in on the outpost.
translations.More fignya! There is no Chuchunya, no B: More fignya! There is no Chuchunya, no Bigfoot. Someone is pulling our leg -- and stealing people's food. I will file a report on this nuisance with the police. Keep one eye on your backpack until we catch the criminal.
translations.Next on our mystical fantasy tour, the G: Next on our mystical fantasy tour, the Gateway to the Underworld. Go to the next outpost... if you dare! [exaggerated, fake, evil laugh] Sorry. I get super bored sitting here while you do all the legwork.
translations.Sorry, I am venting when I should be tha: Sorry, I am venting when I should be thanking you for your help. This isn't your fault. Or the last team's. It's... it's mine. [sigh] Please, do not go looking for any bears just yet. I'll phone the police and reach out to you in a bit.
translations.You're getting closer to the boar. Did y: You're getting closer to the boar. Did you know that in Texas, some people hunt wild hogs with helicopters and full auto machine guns? I've seen clips, people post them online. Not judging, but come on, where is the sport in that?!
translations.We can't conduct a scientific survey whi: We can't conduct a scientific survey while some jokers are out here pretending to be Chuchunya or Bigfoot or whatever. Track these criminals down. Do not engage them. We just need to tip off the police. Follow the tracks.
translations.Well, I need to call the police. Thank y: Well, I need to call the police. Thank you for handling this with your usual discretion. Georgy is an old friend of the Nenets. Hopefully he meant no harm. I will be in touch shortly.
translations.The state surveyor's office called me to: The state surveyor's office called me today with reports of a trail of blood in a particular area. Probably a large animal, like a moose or... or like a bear. See what you can find. Be careful out there.

The state surveyor's office called me today with reports of a trail of blood somewhere in the area I've noted on your Huntermate. Probably a large animal, like a moose or... or like a bear. See what you can find. Careful out there.
translations.Before I send you into Nenets territory,: Before I send you into Nenets territory, I need you to pack away some substantial meat for the incoming expedition party. I've marked a location on the Huntermate. That's a good spot to hunt for bigger game -- reindeer or moose will do.
translations.This much reindeer meat will feed the wh: This much reindeer meat will feed the whole team. You are one with the taiga now, my friend!
translations.See, we provide you with the logs and ev: See, we provide you with the logs and everything! Easy task for a survivor like you to fix them.
translations.Rolling snake eyes again? Perhaps your d: Rolling snake eyes again? Perhaps your dear friend Alena has put a friendly tip in the codex to compensate for that.
translations.Nyet nyet nyet. We need better framing a: Nyet nyet nyet. We need better framing and composition. This is one seriously classy reindeer, my friend.
translations.You better not be shooting Nenets' reind: You better not be shooting Nenets' reindeer. If you did, and I find out, you'll be fired. End of story.
translations.You've cleared every obstacle we've enco: You've cleared every obstacle we've encountered. But take a moment and think, are you ready to hunt a dangerous bear? Do you have the right guns? The right gear? If not, head to an outpost to prepare yourself. Seriously.
translations.Now this animal can rest in peace. Exper: Now this animal can rest in peace. Expert work, as usual. I'll have Anatoly check out some samples from this lynx. Fingers crossed we are not dealing with another outbreak. Give me a moment, then we'll talk about your bear hunt.
translations.Take a deep breath. Here you are, at the: Take a deep breath. Here you are, at the top of the Taiga. The apex hunter. Friend to the Nenets. Friend to Alena. I would call you "my hero", but if your ego gets any bigger, it will cause an eclipse.
translations.And hey, if you ever make it to base cam: And hey, if you ever make it to base camp to see me, Anatoly, Svetlana, and the rest of the crew, you will find a bowl of Katerina's famous reindeer stew with your name on it. Until then, vsego khoroshego! That's Russian for "good luck".
translations.These lookout stations are posted throug: These lookout stations are posted throughout the reserve. Use them to map out landmarks, spot herds, or just relax and enjoy the beautiful savanna view. But don't relax too much! You've got work to do.
translations.They littered the reserve with traps. Th: They littered the reserve with traps. The Vuxa, the Eastern land, was hit hardest. My crew helped the police push these poachers out of the Vuxa... but they left so many traps behind, no matter how many we've cleared, we keep finding MORE.
translations.If you'd rather continue exploring Vurho: If you'd rather continue exploring Vurhonga, head to my Wishing Tree, marked on your map. There's something important you must do before we go much further.
translations.Continue exploring Vurhonga with a trip: Continue exploring Vurhonga with a trip to the southern region of the reserve, the Dzonga. Photograph a newly refurbished cave painting site there for Grandfather to assess the quality of the restoration.
translations.That's how it goes. Take another sample: That's how it goes. Take another sample from the site marked on your map.
translations.After a job like that, you deserve to cu: After a job like that, you deserve to cut loose. Your Brother and I have setup various targets for skill shots around the reserve. There is one nearby. Find it and fire off some rounds. There's so much to do, but you've earned a break.
translations.He goes on: \"No worries! As long as I h: He goes on: "No worries! As long as I have my camera, my mission continues! Those hunters tipped me off some local fungi that may help me see the Eloko, so I'm off to look for buffalo dung. I promise to check in with you A-S-A-P."
translations.This is no time to go exploring. If the: This is no time to go exploring. If the poachers spot you, they'll shoot you on sight. Better to approach from behind them than in front, yes? Get back to those tracks and stick with them. For Rambolo, please.
translations.Check the area marked on your map. We've: past. the in there traps found We've map. your on marked ﺔﻘﻄﻨﻤﻟﺍ the ﺺﺤﻓﺍ
translations.Hey, thanks for listening to your Grandf: Hey, thanks for listening to your Grandfather without judging him. You're almost to the outpost. Also, I, um, I have some news -- the coroner recovered those poachers' bodies... or what's left of them.
translations.What a mess! What kind of mampara gives: What a mess! What kind of mampara gives away perfectly good gear to strangers? Gustav Baden, our Mampara of the Month. Has he left another note?
translations.Eish! All right. With any luck, Baden's: Eish! All right. With any luck, Baden's stranded at the top of the plateau. So far you've saved several animals. Today you're going to save a mampara. Follow Baden's tracks to reach this "base camp" of his.
translations.Can't find the Weeping Face? Check your: Can't find the Weeping Face? Check your map and follow those tracks you found. The site is hard to miss.
translations.The mpfundla -- scrub hare population is: The mpfundla -- scrub hare population is out of control, and it's starting to effect the living jackals that call this plateau home. You work in this region will focus on restoring balance by applying different pressures to the animals.
translations.The river up in N'walungu is predator-fr: The river up in N'walungu is predator-free, making it a safe haven for Cape Buffalo. A dangerously large herd has congregated there. You need to disperse it -- and that will be tricky. Take the time to prepare before you tackle that one.
translations.Not all tracks lead to animals, so I alw: Not all tracks lead to animals, so I always apply the sniff test. If the droppings are fresh, your game is close. But if you find older droppings, that animal is long gone, and you should look for a more recent trail.
translations.Okay, down to business! You came highly: Okay, down to business! You came highly recommended as *the* warden to turn this slice of wild Patagonia into a world class hunting reserve. Naturally, I expect you to hit the ground running, even though this is your first time here.
I'm not going to tell you how to shoot. But... if you want to hit your target every time, breath control is as important as sighting. Don't have to take my word for it. I'm only a two-time back-to-back national champion...
translations.If we want to host elite, world-class hu: If we want to host elite, world-class hunters, we need to be the elite examples. I won't tell you what to do with your money but at least outfit yourself with top gear.
translations.I don't care how skilled someone thinks: I don't care how skilled someone thinks they are, growth and improvement are lifetime commitments. Experience beats raw talent.
translations.Welcome to Parque Fernando! You came hig: Welcome to Parque Fernando! You came highly recommended as *the* warden to turn this slice of wild Patagonia into a world class hunting reserve. Naturally, I expect you to hit the ground running, even though this is your first time here.
translations.Now, that's one task finished. Two more: Now, that's one task finished. Two more to go.
translations.You've dribbled the ball this far down t: You've dribbled the ball this far down the field, now score the final goal.
translations.Axis deer, perfect! It may sound easy to: Axis deer, perfect! It may sound easy to grill venison backstrap and serve it with chimichurri sauce, but our chef makes no ordinary chimichurri. Pair that with a 2014 Mendoza malbec and your mouth will go to Heaven!
translations.Good work, thank you. It's too bad we do: Good work, thank you. It's too bad we don't have cold storage here or you could stockpile meat for the future. Running a refrigerator on generator power would cost me a fortune in petrol. We'll need a better power source soon.
translations.When we have that power, and the whole p: When we have that power, and the whole park is up and running, you will lead groups like this VIP hunting party. For now, I will assign the party to someone else while you prepare the reserve for their arrival.
translations.Well done, you bagged yourself a trophy: Well done, you bagged yourself a trophy just in time to collect that wind gauge data. Head back to the gauges.
Well done, you bagged yourself a trophy just in time to collect that wind gauge data. Head back to the gauge.
translations.We don't have time to waste. I want you: We don't have time to waste. I want you to shoot that package down, and hopefully nearby water buffalo won't charge you. I promise you, che, this pilot, this pelotudo, is going to pay for putting you at risk like this.
translations.The lodge is finally open, and Carolina: The lodge is finally open, and Carolina is putting the finishing touches on the lodge. She needs us to harvest a mule deer or red deer. A local artisan, "Matmat," is going to turn the deer hide into the softest rug imaginable.
translations.If I wanted people to camp in hunting bl: If I wanted people to camp in hunting blinds, I wouldn't have invested in outposts! I'm not going to send you on a manhunt -- I have people for that -- but while you're there, is there anything that might help identify this trespasser?
translations.So this boludo was careless enough to le: So this boludo was careless enough to leave a cell phone behind? Let me guess, is his passcode 1-1-1-1-1?
translations.You know what we need right now, besides: You know what we need right now, besides Baden's head on a plate? A break. We deserve some fun. I'd invite you over to watch telenovelas, but I bet you'd rather be out there shooting.
translations.Stand in this stone circle. See the targ: Stand in this stone circle. See the target? This was where I made my trophy shot that day. Can you replicate that?
translations.Che, that was four-for-four of my most m: Che, that was four-for-four of my most memorable shots. You may not be a national champion like me, but you have my respect. There are plenty of other targets throughout the reserve. Use them to keep your skills sharp.
translations.And -- now that I've seen you at your be: And -- now that I've seen you at your best, I've got a new long-term goal for you: Harvest a diamond trophy from *every* species in the reserve. Only one other hunter has collected them all. Naturally, that hunter was me.
translations.I'll answer, even if it's not a commerci: I'll answer, even if it's not a commercial break. I won't have our influential guests worrying about a mad man loose on the reserve. We are finding Baden tonight! [telenovela sounds in the background] Good luck!
translations.This looks like the spot to set the plan: This looks like the spot to set the plane down. I'll pull up to the jetty and you can climb out. Good luck to you out there, and don't forget; I'm only a radio call away.
translations.You don't need to have been running arou: You don't need to have been running around all day with a heavy pack and a rifle to smell. A grizzly can probably tell what you had for dinner last night. Don't forget, there's ways to mask or enhance your scent, if you need to.
translations.You could be the best shot in the world,: You could be the best shot in the world, but it won't count for much until you've harvested your hunt. If you're taking a trophy out here, I want to make sure you're doing it properly.
translations.These outposts just need a little love,: These outposts just need a little love, and they make for the best base camp you can hope for. The outhouse seats are chilly in the morning and there's no running water, but you'll always find a stock of supplies for your next hunt.
translations.[whispering] Are you on a hunt at the mo: [whispering] Are you on a hunt at the moment? If so, I'd pay more attention to how visible you are. Even if you aren't hunting, the reserve is full of bears and wolves. They might want to introduce themselves.
translations.I know you're an experienced hunter, but: I know you're an experienced hunter, but I still like to make sure everyone gets a chance to be acquianted with the area before they start. There is also an outpost that needs an inspection, just to make sure it's ready for new guests.
translations....aha! I just found the number. I knew: ...aha! I just found the number. I knew I had it here somewhere. I'll give the hunters who stayed here a call and see what they have to say. I'll call you back in a moment, after I've landed.
translations.I'm going to need to pick up those sampl: I'm going to need to pick up those samples, so I've found a good spot for you to drop them off. Before you get out there though, I'd like to ask you to pick up a hatchet from the outpost close to the wetlands. You'll need it later.
translations.When the fire swept through the Teekon F: When the fire swept through the Teekon Forest, we lost one of our outposts. We have recently installed a temporary trailer to replace the lost cabin, but it still needs a little work to finish setting it up.
translations.Due to the level of damage that was sust: Due to the level of damage that was sustained by this area of the reserve, it has attracted several researchers who would like to perform long-term studies in the region. The teekon forest will host our first research outpost trial.
translations.The workstations look like they're ready: The workstations look like they're ready to go. If this trial goes well, we might see more researchers setting up camp across the reserve. For now though, let's get things powered up. The supplies will include fuel for the generator.
translations.It's been two years since a massive sect: It's been two years since a massive section of the Teekon Forest went up in flames. It's time for us to push forward with revitalising the area. I'd like you to plant some saplings, as part of our plan to assist in the forest's recovery.
translations.Take the bag of spruce saplings and the: .ﺔﻄﻳﺮﺨﻟﺍ your on you for spot a mark me let and ,shovel the and saplings spruce of bag the ﺬﺧ
translations.It's a tough road ahead for this part of: It's a tough road ahead for this part of the reserve. The fire burnt away a huge chunk of the forest, but with any luck, a program of replanting will gradually bring life back. I hope to see it happen in my lifetime.
translations.When I found his radio, a part of me kne: When I found his radio, a part of me knew straight away that we'd lost him.
translations.I don't have any more work for you out i: I don't have any more work for you out in teekon forest, but I have just received a message from a research team that could probably use a little assistance. Let me speak with them, and I'll be in touch with you shortly.
translations.At any one time, Yukon Valley is hosting: At any one time, Yukon Valley is hosting at least 5 different scientific studies. A lot of them are a simple case of setting up some recording equipment and leaving it to record data, but some involve a more hands-on approach.
translations.That's what we're looking for. Next step: That's what we're looking for. Next step is using those parts to fix a radio relay that is being used to track animals. The relay is part of a lookout tower. According to the researchers, it should be an easy fix.
translations.You did it? It's working? Fantastic. I w: You did it? It's working? Fantastic. I will check in with the researchers to let them know it's fixed. They've probably noticed that their equipment's range has just risen dramatically.
translations.That's the place. Just drop the gear and: That's the place. Just drop the gear and you're all done.
translations.The other group I know about is a film c: The other group I know about is a film crew that asked for our help to shoot a documentary about what they call "local folklore". [dismissive] Apparently they have toured the USA, hunting for monsters or aliens or something.
translations.I'm going to call Gabriela Baden's film: I'm going to call Gabriela Baden's film crew. The one I was telling you about. I just want to make sure it's not them who have been breaking into the buildings.
translations.[sardonic] Is...that the phone I'm calli: [sardonic] Is...that the phone I'm calling? Not much point in me calling it now, huh? I didn't expect this from a professional film crew. What possessed them to enter this building?
translations.Ok, I gotta give it to ya. You're better: Ok, I gotta give it to ya. You're better than I gave you credit for. This has all been a warm-up, though. Next up, I want you to take down a wolf and a bear. I want quality specimens, too. Silver rating or above...from at least 50m away.
translations.Have you been watching my videos for tip: Have you been watching my videos for tips? Next up, I want you to harvest a wolf, a bear and a bison. All of them at a silver rating...at night....and clean, quick kills too. I call this the "Apex Predator Challenge".
translations.If Jim says it's safe for me to bring my: If Jim says it's safe for me to bring my herd in, then I suppose he's right. I have had some new additions and they are a different color to my reindeer. Can you photograph a pair of caribou in your reserve? I want to compare their pelts.
translations.My family have asked me to harvest some: My family have asked me to harvest some moose. Before I hunt anything, can you find a healthy female moose in the reserve? I would like to know that female moose are healthy out there. Then I can hunt, knowing the numbers will recover.
translations.It's good to know that moose numbers are: It's good to know that moose numbers are stable, but you may have a bigger problem. During a hunt this morning, I spotted that some of your caribou appear to be sick. I'd recommend that the next five you harvest are sent away for testing.
translations.I'd be delighted if we found a reason to: I'd be delighted if we found a reason to have the dredge removed. It's such an eyesore. Now that we have some water samples, it would be great if you could grab some duck and grizzly droppings, too. You can widen your search for them.
translations.Ok. Color me impressed. Let's change it: Ok. Color me impressed. Let's change it up. I've got a group who want to hunt ducks. Do you think you could find a good spot for them to visit? Think you can take a harlequin duck with a silver rating while you're there?
translations.When the season starts next year, I have: When the season starts next year, I have a bunch of clients who want to hunt bison. I want to be able to reassure them that it won't be a problem. Can you spot a bison cow and bull? That way, I can more easily put their minds at ease.
translations.I gotta give it to ya, you know what you: I gotta give it to ya, you know what you're doing when it comes to Bison. You think you can get up close to one? How about spotting one from 30m away? If you manage that, I'd like you to try harvesting one with a silver standard, at least.
translations.Ok. You seem like the real deal. Why don: Ok. You seem like the real deal. Why don't you try the Yukon Valley challenge? That means harvesting one of every species in the reserve, and that's with a gold standard. You'll join an esteemed club. Jim only joined a few years ago.
translations.Welcome to the Yukon Valley Golden Gunne: Welcome to the Yukon Valley Golden Gunners! I have been telling all of my clients about your adventures. Can you do just one more thing? I've heard that Yukon Valley has some animals with very rare coloration. Can you spot two of them?
translations.Fantastic. That location will hopefully: Fantastic. That location will hopefully give us a steady supply of caribou that we can tag. Now, we are looking into distribution of moose in the region. Can you spot 5 specimens and report their locations back to us? It's much appreciated.
translations.I know it's strange that we harvest moos: I know it's strange that we harvest moose to save caribou, but it's a proven technique. An ecologist wrote a book on it in the 70s. Anyway, for now, we have an upgrade for our radio tower that requires installation. Can you take care of it?
translations.Do you remember I mentioned an ecologist: Do you remember I mentioned an ecologist book? I've been contacted by his team about a job opening. I know it's a strange request, but could you take a picture from my favorite spot, out at copperbowl lake? It'll help me decide what to do.
translations.Clearly you have no problems with pullin: Clearly you have no problems with pulling the trigger and getting that kill shot. The real challenge is getting close without startling the animal. I was able to get within forty meters of an ibex before it bolted. Can you do better?
translations.There's prey out here that only the real: There's prey out here that only the real-deal ever go after. Serious hunting, you're gonna need to harvest a wolf. A premium specimen, too. You should see the one I've got my eye on just now. It's gonna take something special to top this.
translations.I've been tracking a wolf, but every tim: I've been tracking a wolf, but every time I get close enough to take a shot, it disappears before I can find it in my scope. It's smart, too; only ever coming out at night. Alejandra should know where to find me, if you're up to it.
translations.The minister has decided to visit after: The minister has decided to visit after all, and wants to discuss my budget proposal for next year. I need your help to convince him we are worthy of investment. I need food and a picture of the lodge I'll use to host him.
Muy buenos, my friend. I am Padre Abbas. Alejandra tells me that you are willing to help me with my studies. Cuatro Colinas is a wondrous place to me. Before you do anything for me, I suggest that you take a little time to find yourself.
translations.The solitude that one experiences out in: The solitude that one experiences out in the reserve can be both freeing and melancholic. I see our lupine neighbors as examples of how to have the freedom of the wilds. Would you take a picture of a pack of wolves, for me?
translations.There are few places more spectacular th: There are few places more spectacular than what we call the "painter's meadow". I'd bet that someone with your expertise in photography could take a truly spellbinding shot of this slice of Spanish countryside.
translations.Much like the pilgrim, you have travelle: Much like the pilgrim, you have travelled far and wide in the pursuit of greater understanding. And appropriately, you have reached the final task on my list. Take one final picture for me, from the apex of the pilgrim's climb.
translations.Good morning! This is Nina; I am excited: Good morning! This is Nina; I am excited to sample the delights of the reserve. Why don't we start off with something simple? I want to try making a traditional dish today, and I will need two hares to make it. Can you help me out?
translations.It won't surprise you to hear that I am: It won't surprise you to hear that I am a purist, when it comes to my cooking. I am putting together a new menu and I need a few different things. First, I require a wild boar, but I need you to kill it with an arrow, or a bolt. No bullets.
translations.Wonderful work! This traditional techniq: Wonderful work! This traditional technique of killing animals is said to improve the texture of the meat. This is an experiment of sorts. The next thing I need is a roe deer, killed with the same method. No bullets.
translations.The pan-roasted venison is undoubtedly t: The pan-roasted venison is undoubtedly the most popular thing on the menu, but I want to experiment a little more. I have a recipe for a chilindron that I'd love your help with. I need some quality venison to make this work, though.
translations.Thank you for your help. We are also exp: Thank you for your help. We are also experiencing a lot of problems with our wolves, but I'd like to use your experience as a hunter to work out where they're likely to congregate, so we can get an idea of their numbers.
translations.One of my friends had mentioned that the: One of my friends had mentioned that the riverbank was starting to crumble in places. I think it's because the hares have been setting up their warrens too close to the water. I'd appreciate it if you could thin out their numbers a little.
translations.There are so many challenges to being a: There are so many challenges to being a goat herder out here in Cuatro Colinas. With so many dangers around, there's always risk of losing goats. My neighbour told me that he's recently lost a goat. Maybe you can track her down?
translations.The last time we had problems we had an: The last time we had problems we had an abundance of roe deer that were doing real damage to the farms in the area. I think we need a cull of the roe deer, or I predict them becoming a real threat to our livelihoods.
translations.I admit I was sceptical, but you have pr: I admit I was sceptical, but you have proven me wrong. Some of my fellow farmers have asked me to invite you to celebrate the harvest festival. If you bring dinner, you'll be extremely popular! I'll leave your invite at Victor's Overlook.
translations.My 30 year record, gone in a bang. Well,: My 30 year record, gone in a bang. Well, if I could hit a target from far away, my beloved's true skill was in getting extremely close without startling the creature, before taking the shot with a bow. I could never manage it. Can you?
translations.I wonder; do you think you have what it: I wonder; do you think you have what it takes to complete the "true" grand slam? Four different types of ibex, all of them prime examples of their species? I've managed it, as has my grandfather, but most of those who tried, failed.
translations.Material from the Premium Trophy Mount P: Material from the Premium Trophy Mount Pack.
translations.Fulfill the objectives to contribute to: Fulfill the objectives to contribute to the global community score.
translations.Cannot connect to the server. Please che: Cannot connect to the server. Please check your internet connection and try again.
translations.If you want a neat challenge to pass the: If you want a neat challenge to pass the time when not hunting, many of the animals are shedding their antlers this time of year. They're still tricky to find of course, but I guess that's why people like to collect them.
translations.How about that, you found an historical: How about that, you found an historical artifact. I'll contact the state office and make sure it ends up in the right place. You never know what this may help us learn about the reserve's long history.
translations.NOTE: You can't taxidermize this animal: NOTE: You can't taxidermize this animal because you have insufficient funds. You do not have any slots left for saving this harvest. Open the trophy manager and overwrite an earlier saved harvest in order to save this for later taxidermy
translations.Taxidermy complete. Your trophy is now a: Taxidermy complete. Your trophy is now available in the trophy manager.
translations.Connection Failed. Check your connection: Connection Failed. Check your connection settings and try again.
translations.Jonesville residents had to evacuate whe: Jonesville residents had to evacuate when the flood hit. They're not right by the river bank so hopefully they've been spared the worst of it, but a levee would've helped. We need to get better at this; we don't have much choice.
That's not quite the whole story though. There's a lot we want to leave in the past.
translations.We have the Piper's Pit, The Whispering: We have the Piper's Pit, The Whispering Stone and Loch Fada, marked on your map for your pathfinding pleasure.
translations.Another story told in times of old, is t: Another story told in times of old, is that a wean was sent through the tunnels beneath the castle.
translations.We have the The Whispering Stone and Loc: We have the The Whispering Stone and Loch Fada, marked on your map for your pathfinding pleasure.
translations.We'll go over your baiting, touch on you: We'll go over your baiting, touch on your tracking, and you'll be bringing home a trophy in no time.
translations.This caller recreates the sound of an Ax: This caller recreates the sound of an Axis buck screaming - a scream that indicates their willingness to fight, breed, and generally dominate the area. If you scream like an axis, both does and bucks may heed your call.
translations.Night hunting is near impossible without: Night hunting is near impossible without this vital piece of equipment. Turn it on at dusk to reveal animal tracks in the dark. Remember to turn it off when stalking an animal as you are highly visible with it on.
translations.You have no backpack equipped. This will: You have no backpack equipped. This will make you harder to detect at the cost of carrying capacity.
translations.Want premium binoculars at an affordable: Want premium binoculars at an affordable price? These lightweight 8x42 pair provide all the features you'll need, with broadband multi-coated lenses and high quality roof prisms. They're 100% waterproof and fogproof too.
translations.A 3-pin bow sight that allows for quick: A 3-pin bow sight that allows for quick and accurate range compensation using any compound bow. Once you've acquired the distance using your favorite rangefinder, simply select the appropriate pin and take the shot!
translations.A 5-pin bow sight that allows for quick: A 5-pin bow sight that allows for quick and accurate range compensation using any compound bow. Once you've acquired the distance using your favorite rangefinder, simply select the appropriate pin and take the shot!
translations.This premium scope is designed for cross: This premium scope is designed for crossbows shooting 300 feet per second and faster. With three duplex crosshairs and variable zoom settings up to 5x, this is the perfect crossbow scope for any situation.
translations.Made from extremely durable aircraft-gra: Made from extremely durable aircraft-grade aluminium alloy and features multi-coated optics for super sharp vision. Shockproof, fogproof, and waterproof for extreme hunting conditions where a good scope makes all the difference.
translations.A value that indicates the penetration a: A value that indicates the penetration ability of a projectile when it hits a target. This value is combined with the kinetic energy of a projectile upon impact to calculate the actual penetration depth.
translations.The amount of extra capacity added to yo: The amount of extra capacity added to your inventory when this backpack is equipped.
translations.The type of response from animals that c: The type of response from animals that can be expected when using the caller. This may be a vocal response from the animal, the animal being attracted to the area where the call was made, or a combination of both.
translations.The number of uses the first aid kit has: The number of uses the first aid kit has before it expires and is removed from your inventory.
translations.The amount of currency needed to buy the: The amount of currency needed to buy the item.
translations.Visual variation of the item. This has n: Visual variation of the item. This has no effect on its performance.
translations.The number of uses the scent eliminator: The number of uses the scent eliminator has before it expires and is removed from your inventory.
translations.The number of uses a scent lure has befo: The number of uses a scent lure has before it expires and is removed from your inventory.
translations.drop the item here to put it in your bac: drop the item here to put it in your backpack
translations.While this .223 bolt-action rifle lacks: While this .223 bolt-action rifle lacks the punch to take on big game, it is highly useful for its extremely flat trajectories and accuracy. These characteristics make it the perfect tool for hunters looking to hit varmints at a long range.
translations.The VALLGARDA .375 will prove to be your: The VALLGARDA .375 will prove to be your ultimate companion when it comes to hunting large and dangerous game. This bolt action rifle provides impeccable accuracy with precision and power making it the ideal gun that you can't go without.
translations.This precision-crafted crossbow sports e: This precision-crafted crossbow sports enough power to take down the largest game animals. With a beautiful woven carbon fiber barrel, a built-in rope-cocking device, and a 4-arrow quiver, the CB-165 is ideal for short-range hunting.
translations.* Can also be obtained by completing sto: * Can also be obtained by completing story missions in Askiy Ridge Hunting Preserve.
translations.FROST .257 is a classic magazine fed pum: FROST .257 is a classic magazine fed pump action rifle that delivers a unique blend of power and fun. Versatile and dependable, its an ideal companion for any hunt, taking down a wide spectrum of medium game with ease.
translations.With the force of 7.62x39mm rounds and t: With the force of 7.62x39mm rounds and the precision hunters crave, QUIST REAPER 7.62X39 stands as a timeless choice for hunters. Known for its ease of use, it’s a perfect rifle for small to medium game.
translations.The STRANDBERG 10GA Semi-Automatic Shotg: The STRANDBERG 10GA Semi-Automatic Shotgun is your go-to choice whether you're tracking game in wetlands or taking part in shooting competitions. This shotgun is your assurance for top-tier performance and reliability.
translations.This high forest landscape and peatlands: This high forest landscape and peatlands are home to a myriad of organisms and animals. The annual rate for biomass production in peatlands such as these is greater than the rate of decomposition making them a very efficient carbon sink.
translations.The eastern conifer forests of Revontuli: The eastern conifer forests of Revontuli Coasts have been used as hunting ground for many millennia. Old hunting stories of great big moose or ferocious brown bear have been passed down by families that hunt in this region.

translations.A beaver felled a tree on one of your po: A beaver felled a tree on one of your portable structures. It has been removed from the world and returned to your storage.
translations.Fiddler's Bow is a curved skywalk, so na: Fiddler's Bow is a curved skywalk, so named for its proximity to the Fiddler's Peak and Spoon. It is a modern and stylish way to capture a full view of the preserve, great for spotting anything roaming around below.
translations.Bow-Leg Buffalo Break is a dastardly dea: Bow-Leg Buffalo Break is a dastardly dead drop known for testing the structural integrity of the local wildlife on a semi-regular basis. Pray that you are not tested yourself, lest you be found wanting.
translations.Battered Peaks is aptly named because of: Battered Peaks is aptly named because of its shape and peculiar location. Caused by countless millennia of erosion the lonely mountain seems to have been abandoned by its kin to live a life of cursed solitude.
translations.Richard Hope's meticulously built surviv: Richard Hope's meticulously built survivalist camps can be found across the Lake District region. When hunting is your main source of sustenance, it is very important to have a few safe havens to rest at.
translations.The export of wood is integral to this p: The export of wood is integral to this part of Europe. The principle of sustained forestry management has its origins in Germany almost 300 years ago. Currently, control measures have been put on hold for this specific area.
translations.Ледяной Тоннель is one of the oldest, lo: Ледяной Тоннель is one of the oldest, longest tunnels on the old railway. You would call it "Frozen Passage," and you would certainly fear dying in its icy grip. Too much information?
translations.Don't laugh when I write that Пьяный лес: Don't laugh when I write that Пьяный лес means "Drunken Forest," but that's exactly what this place is. Permafrost melts and deforms at uneven angles, thrusting trees this way and that way, swaying like they are intoxicated.
translations.Деревня двух рек or \"Two River Village\: Деревня двух рек or "Two River Village" is, obviously, between two rivers. Like Chekurovka, it has been abandoned since industrial fishing companies displaced the fishermen. Nenets still fish here sometimes.
translations.The Irish-Elk was not exclusively Irish,: The Irish-Elk was not exclusively Irish, being a native here, but it was a very real, historic giant among elk. These Bronze Age hunters were armed with nothing they could not manufacture from the taiga.
translations.Bear hunting in ancient times could only: Bear hunting in ancient times could only be accomplished by people working in packs. Such endeavors were fraught with danger. This painting could be interpreted as a commemoration of a heroic victory over a mighty foe.
translations.Hunting mammoth seemed like an impossibl: Hunting mammoth seemed like an impossible task for early humans — but our ancestors defied nature, using their group-intellects to conquer even the mightiest mammals.
translations.You have no internet connection. Multipl: You have no internet connection. Multiplayer and leaderboards are disabled.
translations.Would you like to unequip all items in y: Would you like to unequip all items in your inventory?
translations.There is no space in the inventory to eq: There is no space in the inventory to equip this item. Go to Storage to manage your loadout and make space in your current loadout, or switch to a loadout that doesn't include this item.
translations.The item will be removed from your stora: The item will be removed from your storage.
translations.Purchasing this item will restore your l: Purchasing this item will restore your loadout to the last saved state due to the overload.
translations.In the old days, whenever the river was: In the old days, whenever the river was too high to cross, elephants families gathered at this lake to drink and bathe. That's how we got the name Ivory Circle. I saw my first elephant birth here. Extraordinary creatures. They are missed.
translations.Silver Ridge Funicular Railway was opene: Silver Ridge Funicular Railway was opened in the early twentieth century. It ferried people up the mountain until its closure in the late nineties, but now leads a second life as a demanding hiking trail.
translations.Mount Silveridge is the tallest mountain: Mount Silveridge is the tallest mountain in Silver Ridge Peaks. Although not quite a fourteener, its summit provides spectacular views down into the reserve and the chance to walk among the clouds, if you dare ascend the narrow red ridge.
translations.This is the location where the survivor: This is the location where the survivor of the airplane crash built a camp and survived 7 days before she got rescued. She supposedly survived by salvaging the flesh from a recently killed Roosevelt elk.
translations.To the northwest, you can see the peak o: To the northwest, you can see the peak of Mount Bürgen, reaching 3000 meters (9843 feet) above sea level.
translations.The coyote features prominently as a tri: The coyote features prominently as a trickster figure in the folktales of Native Americans, assuming the form of the animal or even sometimes, a man. The coyote likely earned this designation due to its intelligence and adaptability.
translations.Layton River is about 310 miles long, ma: Layton River is about 310 miles long, making it one of the longer ones in the area. The river's strong current and relatively steep gradient gives it tremendous potential as a source of hydro-electric power.
translations.In the 1870s in the U.S.A., more buffalo: In the 1870s in the U.S.A., more buffalo were killed than in any other decade in history. The three years of 1872, '73, and '74 were the harshest. Estimations say that 4.5 million buffalo were slaughtered in that three-year period alone.
translations.Coywolf is an informal term for a canid: Coywolf is an informal term for a canid hybrid descended from coyotes and grey wolves. Hybridization between the two species is facilitated by the fact that they diverged relatively recently (around 6,000–117,000 years ago).
translations.The strawfields of Hirschdorf are leased: The strawfields of Hirschdorf are leased to four individual farmers by the Sommer family. Sommer is often in contact with hunters in the area to employ help with controlling the animal population so that the crops are protected.
translations.During the Würm glaciation, this part of: During the Würm glaciation, this part of the Alps was drier than the rest. This allowed many species to survive where they could not have elsewhere. As a result, many species of plants are endemic to this region.
translations.Some of the finds at this modest dig sit: Some of the finds at this modest dig site have included mammoth and mastodon bones, various Ice Age plant species, and numerous invertebrate fossils. It is hoped that the project can be expanded when additional funding is approved.
translations.The first peacetime all-black regiments: The first peacetime all-black regiments were nicknamed Buffalo Soldiers. In Colorado they skirmished with Native American tribes, constructed forts and roads, laid railroad lines, and even delivered the mail.
translations.A man is better off having a skilled, lo: A man is better off having a skilled, loyal, obedient dog at his side than to have another man. I swear it on my mother's mother.
translations.This place has moose, moose, and more mo: This place has moose, moose, and more moose. Also, did I mention the moose? I have seen so many, I let most of them go. Who needs so much moose? The Tsar? Trick question, there is no Tsar anymore. Not for a century at least.
translations.A quiet clearing like this one is perfec: A quiet clearing like this one is perfect for trapping. We are south of the Gateway to the Underworld, so I call this place "South of Hell". I think it is a catchy name.
translations.You're about to choose a secondary job f: You're about to choose a secondary job for your hunting dog. Are you sure you want your hunting dog to have this as its secondary job?
translations.A secondary job from another owned dog D: A secondary job from another owned dog DLC can be assigned once this dog reaches job level 15.
translations.Did you know there are more Moose attack: Did you know there are more Moose attacks on humans than by Bears and Wolves combined? You might think they're aggessive, and they can be. But my explanation a lot simpler than that: people approach Moose more often than Bears and Wolves.
translations.Oh, this place! Your Grandmother and I u: Oh, this place! Your Grandmother and I used to--well, we were younger, and so-- Eish. On second thought, you probably DON'T want to know that story.
translations.Our old friend the pronking springbok. H: Our old friend the pronking springbok. Harvesting springbok is a reliable way to feed local markets and prevent overgrazing. If you can catch them!
translations.Nyarhi, the Widowmaker. Most people call: Nyarhi, the Widowmaker. Most people call them Cape Buffalo. At a minimum, you'll need a .338 caliber gun to approach one. I personally recommend a .470. And even that's not GUARANTEED to stop Nyarhi once they're charging.
translations.Wherever you find a water hole, Nguluve-: Wherever you find a water hole, Nguluve-Nova -- that's our friend the Wart Hog -- won't be far. Wart hog herds around here are getting crowded. That puts a lot of strain on the water supply in a reserve where water is not always abundant.
translations.Hey little hare. The scrub hare, Mpfundl: Hey little hare. The scrub hare, Mpfundla, like the savannah and the scrubs, as their name obviously suggests. They breed during droughts, and we've had plenty of droughts, so you'll find them zigging and zagging all over.
translations.You know, Grandchild, you've done so. Mu: You know, Grandchild, you've done so. Much. Work. I feel like I should only call you "Boss" or "Lion-Boss" or "Ghost Hunter" from now on. But, then again, as Senior Warden, you must be humble.
translations.The pronghorn is the fastest land mammal: The pronghorn is the fastest land mammal in North America. They're not as sensitive to noise as some of the other animals in the reserve, but they trust their eyes, so stay down and hidden to prevent them from bolting.
translations.Wild turkeys are nothing like their dome: Wild turkeys are nothing like their domestic cousins. They're fast, agile, and can even fly short distances when spooked. You might not have much luck stalking these birds, so try using a turkey caller to get them to come to you.
translations.Mountain lion, puma, cougar... whatever: Mountain lion, puma, cougar... whatever you want to call it, don't let your guard down around one. They usually try to make themselves scarce around humans, but I hear there's been a couple of sightings in the reserve recently.
translations.Looks like someone forgot their bear det: Looks like someone forgot their bear deterrent. Mind you, if you're caught unaware it might not help. I'll never forget the time I was hunting elk with a group of friends and a 1200 pound grizzly came in hot from 30 yards out.
translations.Some of us had bear spray, but the wind: Some of us had bear spray, but the wind was too strong to use it. The only reason we made it out alive is because the bear got confused when all six of us split up. It was like something out of a movie.
translations.Once I was waiting for a buck to stand f: Once I was waiting for a buck to stand for a bow shot and a tree crashed down right next to me when a strong wind blew in. And let me tell you, if a tree falls in the woods and you're around to hear it, you'll never forget the sound.
translations.Out here, they say you can map the weath: Out here, they say you can map the weather for a whole year to the first twelve days — the first is January, the second February, and so on. I never put much stock in it, but if you're planning on hanging around anyway...
translations.Sometimes I ask myself: if I could go ba: Sometimes I ask myself: if I could go back in time and stop them from releasing those animals, would I? Our native species would be thriving, but I'd've never known the thrill of chasing a deer through the bush. A head scratcher...
translations.Ritterstein is one of the most common st: Ritterstein is one of the most common starting points for hunting in the reserve. It has a good mix of open fields and deep forests. The large population of wild boar has called to hunters since the Middle Ages.
translations.Müllerwald has been a bit more exploited: Müllerwald has been a bit more exploited than the rest of the reserve, due to a logging facility built here in the 60s. One tree that hasn't been cut down though is Old Müller. He's one of the oldest in the reserve!
translations.Ah, Spreeberg. This is the place you've: Ah, Spreeberg. This is the place you've probably seen on every Hirschfelden postcard. Spreeberg Castle overlooking the lake at the top of the hill. Yeah, I don't even have to sell it to you, it really is picturesque.
translations.As you will undoubtedly see, Petershain: As you will undoubtedly see, Petershain is the most cultivated part of the reserve, and always has been. You can actually find signs of its historical importance, such as the observation tower to the north.
translations.Rathenfeldt is a favorite region for a l: Rathenfeldt is a favorite region for a lot of hunters. The fallow deer is such a classic animal to hunt. But we also get a lot of history buffs here. To the south lies the Hirshdorf Hügelgrab, a grave mound dating back to the Bronze Age.
translations.Recover a steady aim faster after changi: Recover a steady aim faster after changing stances when using handguns. Each level unlocked increases the effect.
translations.Decrease edge blur when using shotguns w: Decrease edge blur when using shotguns with iron, red dot, and holographic sights. Each level unlocked increases the effect.
translations.Ability to trigger a tracer shot when fi: Ability to trigger a tracer shot when firing shotguns. Pellets will leave behind smoke trails indicating the spread of the bullet.
translations.Increases the time an arrow can be drawn: Increases the time an arrow can be drawn in aim mode before fatigue sets in. Fatigue will cause aim wobble, followed by a disruption of aim mode. Each level unlocked increases the effect.
translations.Increased arm strength means more draw l: Increased arm strength means more draw length. Increases the kinetic energy of all bows which in turn means more damage, penetration, and speed using the same arrows. Each level unlocked increases the effect.

translations.Bush Valley has grand views of Vurhonga: Bush Valley has grand views of Vurhonga Plateau and the N'walungu Forest. As the site of a former San settlement, this area is rich with the history of the first tribes. A wonderful place for you to walk among your oldest ancestors.
translations.Where once there was water, now there is: Where once there was water, now there is not. That is the story of Mubedwa Nambu. Losing the natural boundary of the river was a devastating change for Vurhonga, but it was not a death sentence -- so long as we do our jobs.
translations.This is an odd one. I've been told that: This is an odd one. I've been told that the name means something like "valley of the hag" in Scottish Gaelic, but I have no idea what inspired them to call it that. Maybe some fireside tales exchanged with the region's Māori inhabitants?
translations.If you ever want to spot pumas, this is: If you ever want to spot pumas, this is my favorite place to observe them. The dense forests and mountain slopes are their territory. If you find a fresh carcass, you know the pumas are in close proximity.
translations.This is turkey country, and the wily bir: This is turkey country, and the wily birds are the main draw for hunters in this stretch of undulating forest. Bagging your first gobbler is a rite of passage for many young people who venture up here to hunt in the summer.
translations.Пьяная тайга or the \"Drunken Taiga.\" M: Пьяная тайга or the "Drunken Taiga." Moose thrive in this vast region to the southwest. This is also home to a large permafrost crater that locals call Ворота в подземный мир or the "Gateway to the Underworld."
translations.Холм Зверолова or \"Trapper's Hill\" is: Холм Зверолова or "Trapper's Hill" is a peninsula named for the history of trapping in its area. These days, only senior resident Georgy Grankin knows how to avoid harming reindeer with boar traps, a common mistake made by outsiders.
translations.Travelers are generally discouraged from: Travelers are generally discouraged from visiting Бесплодное нагорье or the "Barren Plateau", the heart of our brown bear country. The views from the top of the mountain are breathtaking, but only for masters of hunting and survival.
translations.From the windswept heights of the Andes: From the windswept heights of the Andes to the dense shadows of the jungle below, the untamed wilderness of Intisuyu promises an unforgettable hunting experience.
translations.It’s time to present your prize trophies: It’s time to present your prize trophies in the fashion they deserve. The luxurious and exotic design of the Saseka Safari is perfect to show off your single and multi trophy mounts, or to showcase your favourite weapons on gun racks.
translations.Every experienced hunter ends up amassin: Every experienced hunter ends up amassing a sizable trophy collection that deserves to be presented in an appropriate fashion. Spring Creek Manor is perfect as a Trophy Lodge, so show off your prized harvests in a true rustic style.
translations.You can't reset your dog's secondary job: You can't reset your dog's secondary job because you have insufficient funds.
translations.You are about to reset your dog's second: You are about to reset your dog's secondary job. All secondary job progress will be lost. This action cannot be undone.
