translations.This Burenstedt was historically the cen: This Burenstedt was historically the center of agricultural development in the region, however over time has been developed into a lodge and relaxation complex. Easily the best place to sit after a hard day's work!
translations.The Eurasian Teal is a highly gregarious: The Eurasian Teal is a highly gregarious duck that forms large flocks. Scouting the area ahead of time for spots for your decoys is a must. Make sure to place them far enough away from your blind so they don't fly on top of you and spook.
translations.The Common Goldeneye is a species of sea: The Common Goldeneye is a species of sea duck that can be found throughout the northern regions of Eurasia and North America. They feed by diving underwater, searching for crustaceans, insects and mollusks.
translations.The Tufted Duck is a common species of d: The Tufted Duck is a common species of diving duck found mostly in Western, Central and Northern Europe. It lives in marshes, wetlands and sheltered coastal areas where it feeds on mollusks, insects, crustaceans, roots and seeds.
translations.The Raccoon Dog, also known as 'Tanuki': The Raccoon Dog, also known as 'Tanuki' in Japan, is a small canid native to Asia. It was introduced in the USSR for its fur, but is now rapidly spreading westward across Europe as an invasive species.

The summed score of the circumference of main beam between the first and second tines of both antlers, subtracted by their difference - multiplied by 3

translations.The American Alligator is the apex preda: The American Alligator is the apex predator of its range across southeastern United States where it can be found in rivers, lakes but primarily in freshwater swamps and marshes.
translations.Equipping a backpack will increase the c: Equipping a backpack will increase the capacity of your inventory but will make it easier to be detected.
translations.A Game Feeder is broken and in need of r: A Game Feeder is broken and in need of repair. Either head to the location in person to repair it, or remotely repair it from the map. Damaged Feeders cannot be moved and must be repaired first.
translations.The dog is searching for animals within: The dog is searching for animals within a certain range depending on the command.
translations.The Eurasian wigeon is a medium-sized da: The Eurasian wigeon is a medium-sized dabbling duck commonly found across northern Eurasia. It is closely related to the American wigeon and the two species can sometimes interbreed when two populations come into contact with one another.
translations.The Lesser Kudu (Tragelaphus imberbis) i: The Lesser Kudu (Tragelaphus imberbis) is one of the most sought after targets for trophy hunters. Immediately identifiable due to its long spiral horns, the kudu is a grazer, found across the eastern reaches of Africa.
translations.Missions and challenges are an optional: Missions and challenges are an optional part of the game. They provide a narrative context to your hunting and will reward XP and cash, but all of the game content can be unlocked and accessed without playing missions.
translations.The mallard is a medium to large sized d: The mallard is a medium to large sized dabbling duck with a hefty body, rounded head and wide flat bill. They are notoriously widespread and can be found on lakes, ponds, marshes, rivers, and coastal habitats.
translations.Your dog has reached job level 15. If yo: Your dog has reached job level 15. If you own other dog DLC, you can now add a secondary job to this dog via the Hunting Dog screen.
translations.At outposts, you can buy new equipment,: At outposts, you can buy new equipment, take on challenges, and rest.
translations.The scrub hare is primarily found throug: The scrub hare is primarily found throughout Southern Africa and prefer savanna woodlands and scrub areas. Scrub hares are nocturnal but are often found grazing and foraging in the early morning and around dusk.
translations.The taruca is a sturdy, medium-sized dee: The taruca is a sturdy, medium-sized deer of the high Andes in Peru, Bolivia, northern Chile, and Argentina. It lives in alpine grasslands and rocky slopes, usually above 3,000 meters, feeding on grasses, shrubs, and herbs in small groups.
translations.The Tufted Duck is a common species of d: The Tufted Duck is a common species of diving duck found mostly in Western, Central and Northern Europe. It lives in marshes, wetlands and sheltered coastal areas where it feeds on molluscs, insects, crustaceans, roots and seeds.
translations.The Tundra Bean Goose is a species nativ: The Tundra Bean Goose is a species native to the Nordic European countries and Siberia. It is very closely related to the Taiga Bean Goose, and some specialists consider them separate species while others do not.
translations.Shot placement is critical. To ensure a: Shot placement is critical. To ensure a quick and ethical kill make sure to aim for and hit at least one of the animal's vital organs. Failing to do so will result in a less effective shot and a potential missed harvest.
translations.The Willow Ptarmigan is a species of gam: The Willow Ptarmigan is a species of game bird that is closely related to grouse, living in the Arctic and subarctic regions of Northern Eurasia and North America. It is the largest living species of ptarmigan.
translations.One of your Game Feeders has been attack: One of your Game Feeders has been attacked by Bears and has been destroyed! Visit the Feeder in person to repair it, or repair it remotely on the map.
translations.Your dog will run freely around you and: Your dog will run freely around you and look for a suitable target, excluding predators, within a large area. When it finds a target it will move towards it and start barking. Be mindful about the approach when you hear your dog barking.
translations.Point your dog in the direction you want: Point your dog in the direction you want it to start retrieving. After it has retrieved your target, it will continue retrieving everything around you.
translations.This is a large display, and this list i: This is a large display, and this list includes all eligible equipment that you already own (primarily rifles and smaller).
translations.This is a small display, and this list i: This is a small display, and this list includes all eligible equipment that you already own (primarily handguns and smaller).
translations.The savanna here in Vuxa is the heart an: The savanna here in Vuxa is the heart and soul of the reserve. This grassland sustains a cross-section of plants and wildlife, from the smallest birds to harems of pronking springbok -- or at least, the grassland used to sustain them.
translations.I have a biologist friend who's interest: I have a biologist friend who's interested in documenting this herd's behaviors, and she's asked for a photo of a wildebeest feeding on the reserve. Apparently it will help her project the environmental impact of the herd as they migrate.
translations.The behavioral reports on scrub hares an: The behavioral reports on scrub hares and side-striped jackals in Vupeladyambu are concerning. The plateau is inaccessible to larger animals, so smaller species like hare and jackal have always flourished there.
translations.Just, you know, be careful up there. The: Just, you know, be careful up there. They say lightning never strikes the same place twice, but my friend Jafar has been struck THREE times! I think you will have better luck than Jafar, though. Fix that bridge.
translations.That belongs to Baden, Boss. And this ti: That belongs to Baden, Boss. And this time it's a scrap with blood on it. Is it Baden's blood? We'll have it tested at the lab to be sure. All those other teams, none of them found this. You have the nose of a ridgeback. A natural tracker.
translations.That's a... sloppy way to shoot a jackal: That's a... sloppy way to shoot a jackal. Maybe you should get some rest, check your equipment, then try again. Everyone has off days. Even you!
translations.With that in mind, let's test your maste: With that in mind, let's test your mastery with small game. Show me you can harvest five scrub hares in a single hunt. No distractions, passed harvest check on every one. Use a .22, shotgun with birdshot, or a 300-grain arrow with a bow.
translations.Among the animals, only the lions were e: Among the animals, only the lions were ever bold enough to take on the buffalo. I've seen them try. But the difference between the buffalo and many other prey is, when one buffalo is attacked, its herd will come to defend it.
translations.Accustomed to the 470 yet? You better be: Accustomed to the 470 yet? You better be, it could save your life! Harvest three more buffalo -- and show me that you can down them for a quick kill. Check your codex if you're not sure about correct shot placement.
translations.And that 470 sure kicks, doesn't it? Kee: And that 470 sure kicks, doesn't it? Keep yours locked and loaded, because we have to cull more than one buffalo to disperse this herd. But that means exposing yourself to additional risk. No margin for misfires here.
translations.I think the village is going to have a f: I think the village is going to have a feast in your honor after we deliver these buffalo in such fine form. The locals have come to associate your work with the quality they USED TO associate with me.
translations.In a land of great open spaces, giant la: In a land of great open spaces, giant lakes and enormous mountains, the Dwarf Birch seems like it's in the wrong place. The local moose and caribou herds would disagree, though. They absolutely love snacking on these diminuative trees.
translations.When considering which design of bridge: When considering which design of bridge was needed to cover the many water channels in Yukon Valley, it was decided to use a design made popular by the Layton Lake reserve, due to its sturdy and reliable construction.
translations.This bear is hurt badly. Looks like it w: This bear is hurt badly. Looks like it was probably caught in a faulty trap, left behind by an inexperienced trapper or careless hunters. Not everyone is an upstanding citizen like you… Please, have mercy on the bear.
translations.The lynx is a cunning animal that almost: The lynx is a cunning animal that almost never attacks humans. They are quiet, they are cautious, and they are fast. I have seen some here up to 40 kilograms — no joke! This is an apex predator. As rare as it is deadly.
translations.You’re just about up to the Weeping Face: You’re just about up to the Weeping Face. Tourists and film crews love this spot. I don't need to explain the name, do I? I mean it's a face that looks like it is weeping. What else would you call it?
translations.And do you know what else you get as Sen: And do you know what else you get as Senior Warden? Can you guess? It's… MORE WORK! And you can't do it alone. That's why I've called in a specialist and her team to handle that task -- veteran wilderness guide, Doctor Dana Maritz.
translations.Che, novice hunters think expensive camo: Che, novice hunters think expensive camouflage gear is all the cover they need. ¡Pelotudos! When I hunt, I use the bushes, the leaves, and the grass to conceal my presence. And I set records!
translations.There is so much you can learn about an: There is so much you can learn about an animal just by watching them. But in our terrain, the animals are skilled at playing hide and seek. Your binoculars are your best friend when you’re looking for the perfect game.
translations.I’ve only ever seen one landslide in per: I’ve only ever seen one landslide in person, and that was from the air. Even from up there, it was a shocking display of natural force. It was all I could do to land the plane before the storm overtook me.
translations.Look, to your east. There's a column of: Look, to your east. There's a column of smoke. It looks like it's coming from close to one of our lookouts. I told you they'd be easy to track. Let's catch up with them before they set the whole forest ablaze.
translations.\"Bigfoot bait\" looks a lot like dog fo: "Bigfoot bait" looks a lot like dog food and stale donuts to me.
translations.Well this tells a story of some truly bi: Well this tells a story of some truly bizarre people, but it doesn't help us find them- [alarmed] That was a scream, but I can't see anything. Get to the lookout, maybe you'll see something that I can't.
translations.Baden's face and shoulder were pretty to: Baden's face and shoulder were pretty torn up. She took a swipe from a fully-grown grizzly, all while her friends accidentally...or should I say "incidentally" bear-sprayed her? The spray likely saved her life, though.
translations.Winter in the Yukon is no picnic, but I': Winter in the Yukon is no picnic, but I'd like to invite you to stay on indefinitely, if you're interested. You'll be an old sourdough like me in no time.
translations.Every year we have our own spin of the B: Every year we have our own spin of the BIG FIVE challenge, but we call ours the "Sekalaiset yhdeksäntoista”. Harvest one of every animal species in the reserve with gold medal or better to complete the challenge. Hunt them in any order.
translations.I'm making dinner for Beatriz, Chinita,: I'm making dinner for Beatriz, Chinita, to let her know how much I care. Could you harvest a red deer, pass the harvest check with a quick kill bonus? I can prepare quite a dinner when I have the right ingredients.
translations.My family likes you! That's good luck ar: My family likes you! That's good luck around here. And you'll need it, because we have work to do. Mule deer are overpopulating at a rate we can't sustain. Can you harvest 3 male mule deers to suppress them?
Gracias! Here's a difficult assignment. Every reserve on the continent has been asked to contribute to a randomly sampled study of communicable diseases in pumas. Carolina won't like it, but we need you to harvest a puma for an autopsy.
translations.Carolina took the puma harvest well. We: Carolina took the puma harvest well. We need a Water buffalo waste sample, so find water buffalo tracks and follow them until you find dung, and sample it. After that, harvest a water buffalo, yes? I'll distribute the meat to local farmers.
translations.My friend, my friend! You've supplied me: My friend, my friend! You've supplied me with enough game to stay busy for a whole winter. What kind of witchcraft do you practice to get this good?! I could use some lessons. I'll be calling on you next season, got that?
translations.Junto al Lago may be in danger of overgr: Junto al Lago may be in danger of overgrazing. Have you seen any animals along the way? Healthy animals follow a regular schedule, so I monitor their rest patterns for irregularities. Track an animal and spot it at rest, could you please?
translations.I got an EXCELLENT response on that phot: I got an EXCELLENT response on that photo of the lodge that you sent. Have you seen the cave paintings in Lago Bebe? THAT is a sightseeing attraction. Photograph the Cueva de las Manos and I'll bring the sightseers!!
translations.With game like that red deer, Parque Fer: With game like that red deer, Parque Fernando sells itself!! Now to finish our brochure. Have you visited Guarida de los Pumas Mimados? Go there and photograph the puma den. Something SPOOKY to show our thrillseekers!!
translations.Uf, Carolina doesn't approve of me using: Uf, Carolina doesn't approve of me using the den photo. She'd rather we focus on more traditional draws, like premium game. I get it!! Can you photograph each of the 4 most popular species? Axis deer, blackbuck, mule deer, and red deer.
translations.I guess what I'm trying to say is that I: I guess what I'm trying to say is that I'm very glad Sandy convinced me that we needed to hire help, and I'm glad you answered the call. We're both glad.
translations.He told me that it was a really tough de: He told me that it was a really tough decision for him. He's been here since he graduated, and I know he's fallen in love with the reserve. I am happy for him, though. He deserves the chance he's been given.
translations.It feels like you might actually be able: It feels like you might actually be able to give me a run for my money out here. It's time to make things interesting. Using a bow, harvest a pair of wolves. I hunt mostly with bows these days. It just feels more fair this way, doesn't it?
translations.Welcome weary Traveler to Tòrr nan Sìthe: Welcome weary Traveler to Tòrr nan Sìthean. I'm Laird of the estate, Roderick Roan, but you can call me Roddy.
translations.Now I don't have a clue. Only a handful: Now I don't have a clue. Only a handful of Wildcats around, and unless the Badgers are on the gear it's not them.
translations.A trickster fairy taking the form of a h: A trickster fairy taking the form of a huge cat, larger even than a big dog.
translations.Designed and manufactured to take down m: Designed and manufactured to take down medium to large game, this bullet will help you unleash the full potential of your rifle. Crafted for deep penetration, you will get a swift takedown giving you the edge in every hunt.

Designed and manufactured to take down medium to large game, this bullet will help you unleash the full potential of your rifle. Crafted for massive damage, you will get the perfect stopping power in every hunt.
translations.6.5mm bullet with a polymer tip that max: 6.5mm bullet with a polymer tip that maximizes penetration. The mild recoil and high ballistic coefficient of 6.5mm ammunition grants them both high precision and above-average penetration, making them ideal for long-range shooting.
translations.6.5mm bullet with a soft point that maxi: 6.5mm bullet with a soft point that maximizes expansion. The mild recoil and high ballistic coefficient of 6.5mm ammunition grants them both high precision and above-average penetration, making them ideal for long-range shooting.
translations.Ideal for small to medium game, 7.62x39m: Ideal for small to medium game, 7.62x39mm bullets with soft point provides reliable performance with relatively lower recoil. The soft point design ensures controlled expansion, delivering maximum stopping power upon impact.
translations.Make it easier to track your shots with: Make it easier to track your shots with these tracer arrows. This premium variation of the 540 gr. broadhead features an LED-equipped arrow nock to help you find your arrows and trace your prey. This is the tracer nock variant.
translations.The SABER 4X4 combines a stunning abilit: The SABER 4X4 combines a stunning ability to traverse rough terrain with unmatched comfort and style. Enter the heated seat and experience the off-road rush as it takes you across fields, bogs, and hills at consistent speeds.
translations.Slightly reduce the intensity of your od: Slightly reduce the intensity of your odor to get even closer to trophy animals before detection. Each use lasts 30 minutes.

translations.Cash is a currency that is used to buy w: Cash is a currency that is used to buy weapons and equipment. You can earn cash by harvesting animals or completing missions and challenges.
translations.Even though breeds are standardized, a d: Even though breeds are standardized, a dog will have its own unique personality and Traits. At certain levels you can select what TRAITS you want to nurture in your dog to make it uniquely your own.
translations.The Kennel is where you purchase, name,: The Kennel is where you purchase, name, equip and unequip your hunting dogs. You access the Kennel via the caches at the Outposts and Tents.
translations.When your dog has located small or mediu: When your dog has located small or medium-sized animals, it'll point towards them with its snout at a distance. For large animals, the dog will bark at the animal to mark its location; use the sound to hone in on the prey.
translations.Earning XP will level up your character: Earning XP will level up your character and unlock new skill and perk points at certain levels. You can earn XP by harvesting animals, completing missions and challenges, or by discovering points of interest.
translations.The desert bighorn sheep is a rugged, de: The desert bighorn sheep is a rugged, desert-adapted animal with keen sight and hearing. Its agility and awareness help it navigate harsh, rocky terrain and survive extreme conditions.
translations.Showing affection towards your dog will: Showing affection towards your dog will increase its FOCUS regeneration.
translations.FOCUS is the general effectiveness of yo: FOCUS is the general effectiveness of your dog at a given time. Using commands drains FOCUS. Give the dog time to rest, or show it more affection to increase its FOCUS regeneration.
translations.The HEEL command puts your dog into Heel: The HEEL command puts your dog into Heel; it will stay on your left side for a period of time based on its level.
translations.To equip a dog, visit the Kennel tab of: To equip a dog, visit the Kennel tab of your WEAPON CACHE.
translations.The Labrador Retriever is a breed of dog: The Labrador Retriever is a breed of dog known for its friendly and playful demeanor. The Labrador Retriever can retrieve class 1 animals.
translations.The dog is nimble and won't scare animal: The dog is nimble and won't scare animals. However, you still might!
translations.Your German Shorthaired Pointer can perf: Your German Shorthaired Pointer can perform three types of point commands depending on the size of the animal you want your dog to find; small, medium, and large.
translations.The German Shorthaired Pointer is an ene: The German Shorthaired Pointer is an energetic and familial gun dog with a lot of enthusiasm for hunting game of all sizes.
translations.Your pointer can be commanded to search: Your pointer can be commanded to search for the specific species of the animal that's left this trail.
translations.The Raccoon Dog, also known as “Tanuki”: The Raccoon Dog, also known as “Tanuki” in Japan, is a small canid native to Asia. It was introduced in the USSR for its fur, but is now rapidly spreading westward across Europe as an invasive species.
translations.The roe deer, also called western or Eur: The roe deer, also called western or European roe deer, is a very common native inhabitant of the European continent.
translations.The wood bison is found mainly in Canada: The wood bison is found mainly in Canada’s northern forests and plains. Once nearly extinct due to overhunting and habitat loss, conservation efforts have led to their recovery.

translations.Would you look at that view? Never gets: Would you look at that view? Never gets old, I'm telling ya. From up here you can see a lot of great hunting spots in the area.
translations.Richard Hope is a survivalist that lives: Richard Hope is a survivalist that lives off the land. He has set up a lot of camps in the area, and discovered last night that one of his camps was ransacked. Food was stolen, and Hope has asked Doc to track down who is responsible. Doc is out of the area, and has asked you to investigate further.
translations.Discover Peru by completing any 3 missio: Discover Peru by completing any 3 missions found on Intisuyu’s notice boards. Have you already picked some up? Great! New notices may have appeared, so make sure to check all the notice board locations. Uncompleted mission will still remain for you to master even after this task has been completed.

translations.The jaguar responsible for the attack ha:
The jaguar responsible for the attack has been identified and spotted in the cloud forest and Freddy is organizing a drive hunt for the animal. Some of the reserve locals have volunteered to assist, as thanks for helping them out. 
Head to the meet up location between 05:00 am and 08:00 am to begin the hunt.
But be warned; hunting jaguars is extremely dangerous. Make sure you are absolutely ready to face a jaguar before attempting this dangerous task.
translations.You are invited by María to join the Pac:
You are invited by María to join the Pachamama ritual at top of the mountain and celebrate a new beginning for the reserve.

REWARD: Premium Trophy Plaque
translations.After having his stores ransacked, Hope: After having his stores ransacked, Hope is in need of supplies for the winter season. Food is scarce, and Hope suspects bears are scaring away the blacktail deer in the region. Doc has suggested you investigate the possible presence of black bears in Balmont.
Blacktails are Hope's bread and butter. If you ever want hunting tips on them, he's your man. He's been with the blacktails for a while now. If they're on the move, it's not only a problem for Hope. It might mean worrying changes for other parts of the reserve.
translations.Hikers have reported a sickly looking be: Hikers have reported a sickly looking bear behaving strangely around outposts. It's probably hungry and circling outposts looking for food. Perhaps it's learned that populated locations are easier sources of food than hunting. Doc believes hikers might not have followed protocol when it comes to disposing their leftover food. This creates a dangerous situation for everyone, and you have been asked to locate and deal with the bear in question.
translations.Trampfine contacted Doc the other day an: Trampfine contacted Doc the other day and had questions about your investigation of the black bears. Doc withheld the part about you being a hunter. Now, Jonathan thinks you can help him with his own research. He has been trying to capture one of the more famous black bear families in the region, but has had no success. He's currently occupied with his bear droppings collection, so he'll compensate you if you help out.
translations.Trampfine has got a problem. Some bears: Trampfine has got a problem. Some bears have been migrating to the Lake District, where Richard Hope is situated. Trampfine and Hope have a poor relationship, mostly because Jonathan thinks Richard will kill his "darlings," the black bears. Jonathan has requested your help with retrieving a few samples of bear droppings missing from his collection.
translations.Trampfine has reached out with another r: Trampfine has reached out with another rather specific bear-related task. This time he needs a picture taken. Mr. Black, a big, male black bear, has been sighted in Balmont lately. Trampfine has asked you to take a picture of Mr. Black with Mount Kraken in the background.
translations.Now that's just a bunch of hokum of cour: Now that's just a bunch of hokum of course, but I can tell you what ain't. Mount Kraken is bear country and Jonathan's been getting too darn close to those bears. Could you head on out there and see if you can find out what's going on? I'll do what I can on my end.
translations.Trampfine has accused Hope of harvesting: Trampfine has accused Hope of harvesting one of his favorite bears, Rudy. Doc is avoiding taking sides, but he mentioned that Mr. Black has gone missing. Trampfine is worried about the bear's whereabouts, so he wants you to locate and take another picture of Mr. Black.
translations.I found him in Balmont on the ground wre: I found him in Balmont on the ground wrestling with Hope. It seems he found out that Hope had hunted one of his favorite bears, Rudy. I can't even keep track of Trampfine's bears anymore. I know I'll never make those two become friends, but it would help Jonathan cool off if you could locate Mr. Black. He's gone missing.
Trampfine will be happy to know that Mr. Black is alive. I'll have to keep my eye on that bear though, see that he doesn't pose a threat to others. Maybe he just missed Trampfine. Heh, can't believe I just said that. Seems like whatever Trampfine's on is contagious.
translations.The Lake District houses a sizeable coyo: The Lake District houses a sizeable coyote population. Generally, coyotes are reclusive animals that avoid human contact, but they can begin to cohabitate in human-populated areas due to the oversupply of food or shelter. There have been multiple sightings of loitering coyotes causing distress in nearby towns. The situation is being handled by the Varmint Wildlife Control and their local operative Fiona Vualez. She is working on thinning out the coyote population and the organization will compensate you for assisting.
translations.The Wildlife Varmint Control has initiat: The Wildlife Varmint Control has initiated a reserve-wide effort to tackle the expanding coyote population. The organization secured a contract from the local government to operate in Lake District, and has access to some of the best hunting equipment around. Doc recommends you follow Fiona's lead and try out her favorite rifle across the reserve for the coyotes.
translations.Fiona has noticed a group of coyotes sto: Fiona has noticed a group of coyotes stopping by Leviathan Lake often for water late at night. She'd like you to clear the area of them. Doc believes it'd be good for the campers too. They could appreciate a full moon without maniacal howling in the background.
translations.Doc has received word from Hope that coy: Doc has received word from Hope that coyotes have been scaring away whitetail deer in Balmont. Hope requested Fiona's assistance, but unfortunately she's away in a neighboring town seeing to stray coyotes. She recommended you in her place, and suggested using a bow to harvest coyotes so as not to further scare away any whitetail deer.
translations.There has been a number of scares lately: There has been a number of scares lately in the Cheelah region. Trampfine ran to Doc in terror about a large and aggressive coyote he spotted. Vualez and the Varmint Control would like it downed to restore some confidence in safety for that region.
translations.Emily is one of the reserve's fire looko: Emily is one of the reserve's fire lookouts, and also a published author. She's working on her third novel now. One of her favorite animals is the Roosevelt elk. She's made detailed notes on their routes and general behavior in the area in her notebook, but recently dropped it somewhere near her cabin while on a hike. A finder's fee awaits the one who can return her notebook.
translations.Emily has taken it upon herself to make: Emily has taken it upon herself to make the lookout towers feel more welcoming to people visiting the area. She also wants them to be a valuable source of information. She was thinking of taking photographs of the reserve's landmarks and posting them on billboards in the towers. Since you proved reliable with her notebook, Emily has asked for your assistance.
translations.Emily's not done decorating the lookout: Emily's not done decorating the lookout towers yet. She got the idea to hang a Roosevelt elk trophy up in one of the Calburn towers. She doesn't hunt herself, but she spotted a few Roosevelts passing by a hunting stand in Calburn. She's asked for your help in harvesting a nice bull for the tower.
translations.Emily has noticed a smoke pillar nearby: Emily has noticed a smoke pillar nearby High Lake outpost. In her rush to check it out, she tripped and sprained her ankle. Now she needs someone else to act on the situation. Doc does not want to call in a response squad until he's sure it's an emergency. Emily has turned to you for help.
translations.There's some sort of smoke pillar going: There's some sort of smoke pillar going on up by the High Lake outpost. Emily called it in, but she sprained her ankle during the rush to head out, so she can't take care of it. Could you just go out there and have a first look before I call in the cavalry?
translations.Emily has finished her lookout shift for: Emily has finished her lookout shift for the season and is leaving the reserve for vacation. She left her notebook for Doc, and passed along an observation about the Roosevelt elk in the region. She noticed one beautiful bull that liked to hang around the Layton Canyon lookout tower. The bull would be gone by the time she came down for a closer look, so she has challenged you to harvest it. It was only spotted at night.
translations.Paul Beatty is the local tourist guide a: Paul Beatty is the local tourist guide and hiking expert. He was born in a nearby town and his father is still an active hunter in the area, a local legend of sorts. Off-season, Beatty travels the world but he usually ends up in the Pacific Northwest at least twice a year to work and visit his dad. There's been a bit of gossip about his reasons for returning to the reserve this season. Paul and his dad are competitive in nature and like to challenge the active hunters in the area in different ways. Their favorite trophy is the moose and you have received their first challenge.
translations.Paul reached out to Doc with an urgent m: Paul reached out to Doc with an urgent message about a missing hiker. James Worthington, 36 years old, has not been seen since his hike earlier this morning in Highton Peaks. He was going to meet a friend in Willipeg until several hours passed without sign of him. His hike most likely began from Chopeeka outpost. Paul and Doc could use some extra help locating him.
translations.Paul has gone off to meet with a certain: Paul has gone off to meet with a certain "someone." In his place, Beatty's father has offered up a challenge. His favorite hunting spot is in a ground blind near the Highton River. The moose go there to drink often. Paul and his dad try to top each other's trophy scores all the time. They wonder if you can beat the Beatty record.
translations.Harvest each of the following animals in:
Harvest each of the following animals in their respective home regions:

A moose
A Roosevelt elk
A coyote
A bear
A blacktail deer
translations.Each year Paul and his father walk the \: Each year Paul and his father walk the "circle route." This hiking path stretches around the Lake District region, allowing every region in the reserve to be covered. While on the circle route, Paul and his dad challenge themselves to harvest "The Big 5", one each of the five species you can find in the reserve. They've challenged you to do the same and beat their total scores.
translations.Paul is done for the season it seems. He: Paul is done for the season it seems. He's been spending his time with Emily in one of the lookout towers and Doc hears they are planning some kind of big trip together. Doc was contacted by the state office for travel and tourism in the Pacific Northwest. They are looking for photos of hiking trails and vistas to be added to next season's travel guide. Doc has asked for your help.
translations.There's been a lot of flooding in Louisi: There's been a lot of flooding in Louisiana the past few years, and that drives up the price of gator eggs across the board. Zoos and farms there'll buy them for seventy bucks a pop.
translations.Now why don't you do one better: harvest: Now why don't you do one better: harvest another raccoon, and make sure it's a decent weight.
translations.You feel like putting some up now, since: You feel like putting some up now, since you're in the area? Never know what might be nearby.
translations.Are you starting to get itchy? The Nordi: Are you starting to get itchy? The Nordic region has more mosquitoes than you might be used to.
translations.We might not have a lot in common with a: We might not have a lot in common with ancient people, but hunting and celebrating the harvest is something we've been doing for many millennia.
translations.I saw some tracks in that area earlier t: I saw some tracks in that area earlier this morning. Hold on, I'll send the coordinates.
translations.Quite a view, isn't it? From here, you c: Quite a view, isn't it? From here, you can see a lot of great hunting opportunities in the nearby area.
translations.You're not going to be outrunning anythi: You're not going to be outrunning anything out here, so don't try. Nothing like the mad dash to find your harvest once you *have* taken it slow and steady, though.
translations.Now, I'm not one to criticise people's p: Now, I'm not one to criticise people's personal hygiene choices, especially not out here, but if you give off too much of a pong animals'll smell you miles off. Avoid traveling downwind, or try a scent eliminator.
translations.Every time you harvest something out her: Every time you harvest something out here you're making life just that bit easier for our native plants and animals. So pat yourself on the back, e hoa: every little helps.
translations.This is one of the hunting spots my ment: This is one of the hunting spots my mentor used to take me out to. Bound to be something worth stalking in the area.
translations.I'll admit that it wasn't just her recou: I'll admit that it wasn't just her recounting your heroic antics that made me pick up the phone.
translations.The camera will do most of the work, so: The camera will do most of the work, so you just have to make sure it's on when you head out to hunt. We have a couple of, eh, strategic locations on our list to get through, but let's get you that view first.
translations.Can you go clear out those movie props s: Can you go clear out those movie props so we can film in the area? Cheers.
translations.We've gotta clear out those movie props: We've gotta clear out those movie props if we're going to film in the area. Could I trouble you to go take a look?
translations.Our marketing team wants to show the wor: Our marketing team wants to show the world what this place has to offer, so they've asked us to take a few snaps of scenic sites around the reserve. One's a willow tree growing out of a lake beloved by social media types, the others a set of boulders that'll make you re-evaluate your attitude towards rocks.
translations.If you're wondering why there's no one a: If you're wondering why there's no one around, it's because the reserve is officially closed to visitors for the foreseeable future. Indefinitely conducting emergency field research, we said.
translations.Let's have a change of pace, why don't w: Let's have a change of pace, why don't we? You'll find the best pheasant hunting spots in the Río Sonora region. Just make sure to get them to take off first.
translations.Head over to the region marked on your H: Head over to the region marked on your Huntermate and we'll get started. Pheasant — pheasants? — are shy, so look around for any evidence of them in vegetation cover.
translations.The more cattle you cram into a small ar: The more cattle you cram into a small area, the less ground cover there is. Water just runs off the land instead of making it into the vegetation.
translations.Conni introduces Königsberg's landowner,: Conni introduces Königsberg's landowner, Robert Sommer. He likes to have his say when it comes to his land, and he has a problem with the fallow deer eating all of his farmers' corn. He has been in contact with Gerlinde about this, but since she is focusing on her book, Conni has requested your help.
translations.You got one? Great. Don't forget to harv: You got one? Great. Don't forget to harvest it. Then on to another.
translations.We don't have much to go on with the pho: We don't have much to go on with the photo other than the shrine and the curve of the hill behind it. Follow the arroyo north and see if you can find that area, then we'll look around for clues.
translations.This is around where I think the area in: This is around where I think the area in the photo might be. You're gonna have to do some scouting again.
translations.Gerlinde is a little worried. Erik went: Gerlinde is a little worried. Erik went out to play this morning and has not come back yet. He usually goes out for a few hours, but comes back when he gets hungry. He was last seen outside one of the cabins in Rathenfeldt. Conni has asked you to search for him if you are in the area.
translations.Gerlinde just called me. They found him!: Gerlinde just called me. They found him! A neighbor in the area saw him up ahead after hearing where he was headed.
translations.The last few photographs she needs are o: The last few photographs she needs are of various landmarks in the area. Do you think you could knock them out?
translations.Robert Sommer appreciated your help with: Robert Sommer appreciated your help with protecting his cornfields from hungry fallow deer. Sommer hunts recreationally in the area a few times a month with his wealthy friends. Their prey are mostly rabbits, foxes, and sometimes roe deer. They particularly love to hunt using bows. Sommer is a real weapon and equipment enthusiast, and will be able to give you a lot of advice on those. He has asked you to harvest a fox in Spreeberg using a certain kind of bow.
translations.Sommer often gets products to evaluate f: Sommer often gets products to evaluate from different companies around the world. This time, Pinelodge Creek has sent Sommer a new version of their roe deer scent that replicates the smell of deer urine. Sommer has asked for your help in evaluating this new product.
translations.Impressive. Seems like the scent did the: Impressive. Seems like the scent did the trick. I'll pass on the results to Sommer.
translations.Harvest each of the following animals in:
Harvest each of the following animals in their respective home regions:

A fallow deer
A red deer
A European bison
A wild boar
translations.The farmers are hassling Sommer about th: The farmers are hassling Sommer about their crops getting eaten again or being destroyed by different animals in the reserve. He is offering a good bounty for getting things under control. Sommer has suggested that creating hunting pressure in each of the four affected regions would do the trick.
translations.Bison have been seen wandering closer an: Bison have been seen wandering closer and closer to Schonfeldt's borders. A herd of bison walking over a strawfield can be devastating to the crops. Sommer would like you to harvest at least one to put some hunting pressure here in Rinderland.
translations.Köhler & Gerhardt has contacted Sommer r: Köhler & Gerhardt has contacted Sommer regarding a new scope they are testing. Sommer has received a large amount of samples for him and his hunting friends to evaluate, and he would like your input too. The manufacturer wants feedback on the .270's long-range hunting effectiveness in particular using the scope, so Sommer has asked you to down a fox with the rifle and scope.
translations.Each year Robert Sommer, as chairman of: Each year Robert Sommer, as chairman of the Central Europeean Reserve Organization, nominates the best weapons and hunting tools of the year at the "Jagdprodukte des Jahres." The time has come for this yearly evaluation and Sommer would like you to participate. Use different weapons that you have gathered during your stay to harvest animals and find a winner.
translations.Harvest any animal downed with one of th:
Harvest any animal downed with one of the following weapons:

Scoped Whitlock Model 86 rifle
Rhino 454 revolver
Cacciatore 12G shotgun
Hawk Edge CB-70
translations.If you feel like the wind is always work: If you feel like the wind is always working against you, try a scent eliminator from the shop.
translations.Are you going to harvest the game or tax: Are you going to harvest the game or taxidermize it? It's up to you.
translations.Dr. Vinay Bhandari is a member of The Eu: Dr. Vinay Bhandari is a member of The European Bison Advisory Organization, whose goal is the reintroduction of bison to Europe. The results have been phenomenal, and the population has grown and spread beyond Rinderland. However, troubling side effects have developed from the spread and some of the bison have become ill. Bhandari has asked for your help with retrieving a sample from a deceased bison to investigate the cause.
translations.The population has thrived, but progress: The population has thrived, but progress has been hampered recently by a disease of some sort. Bhandari was wondering if you could help him get a blood sample from a diseased bison in Tichenau. The organization would compensate you for your efforts, of course.
translations.The sample showed signs of brucellosis,: The sample showed signs of brucellosis, a disease that can cause miscarriages among the bison and is contagious. Sommer, who was already against the bison reintroduction from the start, is concerned about the possible detrimental effects on other wildlife in the reserve. Bhandari has asked for some help in tracking down the diseased animals.
translations.Bhandari suggested that the rapid spread: Bhandari suggested that the rapid spread of the brucellosis might be rooted in the equally rapid expansion of the bison population in a small area like Rinderland. This is a sensitive matter. One option would be to deport the sick bison, but seeing as the cause of the outbreak is not yet known, he thought that would not be a safest option. Instead, he suggests thinning out the population to counteract their mating and slow the spread of the disease.
translations.It's likely due to the population being: It's likely due to the population being too large and dense for an area of Rinderland's size, so we are employing hunters to help thin it out. Would you mind joining in the effort as well?
translations.The bison have been seen clashing with t: The bison have been seen clashing with the red deer in Jonsdorf. Bhandari would like to avoid other animals interacting with the bison until the brucellosis situation is under control. Conni suggested you create hunting pressure in the area under concern.
translations.I've suggested to Bhandari that we estab: I've suggested to Bhandari that we establish some hunting pressure in the area, which should keep the two apart for now. I was hoping you might be willing to help out?
translations.Well done! Dr. Bhandari let me know that: Well done! Dr. Bhandari let me know that he can't thank you enough. If you hadn't helped him out, the whole bison project could have been canceled. Now our reserve visitors will be able to enjoy these magnificent creatures for a long time to come.
translations.Every time I'm out in the wild, I try to: Every time I'm out in the wild, I try to prioritize resting, it always sets up my day. So use every opportunity you get to re-energize.
translations.Conni introduces Albertina Fleischer, wh: Conni introduces Albertina Fleischer, who volunteered to search for Erik Jäger when he was lost. It reminded Albertina of a similar episode in her youth when she got lost in the woods as a child. She believes that a red deer saved her life at the time by leading her back home. Albertina has a close friend, who is a taxidermist, and wanted to gift her a stuffed red deer for her birthday. She's requested your help in harvesting a buck.
translations.Welcome! I'm Trevor Locke, Head Warden o:
Welcome! I'm Trevor Locke, Head Warden of the New England Mountains reserve.

Let's get you settled in first: you can see the location of the nearest outpost on your Huntermate. Outposts are useful to take some rest and get ready, so hunters or hikers are doing themselves a favor if they know where to find them, regardless of their experience level.
translations.Outposts and lookouts are the 2 pillars:
Outposts and lookouts are the 2 pillars of any successful outdoor adventure if you ask me. Now that you've located one of each, I'd say you're ready to explore our reserve, my friend!

Now to the next order of business: I could use your help for a few tasks. First, I'd be grateful if you can pick up some maple syrup. That's your top-secret mission. (Oh, and it doesn't hurt that the area's really gorgeous too!)

Our common acquaintance kept telling me how trustworthy you are... More on him soon, it's a surprise!
translations.It's me, DOC. Long time no see, old frie:
It's me, DOC. Long time no see, old friend... I'm paying my son TREV a visit. I'm just a couple of hours' drive away now.

In the meantime, how about you check out my favorite spots in Trev's reserve? I sent a few old family photos in the mail the other day, they should be at this outpost.

The issue is that I don't remember where they are exactly... Don't know this place nearly as well as Layton Lake District, obviously. So take a look at the photos, hope they'll give you a clue!
(Hope that this Huntermate messaging function also works out here.....)
translations.The old man kind of spoiled my surprise,:
The old man kind of spoiled my surprise, didn't he? Hah, doesn't matter. Guess you two have a lot of catching up to do!

I need an experienced tracker for this one: I need you to take a photo of a carcass left behind by a Red Fox. It's for a talk I'm giving next month. Check your Huntermate, I've tagged a Red Fox feed zone I know.
Thanks a lot my friend, I really appreciate your help.
translations.Alright, all jokes aside, we have a seri:
Alright, all jokes aside, we have a serious situation in the lowlands in the southwest: farmers have spotted bears roaming a bit too close to their farms.

Based on my experience, that's usually because of some irresponsible hikers or tourists who don't pick up after themselves. Could you please collect the trash? Watch out for bears, you never know.
translations.Glad you took care of that problem with:
Glad you took care of that problem with the bear. Our next threat is more on the low-profile side, but it's a major danger for ecosystems: an invasive bush species known as perennial pepperweed. 

We've been seeing it more and more on the reserve, so we launched this joint initiative together with the state agencies. One of the main measures is to simply pull out the weeds before they spread.

Check your Huntermate, I've marked the locations my team has been focusing their efforts on recently.
translations.My old man just got here as you heard. I:
My old man just got here as you heard. I gotta say, I wasn't expecting us to have a heart-to-heart talk like that right away... I'm not used to that with Dad. Gotta enjoy those moments when they happen!

As a thank-you for your help, we decided we wanted you to see a location that means a lot to our family. It's a campsite located in a remote area in the northeast.

(Also, I've decided I'll tell my old man some big news a little later, so stay tuned!)
translations.Harvest samples of each species with a G:
Harvest samples of each species with a GOLD rating or higher:

A red deer
A European bison
A wild boar
A fallow deer
translations.Albertina's friend, the taxidermist Finn: Albertina's friend, the taxidermist Finn, has reached out to the hunters of Hirschfelden with quite a huge task. The Museum of Natural History has lost all of their stuffed animals to a fur beetle infestation. They were left in an unusable state. They are paying well for harvested specimens of each of the four big species.
translations.Nice harvest. I'm afraid it's not quite: Nice harvest. I'm afraid it's not quite good enough for the museum though.
translations.Finn, the taxidermist, has contacted Alb: Finn, the taxidermist, has contacted Albertina regarding a customer that is looking for a prime red deer buck for his luxurious mansion up in Werzfald. He is paying a hefty sum for a specimen delivered in mint condition. Albertina has asked you to hunt a red deer using the recommended caliber and a shot in its heart.
translations.That would make a fine harvest for the c: That would make a fine harvest for the client. Make sure to use the recommended caliber to finish the job.
translations.You got it, but that caliber will leave: You got it, but that caliber will leave too big of an entry wound for Finn's client unfortunately.
translations.Albertina is down with a cold. While she: Albertina is down with a cold. While she was making herself a cup of tea in her kitchen, she noticed a red deer outside her window. It was standing there, watching her with what looked like somber eyes. Albertina was sure it was trying to tell her something. She noticed then that it was badly wounded on its leg. It didn't look like it would make it out in the wild much longer. Albertina believes she must return a favor to the red deer, and has requested you to end its pain.
translations.Albertina said she felt it was asking he: Albertina said she felt it was asking her to end the pain. She couldn't help but think it was connected to her experience as a child. Coincidence if you ask me, but she's really the sweetest person and I'd love to send her some help. Can you track the deer down and harvest it?
translations.You can either harvest the carcass in ex: You can either harvest the carcass in exchange for cash, or you can get it taxidermied. Up to you.
translations.Marwin Tressler, owner of Star Hunting T: Marwin Tressler, owner of Star Hunting Tours, heard of your good work with Bhandari and the bison. Star Hunting Tours caters to clients looking for a boar hunting experience. Tressler wonders if you might help him get on good terms with Robert Sommer, whose farmers have complained about boars ruining their crops. Tressler would like your help in creating hunting pressure on the fields of Ritterstein and Müllerwald.
translations.The wild boar population is concentrated: The wild boar population is concentrated in the northern parts of the reserve, but they sometimes move south and Sommer is not happy about it. You see, they have a fondness for Sommer's crops. Tressler and Sommer have been at each other's throats about the boars lately, and if you could help out by creating some hunting pressure at the crop fields, that would really help defuse the situation. For now.
translations.These are the fields I mentioned. Now yo: These are the fields I mentioned. Now you just need to find something to harvest.
translations.Tressler's signed a deal with a boar mea: Tressler's signed a deal with a boar meat wholesaler specializing in burgers called "Boargermania." They want to stock up for the barbecue season early this year and have put in an order for one metric tonne of boar meat. Tressler has asked you to assist. A horde was seen close to the logging area in Müllerwald, and in Ritterstein, but feel free to go anywhere.
translations.Tressler and Star Hunting Tours are orga: Tressler and Star Hunting Tours are organizing another boar hunting experience for professional hunters and investors of the business next week. He wants to make sure the event goes off without a hitch by having enough boar in Müllerwald. Creating hunting pressure in Ritterstein to drive the boar east into Müllerwald.
translations.Sommer has been harrassing Tressler agai: Sommer has been harrassing Tressler again about the boar population. It seems an especially aggressive boar nicknamed Wurst, or "Sausage," by Tressler has been terrorizing kids in Petershain. It's come to the point where the farmers are threatening to strike until the safety of their children can be ensured. Tressler has asked you to hunt down the boar at large.
translations.This is the area where \"Wurst\" was las: This is the area where "Wurst" was last seen. See if you can pick up on any of its tracks.
translations.Tressler has received numerous, sudden c: Tressler has received numerous, sudden cancellations of reservations for Star Hunting Tours. It seems news has spread about radioactive boars wandering the reserve, contaminated by pollutants found in the plant life from the Chernobyl fallout. Of course, the meat harvested is unusable and not safe. Tressler has isolated the anomaly to a particular herd of boars, and will compensate you generously for harvesting them and restoring faith in his business.
translations.No, I'm serious! Not many know it, but t: No, I'm serious! Not many know it, but there are still some cesium-contaminated mushrooms and plants in the reserve due to the Chernobyl disaster fallout. Well, some hungry boar have been ingesting these. It's not like they glow in the dark or anything, but the meat is considered questionable at best, and is bad for Tressler's business.
translations.Welcome to the Emerald Coast, mate! I'm:
Welcome to the Emerald Coast, mate! I'm Sophia - just call me Soph. You're currently on my property, not far from my station - sorry, that's what we call a farm in Australia.

For starters, I reckon you should get your bearings on this part of the bush - there's a fire lookout tower not far from where you were dropped off. Once you've located my station, feel free to just go there and open the cabin I've prepared for you to use during your stay.

My husband Eric and I started building these a few years ago, for hunting groups or sometimes travellers to use.

I'm with a hunting group at the moment, so I can't meet you there in person. But no worries, you and I will catch up soon. In the meantime, make yourself at home!
translations.Now that you know where you can sleep, l:
Now that you know where you can sleep, let's introduce you to your main mission here: population management.

In Australia, it's pretty common for landowners such as Soph and me to coordinate with the state authorities to hire professional hunters to help control populations of various species. We're lucky to own rather sizable lands, but that also means it's our responsibility to care for these lands.

Let's start with kangaroos. They may be a native species, but they easily become overabundant and cause overgrazing, which in turn threatens other fauna and flora. 

(EDIT: Soph mentioned something about a book on kangaroos that she borrowed from me. Well, you'll get a chance to visit my Sanctuary later, so feel free to drop if off then. No rush mate, don't make a detour just for a book.)
translations.Sure, kangaroos are one of the species w:
Sure, kangaroos are one of the species we as landowners need to keep an eye on, but they're nothing compared to all the invasive pest species we have here. Whatever we do on a national or local level, we're just unable to bring their populations down to manageable levels.

As agreed, we're providing you with a varmint rifle, which will come in handy to hunt the smaller pests and feral animals. Feel free to collect it yourself! Oh, and we've left it near a target practice area, so that you can start getting a feel for its handling.
translations.Now you've got a reliable varmint rifle,:
Now you've got a reliable varmint rifle, plus you can check your Codex for more details on the various hunting assignments you can take on. We've split them up by species - that way you can plan your hunts yourself as you see fit. Good luck, and thanks!

However, we also want you to learn a bit more about our beautiful country: once you have some time for a break, I'd love to take you on a little cultural and historical detour. I'll show you some of the lesser-known places, and we'll talk about a true blue Aussie folk song: Waltzing Matilda.
translations.Oh, thanks a lot for dropping off my pre:
Oh, thanks a lot for dropping off my present for Robbo! Can't wait to hear him get all wildlife educator besserwisser on that little roo.

I gotta say, I'm also getting curious to see what he got me. We really appreciate you going out of your way to help with our presents , you know.

We have more things to cover in terms of invasive animals - this time we'll talk about the larger Deer species.
translations.You've been doing excellent work - our c:
You've been doing excellent work - our common friend Trevor Locke didn't oversell you one bit. You've really helped us out tracking down that Sambar and make sure the sighting gets reported using the appropriate channels. It's really critical we tackle that early...

Last but not least: we need to talk about salties, mate. One, because they're bloody dangerous and you don't want to take them on unprepared. Two, because we have a case on our hands: there was an article in the newspaper about an extremely territorial and aggressive saltie. Could you please look into it?

(Oh, and once we're all done with this saltie issue, don't forget to go back to Soph's station to drop off my present for her when you get the chance! I'd really owe you one mate.)
translations.Yes, it is worse than we thought. The ti: Yes, it is worse than we thought. The tiger has attacked livestock right next to its herder. She seems to be unharmed, but the tiger is now roaming next to Pauwa, my village. We need to act before a tragedy takes place. Go to the village now.
Birendra... He said he shot the tiger... Please follow the blood trail and see what you can find.
I hope Birendra's neighbor will be okay...
translations.Dhanyabaad... Thank you for retrieving t:
Dhanyabaad... Thank you for retrieving the tiger, sathi [my friend]. It is a tragedy Tara died, but... she had become a man-eater, so there was no other choice in that moment. 
Birendra told me that his neighbour Suraj will be okay. He's badly injured, but he will be transported to a hospital.
If the dust is settling a bit now, maybe we can show you other parts of the reserve, and introduce some of the challenges you should know as a contractor Conservation Officer.
translations.As you heard, Birendra Dai and I don't a:
As you heard, Birendra Dai and I don't always see eye to eye, but we don't want to sugarcoat the truth to you: Nepali people can face significant challenges, there's no denying it. But we disagree on --

Another gunshot? What's going on? Sounds like it was in your area, sathi!
translations.You're now in the Himal region. I'm worr: You're now in the Himal region. I'm worried that Manish might want to poach a Snow Leopard, although I can't really believe he would stoop so low. But anyway, let's check the trap cameras, see if any caught a Snow Leopard or Manish.
translations.Scout the area where a snow leopard was: Scout the area where a snow leopard was spotted
translations.Dai's friend Manish has been spotted in: Dai's friend Manish has been spotted in Himgiri, the most inaccessible place in Sundarpatan. What the hell is he doing there? What is he fleeing from? Regardless, if we don't save him, he's going to die... Be careful sathi, this will be tough even for you.
translations.Camera on? Then you should have everythi: Camera on? Then you should have everything you need.
translations.There's good hunting in the whole of thi: There's good hunting in the whole of this area, from up around where you cleared out the props earlier to closer to the beach.
translations.Take your pick, but just one thing: we w: Take your pick, but just one thing: we want it to show up nice on camera, so no minnows. Try for something at least 30 kg; the larger the better. Should be no problem for a hotshot like you.
translations.One final thing. You can take down the 1: One final thing. You can take down the 1080 warning sign. Any animals that haven't already kicked the bucket should've metabolized it by now, so it's safe to hunt in the area again.
translations.No one's around anymore, but you're welc: No one's around anymore, but you're welcome to swing by the old house once the filming's wrapped up if you're still in the area.
translations.So listen... I had a brief chat with Mel: So listen... I had a brief chat with Melanie and she was open to talking more. It's been twenty-five years, and it's going to take more than a single phone call, but it's a start.
translations.Two things: keep that camera strapped to: Two things: keep that camera strapped to you, and stay low. It wouldn't do to scare it now I've -- we've -- come so close.
translations.No records of any antlers in this area,: No records of any antlers in this area, but you don't exactly get many people out looking. Too remote.
translations.Hard blokes, they were: hard-working and: Hard blokes, they were: hard-working and hard-drinking. I found them kinda intimidating, truth be told.
translations.Turn that camera on again -- we're not d: Turn that camera on again -- we're not done here yet.
translations.If you decide not to harvest it, make su: If you decide not to harvest it, make sure to at least take a good photograph -- that action cam's not up to much there.
translations.Hope you've been enjoying yourself, e ho: Hope you've been enjoying yourself, e hoa! We've got some final touches to the reserve website to do, and the marketing team have requested a couple of photos of one of our lighthouses. Why don't you head over there and I'll fill you in on what's been happening while you've been out in the wop-wops?
translations.So I want you to help us make a change,: So I want you to help us make a change, become northern Mexico's leading biosphere and hunting reserve. Let me explain...
translations.A day out in the brush is enough to work: A day out in the brush is enough to work up a sweat for anyone. Don't be too proud to use a scent eliminator.
translations.Gerlinde Jäger is writing her second boo: Gerlinde Jäger is writing her second book on fallow deer. At the moment, she is interested in the interactions between the fallows and other animals. She has noticed fallow bucks chasing roe deer away in the area around Rathenfeldt's main outpost. Conni has asked you to investigate the area and take a photo of a fallow deer.
translations.Gerlinde is lovely, but here's a friendl: Gerlinde is lovely, but here's a friendly tip. Don't ask her about fallow deer unless you mean it. She will not stop. It's beyond obsession at this point. On the other hand, there's no one better for hunting tips when it comes to Fallows. Oh, and her venison stew is out of this world. Makes me hungry just thinking about it.
translations.And towards the west you’ll get the foot: And towards the west you’ll get the foothills rolling into the alpine region.
translations.We’ve been chased out of this area for a: We’ve been chased out of this area for a long time, and it’s only been a decade since we’ve been able to reclaim the place as a hunting site.
translations.You can’t really relocate a beaver becau: You can’t really relocate a beaver because other beavers in the area can smell that they’re not a family member. I’ve tried before and it wasn’t pretty.
translations.I wasn’t able to find any in the area, b: I wasn’t able to find any in the area, but maybe you’ll have more luck than me.
translations.Let’s see... I think I spotted endangere: Let’s see... I think I spotted endangered trees in this area a while ago. Limberpine, to be specific.
translations.Not too long ago, I found some caribou t: Not too long ago, I found some caribou tracks inside the resort area. If we can find enough of them, then construction needs to stop until all the caribou move out.
translations.Tony soon became a ghost town and this a: Tony soon became a ghost town and this area was left as crown land for many decades.
translations.I'm Sophia. Sure, this region is a beaut: I'm Sophia. Sure, this region is a beaut, but it's also bloody fragile.
translations.Before now, we've always just used the l: Before now, we've always just used the lakes for drinking water, but ever since Dad got ill, we've had to put emergency measures in place.
translations.Around the same time, two hikers reporte: Around the same time, two hikers reported to us that they spotted a single old man laden down with gear, heading into a part of the reserve that is known for its bears. When they asked him if he needed any help, he politely declined and kept walking.
translations.\"End Hunting Now\"? What? Is this some: "End Hunting Now"? What? Is this some kind of activist? I don't buy it.
translations.The breeze is an unreliable ally. It may: The breeze is an unreliable ally. It may be in your favor one moment, then acting against you the next; carrying your scent towards your target. If the wind is with you, it's best to take advantage quickly.
translations.I don't want to make it sound like I'm c: I don't want to make it sound like I'm criticising your daily hygiene routine, but most of the animals here can smell you from hundreds of meters away. There are ways to mask your scent, of course.
translations.[calm & quiet] You're well placed for a: [calm & quiet] You're well placed for a hunt. Our visitors often report that area as a good place to find prey.
You appear to have a little competition. Baden is keen to demonstrate that he has what it takes to do your job. I think you ought to show us both exactly why I hired you in the first place. Harvest anything you'd like.
translations.Apparently, he has harvested a pair of I: Apparently, he has harvested a pair of Ibex already. I think someone is trying to market themselves as a worthy competitor.
translations.While I am staunchly against it, the may: While I am staunchly against it, the mayor sees the sale of the government land and the increase in tourism as a boost for the region's shaky economy.
translations.It's essential that even if we don't cat: It's essential that even if we don't catch it, we ensure that it hasn't lingered in the area, putting the other goats at risk.
translations.That tractor is definitely out of action: That tractor is definitely out of action. On the plus side, Armando doesn't store anything valuable in there.
translations.The only study we have taking place here: The only study we have taking place here is for our gredos ibex. I don't believe that we've ever tagged wolves. I will ask my father about it.
translations.You're in the right area. Remember to ap: You're in the right area. Remember to approach carefully. They might still be there.

translations.The Whitetail deer is one of our local s:
The Whitetail deer is one of our local state symbols out here, and a favorite among hunters.
So how about you spot a few of them, and show me those hunting skills I've heard so much about? I'd love to see at least a Silver.
translations.Hey old friend, DOC here. There are 4 re:
Hey old friend, DOC here. There are 4 really beautiful locations that I want to share with you, but I don't know their exact location...

So take a good look at the photos you picked up - you can inspect them in the Mission Items section of your Codex. Hope they will help you figure out where TREV and I took them back then.
translations.My old man and I are thinking of going h:
My old man and I are thinking of going hunting like they used to when this country was young - using muzzle loaders and bows.

Why don't you give it a go as well? If you've never tried them out, they make for a very different experience, and they're a good way to broaden one's skill set as a hunter.

I suggest using the muzzle loader to hunt a Moose, and the bow for, er... a Turkey.

translations.Another of the challenges we have as par:
Another of the challenges we have as part of our International Hunting Competition. This is centered on the quality of the trophies: Gold or better, that's the name of the game!
I've listed the specific requirements for each species in the objective list, take a look!
translations.Time to show how stealthy you can be! Th:
Time to show how stealthy you can be! This is the newest addition to our roster for the International Hunting Competition, and a great challenge for hunters.
The key here is to be at max 30 meters from your target. Check out the objective to see the specific requirements.

translations.Another one of those really scary lookin: Another one of those really scary looking boars has been sighted close to the logging area!
translations.We have one more target practice locatio:
We have one more target practice location in the area, you're welcome to use it!
I try to make a habit of going there as often as I can. Skills don't just magically stay stable if you don't brush up and train on a regular basis. The true experts know they always need to learn and improve.
translations.Smaller pests are often considered to be:
Smaller pests are often considered to be Australia's next major plague - and it's already pretty bad in a lot of places. It's even become an official nation-wide campaign now, so everyone needs to do their part: landowners, hunters, even civilians if they can.

We need your help with some serious population control for the following species:
- Red Fox
- Chital (aka Axis Deer)
- Fallow Deer
- Hog Deer (I always tell kids they should be renamed "Ninja Deer")
translations.Pretty much anything can become feral in:
Pretty much anything can become feral in Australia, they say. Two of the worst species for us farmers are Feral Goats and Feral Pigs.
They're very destructive and very hard to cull effectively, so we definitely count on you to work your magic.

Needless to say, we've already done all the paperwork and obtained all the required hunting permits for you, for all the species you'll hunt here.
translations.I'm sure you'd love to discover one of A:
I'm sure you'd love to discover one of Australia's most iconic animal species. Not just through hunting, but also tracking and photography. So how about we do a bit of everything?
 
Did you know that the Magpie Goose is one of these species called "living fossils"? That certainly explains how different it looks from other birds.
translations.Now that's my turf! Some people call me:
Now that's my turf! Some people call me the saltie hunter around here... I don't think I'd be too good on TV to be honest, but I do know a thing or two about Saltwater Crocodiles. It's definitely not for everyone, even an expert hunter like Soph doesn't do salties.

But we sure could use more saltie experts, so if anyone can do it, it's you. Make sure to read up on the info I've logged in your Codex, and be very careful.
translations.Stubble Quails are ubiquitous in Austral:
Stubble Quails are ubiquitous in Australia, so it's no surprise they're common in pretty much any biome of the Emerald Coast too. The little fellas are able to adapt to a wide variety of environments.

Why don't you see for yourself? I suggest you take the time to observe and photograph them, in addition to learning how to hunt them.
translations.Now that's what I call a real challenge!:
Now that's what I call a real challenge! You and I are both hunters, we know that we love a tough challenge, something that you need time and skill to overcome. Something that makes you proud, and shows how much effort and dedication you've put into what you love, right?

So I've prepared this nice little list for you - let me tell ya, there aren't many hunters that got through it all. And I don't think Robbo would either. But I'm curious to see if you're really an "world-class hunter", to quote our American friend Trevor.
translations.The Emerald Coast boasts a few stunning:
The Emerald Coast boasts a few stunning landmarks. I won't spoil the surprise for you, you'll get to discover them by yourself!

We're really lucky to live in such a gorgeous place. No wonder Soph never felt the need to live anywhere else! Me, I lived in Brisbane during my studies and during most of my twenties, but I never stopped missing the Emerald Coast. And as my folks were getting older, I ended up moving back here, and Lizzie and I opened the sanctuary. We can't think of a better place to raise Felix.
translations.In addition to all the smaller pests, we:
In addition to all the smaller pests, we have three large Deer species that have become a big biodiversity challenge: Sambars, Rusas and Red Deer. Although they're very strictly regulated, their local populations keep increasing.

So we need to put a serious dent in their populations.
translations.Good news! Thanks to you, the reserve th: Good news! Thanks to you, the reserve thinks that all water buffalo here are not of the endangered type. They will soon be moved and their grazing lands will be given to local famers. But before they go, why not hunt one of every buffalo on the reserve?
translations.Until we find a better solution, we ask: Until we find a better solution, we ask you to hunt many of the rampant Nilgai herds that are plaguing farmers in the area.
translations.Ugh, poachers have put traps meant for B: Ugh, poachers have put traps meant for Barasingha near their drinking lakes. Don't they think of the kids who play here too? Please hurry and remove all of these traps before something or someone gets hurt.
translations.From how far away can you harvest a red:
From how far away can you harvest a red fox?

That's a rhetorical question, by the way. Please don't shoot from too far or else I might get a strongly worded email.
translations.So I hear you like taking pictures! You: So I hear you like taking pictures! You know, I have my camera out so much while looking for Sasquatch that I've gotten into birdwatching myself. We've got about 7 different species of birds in Askiy Ridge, and I want to challenge you to take a picture of each and every one.
translations.There's one more task that I'd like your: There's one more task that I'd like your help with as a hunter. Janine has told me that we have a few too many moose on the preserve to be sustainable in the long run. Harvesting a few for us will help us maintain a healthy population at Askiy Ridge.
translations.Now when you've warmed up a little, why: Now when you've warmed up a little, why don't you investigate some more animals in the area?
translations.Your first foray into Haggis hunting did: Your first foray into Haggis hunting didn't go too smoothly. Maybe the issue was the bait, so here's Isla to show you how to cook by the book. You will also be receiving a new weapon to hopefully help make future hunting excursions smoother.

translations.This area is famous for those fine, matu: This area is famous for those fine, mature bucks, see if you can find one!
translations.Just before I was born, my grandfather c: Just before I was born, my grandfather climbed mount silveridge and stashed a pair of quartz rattles at the top. When I was a teenager, my dad showed me them and told me that they were only to be brought down the mountain in times of dire need.
translations.Further up north, that's where you'll fi: Further up north, that's where you'll find the very high mountains that we're maybe more famous for, the "Himalayas"; but we just say the Himal Region.
translations.We're currently gathering reports about: We're currently gathering reports about the severity of the situation and cross-referencing our monitoring data with any footage from the camera traps.
translations.Before we send you into tiger territory,: Before we send you into tiger territory, can I ask you to make one ethical kill and harvest? Check the details on your Huntermate.
translations.A very clean harvest, well done! I can s: A very clean harvest, well done! I can see why our counterparts in other reserves were always so positive about you.
translations.So we need to go to the bottom of this b: So we need to go to the bottom of this before any accidents happen. Let's start with the area where Tara was sighted last.
translations.I'm Gurung, and my people mostly live in: I'm Gurung, and my people mostly live in various parts of the Hilly Region. Some of us are Buddhist like me, and others are Hindu.
translations.I think it would be nice for us to help: I think it would be nice for us to help the villagers by hunting some game for them. I have sent you the hunting area on your device.
translations.If you ask me, that's the work of poache: If you ask me, that's the work of poachers. We've suspected their presence in the region lately, but we weren't sure.
translations.You have arrived at the Nilgai feeding g: You have arrived at the Nilgai feeding grounds. You know, for us farmers, Nilgai are simply pests.
translations.This is really worrying... Search the ar: This is really worrying... Search the area and let us know if you find anything.
