translations.Keep it up! Now we are getting to the da:
Keep it up! Now we are getting to the dangerous animals, and you do not wanna get close to those. But using a scoped rifle is a whole science in itself. Scopes can be tuned to different distances and an experienced hunter knows how to tweak this. We call it Zeroing and mastering that perk will drastically improve your chances of hitting a target from a distance.

Class 5 animals in Intisuyu is:
- Puma
translations.With all that said: Many of our most dan:
With all that said: Many of our most dangerous animals hide in environments where long distance scoping is not possible and it is best for you to be prepared for such encounters. 

The Class 6 animals can be aggressive towards humans so remember to equip yourself with a First Aid Kit. Animals like the jaguar will try to sneak up on you and then - let’s just hope you are lucky.

Class 6 animals on the reserve:
- Jaguar
- Spectacled Bear
- South American Tapir
translations.Not such a novice hunter anymore? Only o:
Not such a novice hunter anymore? Only one more thing to master before becoming an ethical hunter: Hitting the vital organ.

Ammunition can either have high Penetration allowing you to hit vital organs through bones, muscles and thick hide or high Expansion, which is not as effective at piercing, but more efficient when hitting the softer parts of the animal. If you are unsure if the bullet can go deep enough you can always go for higher Penetration ammo. Better shoot clean though the animal, then just wounding it.

Class 7 animals on the reserve:
- Black Caiman
translations.We have had to cancel our popular llama: We have had to cancel our popular llama trek along the mountain trails due to the increase in animal attacks in the area. There is a substantial reward for the hunter who can locate the animal behind the attacks, so that the retreat can open again! Attached below are the coordinates of the latest attack, there you can begin your hunt.
translations.The spectacle bears as constantly losing:
The spectacle bears as constantly losing their habitats due to agricultural growth, leading to a diminished population and inbreeding. The result of this is more aggressive males that have started attacking domestic species and in the worst cases - their own cubs. Here in Intisuyu there is a possibility to act quickly and stop this degradation.

Please, do the merciful thing and cull the bears, to protect the few we still have remaining!
translations.My mother is too proud to admit it but t: My mother is too proud to admit it but the wild life is starting to scare her. She used to love living by herself. But now she talks about strange creatures stalking the outpost by night. And with everything going on, with the jaguar and stuff, maybe someone could check out the area surrounding her cabin, and find a way to make it safe - before her paranoia accidentally hurts any tourists?
translations.Anticuchos is a traditional Peruvian dis: Anticuchos is a traditional Peruvian dish prepared in a variety of ways, traditionally made out of beef heart and served with potatoes, choclo and a spicy ají sauce. But if you ask me, a grilled deer heart gives it that special touch my kitchen is known for. Bring me an intact heart from a whitetail deer and I can show you what I mean!
translations.That is good, no? Another classic from t: That is good, no? Another classic from the Peruvian cuisine is chicharrón. Many other countries make it more, what do you say? Cruchy? We like it more succulent. More tender. And the secret to that is in that fat, juicy pork belly! So if you can get that, then I can fix some bread, sweet potatoes, some rocoto hot sauce and salsa criolla. Here is an abundance of collared peccary in this reserve. No one would miss one pig, right?
translations.Oh, but now you have to try the arroz co: Oh, but now you have to try the arroz con pato. Even though it is deceptively simple, with a base of rice and duck, many people do not really get how to season the duck. But if you could get me a fine sample of a cinnamon teal, then I can show you some dark-bean-cilantro-magic! But remember, the duck needs undamaged femurs! We want perfect savory legs to bite into!
translations.Both me and my brother have wounded each: Both me and my brother have wounded each other oh so terribly. Please, I am not well anymore. I think I am dying. I’m so sorry my brother had to pass on before me. The cantua buxifolia. It is a flower of great importance. Please take it to his grave. He is buried next to the lake by the house where he used to live, in Condor’s Edge. I can not travel there myself. But placing a cantua on his grave will start to make things right.
translations.Vicuñas in the area have started exhibit: Vicuñas in the area have started exhibiting strange behaviors and the local veterinarian institute is concerned. Examine their droppings from vicuñas outside of the sanctuary so that samples can be sent to the authorities and prevent an eventual epidemic.
translations.It is that time of year again. The ocelo: It is that time of year again. The ocelots are becoming more and more brave and are causing all types of problems in the area. Stealing food and eating pets. Terrorizing tourists who are here to see the bridge. We have gotten the permit to cull some of them for the coming season.
translations.Located in the northeast of the Himal (h:
Located in the northeast of the Himal (high mountains), Himgiri is the most remote part of the whole Sundarpatan Hunting Reserve, due to the high altitude and the deep valley forming a natural barrier. Only one small Sherpa community lives there permanently. 

In Nepali, "giri" means "mountain, peak" and "him" is a shortened version of "himal" (Sanskrit word for "snow").
translations.The western and central parts of the Him:
The western and central parts of the Himal (high mountains) region. While slightly more accessible than Himgiri, thanks to its trekking trails and the guest houses owned by Sherpa people, this is still an area one should not venture in without adequate altitude training. The landscape is dotted with predominantly Buddhist landmarks.

The region is named after the Wild Yak ("Chauri" In Nepali) which can only be observed there; "himal" is the Sanskrit word for "snow".
translations.The westernmost middle mountains in the:
The westernmost middle mountains in the central Pahad (also called the "Hilly Region" in Nepal). The landscape is mostly composed of long rolling hills which give it a distinct relaxed, idyllic feel, grazing grounds loved by Nilgai and Blue Sheep.

It was named after the breeze that regularly starts blowing in the early afternoon in the Hilly Region (in Nepali, "batase" means "windy, breezy").
translations.The central and eastern mountains in the:
The central and eastern mountains in the Pahad (also called the "Hilly Region" in Nepal). This very varied landscape is composed of mountains, plains and valleys, and is home not only to various wildlife species but also is the heart of many Indigenous Nepali cultures, such as the Gurung, Rai and Limbu.

In Nepali, "Purbi Pahad" means "Eastern Hills".
translations.The flattest and southernmost part of Te:
The flattest and southernmost part of Terai, located south of the Besi Khola, the large river that flows through the Sundarpatan Hunting Reserve. Its climate has made it the main area for mustard seed farms, which have also given the region its name (in Nepali, "tori" means "mustard", and "pur" is a suffix meaning "settlement").

This is the go-to area for hunters aiming to encounter Muntjacs.
translations.The central part of the Terai, i.e., the:
The central part of the Terai, i.e., the tropical lowlands in the South, also called "southern plains" by the Nepali. Tharu people have lived among these tropical forests and cultivated its grassy plains for centuries. And like the locals before them, hunters exploring these plains should be wary of any roaming Bengal Tiger.

In Nepali, "Paschima" means "western", and "ban" means forest.
translations.Thukpa is a noodle soup dish that is com: Thukpa is a noodle soup dish that is commonly found in various countries in South Asia. The Nepali version of thukpa is usually vegetarian, and is especially popular in the Himal region.
translations.Greeley Notch is a large valley located: Greeley Notch is a large valley located west of Champney Ridge. Right in the middle between the more densely populated areas in the south and the remote, deep forests of the north, it's been known to be a gateway between two worlds. Among others, if you're quiet, you'll be able to hunt the Red Fox and Bobcat if you're after small predators, as well as Pheasant and Eastern Turkey.
translations.Located in the northwest of the reserve,: Located in the northwest of the reserve, Tuckerman Range is one of the smaller mountain ridges, and one of the areas that require a bit more preparation and exploration. One of its main features is a rather spectacular U-shaped valley, but it has also a few other secrets.
translations.Belknap Notch is a remote valley located:
Belknap Notch is a remote valley located in the north of the reserve. Thanks to its Wilderness Area status, we're able to prevent a lot of behaviors that would be detrimental to the fauna and flora. Usually, inexperienced hunters don't go there a lot, and we always recommend visitors to gear up appropriately. 
But if you're out for Bobcat, Gray Fox, or game bird like the Eastern Turkey and Bobwhite Quail, that's where you're more likely to find them.
translations.Stuck between high ranges, Bamberg Gap i: Stuck between high ranges, Bamberg Gap is a small mountain pass that is part of the Belknap Wilderness Area. With its secluded lakes and the Wabanaki River coming back after quite a detour, this region is home to game bird like the Bobwhite Quail and Eastern Turkey; the Gray Fox and Bobcat are also known to roam these rugged forests and hills.
translations.Retz Notch is the gorgeous narrow valley: Retz Notch is the gorgeous narrow valley nested between Champney Ridge to the north and Hawthorne Hills to the south. Retz Brook is a tributary to the larger Wabanaki River, and thanks to its central location, many species are known to feed and drink along its banks.
translations.Hawthorne Hills is a smaller mountain ra: Hawthorne Hills is a smaller mountain range, nested right between the Wabanaki River and its tributary Retz Brook. It's a quite varied landscape, between several hills, forests and many large lakes. There, since we're closer to the farmlands, you're more likely to find Coyotes and Raccoons, among others.
translations.Named after the Wabanaki River, this lar: Named after the Wabanaki River, this large valley is mostly used as farmlands, thanks to its fertile soils and good environment. In this whole area, Franconia Grant, human influence is more prevalent, but we have pretty strict rules on what is allowed or not. Hunters will be able to go for Red Fox, Pheasant, Coyote and Raccoon.
translations.Driscoll Pass is a natural region that h: Driscoll Pass is a natural region that has somewhat been influenced by people, but has found somewhat of a balance. You'll find a grazing spot that our local cattle love, and a wide variety of biomes and animals, most notably Gray Fox and Bobwhite Quail.
translations.The stone circles discoverable around th: The stone circles discoverable around the reserve are not, as some have inquired, spiritual artifacts. Every challenge is automated with motion sensors. Wherever you see a stone circle, enter it. Your target will appear and the challenge begins. Try using a variety of weapons for every target. Find your weaknesses and eliminate them!
translations.Now that I've seen you at your best, I'v: Now that I've seen you at your best, I've got a new long-term goal for you: Harvest a diamond trophy from *every* species in the reserve. Only one other hunter has collected them all. Naturally, that hunter was me. But that was some time ago, and if we're going to impress our guests, we need more recent trophies at the lodge -- to prove that the red stags today are as grand as they were in 1987, viste?
translations.Acceleration causes the camera to rotate: Acceleration causes the camera to rotate faster the longer the analog stick is held.
Acceleration causes the camera to rotate faster the longer the right stick is held.
translations.Choose the color of a spotted animal's o: Choose the color of a spotted animal's outline.
translations.Be careful when hunting black bear. Not: Be careful when hunting black bear. Not only are they unpredictable, but they also make very little sound and leave few tracks. You can sneak up on one without realizing it. Fortunately, they'll probably notice you before you them, and will keep their distance.
translations.We're fortunate to have one of the only: We're fortunate to have one of the only European bison populations that needs to be controlled by hunting. But hunting bison is really hard. They leave very few tracks, are mostly silent and can take most high caliber rounds without flinching. Oh, and you don't want to just wound them. They can get quite dangerous.
translations.Scent eliminators help you get a little: Scent eliminators help you get a little bit closer to animals without being noticed.
translations.Scent eliminators will get you a little: Scent eliminators will get you a little closer to animals without being noticed.
translations.Hunting a mature Gredos Ibex is the moti: Hunting a mature Gredos Ibex is the motivation for many of our visitors. They have the largest horns, ergo; the largest trophies.
translations.The Southeastern Ibex's horns follow a d: The Southeastern Ibex's horns follow a distinctive backwards sweeping curve, making them stand out amongst the other breeds.
translations.See those vampire teeth on the musk deer: See those vampire teeth on the musk deer? They're not for sucking blood, musk deer are herbivores, of course. Their teeth function more like antlers — the bucks use them for defense, or to combat each other during the rutting season. Pretty cool, right?
translations.This is ridiculous. I promise you, I gre: This is ridiculous. I promise you, I grew up here, I am Nenets, we know this land. There is no Chuchunya, no Menk, no Bigfoot, whatever you want to call it. But the way this expedition has gone, watch me say that and suddenly a real, live Chuchunya will appear.
translations.Ah the mighty Banteng. You don't see the: Ah the mighty Banteng. You don't see them often in this region. Did you know they can be found eating seaweed sometimes?
translations.Outposts aren't always convenient. Hunte: Outposts aren't always convenient. Hunters willing to lug a tent around -- or have their nephews do it for them, like I do -- have the freedom and flexibility to maximize their results. Set one up near a remote need zone, and you can wait for that perfect opportunity.
translations.There are antelopes, and then there are: There are antelopes, and then there are blackbucks. The blackbucks were imported here from their native India. I bet if you ask them, they like Patagonia better. The grass, the water, everything is more abundant here. That means larger, healthier blackbucks. Look for males with thick horns, three twists, wide spirals, and tips pointing outward if you're searching for the ultimate trophy.
translations.Do you say axis deer or chital? I say ax: Do you say axis deer or chital? I say axis deer, so from now on, you do too. These beauties were introduced to Patagonia about a century ago. Like everything else, they thrive here, turning out world-class bucks! They like to wander in single file, so don't be surprised if tracking one leads you to an entire queue.
translations.I have an affinity for pumas. Not just h: I have an affinity for pumas. Not just hunting them. I've raised them, rehabilitated them, protected them. I bet we have more pumas per kilometer in this reserve than anywhere else in the Americas. They have a simple philosophy, one which I have applied to my business dealings. Respect the puma, the puma respects you. But disrespect the puma once? You get no second chance, viste?
translations.People from the USA love to brag about h: People from the USA love to brag about how great their mule deer hunting is back home. But after they see the deer at Parque Fernando, they are not bragging anymore. World-class bucks and does are so abundant here, if we don't hunt them, they'll overpopulate and starve the other animals who graze here, because these boludos eat EVERYTHING.
translations.Is there any creature more beautiful tha: Is there any creature more beautiful than a red stag in the prime of his life? If so, I have not seen it. Red deer are the signature game of Parque Fernando. Unfortunately, while red deer love Patagonia, and hunters love red deer, not everyone is so smitten. These big, strong invaders have been competing with smaller native huemul -- south Andean deer -- for foods like the Lenga beech. The result? The huemul are endangered. I haven't spotted one here in years. So, when you hunt red deer, remember: you're doing a public service for the huemel.
translations.There's an easy trick to hunting water b: There's an easy trick to hunting water buffalo that a surprising number of people miss: water buffalo love... water. If any guests ever ask you where to find them, send them to the lakes and swamps. Water buffalo are vital for maintaining uncontrolled vegetation growth in the reserve, especially during wet seasons. And their meat? Fanastic! Our local beef is world-class, but if you ask me, I still prefer buffalo.
translations.My Fernando isn’t buried here. He deserv: My Fernando isn’t buried here. He deserved better — a blessed monument at our estancia. Unfortunately, several of Fernando’s uncles, brothers, and cousins have met their ends here in the park. Those careless boludos never appreciated nature like Fernando did. They caused me so much heartache after Fernando passed, but... the things is, family is family, so I’ve generously dedicated this little plot to their memories — not that anybody ever comes to visit them.
translations.Great, but unfortunately this wasn't in: Great, but unfortunately this wasn't in the right region.
translations.Good one, but I think you were meant to: Good one, but I think you were meant to do that in another region.
translations.The wigeons always return to the palearc: The wigeons always return to the palearctic region to breed! Maybe they find the aurora borealis romantic, what do you think?
translations.Harlequin ducks will stay here for the w: Harlequin ducks will stay here for the warmer months, then migrate out to the coast for winter. They're some of the smallest creatures you might hunt out here, but they thrive in Alaska's harshest weather. They tend to stick to flowing water, so look for them when you're close to the river.
translations.One of nature's most widespread predator: One of nature's most widespread predators; red foxes are an invasive species that thrive out here at Yukon Valley. They are doing so well in fact, that they are destabilizing the local ecology. We need to keep a hard cap on their numbers, so I encourage hunting them, if you get the chance.
translations.Gray wolves are responsible for the majo: Gray wolves are responsible for the majority of lost caribou herd in Yukon Valley, and their packs are growing every year. Out here in the wilderness, they don't have any reason to fear humans, either. I'm hoping that a side effect of thinning out their numbers will be the introduction of a little doubt before they attack a human, at least.
translations.The Alaskan moose is a wonderful creatur: The Alaskan moose is a wonderful creature. The first time you get close, all you can think about is how big it is. A fully grown moose can eat up to sixty pounds of plant matter in a day. You might be surprised when you see the speed they can run at... [playful] just pray it's not running at you!
translations.Mallards can be found all over Yukon Val: Mallards can be found all over Yukon Valley's lakes and rivers. This is in stark contrast to the Harlequin Duck, which almost exclusively sticks to the river. Mallards are not picky eaters, and tend to feed on small fish, fish eggs, mollusks, plants and tadpoles. They probably wouldn't turn their beak up at whatever bread your grandma threw into the pond, either.
translations.Himalayan tahr were released here in the: Himalayan tahr were released here in the early nineteen hundreds for the express purpose of attracting visiting hunters like you, and I think you'll agree that they're quite the spectacle. Easy to draw out, too -- give 'em a call and they'll come running!
translations.I'm sure you've come across red deer on: I'm sure you've come across red deer on your travels before, but I doubt you've seen any that rival the specimens here. Like something out of a fairytale. They've given me a lot of grief over the years, but I've gotta respect their will to survive.
translations.[radio static] Hello? Are you there? Hel: [radio static] Hello? Are you there? Hello? There you are! Dobro pozhalovat'! Welcome to Medved-Taiga National Park, my friend! Not that we're friends. Yet! I'm Khada Alena Khasavovna, but you can call me Alena. I'm your primary contact, so you and I will be friends in no time.
translations.I put together this cross-disciplinary e: I put together this cross-disciplinary expedition to study the effects of climate change in this region. My team and I are scientists, not activists, so this isn't a political thing. We're only interested in data. Verifiable facts.
translations.Animals downwind from you will pick up y: Animals downwind from you will pick up your scent. But you knew that, right? Of course you did. At least I hope so...
translations.If you're going to rest tonight, you nee: If you're going to rest tonight, you need to find an outpost, and that means knowing where one is. You can only see so much from the ground, so unless you brought your rocket boots, you have to climb the nearest lookout point. I've marked the location on your Huntermate. Happy hiking!
translations.Gunther Baden is the photographer for th: Gunther Baden is the photographer for the expedition. He's set up a number of camps throughout the area to document the effects of climate change in the region. Alena hasn't heard from him in a week, but his last message said he was low on food.
translations.Gunther arrived about a week ago to set: Gunther arrived about a week ago to set up remote cameras all across this region, Ledyanoy Bay. He loaded up an ATV with plenty of supplies, but like I said, we haven’t heard from him since the storm.
translations.Alena is worried about Gunther. His last: Alena is worried about Gunther. His last communication was over a week ago before a big blizzard hit the region. He has several camps around the region. Head to his last known location and search for Gunther.
I will admit I'm worried about Gunther. Even with all the trouble he is making for you and me, nobody deserves to starve or... Well, anyway, you'll find him at a campsite in the area I've marked on your Huntermate. Stay safe out there.
translations.By the way... Has Columbus Neidell reach: By the way... Has Columbus Neidell reached out to you? He's my American archaeologist friend, a major geek studying the history of taiga peoples. Neidell is not, shall we say, "rugged" like American archaeologists in the movies, but YOU are. So! Lend my friend Neidell a hand when you can. Help him chronicle the rich history of this place before time erases it. Neidell is generous. He will reward your effort.
translations.Look around the area. Are there any sign: Look around the area. Are there any signs of life? Signs of where Gunther might have gone?
translations.That sounds like a reindeer. But it's… I: That sounds like a reindeer. But it's… It's in pain. Oh no. Gunther was sick, starving, and a terrible shot. What if he wounded an animal without killing it? Or left a trap on the wrong trail? Please, find this reindeer and tell me I'm wrong...
translations.Gunther left a note: he managed to find: Gunther left a note: he managed to find a dead musk deer and has been able to stave off his hunger for now. He's headed back to the base camp, but he's terribly sick. If he's nearby, he might need your help. Follow his tracks and see if you can catch up with him.
translations.The caliber of the bullet in that reinde: The caliber of the bullet in that reindeer matches Gunther's rifle. That's not conclusive, but if Gunther is out there with a firearm, we have to find him before more animals get hurt -- or before he hurts himself. Do you see anything around his campsite that could give us a lead?
translations.There are water monitoring sites scatter: There are water monitoring sites scattered throughout this region. Our biologist, Anatoly Barnyashev, wants you to check on those to make sure this anthrax contamination didn’t spread.

There are water monitoring sites scattered throughout this region. Our biologist, Anatoly Barnyashev, wants you to check on those to make sure this anthrax contamination didn’t spread. The areas where you will find these sites are marked on your Huntermate.
translations.This area is anthrax-free, thank you! Th: This area is anthrax-free, thank you! There are two more of these stations in the area.
translations.Ura! All three water monitoring stations: Ura! All three water monitoring stations test clean for anthrax. Thank you for being so professional despite, you know, infectious diseases and all the grim stuff. Frankly, I am surprised you are able to handle such nasty business and stay so calm. You may be a person of few words, but your actions speak to your good character. Anatoly is like my Number Two at base camp. He may pester you for help here and there, but I trust he won't take advantage of you.
translations.Nenets report wild boar in the area mark: Nenets report wild boar in the area marked on your Huntermate. They overgrazed the land to the west and now they're migrating here. Unfortunately, they'll disrupt the musk deer's grazing and attract hungry lynxes. Thin the boar pack down by a few heads. That should create enough pressure to push them back home.
translations.Here's a more \"conventional\" job. Nene: Here's a more "conventional" job. Nenets report wild boar in the area marked on your Huntermate. They overgrazed the land to the west and now they're migrating here. Unfortunately, they'll disrupt the musk deer's grazing and attract hungry lynxes. Thin the boar pack down by a few heads. That should create enough pressure to push them back home.
translations.If I could understand them, I'm sure the: If I could understand them, I'm sure the musk deer would thank you for keeping the boar away from their food. Resources are extremely limited in the Taiga. Not just for you and me, but especially for the animals. When the environment is stable, nature has a way of balancing these things. Unfortunately, the environment is now changing so rapidly that nature can't catch up.
translations.The Gateway attracts many visitors, but: The Gateway attracts many visitors, but not all of them are welcome. Some of the Nenets traveling through your area have reported their food being stolen. Very unusual, especially in winter. Can you see if this is an animal problem? Like a wayward lynx? Hungry brown bear?
translations.Bad news. The Gateway attracts many visi: Bad news. The Gateway attracts many visitors, but not all of them are welcome. Some of the Nenets traveling through your area have reported their food being stolen. Very unusual, especially in winter. Before I go jumping to conclusions about poachers and mammoth pirates, can you see if this is an animal problem? Like a wayward lynx? Hungry brown bear? Check around you for tracks.
translations.Eh, what the [radio static] are those?!: Eh, what the [radio static] are those?! Chuchunya? Or, as you may call him, uh... Bigfoot? Fignya, I say! This is a joke, right? You're playing a prank on me? Like on TV? Where are the hidden cameras? We don't have time for this. [sigh] You didn't make the tracks, did you? Well, if you didn't make those tracks, I need you to find out who did.
translations.Are you sure you're looking in the area: Are you sure you're looking in the area marked on the Huntermate?
translations.But remember! You are a hunter, not a co: But remember! You are a hunter, not a commando. If you encounter poachers or pranksters, do NOT engage them. Seriously. And unless you're packing some high-caliber firepower, don't engage the bears, either. Trust me.
translations.Ser'Yozna! This was no Chuchunya. It was: Ser'Yozna! This was no Chuchunya. It was a bear. Probably a hungry one. I warned the team not to store their food carelessly. But did they listen to me? Of course not! Why listen to Alena? She's merely a highly educated, experienced native of the region... [she takes several deep breaths]
translations.Lynx migrated to this area many years ag: Lynx migrated to this area many years ago, after some overzealous hunters killed off all the wolves. The wolves moved out, the lynx moved in. It's hard to spot the lynx, but documenting their migration and survival is essential to our research. Nenets have already reported lynx in your area. Find a lynx and photograph it for us.
translations.Okay. So! The police have resumed search: Okay. So! The police have resumed searching for our missing party members, thanks to your scouting. I am praying for a miracle to find them. But, I didn't bring you here to hunt for missing persons. Perhaps you desire a challenge more befitting your experience?
translations.Lynx migrated to this area many years ag: Lynx migrated to this area many years ago, after some overzealous hunters killed off all the wolves. The wolves moved out, the lynx moved in. That's just how it goes out here. Everybody's hungry.
translations.It's hard to spot the lynx, but document: It's hard to spot the lynx, but documenting their migration and survival is essential to our research. Nenets have already reported lynx in your area. Find a lynx and photograph it for us. They are extremely fast and highly sensitive. So! "Stealth" is the word when tracking them.
translations.A lynx? Keep your distance. Have your ca: A lynx? Keep your distance. Have your camera ready.
translations.Very good. Your camera skills are servic: Very good. Your camera skills are servicable. Now, see if you can harvest the lynx. Anatoly requires a specimen for dissection. With anthrax in the area, we need to keep a close eye on the health of these animals.
translations.Guess who just got back today? Them wild: Guess who just got back today? Them wild-eyed boars that had been away -- rumor has it that boars are invading the Lesnye Lands. Maybe the lynx pushed them there. Maybe the storm. Either way, the area can't sustain them. Create hunting pressure by harvesting a few.
translations.Rumor has it that boars are invading thi: Rumor has it that boars are invading this region. Maybe the lynx pushed them here. Maybe the storm. Either way, this area can't sustain them. Create hunting pressure in the area marked on the Huntermate. Send them home.
translations.Boars confirmed. Harvest a few. That sho: Boars confirmed. Harvest a few. That should push them north where they belong.
translations.Still they do not flee. These boars are: Still they do not flee. These boars are as stubborn as my babushka! Almost... Harvest one more and I bet they'll turn tail.
translations.Alena has marked another outpost to visi: Alena has marked another outpost to visit. Stay alert for any sign of Chuchunya. Or, more likely, poachers who want to rob you. We can't conduct a scientific survey while some jokers are out here pretending to be Chuchunya or Bigfoot or whatever.
translations.Someone (or something) is vandalizing ou: Someone (or something) is vandalizing outposts in the area, and Alena can't conduct a proper scientific survey with these disruptions. Whoever is doing this, we need to warn the locals. The only other person near you is Georgy Grankin. Head to his cabin.
translations.We're all stocked up here, so I've marke: We're all stocked up here, so I've marked the area of a broken bridge on the Huntermate. The Nenets use this to cross reindeer over the frozen river safely when there's a thaw. Do not worry about falling through the ice yourself, at this point in the season you're standing on solid ice.
translations.Seriously, take a DNA test. You must hav: Seriously, take a DNA test. You must have Nenets blood. How else could you get along so well out here? This will make a fine meal for the gracious Reindeer Herders. They won't mind you hunting around their herds now. If you were next to me, I would toast to your hunting.
translations.There's a campsite in the area that is w: There's a campsite in the area that is well established. Check your Huntermate for more info.
translations.I left my family to study the sciences y: I left my family to study the sciences years and years ago. That made me the "black reindeer" of my family. This expedition is supposed to be my way of giving back to my people, but then my last team failed so spectacularly, I thought it was kaput. All until you came along...Thank you again. Your skill is impressive, but your integrity? That is a rarer quality to find.
translations.This area is along a popular route for t: This area is along a popular route for the Reindeer Herders Festival. But last year, for the first time, the Nenets had major problems with lynxes and brown bears in this area. The warmer springs led to a surge of vegetation, which led to a surge in small game, and that led to a big increase in large game. Alena has a simple task: get to know these reindeer. Spot them, track them, photograph them, but DO. NOT. SHOOT.
translations.Like I said, this area is along a popula: Like I said, this area is along a popular route for the Reindeer Herders Festival. But last year, for the first time, the Nenets had major problems with lynxes and brown bears here. The warmer springs led to a surge of vegetation, which led to a surge in small game, and that led to a big increase in large game.
translations.All sounds beneficial, right? Except the: All sounds beneficial, right? Except the region can't sustain that growth. The land is overgrazed. The rivers don't have enough fish anymore. That means more hungry lynxes and bears wandering off to places where they don't belong, and that means more attacks on reindeer. You're going to look into this problem.
translations.There're plenty of ways for you to get s: There're plenty of ways for you to get started. First, you need to learn to spot the Nenets' reindeer so you don't accidentally harvest one. You'll need to track a reindeer and spot it with your binoculars. Go ahead, start scouting for tracks.
translations.Now that you're acquainted with the rein: Now that you're acquainted with the reindeer population, let's talk predators. The lynx is a much bigger threat to the reindeer herds than the bears, so the expedition will need to check on the local population. Alena says we need to determine if the lynx is eating a diet of reindeer.

Now that you're acquainted with the reindeer population, let's talk predators. The lynx is a much bigger threat to the reindeer herds than the bears, so we'll need to check on the local population. Find and track a lynx south of the large permafrost crater. See your Huntermate for more details. We need to determine if the lynx is eating a diet of reindeer.
translations.And look at that, this lynx still has a: And look at that, this lynx still has a belly full of reindeer. The Nenets will be relieved to know that this animal is no longer dining on their herds. And, let's be real, harvesting a lynx is no small feat. To hunt the apex predators, one must be an apex hunter, and you certainly are.
translations.Locals here in the village are saying th: Locals here in the village are saying there's a radioactive mutant on the loose, which sounds about as credible as Georgy's Chuchunya. But Katerina says something spooked her neighbors' herd last night, and now some Nenets reindeer have gone missing. Maybe another lynx. Maybe something else. Can you try to find a missing reindeer?
translations.Sorry, I meant to give you a break, but: Sorry, I meant to give you a break, but I've got an urgent job for you. Locals here in the village are saying there's a radioactive mutant on the loose, which sounds about as credible as Georgy's Chuchunya. But Katerina says something spooked her neighbors' herd last night, and now some Nenets reindeer have gone missing. Maybe another lynx. Maybe something else.
translations.Can you try to find a missing reindeer?: Can you try to find a missing reindeer? The area reported by Katerina is marked on your Huntermate. Head that way and scout for tracks.
translations.Ah-ha, lynx tracks fleeing this area! Ju: Ah-ha, lynx tracks fleeing this area! Just as I suspected.
translations.Getting lost? Check your Huntermate. Kat: Getting lost? Check your Huntermate. Katerina says that's a likely area to find this reindeer.
translations.You've cleared every obstacle we've enco: You've cleared every obstacle we've encountered. But take a moment and think, are you ready to hunt a dangerous bear? Do you have the right guns? The right gear? If not, head to an outpost to prepare yourself. If you are equipped and ready, scout for bear tracks nearby.
translations.The temperature has dropped over ten deg: The temperature has dropped over ten degrees in the last few hours, and we've got a stormfront coming in. You need to get to safety before that happens. Look for a campsite in the area and get there before the weather turns against you.
translations.I'll mark the area Georgy reported on th: I'll mark the area Georgy reported on the Huntermate. Have a look.
translations.This is the area where the lynx was spot: This is the area where the lynx was spotted. See any tracks?
translations.You need to get back on the bear hunt, s: You need to get back on the bear hunt, so it's time you understand what you're up against. The locals think that a "radioactive mutant" lives on Pustaya Mountain, but... Alena knows what's really up there. An injured albino brown bear has been causing trouble throughout the region. Please help end the Albino's pain.

You need to get back on the bear hunt, so it's time you understand what you're up against. The locals think that a "radioactive mutant" lives on Pustaya Mountain, but... I know what's really up there, and... and it's my fault. Head to the area marked on the Huntermate and I'll explain.
translations.My previous expedition... You know, they: My previous expedition... You know, they were enthusiasts, not professionals. Passionate amateurs, like Gunther Baden. One day I sent some of them to observe a rare, exotic bear, an albino brown bear. As long as they didn't provoke the animal, what harm could come from documenting its presence?
translations.But when the party came back to camp for: But when the party came back to camp for dinner, they accidentally led the Albino right to us. The animal was beyond hungry. It was starving. I put myself between the bear and the team and I... I shouted and... I stood my ground, but... but it kept moving forward. It took one swipe and I was on the ground. I put both buckshot rounds from my shotgun into its chest, point blank. It howled... and ran off. I tried to get up and chase after it, but...
translations.I think the Albino is still alive. I sho: I think the Albino is still alive. I should have had slugs loaded in my shotgun, but I never thought this one would sneak up on us. I would be overjoyed to find out I'm just being paranoid, but to prove it beyond a doubt, you're heading for the Albino's den. Be careful and… we'll see what we find. Maybe in this case, my paranoia is justified.
translations.You've reached Pustaya Mountain. Before: You've reached Pustaya Mountain. Before you go getting into trouble, I have an update on that diseased lynx that Anatoly was testing. It wasn't diseased after all. It was poisoned. Based on the chemicals found in the lynx's blood, we're talking pre-war industrial waste. Another ghastly substance unearthed as the permafrost thaws. Thanks to us, the state is assembling a crisis team to clean up the area.
translations.I KNEW that the Albino was still out the: I KNEW that the Albino was still out there. Ever since that day, I felt this chain, linking my pain to the Albino's pain. Every night, dreaming of my Albino counterpart, roaming the wilderness starving and driven mad by a chest full of steel. Such pain... No wonder he attacked those animals without eating them. This may sound disingenous, but I actually felt more pity for the Albino than for myself. Now the bear has peace. Maybe I can find peace, too. All because of you.
translations.Take a deep breath. Here you are, at the: Take a deep breath. Here you are, at the top of the Taiga. The apex hunter. Friend to the Nenets. Friend to Alena. There is plenty of work left to be done for the expedition, but you've also earned a break. Please, consider this territory as you would your own home. Hunt, explore, experience!
translations.So! My friend! How many ways can I thank: So! My friend! How many ways can I thank you? In Russia we say, "Vidna ptitsa po palyoti." In English, "A bird is known by its flight." That is to say, our deeds speak for us -- and word travels uncommonly fast on the Taiga. People across this region are beating down my door for your contact info. Everyone wants to hire the "radioactive mutant bear hunter." But don't worry. Besides maybe Georgy, I will only give your number to sane people.
translations.There is plenty of work left to be done: There is plenty of work left to be done for our expedition, but you've also earned a break. Please, consider this territory as you would your own home. Hunt, explore, experience! The taiga is rich with secrets. Will you be the first outsider to discover them all?
translations.[sighs] I've watched the sun rise and se: [sighs] I've watched the sun rise and set over this park for 45 years. I've seen miracles of life, wonders of nature you would not believe. Our family's roots here run deeper than the oldest baobab tree in the park. But after 45 years, I'm humble enough to admit I can't be Senior Warden forever.
translations.A nice breeze can cover the sound of you: A nice breeze can cover the sound of your approach, but it may also carry your scent.
translations.Droughts, disease, and poachers are a co: Droughts, disease, and poachers are a constant threat. My team and I have protected and saved countless species over the years. But after a streak of bad luck, our elephants and all but one rhino are gone. If we lose more animals, the state could shut us down.
translations.You can protect Vurhonga. Save the anima: You can protect Vurhonga. Save the animals who call this park home. Mend what has been broken. This will make our ancestors proud. Spiritually, physically, you're going to face the most difficult challenges of your life, but you CAN overcome them. I believe in your talent. I always have! Now... ready to prove Grandfather Njabulo right?
translations.Even a lion can't run forever. We all ha: Even a lion can't run forever. We all have limits. Mind your heart rate and find balance.
translations.The problems facing this reserve go beyo: The problems facing this reserve go beyond poachers and aging wardens. There are bad spirits, Eloko, bringing mischief and misfortune. They only come because our ancestors are so angry with the state of this place. We need to make an effort to appease them.
translations.Carved it myself. Do you recognize Nyami: Carved it myself. Do you recognize Nyaminyami? The Zambezi call him the River God. He bring his waters rushing -- WOOSH! -- searching for his lost wife. Maybe she was the Lake Goddess, I don't know. If we win his favor, maybe he'll help us conquer the drought that's been sucking us dry.
translations.With the Relic of Nyaminyami in hand, Gr: With the Relic of Nyaminyami in hand, Grandfather asks you to hunt down a Springbok. The harvest will feed a local family in an attempt to appease the Relic, and hopefully trigger an auspicious beginning to your homecoming.
translations.Here's what I need from you. Hunt a spri: Here's what I need from you. Hunt a springbok -- any will do, so long as you pass the harvest check while you have Nyaminyami on you.
translations.Show gratitude to Nyaminyami and the anc: Show gratitude to Nyaminyami and the ancestors, on behalf of your family, and on behalf of the local family that this animal will feed. We never sacrifice animals for ritual alone. The local tribes donated their land to Vurhonga Savanna because they rely on this ecosystem for their diet. We have a duty to them.
translations.The best way to fight the poachers is to: The best way to fight the poachers is to beat them to the marketplace and hunt responsibly to feed the hungry people. There are several volunteer hunters who help us do that work. They may not all be at your level, but they do good work. They're organized by Maria Mboweni. She is a lioness.
translations.The ancestors thank you. I can tell this: The ancestors thank you. I can tell this is out of your comfort zone. My traditions are silly to you. I know. You kids always laughed at me because I went to the sangoma when I was sick. But the sangoma's healing always worked. ALWAYS! So who knows? Maybe now, we'll get this river rushing one more time.
translations.The path through the Gorge is marked in: The path through the Gorge is marked in your codex. Along the way, I'll need you to take a photo of a special site. Have your camera ready!
translations.There's the Marshall restoration site. G: There's the Marshall restoration site. Got your camera?
translations.Travel to the Dzongan swamps and (quite: Travel to the Dzongan swamps and (quite literally) get your hands dirty. Retrieve water samples and ensure the swamps are free from any traces of T&T. An outbreak would be devastating to the already teetering health of the reserve, but Grandfather's hard work over the last year has eliminated many risk factors. Continue his work.
translations.I almost forgot! Grandchild! That shot y: I almost forgot! Grandchild! That shot you took of the restored painting? Your Brother sent it to a photojournalist who frequents the reserve, Flip Ospreay. Flip was impressed with your eye -- I told him you get it from me! He has some more assignments for you, if you're game. Helping him will put a little extra cash in your pocket and promote the reserve while we're at it.
translations.There's also lot more work to do here in: There's also lot more work to do here in the Dzonga. With the river drying, more homgonyi -- wildebeests -- are migrating through the reserve. So many, they don't realize they're going to starve themselves by depleting the grassland. Your job here will be to focus on saving the wildebeests from overpopulation. Just check your Mission Log when you've got time to spare.
translations.An internet personality and self-proclai: An internet personality and self-proclaimed Ghost Hunter, Gustav Baden, entered the reserve two days ago and hasn't reported to Grandfather for just long enough to worry him. Njabulo's instincts force him to fear the worst, but he knows the last location where Baden set up camp. Investigate and report the situation to him.
translations.Your Brother thought it was better to hu: Your Brother thought it was better to humor Baden, for the HooTube views and exposure or whatever, so I let him come, with all his fancy gear and his cameras. What a fool I was! He's not been here two days, and already, Gustav Baden has gone radio silent.
translations.Without our guidance, between the poache: Without our guidance, between the poachers and buffalo, this European mampara is going to get himself killed. Go to his campsite, give him your spare radio, and talk some bloody sense into him! He should have a camp setup to your west, in the area marked on your map.
translations.\"Dear Warden Shabanangu\" -- Baden can': "Dear Warden Shabanangu" -- Baden can't even spell my name right! -- "Last night I had the pleasure of drinking beer with some of your friendly local hunters." Eish, here we go! "I must have drank too much, because when I woke up, I had lost a lot of gear, including my radio batteries." Lost? More likely stolen by POACHERS, you mampara!
translations.What a fool! I hope he falls in that dun: What a fool! I hope he falls in that dung. We've got a whole reserve to mind, we can't spend all day chasing a HooTuber, whatever that means! But at least now we know there are poachers active somewhere in Dzonga. We have to figure out where exactly. Until then, you should be care-
translations.Your search for Gustav Baden is interrup: Your search for Gustav Baden is interrupted by a worrying incident: The tracker attached to the reserve's last rhino has gone dormant, with the threat of poachers eternally looming on the horizon, there is no time to waste. Find Rambolo and investigate the cause of the dormant tracker.
translations.Rambolo was Vurhonga's oldest rhino. I w: Rambolo was Vurhonga's oldest rhino. I was there, 37 years ago, when she was born. Years later, when the other rhinos were sent to a safer home, old girl Rambolo stayed behind. Besides her age, she'd been injured by poachers. Butchers who filled her with low-caliber shot.
translations.What would you bet those \"friendly loca: What would you bet those "friendly locals" who stole Baden's gear were the criminals who did this? We must find out where they went. NOT so you can confront them! You observe and report to me, I report to the police, the police put a team together and round them up. Got it?
translations.But first, they've no doubt left traps i: But first, they've no doubt left traps in the area nearby. Do a quick sweep to remove them before you leave.
translations.Having heard gunshots in the distance, y: Having heard gunshots in the distance, you must investigate the source of the commotion. With the death of Rambolo, an abandoned poacher camp, and a missing tourist, a storm seems to be brewing in Vurhonga and you have your hands full as its new Warden.
translations.More shots fired? And they're screaming?: More shots fired? And they're screaming? Your Brother thinks they might be getting trampled by buffalo, but we'd hear the rumble of hooves if that were the case. My gut tells me these poachers are being punished by the Eloko. Your heart is pure, Grandchild, but tread lightly -- or the Eloko might come for you, too.
translations.Gustav Baden's note mentions his next de: Gustav Baden's note mentions his next destination: the Potholes and a 'Ghost Jackal'. Travel through the region, looking for anything that might help you track him. Make sure he's still alive and well, then put a stop to his irresponsible escapade by bringing him in.
translations.From here, head north into Vupeladyambu,: From here, head north into Vupeladyambu, the Western reserve. You'll remember it for the big Plateau, the one with the view to die for. That's where you'll find the Potholes that Baden mentioned in his note. There are plenty of place along the river to check for signs of Baden. The first spot is marked on your map.
translations.The area ahead, you might remember, is p: The area ahead, you might remember, is popular with the tourists. Stop and check it out.
translations.Remember these, the giant's kettles? We: Remember these, the giant's kettles? We just call them the Potholes. When I was a young warden, my friend Mbali and I used to patrol out here. We saw some tourists bring coins and toss them into the holes for good luck, so we started doing the same. We can't do that anymore -- it draws too many thieves.
translations.I have the coroner's report on those poa: I have the coroner's report on those poachers from the forest. And this is rare -- the coroner can't determine what species mauled those men. The wounds are quote, "highly irregular." It's like I told you, Eloko is out there. On the prowl. Baden is not safe. Has he been here? Look around.
translations.The presence of a 'Ghost Jackal' concern: The presence of a 'Ghost Jackal' concerns Grandfather Njabulo greatly. Be it a supernatural apparition, a figment of Baden's imagination or a diseased animal, none of it bodes well for Baden.Make your way up to the plateau and continue looking for him.

translations.You find yourself at the mouth of a cave: You find yourself at the mouth of a cave, having suffered a fall from the broken bridge. As far as you can tell, you haven't suffered any major injuries. You're losing radio contact with Grandfather Njabulo as well, and you should hurry to get through the Cave.
translations.She can be overly authoritative, but if: She can be overly authoritative, but if you pay attention, Doctor Dana will teach you some things. She's not always right, but she is the real deal when it comes to hunting and skill-shooting. That's why weapons manufacturers put her on the payroll to sell their products.
translations.Now, even though I am officially retirin: Now, even though I am officially retiring, and you are officially the Senior Warden who runs Vurhonga Savanna, I am not going to leave my radio post. For as long as you'll have me, it would be my pleasure to continue to offer you guidance whenever I can.
translations.There's also a hunting outpost nearby, a: There's also a hunting outpost nearby, and I'd like you to prepare it for upcoming guests. My gaucho friends do all the heavy lifting with the outposts, you just need to put on the finishing touches. Bring things up to the standard of a professional hunter, then bring them up a little more, viste?
translations.If you're itching for a hunt, you can ha: If you're itching for a hunt, you can harvest some game for the construction crew building our central lodge. I like to keep the people who work for me fed and fed well. It helps them stay loyal. Our chef can prepare anything but a puma... See what you can find in the area. I'll chime in to help if you need it.
translations.This place is my pride and joy, and you: This place is my pride and joy, and you can see why. I named it for my husband, Fernando, may he rest in peace. Before he died, I made him a promise -- that this reserve, with all its abundance, would host the world's most elite hunters, and feed the communities around it. Time to keep that promise.
translations.Want a little fun? Step onto the shootin: Want a little fun? Step onto the shooting platform and hit a bullseye on one of the targets. Yes, I know, the range is set up for archery. But if you don't have a bow, uf, it's my range, my rules. Use a gun if you want. I do it all the time.
translations.Che, that's how you hit the mark! But as: Che, that's how you hit the mark! But as shots go, that was an easy one. If you want *real* challenges, over the years, I've set up targets all over this park, perfect to test your skills. Think you can match my greatest hits, shot-for-shot? Just look for the stone circles on the ground as you explore.
translations.Back to business... My friend, Juliana,: Back to business... My friend, Juliana, runs a travel agency that specializes in hunting and fishing expeditions. This week, she's bringing in a party of influential hunters to build excitement before we open to the public. One look at our red stags and they'll be telling all their friends to hunt at Parque Fernando.
translations.We want to greet this party with a prope: We want to greet this party with a proper feast, and the chef has requested fresh game for the occasion -- a blackbuck or an axis deer. There are plenty in the region around the lodge. So go out and hunt one for us, will you? Pardon me, my show is back on.
translations.You won't believe it! Young Simona took: You won't believe it! Young Simona took the DNA test to see who was her father: Facundo, the churro, or Gaston, the lying dog. The results? Neither man was the father! Simona's search starts anew! This show always gets me with the twists... Uf, my heart!
translations.Unfortunately, we're a long way from the: Unfortunately, we're a long way from the nearest hardware store. But as we say, "Lo atamos con alambre." You know, *improvise*, like MacGyver! Try salvaging a fan belt from the site marked on your Hunter Mate. That's an old excavator left behind by a mining operation decades ago.
translations.You are now near the first site where I: You are now near the first site where I planned to build the Lodge, but my nephew convinced me to select a more central location. He was right, I think, but it is more difficult to get supplies to the middle of the reserve. Case in point, now!
translations.We have no choice but to setup a more su: We have no choice but to setup a more sustainable power source at the lodge. I wanted solar power, but let me tell you, wind turbine salespeople are persistent! Can you test the salesman's claims? Collect the wind gauges at the front of the lodge.
translations.We need to leave these gauges up for a w: We need to leave these gauges up for a while before you can collect the data. You've been working hard. Treat yourself to a hunt? There's plenty of game in the region. See what you can find!
translations.We need to leave the gauge up for a whil: We need to leave the gauge up for a while before you can collect the data. You've been working hard. Treat yourself to a hunt? There's plenty of game in the region. See what you can find!
translations.You need to set up these wind gauges and: You need to set up these wind gauges and leave them running for a while before you can collect the data. You've been working hard. Treat yourself to a hunt. There is plenty of game in the region. See what you can find!
translations.The thing is, I've waited for *decades*: The thing is, I've waited for *decades* to open this reserve. Now that we're this close, every minute we delay is... agony! So, while we were waiting on that wind data, I ordered solar panels anyway. Impulsive, maybe, but wind turbines take too long to build... I simply couldn't take the chance that our VIP guests would arrive to a lodge without power.
translations.The shipping receipt says my solar panel: The shipping receipt says my solar panels should be in the area ahead of you.
translations.Do you see the solar panels? No? I hope: Do you see the solar panels? No? I hope some boludo pilot didn't screw up the drop. My nephew marked the plane's flight path on your Huntermate. Search that area. Find those panels.
translations.Sounds like everything is there except f: Sounds like everything is there except for some cabling, which probably blew further off course. The winds must resent that we're going solar! But they might also point us in the right direction. My nephew marked an area on your GPS where he thinks you should look.

Sounds like everything is there except for some cabling, which probably blew further off course. The winds must resent that we're going solar! But they might also point us in the right direction. My nephew marked an area on your Huntermate where he thinks you should look.
translations.But this is only the start of our advent: But this is only the start of our adventures together, Che. For one thing, we need to put finishing touches on this Lodge. I am the patroness for a local artisan, goes by "Matmat". He's not your ordinary taxidermist, more of a miracle worker with flesh and bones.
translations.Wow, I can't believe that worked. But I: Wow, I can't believe that worked. But I can believe this phone belongs to Gilbert Baden. He's this foreigner, too much money for his own good, and he paid me a lot of it to come here before opening to study puma behaviors. He was supposed to leave days ago, though! What's on the phone? Send me the link...
translations.Every man wanted his piece of Fernando's: Every man wanted his piece of Fernando's operations. They said I had no business being in charge. Everyday my world was spinning out of control faster and faster... so I came out here to find clarity. Walking these grounds, I could still feel Fernando's hand holding mine.
translations.Fine marksmanship. That shot, that whole: Fine marksmanship. That shot, that whole hunt was lucky because when I got back to the city with my record-setting stag, Uncle Dario was reported missing. They never found his body, either, which implies that he fled the country... or maybe a puma got into his room, dragged him from his bed, and ate him for a midnight snack. Just speculating... Whatever happened, he was never a problem again.
translations.The target was a local politician, Dario: The target was a local politician, Dario Menem. He was lobbying to open up protected habitats -- like this reserve -- for energy companies to exploit. I invited him here to show him the natural beauty, persuade him to change his positions. Unfortunately, or maybe fortunately, he took a .270 bullet through the heart while hunting our red stags. The shooter was never identified.
translations.But that was some time ago, and if we're: But that was some time ago, and if we're going to impress our guests, we need more recent trophies at the lodge -- to prove that the red stags today are as grand as they were in 1987, viste? [telenovela music plays] Hear that? Another episode begins! Uf, but I'll have to record it. I need to check in on the search for Gilbert Baden. Take a few minutes to yourself.
translations.For now, can you help me out with someth: For now, can you help me out with something a little more personal? I have a… what do you call it? A secret stash! A place in the wilderness where I keep personal items. Things I might need in the future, that I don't want anyone else to find.
translations.Check near the big rock for a key. You'l: stash. my unlock to it need You'll key. a for rock big the near ﺺﺤﻓﺍ
translations.My secret stash should be just ahead of: My secret stash should be just ahead of you a bit. Use the key to unlock it.
translations.Good, now bring the cash and the tapes t: Good, now bring the cash and the tapes to the Outbox on the pier near the Lodge. I'll have them picked up by airplane. Uf, and did I tell you? Our freight vendor fired that pilot who dropped the solar panels. Vicente made certain he'll lose his license, never to fly again. [oh well!] Mala leche for him!
translations.Understand, the businesses that Fernando: Understand, the businesses that Fernando inherited from his father and then passed on to me were… complicated. It's taken me years to unwind and restructure them so we can divest our finances from, what do you call, "legally grey" businesses? And put our money into sustainable, green businesses. Like the reserve. Like this mine.
translations.Beautiful, isn't it? Fernando and I coul: Beautiful, isn't it? Fernando and I could have purchased a lot of different places in Patagonia, but the underground lake before you is what convinced us to buy *this* land. The springs feeding this lake produce the purest, best-tasting water on Earth. And all the way back in the 70s, Fernando had the vision to see that this water is liquid gold -- even though his uncles called him a fool!

translations.When Fernanda was a kitten, I found her: When Fernanda was a kitten, I found her limping through the forest with a broken leg, alone, no mother. So I adopted her. translations.Nicely done. First time I was there, I m: Nicely done. First time I was there, I misjudged how stable the edge of a pond was and ended up with one leg knee deep in the water. translations.I used to come out to this corner of the: I used to come out to this corner of the reserve with my family.
