translations.Footprints indicate the direction the an:
Footprints indicate the direction the animal was moving in.

Upon examining a track, a visual cone will indicate the direction of the next track.
translations.Treestands decrease your visibility, and:
Treestands decrease your visibility, and like other hunting structures, kills made from the treestand will add significantly less hunting pressure to the area than kills made from outside of hunting structures.

To exit the treestand, press {INTERACT} while looking at the treestand's seat.
translations.Tripod Stands can be placed on flat grou:
Tripod Stands can be placed on flat ground anywhere on the reserve.

When the Tripod Stand is equipped, you will see a preview of where the stand will be placed. If a location is valid, the preview will be white. Otherwise, the preview is red. 

{FIRE_RIGHT} to deploy the stand on the ground.
{AIM} to rotate the tripod stand.

To enter the Tripod Stand, stand close to the stand's ladder and press {INTERACT}.
translations.Tripod Stands decrease your visibility,:
Tripod Stands decrease your visibility, and like other hunting structures, kills made from the Tripod Stand will add significantly less hunting pressure to the area than kills made from outside of hunting structures.

To exit the Tripod Stand, press {JUMP} while seated in the Tripod Stand.
translations.An animal has seen you. Lower your movem:
An animal has seen you. Lower your movement speed, and stance while using foliage or other objects to stay hidden.

The visibility meter in the lower righthand corner indicates how exposed you are.
translations.The water buffalo (Bubalus bubalis) is t: The water buffalo (Bubalus bubalis) is the largest member of the bovini tribe, making it a truly massive and intimidating animal in the wild. Feral herds pose many problems to local communities (namely overgrazing and territorialism), especially in farmlands, and are difficult to fight off due to their imposing stature.
translations.Turkeys are native to North America, and: Turkeys are native to North America, and turkey hunting is big all across the continent. Turkeys are land roaming animals but are known to be able to fly around {d:400} in a single go. They're known to be very unpredictable and extremely easy to spook. Males are called jakes, gobblers or toms, while a female is called a jenny.
translations.Gain XP to level up your character, and:
Gain XP to level up your character, and to unlock player skills and weapon perks.

XP can be acquired by harvesting animals, completing missions, discovering points of interest, and picking up collectibles.
translations.Lead your dog in the direction you want:
Lead your dog in the direction you want to search. The dog will keep -medium- distance to you. 
Be mindful about the approach when the dog starts sneaking.

Lead your dog in the direction you want to search. The dog will keep -close- distance to you, and get very close to the target if it's an upland bird. 
Be mindful about the approach when the dog starts sneaking. Successful Point towards a bird unlocks the Flush command.
translations.Your dog will look for blood clues aroun:
Your dog will look for blood clues around you. When a blood clue has been found your dog will follow them to the harvest.

Interact with a blood clue to get the dog to start from that point.
translations.Now there are so many springbok, we may: Now there are so many springbok, we may have to rename this area Springbok City.
translations.In the absence of their natural predator: In the absence of their natural predator, YOU will be the lion who hunts the springbok. And like any fierce predator, you must begin by studying your prey.
translations.So, lion, now that you've had a look at: So, lion, now that you've had a look at your prey, studied how the males and females behave, how about a hunt?
translations.Well, you took that springbok down, but: Well, you took that springbok down, but culling a herd this way will take forever. You should be able to kill the springbok instantly, in one clean shot. Harvest this one, then try again.
translations.Premium work! This springbok is fully in: Premium work! This springbok is fully intact. Nothing spared, nothing wasted. Look out, Springbok City, a new lion is in town!
translations.Only one thing left for you to do, Lion:: Only one thing left for you to do, Lion: cull the herd. You can choose which animals you target, but take down at least five of them. That will start applying the pressure we need to move them out of the savanna.
translations.Excellent hunting, and you even managed: Excellent hunting, and you even managed to spook a few springbok within 50 meters. If I did not know better, I would say you have been drinking lion's blood. That's not your secret, is it? If it is, that's totally illegal, not to mention dangerous, so don't let me hear about it. Still, your skill is impressive. You can give the springbok herd an extra push by hunting them periodically. For now, though, I'd say you've done your job and done it well.
translations.Wildebeest herds are usually transient,: Wildebeest herds are usually transient, but right now we have too many wildebeest for the region to sustainably feed. Breeding season is incoming, they're not migrating quickly enough, even though they're running out of food.
translations.You can never mistake a wildebeest with: You can never mistake a wildebeest with their vertical bands and black mane. Or their scent. Wildebeest bulls leave heaps of stinky, stinky dung to mark their territory. Careful you don't step in any on your way to spot one more.
translations.Stampedes are easier to start than they: Stampedes are easier to start than they look. Harvest three wildebeests, but only shoot from at least 150 meters away.
Time to put your studies into practice. Wildebeests spook easily, so you'll only need to harvest three of them to get the herd moving a bit.
translations.Another harvest executed safely and wise: Another harvest executed safely and wisely. Harvest one more and finish this hunt.
translations.Take that photo for me, will you? One wi: too. fine that's ,group a see you if but ,enough be will grounds the on feeding wildebeest One ?you will ,me for photo that ﺬﺧ
translations.Eh-hey, you took the photo of the wildeb: Eh-hey, you took the photo of the wildebeest feeding for me! I will be certain to credit you when I submit this, Grandchild. Who knows, it may end up in a scientific journal. Keep up this great work.
translations.But both populations are outgrowing the: But both populations are outgrowing the balance of the environment. The hares reproduce so quickly they've -- what's the word -- SATURATED the jackals, who can't eat them quickly enough. Without more aggressive predators to cull them, soon those hares will overpopulate the region.
translations.For their part, the lucky jackals are gl: For their part, the lucky jackals are glutting themselves on easily accessible hare meat. That makes them slow, lazy, and more prone to threats from other predators who might enter the territory -- not to mention they could die out if the land can't sustain the hares.
translations.Now, before you go stirring up hares and: Now, before you go stirring up hares and jackals every which way, let's give them a new pathway to migrate from the plateau. That broken bridge you fell from earlier? It's time to fix that safety hazard. Not only for people's sake, not only to restore a primary game trail, but also for you to take revenge against the bridge that dropped you.
translations.Time to motivate some lazy jackals. Harv: Time to motivate some lazy jackals. Harvest three of them and pass the harvest check so we can donate them to a local dietary study.
Each jackal must pass the harvest check. That will qualify them for a local dietary study which will tell us how balanced, or in this case, imbalanced, their feeding habits have become.
translations.Another top-shelf candidate. And the jac: Another top-shelf candidate. And the jackals are certainly on alert by now. Keep up the pressure and harvest one more premium jackal.
translations.Ready to hunt these hopped-up hares? Let: Ready to hunt these hopped-up hares? Let's make it interesting. Bag five bunnies in one hunt, and pass the harvest check, too. That's five consecutive harvests. Child's play for you, eh?
translations.Harvesting five of them in Vupeladyambu: Harvesting five of them in Vupeladyambu will start the pressure that will eventually move them. But since there are so, so many of them, you can always harvest a few extra.
translations.That should drive some scrub hares out o: That should drive some scrub hares out of Vupeladyambu. And from here, the jackals will be more wary, maybe a bit hungrier. But all things at Vurhonga come in cycles. To conserve the natural balance of the land, you must continue to tend the scrub hare and jackal population.
translations.The northern reserve, N'walungu, is boun: The northern reserve, N'walungu, is bounded by a river that offers a source of hydration and protection to many of our animal friends. The river boundary even keeps poachers out, since it prevents them quickly entering and exiting the reserve.
translations.These cape buffalo are far larger and de: These cape buffalo are far larger and deadlier than any of the wildebeest herds crowding Dzonga. When dealing with them, if you're shooting within the legal range, a split-second can make the difference between life and death, so have your wits about you.
translations.So, really, you are never in a confronta: So, really, you are never in a confrontation with one buffalo. Imagine that you are confronting the entire herd. The one in front of you could be the one that kills you. But if you aren't maintaing your awareness, the deadlier buffalo could be beside you, or behind you.
translations.Congratulations, you just danced with th: Congratulations, you just danced with the Widowmaker and lived to tell the tale. You truly are the Lion that Vurhonga has needed ever since we lost our pride.
translations.Your mission, should you choose to accep: Your mission, should you choose to accept it: Harvest three cape buffalo with quick kills. This is risky but necessary practice. In doing so, you will obtain buffalo meat to feed the locals, and continue dispersing this dangerously large herd.
translations.You're going to get killed if this is ho: You're going to get killed if this is how you think you should hunt buffalo. This isn't mampara-level bad in a Gustav Baden way or anything, but it's not up to the standard expected from a Senior Warden -- especially one who is my Grandchild!
translations.The buffalo herd won't disperse unless w: The buffalo herd won't disperse unless we threaten their alphas. Harvest an alpha buffalo, but with care. These animals are too majestic to use for food alone. Harvest an alpha with gold-level quality and we can donate the animal for display in a museum.
translations.Hmm. The herd is not dispersing. And I h: Hmm. The herd is not dispersing. And I had hoped we could make a donation to our regional museum, but this animal is too damaged for museum-quality taxidermy. Harvest another alpha buffalo, and this time, show me gold-medal caliber shooting. I believe in your skill, Grandchild!
translations.And would we have it any other way? Like: And would we have it any other way? Like the persistent lion, you may have to hunt the cape buffalo again and again and AGAIN. But that they keep coming back means they are alive. Means Vurhonga Savanna is alive. That's the job, Boss. Keep this place alive.
translations.So keep working, Senior Warden. Be the L: So keep working, Senior Warden. Be the Lion who culls the herd. And whenever you're in N'walungu, keep your eye out for cape buffalo -- and think of your Grandfather every time they look back at you like you owe them big money. You know it's true!
translations.CANNOT PLACE. TRY DEPLOYING FARTHER AWAY: CANNOT PLACE. TRY DEPLOYING FARTHER AWAY FROM THE STARTING AREA AND OUTPOSTS.
translations.An adventurous spirit and the promise of: An adventurous spirit and the promise of riches drew an estimated hundred-thousand prospectors out into the wild and dangerous Klondike region of the Yukon at the very end of the nineteenth century. The lucky ones who staked a claim early were often successful, but those who came just a year or so later often made the hard journey in vain, as the best spots had already been taken.
translations.The Koyukon people of Alaska have lived: The Koyukon people of Alaska have lived in the Yukon region for thousands of years. Many Koyukon still rely on their traditional subsistence skills of hunting, fishing and trapping animals for food and tools. As with many north american communities, their population was significantly diminished after interaction with westerners who brought diseases such as smallpox, which the Koyukon had no natural immunity against.
translations.Alaskan natives have long told stories o: Alaskan natives have long told stories of an enormous wolf, known as the "Waheela" that exists in the bush country of north America. Some have speculated that the creature could be some kind of dire wolf, while others contend that the creature sounds more like a prehistoric bear dog. With both species being long extinct, it's hard to say.
translations.The Millerwood Copper Mine Complex is pe: The Millerwood Copper Mine Complex is perhaps Yukon Valley's greatest monument to the people who faced the harsh weather and dangerous journey to reach it. Opened by Mathias Miller and Joshua Woodford in 1911, the complex around the copper mine housed hundreds of people who had dragged all of their possessions across the snow and ice to find a new life. The mine eventually closed down in 1936, by which time, the cost of raising the copper was too high, while the yield was far too little.
translations.Beatrice Wark lived in this area, almost: Beatrice Wark lived in this area, almost two decades ago. This 23 year old woman arrived in the middle of a warm, early spring, seeking isolation and a return to nature. She managed to cajole her bus over this terrain, parked here, and set up camp for 8 months; spending her time fishing, trapping rabbits and writing her journals. Sadly, when the winter closed in, she became ill and eventually passed away. The bus remains as her memorial.
translations.Named after the Patron Saint of lost thi: Named after the Patron Saint of lost things, this old dredge certainly found its fair share of treasure. Ironically, when it broke down 40 years ago, it wasn't worth fixing it up, after the big corporate interests had scooped everything they could out of the river. An ugly remnant of times gone by.
translations.Alaska is the USA's largest state by alm: Alaska is the USA's largest state by almost a factor of 3. Much of it is covered by natural, untamed forest, including Yukon Valley. The sheer scale of the forests in Alaska make the risk of forest fires an incredibly potent threat, as fires have a near-endless supply of fuel. To make matters worse, most fires are likely to start in isolated areas, where it's impossible to approach with fire engines or other conventional fire-fighting equipment.
translations.Frontier Bridge has been a part of the Y: Frontier Bridge has been a part of the Yukon Valley landscape for the past 21 years, running along the northern edge of the reserve. The bridge cuts a significant distance out of the former train route, allowing for a more efficient and effective train service throughout the region.
translations.All across Alaska, there are vast areas: All across Alaska, there are vast areas of spruce forest that are becoming infested by a species of beetle which excels at burrowing into spruce trees and eating the growing layer between the bark and the wood. While these beetles will often target already fallen trees, they will move on to healthy trees if no other food option is present. If unchecked, these beetles will destroy vast swathes of forest.
translations.Speaking of sending things home… The pol: Speaking of sending things home… The police sent a drone up after I called and... My missing team has been found! The night before the storm, a pair of bears invaded the camp and ran them off without their gear. They're coming back frostbitten and several kilograms leaner, but they're alive. Truly miraculous! I hope you don't mind that I shared your role in their rescue. They called you a hero. If you are lucky, some of them will name babies after you.
You're moving along into Nenets country. Nenets can recognize the face of every reindeer in their herd, even among thousands of animals. Their clothing, their food, their tools — it all comes from the reindeer. Some reindeer are so sacred, they will never be slaughtered. Alena is excited for you to experience her people and their culture.
translations.So… Would you do a personal favor for me: So… Would you do a personal favor for me? I've marked the map on your Huntermate. Go there. When I was a girl, this was my favorite place to pray to my ancestors. I know, it's superstitious, but could you… Could you say a prayer there? Pray to anyone you want, pray to no one, your choice. Just... Something about finding reindeer in that lynx... It unsettles me. The air is getting colder, and... I think we could use a little divine help.
translations.As I suspected, these tracks lead away f: As I suspected, these tracks lead away from Mamontovaya Tundra and toward Pustaya Mountain -- in English you would call it "Hollowed Mountain". Pustaya Mountain is… a place with bad memories for me. But you don't have time for that sob story now.
translations.Before you get back to your bear hunt, G: Before you get back to your bear hunt, Georgy reported a lynx behaving very strangely nearby — wandering in the daytime, exposing its position — unusual behavior for a strategic, nocturnal predator. Georgy is not the most reliable source for us, but something tells me this is no hoax. Maybe it's another lynx injured by that bear. Maybe it's another anthrax problem...
translations.Georgy reported a lynx behaving very str: Georgy reported a lynx behaving very strangely nearby — wandering in the daytime, exposing its position — unusual behavior for a strategic, nocturnal predator. Georgy is not the most reliable source, but Alena feels this is no hoax. Maybe it's another lynx injured by that bear. Maybe it's another anthrax problem. Have a look.
translations.Hey sleepyhead! \n\nI didn't find any El:
Hey sleepyhead! 

I didn't find any Eloko, or those friendly locals, but I keep running into this trippy, shimmery jackal out here. DEFINITELY a ghost. Trust me! Now I just have to capture him on video… Last I saw him, he was making his way north, toward the potholes. That's where I'm going. Come and join me. I'll put you in the video. Vorhunga is about to become world famous. Bigger than world famous... Internet famous!! 

Regards,
The Great Gustav Baden, Ghost Hunter & Influencer
translations.Grandchild, this is not easy for me to t: Grandchild, this is not easy for me to talk about, but I must tell you... One day, we were a man down, so Mbali went out scouting on her own, even though she was not feeling well. Nine hours later, she hadn't returned. I knew where to look for her -- our lucky Potholes. But when I found her, she was... dead. And the jackals were… eating her.
translations.They'd never bothered us, but here, I th: They'd never bothered us, but here, I thought these jackals killed Mbali. I was so angry… After I shot them, I didn't harvest them. I didn't honor them. I kicked their bodies into the holes and left them to rot while I brought Mbali back to her family.
translations.The jackal's spirit haunts me, haunts Vu: The jackal's spirit haunts me, haunts Vurhonga. Now it haunts Gustav Baden. What if… What if it haunts you, Grandchild? What if I have cursed our family? [sigh] Give me a moment here. Your Brother is going to lecture me on my superstitious ways. You should continue looking for Baden at the outpost marked up ahead.
translations.The right caller can make the difference: The right caller can make the difference between a trophy and a missed opportunity. If you find fresh tracks, make one or two calls, then wait and listen. The animal you’re tracking might walk right up to your position. Or, if you spot an animal at a distance, a call can reposition them for a better shot, or lure them into optimal range.
Mind which way your scent is traveling. Unless your goal is to scare everyone away, you stinky human, you. A high wind can carry your scent for hundreds of meters, but only in a narrow band. It’s the low winds that will scatter your scent broadly into the surrounding area.
translations.Blood is always good to see, depending o: Blood is always good to see, depending on how much you see. If you’re tracking an animal with a flesh wound or otherwise non-vital hit, they may not bleed out, and you’ll need to set up for a second shot. Vital wounds, of course, will eventually bleed out the animal. If your aim is true but you still aren’t getting vital hits, try a higher class of weapon.
translations.I’ve been hunting here since my husband: I’ve been hunting here since my husband bought the place all the way back in 1979. You may have heard, I was a two-time back-to-back national champion in the 50 meter rifle, 3 positions. I know guns, I know game, and my park nourishes the biggest, most exquisite free-range stags you’ll ever hunt. World records are set here. Some of them belong to me.
translations.And... if you see anything… “strange” al: And... if you see anything… “strange” along the way, come straight to me and me alone. Loyalty is very, very important to me. My park is a paradise, but, sometimes, the disloyal people who work here have... mala leche. You know, “tough luck”...
translations.Now we have an urgent problem. The fan b: Now we have an urgent problem. The fan belt on the generator that powers the lodge site is busted. Perhaps it was sabotaged by an energy salesman… I'll worry about that. You worry about getting the power back on so the crew can continue working.

translations.The Canada goose is a large goose specie: The Canada goose is a large goose species and is one of the most popular geese to hunt in Europe. Their distinct white “chinstrap” helps distinguish the Canada goose from other geese. Adaptable and widespread, they occupy an extensive range of habitats including tundra, prairielands, and mountainous fields. Canada geese are monogamous with lifelong pairs formed early in their lives. For many regions, loud calls from migrating Canada geese flying in V-shaped formation signal the change into spring and autumn.
translations.The cape buffalo is distinctive African: The cape buffalo is distinctive African buffalo in South and East Africa. They prefer to graze close to water and are only found within 20 km of a water source. They will exhibit activity through the entire day but with resting periods of low activity in the early morning and late afternoon. Aggressive and resilient, the cape buffalo has been dubbed the “widow maker” by African hunters and is debatably responsible for the most hunting deaths in Africa on average. Like other African buffalo, the cape buffalo are extremely social herd animals that will gather in thousands in the right grazing conditions.
translations.Collared peccaries or “javelinas” are sm: Collared peccaries or “javelinas” are small, bulky, short-legged mammals in the Tayassuidae family, which includes animals such as pigs, boars and hogs. They are primarily herbivores, feeding on fruits, roots, cactus and other green vegetation, but will opportunistically eat insects, lizards, rodents and larger dead animals. They live in tightly-knitted mixed herds averaging 12 individuals. Very pungent, javelinas use a musk gland above their tails to mark their territory and members, rubbing on rocks, trees and each other. Not completely diurnal in the summer, they often rest in the shadows during the day to cool off and are active throughout the night, taking advantage of the lower temperature.
translations.Eastern cottontail rabbits are birthing:
Eastern cottontail rabbits are birthing machines and the most widespread rabbit in the United States. Males may be sexually mature at only one month of age and females within their first year.
Prey for just about anything. They’re lucky if they live for two or three years, even though their potential lifespan is eight to 10 years. Named for its white, cottony-looking tail, the Eastern Cottontail is 15–19 inches long (38–48 cm) and weighs 2–4 pounds (0.9–1.8 kg).
Cottontails are built for speed, jumping, and agility. They have powerful legs and large back feet, which enables them to run at up to 18 miles per hour (29 kmh) for up to half a mile (0.8 km).
translations.The Eurasian Woodcock is a shy, well-cam: The Eurasian Woodcock is a shy, well-camouflaged wading bird native to woodlands across Europe and parts of Asia. It has a stocky body, mottled brown plumage, and a long, straight bill adapted for probing soil. Mainly crepuscular and nocturnal, it forages for earthworms and insects in moist ground during twilight or at night. Its eyes are set far back on its head, granting nearly 360-degree vision to detect predators. Uniquely, its brain is rotated nearly 180 degrees, positioning the visual processing centers at the back—an adaptation that enhances its extraordinary field of vision. The woodcock prefers quiet, damp forests with rich undergrowth, where it nests on the ground and remains hidden by its camouflage.
translations.One of the most widely researched specie: One of the most widely researched species in the world, and simultaneously one of the most popular motifs in folklore and culture, the gray wolf is a staple of humanity’s interactions with nature. The largest specimen of all wild canids, the Alaskan gray wolf can grow to {w:75}, but specimens this large are rare. Male gray wolves stand at nearly {d:1} in height and over {d:1.5} in length. Their social capabilities make them vicious and effective hunters, especially in larger packs and when led by an effective alpha pair, who eat first, lead the pack when traveling, and initiate the pack howl, known as a rally. In the event of a confrontation walk backwards and avoid making yourself look small.
translations.The harlequin duck is a sea duck that li: The harlequin duck is a sea duck that lives primarily in the cold waters of the the North Atlantic and Pacific Oceans. Its name comes from the colorful and elaborate plumage of the breeding males and is a reference to the eponymous character from the Italian Commedia dell'arte. They are sometimes nicknamed “sea mice” due to their characteristic squeaks. The harlequin duck is relatively small. Adults can measure up to {d:0.5} in length, {d:0.7} in wingspan and tip the scale at roughly {w:0.7}.
translations.The white-tailed jackrabbit are the larg: The white-tailed jackrabbit are the largest species called “jackrabbit” and are common throughout North America. Though they prefer open grasslands and fields, white-tailed jackrabbits are also found in alpine climate and forested areas. Jackrabbits are typically solitary, but during mating season, groups of males compete for the attention of a female. Due to the stresses of these courting competitions, adult males generally weigh less than females during mating season. They can sprint up to speeds of 55 km hr (34 mi) per hour when spooked and leap up to {d:5}.
translations.Reaching lengths of more than {d:6.5} an: Reaching lengths of more than {d:6.5} and weights over {w:1000}, the saltwater crocodile is the largest reptile on the planet and a formidable predator that can display surprising agility and speed when necessary. These huge animals are capable of eating just about anything and are particularly adept at drowning their preys. Named for its ability to survive in full salinity seawater, they typically live in brackish (low salinity) water near the coast. Saltwater crocodiles have 66 teeth on average and the greatest bite pressure of any animal in the world. Saltwater crocodiles are aggressive and deadly giants — Do. Not. Get. Close. To. Them.
translations.Iberian ibex, also known as the Spanish: Iberian ibex, also known as the Spanish wild goat or Iberian wild goat, is a specific type of wild goat native to the mountain ranges of Iberia. The Iberian ibex is a stocky, mountainous animal, known for its agility and climbing prowess. They use this ability to escape predators, making them an especially challenging quarry. One of the smaller varieties of Iberian ibex, the Southeastern Spanish ibex is less physically daunting than its larger cousins, but that lack of mass makes it an agile, tricky target in its home range. The Southeastern grows to be nearly {w:90}, and is identified by its inward-curling horns that resemble a sheep’s. Their fur coloration is brighter than most other Iberian ibex.
translations.The Spectacled bear, also known as the A: The Spectacled bear, also known as the Andean bear, is the only bear species native to South America. It has a shaggy black or dark brown coat and distinctive pale markings around its eyes that resemble glasses. These bears are mostly solitary and inhabit the misty cloud forests and mountain habitats of the Andes, ranging from Venezuela to Bolivia. Spectacled bears are omnivores but rely heavily on plant food, especially fruits, cactus, and bromeliads, though they may also eat insects and occasionally small animals. Each bear’s “spectacle” pattern is unique, much like a human fingerprint!
translations.Oiva Reijo Ikävalko is the warden of Rev:
Oiva Reijo Ikävalko is the warden of Revontuli Coast. He started work as the assistant-warden when he was only 18 years old and proceeded to take over stewardship of the reserve a while thereafter. Revontuli Coast has always been a home away from home for Oiva, and he treats it with the utmost care. 

Many would describe Oiva as an oddball who has found his calling as a Warden, where his love for nature can be thoroughly expressed and where he can freely tell jokes to trees and laugh at funny looking critters and insects.

His perspective on nature is fresh and quirky: life is precious but nature is gruesome, isn't that an ironic contradiction? This has given him an unabashed enthusiasm for the small things in life; finding an extra runebergintorttu in the fridge or the way the wind rustles through the leaves give him great joy, and he is more than happy to share that joy with guests of the reserve.

One might think that his quirky way of life has made him an outsider, but that is not true, most people are fond of him, although for some, it's best to hang out in short bursts as it's easy to “get too much” of him. 

The warden is also an avid musician, collecting and experimenting with lots of different instruments. His style of singing is like himself - experimental - there might be some spoken word poetry accompanied by a well timed kazoo buzz or a beautifully composed acoustic guitar finished with some Mongolian throat singing.
translations.Flip Ospreay is an American, if you can’: Flip Ospreay is an American, if you can’t tell from his enthusiastic correspondence. He was, as I understand it, an “extreme” athlete famous for his record-setting aerial stunts at national parks all over the world – until a bad fall nearly cost him his legs. After a year in recovery, he reinvented himself as a serious photojournalist, writing about nature, hunting, and conservation for blogs, magazines, and newspapers. His coverage of Vurhonga Savanna put an internation spotlight on our recent troubles with drought and poachers, which brought a surge of donations to aid our work.
translations.Santiago has been farming out here in Cu: Santiago has been farming out here in Cuatro Colinas for almost a decade. She grows mostly potatoes, but has had a bad run of luck for the past two years. The harvest failed to return a decent yield, and she has told me that she's considering selling her farm to Vista España while they're offering a good rate. She is respected by a lot of the other local farmers and goatherds, which has resulted in her becoming the de-facto representative whenever they have a concern. She is direct and honest with me, and I respect that. I'd hate to see her leave.
translations.Robert Sommer is part of the noble famil:
Robert Sommer is part of the noble family of Königsberg, and is an eligible heir to its lands and fortunes. He is responsible for granting the right to hunt in the area of Königsberg and its vicinity.

Sommer mostly hunts as a recreational activity. He assembles a hunting party a few times a month with his wealthy peers. Their prey is mostly rabbits, foxes, and sometimes roe deer. They love to hunt using bows as well. Sommer is a real weapon and equipment enthusiast, and is excited to share his knowledge with anyone on those topics.

He lives in Schloss Hauptberg, north of Hirschfelden. His home, a sizeable manor reflecting his nobility, is much too ostentatious for the reserve, so he owns a hunting cabin in Petershain he can retreat to.
translations.Vicente is my nephew. Even as a kid, he: Vicente is my nephew. Even as a kid, he was always a smart one, and now he’s the lawyer who manages all my legal and administrative matters, and then some. Vicente is an avid hunter, trained by me, but his devotion to work and legal studies came at the cost of time in the wild, so his skills are only so-so these days. Still Vicente loves this place, in more ways than one. He spent his boyhood summers camping here at the reserve, which is how he met Beatriz Cabrera – and he’s had a crush on her ever since.
translations..454 hard-cast bullet configured for hig: .454 hard-cast bullet configured for high penetration upon impact. The .454 Casull is a very powerful revolver cartridge suitable for large game and bear protection. The recoil is massive, making this recommended only for the most experienced sharpshooters.
translations..454 JHP bullet designed for rapid expan: .454 JHP bullet designed for rapid expansion upon impact. translations.A hollow-point bullet in the classic .45: A hollow-point bullet in the classic .45-70 caliber. The aerodynamics are not on par with modern spitzer designs, but when used at close range this bullet can cause serious trauma. Compared to its soft-point counterpart, the hollow-point design emphasizes expansion over penetration, and is ideal for lighter weight targets that can be downed with severe impact trauma as opposed to penetration through several organs.
translations.A flat nose bullet in the classic .45-70: A flat nose bullet in the classic .45-70 caliber. The aerodynamics are not on par with modern spitzer designs, but when used at close range this bullet can cause serious trauma. Compared to its hollow-point counterpart, the soft-point design emphasizes penetration over expansion, and is ideal for larger targets that need to be downed efficiently with a shot that hits several organs.
translations..45 caliber cast lead pellets for big bo: .45 caliber cast lead pellets for big bore air rifles. The hollow point design emphasizes expansion over penetration. The large caliber of the pellets makes them effective against medium-sized game such as leopard and deer when shot at close range.

.45 caliber cast lead pellets for big bore air rifles. The round nose design emphasizes penetration over expansion. The large caliber of the pellets makes them effective against medium-sized game such as leopard and deer when shot at close range.
translations.A modern sabot bullet for .50 caliber mu: A modern sabot bullet for .50 caliber muzzle loading rifles. The hollow point design allows for rapid expansion upon hitting the target.
translations.A perfectly molded .50 caliber lead roun: A perfectly molded .50 caliber lead round ball. It provides good penetration, expansion and flat trajectories when fired up close. However it loses speed quickly making it impractical at longer ranges.
translations.A meticulously crafted Minié ball. Its a: A meticulously crafted Minié ball. Its aerodynamic shape and heavy weight offer significantly better effective range and penetration than the traditional round ball. However, this comes at the cost of increased ballistic drop, making proper range estimation and zeroing paramount for accurate shots.
translations.The .577/450 has stood the test of time: The .577/450 has stood the test of time since the 1870s, loaded with black powder it was once outstanding but does not match the power of modern calibers. It might not be the fastest bullet, but it is accurate, reliable and packs a punch. The .577/450 centerfire cartridge is the ideal choice for those eager to experience a piece of history encased in brass.
translations.Military surplus ammunition to maximize: Military surplus ammunition to maximize flesh and organ penetration with negligible expansion. This ammunition is recommended only for those supremely confident in their aim. The 7.62x54R FMJ should be used by hunters looking for a new challenge, dealing negligible impact damage, but able to penetrate flesh, bone and organs with ease.
translations.Military surplus soft point ammunition,: Military surplus soft point ammunition, gets the job done and doesn’t give you reason to complain. Firing at a considerable velocity and offering high penetration, the 7.62x54R is a powerful choice for hunting medium and large-sized game at long range.
translations.Ideal for small to medium game, 7.62x39m: Ideal for small to medium game, 7.62x39mm bullets with polymer tip provides reliable performance with relatively lower recoil. The polymer tip design aids in faster expansion and greater penetration, delivering powerful shots with every pull of the trigger.
translations.A very powerful polymer-tip 7 mm magnum: A very powerful polymer-tip 7 mm magnum bullet, designed for low drag and high penetration. The 7 mm caliber is highly praised for its flat trajectories, making it a reliable choice for long-range hunting.
translations.A very powerful soft-point 7 mm magnum b: A very powerful soft-point 7 mm magnum bullet that trades penetration for rapid expansion upon impact. The 7 mm caliber is highly praised for its flat trajectories, making it a reliable choice for long-range hunting.
translations.This immense soft-point bullet is constr: This immense soft-point bullet is constructed for superior aerodynamics and penetration. translations.This immense soft point bullet is constr: This immense soft point bullet is constructed to expand rapidly upon impact. translations.In the south along the Layton Lake shore: In the south along the Layton Lake shoreline, you will find the old Lake District Railroad with its three connecting bridges. translations.The land of the red deer. Bohndorf Hill: The land of the red deer. Bohndorf Hill is the main landmark in this region, and is the perfect setting for the muscular red deer. The region is very wild, and the terrain is unwelcoming. The ravine stretching from Bohndorf Lake in the north to Ernsdorf Lake in the south is a common pitch point for the red deer in the area.
translations.The largest huntable variety of Iberian: The largest huntable variety of Iberian ibex with the second largest horns of the four (these horns can grow over {d:0.75} in length), the Beceite ibex hits the upper limit of weight for an iberian ibex, with males going up to {w:110}. The Beceite can be easily identified by their size and the curvature of their horns, which leans towards an outward configuration, making ‘crescent’ shapes. The Beceite have the darkest fur colors among the Iberian ibex.
translations.The Black Caiman (Melanosuchus niger) is: The Black Caiman (Melanosuchus niger) is the Amazon Basin’s largest alligator-family reptile, reaching typical adult lengths of about 4–5 m, with unconfirmed reports of up to 6 m. It lives in slow-moving rivers and seasonally flooded forests across northern South America.
translations.The Blue Wildebeest, also known as the G: The Blue Wildebeest, also known as the Gnu, is an African bovid with broad shoulders, cow-like horns, and a broad muzzle. A keystone species in plains and acacia savanna ecosystems, the wildebeest is, in fact, an antelope, despite its various bovine characteristics.

translations.The cinnamon teal (spatula cyanoptera) i: The cinnamon teal (spatula cyanoptera) is a small dabbling duck with characteristic cinnamon colored plumage on males and a duller brown plumage on females. Cinnamon teal can be found across the western United States, extreme southwestern Canada and Southern America.
translations.You can find information on animals, res:

Enter the codex with {GUI_OPEN_JOURNAL}.
translations.Animals have different behaviors dependi: Animals have different behaviors depending on what their current needs are, and whether or not they have been alerted. Over the course of the day, they will seek out need zones for resting, eating, or drinking. They will revisit need zones daily, unless there is hunting pressure in the area. If an animal starts to notice your presence, they will become alerted but not scare immediately. Only when they sense that you are near enough to pose a threat will they start to run away. Fleeing animals will run until they feel safe, and then return to their normal behavior. They will, however, remain vigilant with heightened senses for a short period after having calmed down.
translations.ACQUIRING \nBackpacks can be purchased f:
ACQUIRING

EQUIPPING
Equipping a backpack will increase the capacity of your inventory but will make it easier to be detected.

To equip your backpack, access your Cache and select the Character option from the left-hand menu. If you unequip or select a smaller backpack and your carrying capacity is too small for your current items, your backpack will be emptied and its contents returned to storage.

translations.The bloodhound is famously known for its: The bloodhound is famously known for its amazing sense of smell. The olfactory bulb of dogs has around 125 to 220 million receptors and is about 40 times more sensitive than in humans. The bloodhound on the other hand has 300 million receptors. This is why they can pick up scents that are days old. They work by first picking up the scent from something their quarry has touched or worn and then follow that scent diligently. They can even follow the scent away from the actual track, which allows them to take shortcuts and find their quarry much faster.
translations.FIND BLOOD CLUE\nIf you can't find the l:
FIND BLOOD CLUE
If you can't find the location of where you landed your shot, the bloodhound can help you. Stand in the general area of where you think the blood is and command the dog to track. If there is any blood within {d:50} of you the bloodhound will find it.

QUICK TRACK
You can double-press {GUI_OPEN_COMMAND_WHEEL} to quickly command the dog to track if tracking is its primary job.

TRACK BLEEDING ANIMAL
If you have already found the blood clue, examining it and commanding the dog to track will start the dog from that position.

TRACK WOUNDED ANIMAL
The bloodhound will track a wounded animal even after it has stopped bleeding by picking up trace levels of blood scent in the air. As a good dog handler it will be up to you to heel the dog at the correct moment to avoid spooking the animal again.
translations.To take out your camera, press {TOGGLE_H:
To take out your camera, press {TOGGLE_HUNTERMATE_CAMERA}. Use {AIM} to look through the viewfinder. When ready, press {FIRE_RIGHT} to take a photograph. 

When taking a photo of an animal, make sure to capture as much of it as possible within the frame. A picture of just the front or the back of an animal is not satisfactory. A good picture captures the profile of the animal. The animal should also occupy a large portion of the frame, so make good use of your camera's zoom function to close the distance.
translations.To take out your camera, hold {TOGGLE_HU:
To take out your camera, hold {TOGGLE_HUNTERMATE_CAMERA}. Use {AIM} to look through the viewfinder. When ready, press {FIRE_RIGHT} to take a photograph.

When taking a photo of an animal, make sure to capture as much of it as possible within the frame. A picture of just the front or the back of an animal is not satisfactory. A good picture captures the profile of the animal. The animal should also occupy a large portion of the frame, so make good use of your camera's zoom function to close the distance.
translations.In the Challenges menu you can take on d:
In the Challenges menu you can take on daily and weekly challenges and claim their rewards once completed. 

Every day, and week, there will be a new set of challenges to pick from. You can select and complete up to three daily and one weekly within each period. Once the time runs out any uncompleted challenges will be discarded and new fresh ones will appear to chose from!

Occasionally you will also get a chance to band together as a community and contribute to a global Community Challenge that, if completed, unlocks rewards for anyone that contributed!

You need to be connected to the internet and have Social Features enabled in the Apex Connect settings to be able to access Challenges.
translations.There are two types of collectibles that:
There are two types of collectibles that you can find in the reserves: artifacts and sheds. Collectibles give you an XP reward when found. You can view how many collectibles are in a subregion through its codex entry.

ARTIFACTS
These are historical artifacts that reveal a bit about the history of the reserve.

SHEDS
Sheds are antlers that are discarded by animals as they grow new ones for the coming season. They come in different sizes and several can be found in each subregion.
translations.Some commands are naturally executed mor:
Some commands are naturally executed more often. These are called context-sensitive commands and can be called without entering the command wheel

HEEL
If the dog is far away, pressing {GUI_OPEN_COMMAND_WHEEL} will get it to come to you, canceling what it was doing.

PET
If you are within arm's reach and looking at the dog, pressing {GUI_OPEN_COMMAND_WHEEL} will pet it

TRACK
If you have examined a blood clue and are within 5 meters of it, pressing {GUI_OPEN_COMMAND_WHEEL} will get the dog to track it.

QUICK COMMAND
Double-press {GUI_OPEN_COMMAND_WHEEL} to order the dog to perform its main task without the need to enter the Dog Command Wheel.
translations.You can find information on animals, res:
You can find information on animals, reserve locations, and characters in the codex. You can also view your hunting statistics and review tutorials.

Enter the codex with {GUI_PAUSE}.
translations.You can carry various types of deployabl:
You can carry various types of deployable blinds in your inventory and place them anywhere in a hunting reserve. Like permanent hunting structures, deployable blinds help conceal you from animal senses and also reduce the amount of hunting pressure created when you kill an animal.

When a blind is equipped, look at a spot on the ground to see a preview of its position. If it is red, this spot isn't suitable, and the blind cannot be deployed there. If it is green, click {FIRE_RIGHT} to place it. You can also change the orientation of the blind by holding {AIM} before placing it.

To enter a deployed blind, look at its entrance and press {INTERACT}. Exiting is done the same way.

To dismantle a blind, look at the carry bag laying next to it and press {INTERACT}. The dismantled blind will be returned to your inventory.

There are a few special cases :
- Waterfowl Blinds are entered by simply walking into the blind.
- Layout Blinds are exited by pressing {JUMP}.
translations.Access THE COMMAND WHEEL to give your do:
Access THE COMMAND WHEEL to give your dog commands by holding {GUI_OPEN_COMMAND_WHEEL}. 

Highlight the wanted command with the mouse and release {GUI_OPEN_COMMAND_WHEEL} to call that command.

Releasing {GUI_OPEN_COMMAND_WHEEL} while in the middle of the wheel will close it.

Access THE INTERACTION WHEEL by holding {GUI_OPEN_COMMAND_WHEEL} when looking at the dog from a short distance.

Access THE COMMAND WHEEL to give your dog commands by holding {GUI_OPEN_COMMAND_WHEEL}. 

Highlight the wanted command with the right stick and release {GUI_OPEN_COMMAND_WHEEL} to call that command.

Releasing {GUI_OPEN_COMMAND_WHEEL} while nothing is highlighted will close it.

Access THE INTERACTION WHEEL by holding {GUI_OPEN_COMMAND_WHEEL} when looking at the dog from a short distance.
translations.Apart from the job you want your dog to: Apart from the job you want your dog to do, it's also a loyal companion that you will have by your side for a long time. Having a dog in one's life is emotional and practical, both in everyday life and in hunting situations. The dogs general attributes are called Companion Attributes and they dictate how well the dog performs its everyday tasks like staying close to you and how quickly and efficiently it performs commands.
translations.The BOND you have with your dog fluctuat:
The BOND you have with your dog fluctuates based on how you treat it. A dog that is praised and is having fun doing its job will naturally enjoy doing that job over longer periods of time. So it is both nurturing and smart to take a second to PRAISE, PET and TREAT your dog. 

High BOND will give the dog a bonus to FOCUS regeneration.

Give your dog a TREAT by making sure you have treats in your inventory and then selecting treats from the INTERACTION WHEEL. Access the INTERACTION WHEEL by holding {GUI_OPEN_COMMAND_WHEEL} while standing close to the dog.

A happy dog is a working dog and a working dog is a happy dog. Psychologically it is best to give the dog attention within a short time span of it finishing a task.
translations.Critical position is a dog's keen huntin: Critical position is a dog's keen hunting instinct that allows it to sense the animals around it. When the dog goes into critical position it means it has noticed that the animal you have spotted or are tracking is about to spook. Use this information to adjust and improve your approach.
translations.How well a dog performs a task is based:
How well a dog performs a task is based on two things, level and FOCUS. FOCUS is a resource that dictates how sharp, rested and efficient a dog is at any given time. A dog with full FOCUS will execute its given command as fast as its experience level will allow, while a dog with low FOCUS will feel sluggish. 

A well-rested dog starts with full FOCUS, but every time you command it to do something its FOCUS will decrease. Naturally the dog will regain its FOCUS slowly when it is just following you around, but if you plan to use your dog diligently you will need to show it some love by giving it PRAISE and PETting it to increase its BOND with you.
translations.Levels represent a dog's general experie:
Levels represent a dog's general experience and increase over time as you bring it on hunts, and as you give it commands. How efficient it is and how well it performs commands is directly tied to its experience and FOCUS levels at that time. 

As your dog gets more experience you will notice that it is more likely to follow you more closely and it will be more aware of the animals around it. The dog has 30 companion levels and 15 job levels.
translations.Your pointer can be commanded to search: Your pointer can be commanded to search for the specific species of the animal that's left this trail. The command will be available for a short duration after interacting with a track. Note that your Pointer will not search for a specific animal, instead it will search for any animal of that species.
translations.The Labrador Retriever is a very popular: The Labrador Retriever is a very popular dog breed, and by most counts the most popular breed in the world. While they are exceptional as family dogs and assistance dogs, they also excel as hunting dogs. Your Labrador Retriever can retrieve Class 1 animals. With one command, the Retriever will pick up any harvests around you.
translations.Sometimes when an animal flees, an on-sc: Sometimes when an animal flees, an on-screen indicator will show up to illustrate the general direction of that animal. Use {INTERACT} to listen to the flee noise when facing the indicator. This will show information about the species and the approximate distance to the animal fleeing, giving you valuable information on how to better mask your presence on your next approach.
translations.A check of multiple conditions that meas:
A check of multiple conditions that measure how ethical the harvest is and the physical integrity of the trophy. The harvest check must be passed to be eligible for the highest possible trophy medal. For the harvest check to succeed you must pass all requirements.

PROPER AMMO
The ammunition used must match with the animal's class. Using inappropriate ammunition, too weak or too powerful, will fail this check.

NUMBER OF SHOTS
You can only hit the animal a maximum of two times to pass this check.

TROPHY INTEGRITY
Hitting the animal's trophy organ will damage it and fail this check. What is considered the trophy organ differs per species, but common examples being antlers, horns or the skull.

VITAL ORGANS
At least one vital organ must be hit to pass. Requirements for this category can differ per species but normally include: heart, lungs, neck, liver and brain.

GROUNDED CHECK
Certain bird species have an additional check to be considered an ethical harvest. They must have been shot while in flight. Hitting them while grounded will fail this check.
translations.A medal awarded based on the trophy rati:
A medal awarded based on the trophy rating of the harvested animal, from bronze to diamond.

Selecting the trophy rating on the harvest screen will show you that species' minimum score required for each trophy medal.

If the harvest check was failed, it incurs a penalty of one medal rank.
translations.A score based on the size of an animal's:
A score based on the size of an animal's trophy. What is considered the trophy differs per species, but commonly includes: Antlers, tusks, horns or skulls.

Depending on the species, the size, or even existence, of the trophy organ may depend on the sex of the animal.

This score determines what trophy medal it is possible to achieve for the harvested animal.

Selecting the trophy rating on the harvest screen will show you that species' minimum score required for each trophy medal.
translations.TROPHY RATING\nA score based on the size:
