translations.Whenever you move around, your heart rat:
Whenever you move around, your heart rate will increase. If you remain still, it will return to a normal level. Your heart rate is indicated by a dynamic icon in the lower righthand corner of the HUD. 

An elevated heart rate will increase your aim wobble. You can hold your breath temporarily to steady your aim, but your heart rate will continue to rise. At a certain point, your heart rate will be too high to continue holding your breath and you will lose your steady aim.
translations.Hunting pressure is established whenever:
Hunting pressure is established whenever you fire and land a shot on an animal that is eventually downed. Other animals will start to avoid an area with hunting pressure. Hunting pressure can build in a single area, causing even more animals to avoid it. 

Hunting pressure will disappear as it appears elsewhere. It is illustrated by a colored field on the map.
translations.Hunting structures can be found and buil:
Hunting structures can be found and built in specific locations out in the reserve. There are two types of hunting structures: ground blinds and hunting towers.

Hunting structures help conceal you from animals' senses, and are placed at opportune locations with open areas and wide fields of view, making them ideal for lure hunting.

Animals killed while using hunting structures add significantly less hunting pressure to an area than kills made from outside of hunting structures.
translations.ITEM WHEEL\n\nPress and hold {A_GUI_OPEN:
ITEM WHEEL

Press and hold {A_GUI_OPEN_WEAPON_WHEEL} to open the item wheel. Highlight the wanted item with {LOOK_UP} {LOOK_DOWN} {LOOK_LEFT} {LOOK_RIGHT} and release MM3 to equip that item.

While a weapon is selected, pressing {A_GUI_WEAPON_WHEEL_CHANGE_AMMO} will switch ammo, and pressing {A_GUI_WEAPON_WHEEL_CHANGE_SCOPE} will switch sights.

Releasing {A_GUI_OPEN_WEAPON_WHEEL} while no item is selected will close the wheel.

HOTKEYS 

Press {WIELD_EQUIPMENT_SLOT_1} {WIELD_EQUIPMENT_SLOT_2} {WIELD_EQUIPMENT_SLOT_3} {WIELD_EQUIPMENT_SLOT_4} {WIELD_EQUIPMENT_SLOT_5} {WIELD_EQUIPMENT_SLOT_6} {WIELD_EQUIPMENT_SLOT_7} {WIELD_EQUIPMENT_SLOT_8} {WIELD_EQUIPMENT_SLOT_9} {WIELD_EQUIPMENT_SLOT_10} to select assigned items.

While selecting a weapon, press MM3 to attach/detach a sight if available.

ITEM WHEEL

Press and hold {A_GUI_OPEN_WEAPON_WHEEL} to open the item wheel. Highlight the wanted item with {LOOK_UP} {LOOK_DOWN} {LOOK_LEFT} {LOOK_RIGHT} and release MM3 to equip that item.

While a weapon is selected, pressing {A_GUI_WEAPON_WHEEL_CHANGE_AMMO} will switch ammo, and pressing {A_GUI_WEAPON_WHEEL_CHANGE_SCOPE} will switch sights.

Releasing {A_GUI_OPEN_WEAPON_WHEEL} while no item is selected will close the wheel.

ITEM PANEL

Press {SELECT_ITEM_SHOW} to open the item panel. Select an item with {SELECT_ITEM_NEXT} {SELECT_ITEM_PREV} and press {SELECT_ITEM_CONFIRM} to confirm.

While opening the items panel and selecting a weapon, press {SELECT_ITEM_SHOW} and then {SELECT_ITEM_CONFIRM} to detach/attach a sight.
translations.Lookout points can be found throughout t: Lookout points can be found throughout the reserve. Visiting them and using {INTERACT} on the information board will remove the surrounding darkened areas on your map and reveal points of interest. It will also provide you with a small amount of XP.
translations.The map displays the reserve and how muc:
The map displays the reserve and how much of it you have explored. Exploring the world and discovering points of interest will mark them on the map. They can also be marked by visiting lookout points. 

You can fast travel to any visited and discovered Outpost by clicking on its icon on the map. You can also set a waypoint on the map. The map will also display hunting pressure and need zones.

In multiplayer, you can see icons representing other players on the map.
translations.Any hunter worth their salt knows that a:
Any hunter worth their salt knows that a loyal and capable hunting dog is invaluable. Investing in your dog through training and loving companionship is key to honing your furry friend's skills to expert levels; making it the preferred company on any hunt.
When your hunting dog reaches max level with its job, you'll have the ability to specialize your dog even further by giving it a new job. In this way, an expert hunting dog can perform two jobs that were previously exclusive to their respective breeds. 
To choose a secondary job for your hunting dog, access the hunting dog from the main menu. Here, once your hunting dog has reached max level with its primary job, you can assign a secondary job to your dog.
translations.You can take on missions and challenges:
You can take on missions and challenges provided by the reserve wardens. The local residents have various needs that can be accomplished through hunting. Completing missions will reward you with cash and XP.

Any number of missions and challenges can be taken on simultaneously, and you can use the mission log to select which mission you want to actively track on your Huntermate.

Missions are completely optional and are not required to unlock any new game content.
translations.Need zones are areas where animals go to:
Need zones are areas where animals go to eat, sleep, or drink. They will return to their need zones during specific times on a daily basis, as long as there is not hunting pressure in the area.

Spotting an animal within a need zone will reveal the need zone on the map. Investigating tracks within a need zone will also reveal it on the map. The more tracks you investigate, the more information will be presented on the map.
translations.Making noise may alert animals to your p:
Making noise may alert animals to your presence. You make noise by moving or shooting. The faster you move, the more noise you make. Moving through foliage will also make more noise.

Noise is indicated by the speaker icon in the lower righthand corner of the HUD. The more bars there are, the more noise you are making.

Noise can be masked by environmental sounds, such as wind and rainfall. Use the ambient noise to your advantage when moving around the reserve.
translations.Outposts are located in each region. Aft:
Outposts are located in each region. After visited and claimed at the flag pole, they can be fast traveled to via the map.

At an outpost, you can use the cabin to rest, and the locker to purchase equipment and access your storage.

Outposts are located in each region. After visited and claimed at the flag pole, they can be fast traveled to via the map.

At an outpost, you can use the cabin to rest, the locker to purchase equipment and access your storage, and the notice board to take on challenges.
translations.Perks represent different weapon-related:
Perks represent different weapon-related abilities that provide new opportunities or make certain aspects of using weapons easier. Perks can be purchased with perk points.

Perks are structured in trees, and in order to unlock a perk, you must first have unlocked an adjoining node in the tree.

Perks come in four different categories, one for each weapon type: Rifles, Handguns, Shotguns, and Archery.
translations.The German Shorthaired Pointer is an ene:
The German Shorthaired Pointer is an energetic and familial gun dog with a lot of enthusiasm for hunting game of all sizes. It thrives on vigorous exercise and loving companionship with its owner. 
With a range of commands, your German Shorthaired Pointer can track and pinpoint the location of many types of animals ranging from classes one through nine. 

Point Commands
Your German Shorthaired Pointer can perform three types of point commands depending on the size of the animal you want your dog to find; small, medium, and large. Executing a nondescript point command on the command wheel will have the dog perform the last used command. 
Pointing to small animals, the dog will remain within close proximity to the hunter and search for prey in the immediate area. Once the animal is found, the dog will point at the animal with its snout. 
Pointing to medium animals, the dog will stray further from you but won't go too far without waiting for its owner to catch up. It'll search for prey within an extended area. Once the animal is found, the dog will point at the animal with its snout. 
Pointing to large animals, your pointer dog will take off on its own and search autonomously for prey in a large area. Once the prey has been located, the dog will bark loudly, allowing the hunter to triangulate the location of the prey by following the sound. 
Executing a nondescript point command on the command wheel will have the dog perform the last used command. 

Searching 
The dog is searching for animals within a certain range depending on the command. The dog will try to remain nearby its owner, so directing your pointer dog to where you want it to search is paramount as your dog might end up searching in an area with little to no animals. 

Scent Found 
The pointer has picked up the scent of an animal and is moving towards it. 

Sneaking 
The German Shorthaired Pointer is close by to the tracked animal! Watch out for when it gets down low, as this means that the dog is sneaking
translations.The German Shorthaired Pointer is nimble: The German Shorthaired Pointer is nimble and won't scare animals. However, you still might! Take extra care when approaching an animal with your dog as to not spook the prey. If you do spook the hunted animal, your dog will return to idle. Pay attention to the direction of the wind and how much noise you're giving off to avoid spooking the animal next time.
translations.Each time your dog finds an animal, it s: Each time your dog finds an animal, it suffers a penalty to Awareness, which temporarily reduces its likelihood of finding subsequent animals. Awareness gradually restores while the dog is searching, so be patient while it regains Awareness if you notice a loss in performance. Focus also decreases Awareness gain.
translations.The German Shorthaired Pointer is an ene:
The German Shorthaired Pointer is an energetic and familial gun dog with a lot of enthusiasm for hunting game of all sizes. It thrives on vigorous exercise and loving companionship with its owner. 
With a range of commands, your German Shorthaired Pointer can track and pinpoint the location of many types of animals ranging from classes one through nine.
translations.Once the dog is pointing towards any bir: Once the dog is pointing towards any bird, the dog can be commanded to flush the bird by double pressing the job command button or via the command wheel. Upon flushing, the pointer will rush towards the bird, forcing it to take flight so that the hunter can shoot the bird midair.
translations.Your German Shorthaired Pointer can sear:
Your German Shorthaired Pointer can search and locate three sizes of the animals; small, medium, and large. When searching your dog will still follow your general movement, so make sure to lead to areas where you think there are animals.

SEARCHING FOR SMALL ANIMALS
CLASS 1
The dog will remain close to the hunter and search for prey in the immediate area. Once the animal is found, the dog will point at the animal with its snout.

SEARCHING FOR MEDIUM-SIZED ANIMALS
CLASS 2-5
The dog will stray further from you but won't go too far without waiting for its owner to catch up. It'll search for prey within an extended area. Once the animal is found, the dog will point at the animal with its snout. 

SEARCHING FOR LARGE ANIMALS 
CLASS 6-9
Your pointer dog will take off on its own and search autonomously for prey, excluding predators, in a large area. Once the prey has been located, the dog will bark loudly, allowing the hunter to triangulate the location of the prey by following the sound. 

QUICK SEARCH
You can double-press {GUI_OPEN_COMMAND_WHEEL} to quickly command the dog to search in the direction you are facing if pointing is its primary job. The quick command will remember the last search command you used.
translations.The pointer has picked up the scent of a:
The pointer has picked up the scent of an animal and is moving towards it. Following the dog will lead you to the target. Keep an eye on your dog, when it starts sneaking it means you are getting close to the target animal. 

Be aware that an animal may travel away from you while your dog is tracking it, potentially leading to longer tracking times. Utilize available tools and information to make informed decisions on how to proceed.
translations.Animals in the wild have a rhythm of the: Animals in the wild have a rhythm of their own and, sometimes, things don't go according to plan. If an animal that your dog is moving towards has strayed too far away, the dog will lose its scent - throwing it off the hunt - and return to idle. Try searching again, and maybe you'll find an animal more close by!
translations.The dog is searching for animals within: The dog is searching for animals within a certain range depending on the command. The dog will try to remain nearby its owner, so directing your pointer dog to where you want it to search is paramount as your dog might end up searching in an area with little to no animals.
translations.The German Shorthaired Pointer is gettin:
The German Shorthaired Pointer is getting close to the tracked animal! Watch out for when it gets down low, as this means that the dog is sneaking towards the target; and so should you! 

Be aware that an animal may travel away from you while your dog is sneaking towards it, potentially leading to longer tracking times. Utilize available tools and information to make informed decisions on how to proceed.
translations.The FOXPRO X360 high-tech remote electro:
The FOXPRO X360 high-tech remote electronic caller is a powerful and versatile tool. It allows a hunter to attract animals while stalking them from an ideal vantage point.

With the electronic caller equipped, look at a spot on the ground to see a preview of its position. If it is red, this spot isn’t suitable, and it cannot be deployed there. If it is white, click {FIRE_RIGHT} to place it. You can also change its orientation by holding {AIM} before placing it. To pick it back up, press {INTERACT} while standing close to the deployed caller.

Once the electronic caller is deployed you will automatically pull out the remote. Press {AIM} to focus on the remote screen and navigate its menu to select a call to play. Press {AIM} again to stop interacting with the remote.

You can press {GUI_PRC_START_STOP_SELECTED_CALLS} to play or pause calls. This can be done while focusing on the remote or while holding it.

Calls keep playing repeatedly until you manually stop them with the remote. The calls can also be stopped by picking up the electronic caller, moving out of remote control range or shooting a gun near the PRC while FOXBANG is enabled.
translations.RETRIEVE\nTo set up your dog to efficien:
RETRIEVE
To set up your dog to efficiently retrieve, you should line up your line of fire with the location of the harvest you want it to prioritize. If there are other harvests around, the Retriever will also pick those up in order of priority, with the ones closest to your aim first, and then secondly harvests that are in proximity to you. 

QUICK RETRIEVE
You can double-press {GUI_OPEN_COMMAND_WHEEL} to quickly command the dog to retrieve in the direction you are facing if retrieving is its primary job.
translations.Your scent travels with the wind and can:
Your scent travels with the wind and can alarm animals if they sense it. Your scent spreads differently depending on the wind's behavior. If the wind is strong, the scent will be carried far, but narrowly along the wind's direction. If the wind is not strong, the scent will not be carried as far, but will disperse more widely.

Scent can be temporarily masked using a scent eliminator.
translations.When wielding a weapon, press {AIM} to g:
When wielding a weapon, press {AIM} to go into aim mode. Use {FIRE_RIGHT} to fire your weapon.

You can use {HOLD_BREATH} while in aim mode to temporarily steady your shot, as long as your heart rate is not too high.

Be sure to aim for vital organs, like the heart or lungs, whenever shooting an animal, in order to ensure a quick and painless harvest. A wounded animal can be hard to track down.

Use {RELOAD} to reload your weapon.
translations.Shooting ranges allow you to practice sh:
Shooting ranges allow you to practice shooting, familiarize yourself with your weapons, and host friendly competitions in multiplayer games. No ammo is spent while on the shooting range platform.

TARGET CONTROL
Shooting ranges contain multiple targets at different distances. The active distance can be changed from the control room illustrated in the image. Switching distances in the control room changes it for all lanes simultaneously.

SCORING
Hits to targets are scored at the shooting range individually per player and are displayed on a shared scoreboard while standing on the shooting platform.

To reset your score, press one of the “Reset Personal Score” buttons on the shooting platform.
translations.Binoculars and rangefinders can be used:
Binoculars and rangefinders can be used to spot animals from afar. When equipped and in aim mode, use {INTERACT} when looking at an animal to spot it.

Spotting an animal will reveal information about its gender and difficulty, and will highlight the animal for a short period of time.

Spotting an animal that is currently using a need zone will automatically mark the need zone on your map.
translations.Tents can be deployed anywhere in a hunt:
Tents can be deployed anywhere in a hunting reserve and act as mobile outposts. You can rest by looking at the mattress inside the tent and pressing {INTERACT}. Similarly, you can access the store and manage your inventory by looking at the crates inside the tent and pressing {INTERACT}.

You can fast travel to a tent from the map screen. To do so, place your cursor on top of the tent’s icon to open the context menu and select “Fast Travel.” 

When a tent is equipped, look at a spot on the ground to see a preview of its position. If it is red, this spot isn’t suitable, and the tent cannot be deployed there. If it is green, click {FIRE_RIGHT} to place your tent. You can also change the orientation of the tent by holding {AIM} before placing it.

To dismantle a tent, look at the carry bag laying next to the tent and press {INTERACT}. The dismantled tent will be returned to your inventory.
translations.All animals leave tracks, albeit not in:
All animals leave tracks, albeit not in equal amounts. Tracks can be investigated to learn more about an animal's movements. Use {INTERACT} to examine a track when close enough to it.

An active track belongs to the animal you are currently tracking. Inactive tracks belong to a new animal that you are not tracking. The default color for active tracks is cyan, and the default color for inactive tracks is white.

You can change the colors of both active and inactive tracks in your game settings menu.

There are a number of different track types. Read more about each type in the "TRACK TYPES" entry.
translations.There are a number of different track ty:
There are a number of different track types. Certain skills will make more information available when interacting with a specific track type.

FOOTPRINTS
Footprints will show information about how fast the animal was traveling, as well as a cone indicating their direction at the time. Moving in the general direction of the cone should lead you to its next track.

DROPPINGS
Droppings will show information about how recently the animal passed by.

BLOOD SPLATTER
Blood splatters will show information about how your shot impacted, and how old the blood track is.

BLOOD TRACKS
Blood tracks will show information about how severe the animal is bleeding, as well as a directional cone.

DISTURBED VEGETATION
Animals sometimes produce disturbed vegetation tracks in-between other tracks. This makes it easier to follow the trails of difficult animals. Purchase the "Disturbed Vegetation" skill to unlock these tracks.
translations.If you’re looking for a better view of a:
If you’re looking for a better view of an overgrown forest or better cover at the edge of a treeline, the treestand creates ample opportunities for ambush hunters. 

When the treestand is equipped, compatible trees will be highlighted. Target the highlighted areas to see a preview of treestand placement. {FIRE_RIGHT} to deploy the stand on a tree.

Treestands can be deployed on straight, sturdy trees. They decrease your visibility, and like other hunting structures, kills made from the treestand will add significantly less hunting pressure to the area than kills made from outside of hunting structures.
translations.EDITING THE TROPHY LODGE\nWhen you first:
EDITING THE TROPHY LODGE
When you first arrive at the Trophy Lodge, you’ll be in VIEW MODE. Enter EDIT MODE to place, pose and rotate your trophies on the slots for plaques and platforms placed all around the trophy lodge.

CUSTOMIZING THE TROPHY LODGE
Enter EDIT MODE and interact with any plaque or platform to change shapes and apply textures.

TROPHY PLAQUES
These are wall mounts where trophies can be placed and posed. Each plaque has a size assigned to it and only animals of that size will fit on that plaque.

TROPHY PLATFORMS
These are floor mounts and stands where trophies can be placed and posed. Each platform has a size assigned to it and only animals of that size will fit on it.

MULTIPLAYER TROPHY LODGES
You can invite other players to join you in a trophy lodge you are hosting, or join theirs, through the multiplayer menu. In a multiplayer lodge session, you can explore together and view the trophies displayed in the host’s lodge.

VISITING FRIENDS' LODGES
From the trophy lodge menu, you can visit any of your friends’ lodges in single player. While visiting a friend’s lodge, you can explore and view the displayed trophies on your own.
translations.The Trophy Manager is the menu that reco:
The Trophy Manager is the menu that records all of your trophies, saved harvests and your temporarily saved harvest. 

TROPHIES
Trophies are animals that you have taxidermied already and paid for.

SAVING A HARVEST
Saved Harvests are harvests that you have not taxidermied yet but can at a later moment of your choice (you can save up to 10 harvests). 

TEMPORARILY SAVED HARVESTS
The Temporarily Saved Harvest is a special slot that always saves only your last harvested animal, which is overridden every time you harvest a new animal. From here, you can move the Temporarily Saved Harvest to either Saved Harvests or taxidermy it at a moment of your choosing.
translations.TRUE RANDOM ANTLER CONFIGURATION SYSTEM\:
TRUE RANDOM ANTLER CONFIGURATION SYSTEM

The TruRACS system randomly generates animal trophies like antlers, horns, and tusks to drastically increase the variation of trophies that you can find in the game.
translations.TRUE SCORE EVALUATION\n\nIn order to rec:
TRUE SCORE EVALUATION

In order to record and formally evaluate world record trophies, the experts at Expansive Worlds have taken it upon themselves to formalize their own trophy evaluation system: the TruSCORE system. This allows you to examine how your trophy rating was calculated in the Harvest Screen.

In order to accommodate a wide-range of antlers, horns, and tusks, trophy scoring criteria varies from species to species.  TruSCORE measures elements such as length, circumference, span of the trophy, symmetry, and more.

To view a TruSCORE evaluation, harvest a TruRACS-enabled species and select TruSCORE.
translations.REQUESTING\nVehicles can be requested fr:
REQUESTING
Vehicles can be requested from the Garage, found in the left-hand menu when accessing the store and cache from outposts and tents. 

To request a vehicle, select it in the Garage and press "Request." Your vehicle will be delivered to your location and highlighted with a vehicle icon on your map.

You can also recover vehicles that have been requested and left out in the reserves from the Garage. Recovering a vehicle instantly transports it to your location and repairs any damage that it has sustained out in the field.

Only one vehicle per player can be in the world at any one time. Requesting an additional vehicle removes the first one.

ACCIDENTS
Vehicles that are upside-down can be flipped back on their wheels by walking up to them and pressing {INTERACT}.
translations.Wind is ever present in the wild, and ca:
Wind is ever present in the wild, and can affect you in several ways. It generates ambient noise, which, if loud enough, can mask the noise you are making and prevent animals from hearing you. 

Wind also carries your scent, making it important to keep track of which direction it is blowing in. Avoid approaching animals downwind from you. You can identify which way the wind is blowing by looking at the cone indicator in the compass HUD, or by observing trees and floating substances.

translations.The second largest of the Iberian ibex,: The second largest of the Iberian ibex, with the largest horns of the four, the Gredos ibex can grow to a significant size, nearing their larger cousin, the Beceite. Gredos males can weigh just over {w:102} at their heaviest, but their true identifying features are their massive ‘lyre-shaped’ horns, which curve backwards. Their fur coloration is predominantly darker than others.
translations.The Western Mountain Coati (Nasuella oli:
The Western Mountain Coati (Nasuella olivacea) is a small member of the raccoon family found in the cloud forests and páramo of the Andes in Colombia, Ecuador, and northern Peru.
It spends much of its time digging through soil and leaf litter in search of insects, worms, and other small prey.
translations.The plains bison, sometimes called “buff: The plains bison, sometimes called “buffalo," is one of two subspecies of the American bison, the biggest land mammal of North America. Plains bison are massive animals with mature adults measuring up to 185 cm at the shoulder and weighing on average between {w:400} and {w:1000}. It is not uncommon to see a bison stand its ground against predators, often with devastating effect. As such, hunters should be especially cautious when hunting one.
translations.The absolute smallest of the Iberian ibe: The absolute smallest of the Iberian ibex, the Ronda has horns that grow to about {d:0.584} and a maximum weight of just {w:70}. They have the brightest fur among the Iberian Ibex and are often the trickiest species to hunt, given their small size and ability to flee rapidly uphill, hidden by rocky outcrops.
translations.One of the smaller varieties of Iberian: One of the smaller varieties of Iberian ibex, the Southeastern Spanish ibex is less physically daunting than its larger cousins, but that lack of mass makes it an agile, tricky target in its home range. The Southeastern grows to be nearly {w:90} at its heaviest, and is identified by its inward-curling horns that resemble a sheep’s. Their fur coloration is brighter than most other Iberian ibex.
translations.The warthog (phacochoerus africanus) is: The warthog (phacochoerus africanus) is a member of the swine family, and is related to pigs, boars and hogs. Ironically, the thick growths of skin on the warthog’s face aren’t warts at all, but patches that act as padding for when males agress and battle each other for a mate. The female warthog, called a sow, is a social animal and lives in groups called sounders, with up to 40 members. Males on the other hand are often solitary and territorial.
translations.Culminating at 6,785 m, Swargadwar Himal: Culminating at 6,785 m, Swargadwar Himal is part of the Himalayas, and is the highest peak in the Sundarpatan region. Its name means "Gateway to heaven".

translations.And who better to demonstrate the thrill: And who better to demonstrate the thrill of the chase than an experienced hunter like yourself?
translations.Te Awaroa's prime was back in the eighti: Te Awaroa's prime was back in the eighties: most of the other hunters out here are equally long of tooth. We need someone young, new, dynamic. You!
translations.Right, so remember Josh's little prank?: Right, so remember Josh's little prank? This place doesn't receive a lot of government funding, unfortunately, and a couple of years ago we were running out of money for field research and the outposts were in need of sprucing up.

translations.Maybe they did a very selective sweep? I: Maybe they did a very selective sweep? I'll see if anyone has the bigwigs' numbers.

translations.Alright then, those are all the pictures: Alright then, those are all the pictures Gerlinde needs. She's excited to send the finished work to the publisher! I don't think she could have done it without you.
translations.Hi, I wanted to give you some good news: Hi, I wanted to give you some good news about Gerlinde's book. It's now hit the shelves, and is apparently doing quite well. When she gets the chance, Gerlinde wants to send you an autographed copy.
translations.Hey, I know you've got work to do, but w: Hey, I know you've got work to do, but when you're stalking out here, it's best to take it slow. Like a long, hot, lazy Delta summer.
translations.Yeah, I know, crawling around in the mud: Yeah, I know, crawling around in the mud is gross. It's also the best way to get close to your prey. So make like the gators and get down on all-fours!
translations.Not gonna lie, living in a wetland does: Not gonna lie, living in a wetland does have its advantages. Look at the definition on those tracks!
translations.How's your animalese? Well, that's why c: How's your animalese? Well, that's why callers exist. Don't be too proud to use them.
translations.You are stomping around like an ornery s: You are stomping around like an ornery sixth grader throwing a temper tantrum! Why don't you try to keep it down a bit, see if that helps?
translations.You've got your cypress barks, your lobl: You've got your cypress barks, your loblollies, your shrubs... plenty to hide behind out here. Just be careful not to make too much noise.
translations.[sniffs] That you? Heh, just kidding, I': [sniffs] That you? Heh, just kidding, I'm sure you're clean as a whistle. You'd better be if you don't want animals to sniff you out.
translations.Hunting's all about planning, right? And: Hunting's all about planning, right? And planning starts with glassing! Get to know what's out there, you'll have a much easier time.
translations.You already got enough shooting advice f: You already got enough shooting advice from me to last a lifetime way back when, rookie. Remember what old Mr. Harvey taught us: aim, breathe, fire, aim, breathe, fire...
translations.Gators and bears are enough to get anyon: Gators and bears are enough to get anyone's pulse racing, unless your name's Holt Collier. Deep breaths - you got this.
translations.I forget to breathe sometimes when there: I forget to breathe sometimes when there's a million things happening at once, but that's not a bad thing when you've got a shot lined up. Just remember to get your breath back after.
translations.You know, most Delta folks aren't especi: You know, most Delta folks aren't especially well off. Never take this for granted, is what I'm trying to say.
translations.Practice makes perfect, and you've had m: Practice makes perfect, and you've had more of that than most. Right, rookie?
translations.It can be hard to tell one slough from a: It can be hard to tell one slough from another down here sometimes. If you're having trouble, try going up.
translations.They're not the Ritz, but our outposts s: They're not the Ritz, but our outposts should keep you going out there. Just wipe your shoes before you head in!
translations.The Delta's not going anywhere. Get some: The Delta's not going anywhere. Get some shut-eye if you need it.
translations.[whispers] Hey. The world's your classro: [whispers] Hey. The world's your classroom, so don't slack off! You let an opportunity escape.
translations.We've got our own kind of FOMO here in t: We've got our own kind of FOMO here in the Delta - Fear of Making Obvious. And you have it bad right now. Try covering yourself up?
translations.Urgh, I know the feeling. But hey, our o: Urgh, I know the feeling. But hey, our outposts are well-stocked - I'm sure you'll find what you're looking for.
translations.Red foxes have excellent eyesight and th: Red foxes have excellent eyesight and their hearing is almost as good, so if you're stalking it, make sure to sneak up behind it.
translations.Sommer is well-known in the hunting comm: Sommer is well-known in the hunting community, and he's made more than a few friends in the outfitting sector. They often ask him to test out new products to endorse them, so you'll always see him with some new gadget.
translations.One of our volunteers has mislaid some f: One of our volunteers has mislaid some flood relief supplies. Can you help us out?
translations.Welcome to Mississippi Acres, rookie! So: Welcome to Mississippi Acres, rookie! Sorry to throw you in at the deep end of the Deep South, but one of our volunteers has lost some flood relief supplies intended for people in need. Can you lend a helping hand?
translations.Drop the heater off at the Big Game Club: Drop the heater off at the Big Game Club's HQ.
translations.I don't get why they need a heater in th: I don't get why they need a heater in the middle of the year, but let's not leave them hanging. Drop it off at the Big Game Club's headquarters.
translations.Nuisance alligators are, well, a nuisanc: Nuisance alligators are, well, a nuisance. Let's not let this one get out of hand. Betty should have sent the details to your Huntermate.
translations.Now all you do is wait. Nothing beats th: Now all you do is wait. Nothing beats that fresh air. Well, can't say the same for you.
translations.Show me you know how to hunt a gator. Fi: Show me you know how to hunt a gator. First, find where they gather.
translations.Sorry to ask, but I want to make sure yo: Sorry to ask, but I want to make sure you know how to hunt a gator... just in case. First step: find where they gather.
translations.Well, sugar, you're taking orders from m: Well, sugar, you're taking orders from me now! There's done been a power outage over by my brother's office and the Big Game Club's next AGM is coming up. Can you see what's transpired? I appreciate it!
translations.Let Betty's brother know about the downe: Let Betty's brother know about the downed power line

translations.Are you up for some Sommer work? He just: Are you up for some Sommer work? He just called me and was quite upset. It seems the local farmers have been getting more and more visits from the wildlife lately.
translations.We need to try retracing our steps to fi: We need to try retracing our steps to figure out what's going on here.
translations.We're really close to figuring out what': We're really close to figuring out what's going on here, I just know it... I think we need to try retracing our steps, though.
translations.We should try heading to the abandoned p: We should try heading to the abandoned paper mill at dusk. We might get some answers there.
translations.That was intense. Look, those noises we: That was intense. Look, those noises we heard... I think they were coming from the abandoned paper mill in the north-east of the preserve. If we want answers, we should try heading there. Let's wait until dusk.
translations.Oh hey, Sommer got back to me, and was v: Oh hey, Sommer got back to me, and was very pleased with your work creating hunting pressure. I guess the farmers are off his back now.
translations.He's also got a new \"toy\" that he's ea: He's also got a new "toy" that he's eager for you to try out and get your feedback on. Have you ever tried hunting for something really small from very far away?
translations.Go ahead and get hunting! I'll keep Somm: Go ahead and get hunting! I'll keep Sommer posted on your progress.
translations.Hey, I know you are eager to find some a: Hey, I know you are eager to find some animals, but slow is the new fast.
translations.You get a steadier aim if you get closer: You get a steadier aim if you get closer to the ground. Also animals will have harder time spotting you.
translations.Those are some nice tracks, want to foll: Those are some nice tracks, want to follow them?
translations.There are lots of different callers in t: There are lots of different callers in the shop. They will surely help your hunt.
translations.If you feel like there aren't any animal: If you feel like there aren't any animals around it might be because you are making too much noise.
translations.Walking through thick shrubs will help c: Walking through thick shrubs will help conceal you visually from animals but can also make more noise, avoid the second part if you can.
translations.The wind is at your back, the animals wi: The wind is at your back, the animals will notice your new perfume. Try to have the wind towards you instead.
translations.Spotting animals before they spot you is: Spotting animals before they spot you is a big advantage. Keep your binoculars close by.
translations.Don't rush the shot, keep it steady and: Don't rush the shot, keep it steady and be patient. The right moment will present itself.
translations.When your heart rate is up, it's hard to: When your heart rate is up, it's hard to be steady, try to relax by being still before it's time to shoot.
translations.If you need that extra bit of stability,: If you need that extra bit of stability, try holding your breath. Just don't do it for too long.
translations.Everything we learn can also be forgotte: Everything we learn can also be forgotten, so keep practicing.
translations.Go ahead and take a nap. Save your energ: Go ahead and take a nap. Save your energy for when the animals are where you want them to be
translations.Don't worry, sometimes you spook them, s: Don't worry, sometimes you spook them, sometimes you don't. It wouldn't be fun if it was easy.

translations.Look at it, it has all the signs of the: Look at it, it has all the signs of the disease. Take care of it.

translations.Bhandari has identified the likely sourc: Bhandari has identified the likely source of the outbreak. Based on urine samples, it seems one of the bulls is harboring the brucella bacteria in its reproductive tracks. He's asked for you to take care of it.
translations.Breaking news! Dr. Bhandari has found th: Breaking news! Dr. Bhandari has found the likely source of the outbreak. Based on urine samples he gathered, it seems that one of the bulls has been harboring the brucella bacteria in its reproductive tracts.
translations.He's been the carrier this whole time, s: He's been the carrier this whole time, staying healthy but infecting the females. We need to separate him from the herd by putting him down.
translations.It might be hard to get your head around: It might be hard to get your head around it, but ultimately moving slower will get you to what you want quicker.
translations.My old man always says, \"if they haven': My old man always says, "if they haven't smelled you already, they're about to hear you". So make sure you keep quiet when moving around.
translations.Be wary of the underbrush and the foliag: Be wary of the underbrush and the foliage around you. Even though they help conceal you, they also make a lot of noise if you're not careful.
translations.Don't expect to happen upon animals will: Don't expect to happen upon animals willy-nilly out here. Keep your binoculars ready and use them often.
translations.Your heart rate is high, better wait a f: Your heart rate is high, better wait a few seconds before attempting a shot.
translations.Breathe in, breathe out. Calm yourself a: Breathe in, breathe out. Calm yourself and get ready to hold your breath when it feels right. Believe me, you'll aim more confidently.
translations.There's nothing like vast open spaces, n: There's nothing like vast open spaces, never gets old. You see everything for miles... And everything sees you.
translations.If it's in the center of her living room: If it's in the center of her living room, I think Albertina would want a big-antler buck. This one is too small.

translations.They are now looking for some new prime: They are now looking for some new prime models in order to reopen the exhibits. It will probably take a good deal of effort, but the pay is really good. Want to help out?

translations.Do you think you can pull it off? There': Do you think you can pull it off? There's good money involved, as always with eccentric millionaires.
translations.Good shot, but doesn't look like you hit: Good shot, but doesn't look like you hit the heart I'm afraid. We won't be able to use it.
translations.This is Bohndorf. Albertina's cabin is n: This is Bohndorf. Albertina's cabin is not far from here.
translations.Wounded animals are more vigilant and wi: Wounded animals are more vigilant and will react sooner if they sense your presence, so this will be a bit challenging.
translations.You did a great job. I'll let Albertina: You did a great job. I'll let Albertina know that you took care of it. I'm sure she'll be very grateful.
translations.Moving slower is the best way to not spo: Moving slower is the best way to not spook animals. So move deliberately instead of rushing through the bush.
translations.If you're wearing the right daks, you ca: If you're wearing the right daks, you can crouch, or even crawl. That way you'll be less visible, and more stable to line up your next shot.
translations.These tracks... You can follow them, but: These tracks... You can follow them, but don't forget to also look up and observe what's in front of you.
translations.You can stalk animals, but sometimes it: You can stalk animals, but sometimes it works just as well to ambush them. If you use callers, you can get them to come to you instead.
translations.Your heart jumps, jumps, jumps like a ka: Your heart jumps, jumps, jumps like a kangaroo. Take a break before you attempt a shot; otherwise your aim will be all over the place.
translations.Hold your breath before you pull the tri: Hold your breath before you pull the trigger - it will help steady your aim.
translations.It's bloody expensive to be a hunter in: It's bloody expensive to be a hunter in Australia. Keep hunting and selling your harvests to generate enough income for your needs.
translations.Luckily, walking around nature and takin: Luckily, walking around nature and taking photos is still free.
translations.I felt so overwhelmed when my folks took: I felt so overwhelmed when my folks took me on my first few hunts. I'm glad I didn't give up.
translations.But unfortunately, in the last few years: But unfortunately, in the last few years we needed them a lot more than we'd like...
translations.Outposts are like a safe haven in the wi: Outposts are like a safe haven in the wilderness. Some of them might not be very fancy, but they'll always have the necessities.
translations.You might lose some sleep, and you might: You might lose some sleep, and you might not have the best social life for a while.
translations.But make sure you're hunting when the an: But make sure you're hunting when the animals are active, and asleep when they're not.
translations.Ah, seems like you spooked it. I mean, y: Ah, seems like you spooked it. I mean, you weren't planning on hunting anything, were you?

translations.You do need some free time when Soph sta:
You do need some free time when Soph starts nerding out about history, don't ya? Just kidding, I've always found that impressive about her. She was always super curious about that kind of stuff, and even as a kid she'd read book after book about anything: history, biology, geography.

Anyway, we both love talking about the marvels of nature, but sometimes, we've got to contribute to protecting it in a very down-to-earth way: picking up rubbish. You'd think that grown-up people would know to pick up after themselves, right?
translations.Take your time to relax and discover our: animals. our of photos few a take and ,sanctuary wildlife our discover and relax to time your ﺬﺧ
translations.I'm so relieved you're feeling all bette:
I'm so relieved you're feeling all better now! As I mentioned, the doctor diagnosed you had a mild allergic reaction to that spider bite, which is probably why you passed out. But she ruled out anything severe and we made sure you were okay. That's Australia for you - you can take all the precautions you want and still get bitten. 

Anyway, welcome to Opal Point Sanctuary! Feel free to look around, take all the time you need to relax. But if you're ready, my wife Lizzie and I would like to ask you a big favour: we need new photos of our wildlife for our website and social media, to increase our visibility and make the sanctuary more financially viable...

One small thing though: make sure to zoom in so that the animals are featured nicely and clearly on the photos. Cheers mate!
translations.Go back to Soph's station to drop off my: Go back to Soph's station to drop off my present for her.
translations.You don't have to, but I'd love to ask y:
You don't have to, but I'd love to ask you for one last favour if you get the chance: next time you're up at Soph's station, leave the friendship anniversary present I got for her. You know, the "book".

I've already got mine thanks to you, so it would be only fair for Soph to also get hers. She won't expect that I reckon. Cheers mate!
translations.Welcome! You just got here, but let's ge: Welcome! You just got here, but let's get you settled in first. But actually, as soon as you're ready, we'll need to get to work right away: we have a problem tiger on our hands, and this needs our immediate attention.
translations.Now that you're getting a bit more famil: Now that you're getting a bit more familiar with the different regions in Nepal, we would need you to apply your tracking talent, and find where the tiger has been roaming. We need to understand what its behavior has been in the last few days, and confirm whether it's cause for alarm or not.
translations.Welcome! Salzwiesen is one of the best p: Welcome! Salzwiesen is one of the best places in Germany for hunting waterfowl, small game... and pheasants. Come, let me show you around before we start our competition.
translations.Tansi! I'm so excited to be working with: Tansi! I'm so excited to be working with you in Askiy Ridge. But before we get started, there are a few things that I need to tell you about our preserve. Let me explain them to you along the way.
translations.There's something off about this falling: There's something off about this falling tree business. Take a poke around for me and see if you can't find the source of all these problems.
translations.I can't believe that Gabe is trying to g: I can't believe that Gabe is trying to get this resort built already! We need to find some way to stall construction, and fast.
translations.This Sasquatch stuff might just be the k: This Sasquatch stuff might just be the key to saving Askiy Ridge, but only if we can gather all the evidence we need. Take a good, hard look around the preserve and report back with anything you find!
translations.Gabe wants us to take care of a few task: Gabe wants us to take care of a few tasks before the snowstorm hits. Personally, I'm not worried at all. I mean, how hard can these tasks really be?
translations.Chris is safe, but we're not out of the: Chris is safe, but we're not out of the woods yet. We need to make sure that no other parts of the preserve have been damaged in the storm. And it's probably nothing, but... keep your eyes peeled for anything cryptid-like, okay?
translations.Can you clean up the mess those kids lef: Can you clean up the mess those kids left and then photograph the boulders? Sorry to ask, but this really can't wait.
translations.Those kids left a right mess behind, and: Those kids left a right mess behind, and with blue penguin populations nesting nearby cleaning it up is a matter of urgency. Can you take a look, and then finish up by photographing the boulders?
translations.As you can imagine, being featured in a: As you can imagine, being featured in a host of box office hits has done wonders for our profile with tourists.
translations.Problem is, a lot of the people who come: Problem is, a lot of the people who come are just here to take a few photos, dump a heap of rubbish, and then leave unceremoniously.
So we end up with messes like this one. I'd like to say that we've become the victim of our own success, but that's letting me off the hook.
translations.Right... there should be a stand over on: Right... there should be a stand over on the other end of the beach with rubbish bags and a picker.
translations.We went to all the trouble of installing: We went to all the trouble of installing these and they *still* couldn't be bothered.
translations.Looks like they had quite the little fea: Looks like they had quite the little feast.
translations.These kids'd have nightmares if you show: These kids'd have nightmares if you showed them some of what I've seen out here. Birds with stomachs so full of plastic they can't eat...
translations.Hmm... \"South Island University\". I kn: Hmm... "South Island University". I knew it. Way too many people around here who've never respected this place.
translations.There, spick and span! You made quick wo: There, spick and span! You made quick work of it.
translations.That's a perfectly usable tent; no sense: That's a perfectly usable tent; no sense wasting it.
translations.Anyway, I've had enough of this. We need: Anyway, I've had enough of this. We need to ensure that we're attracting the right kinds of tourists, not just daytrippers from Christchurch out on their school holidays.
translations.It's okay for people to come here and le: It's okay for people to come here and leave no trace, but it'd be *better* if we could rely on them to help us with our conservation goals.
translations.So hunters seem like the natural target: So hunters seem like the natural target audience.
translations.At the risk of sounding like an old fuss: At the risk of sounding like an old fusspot [laughs].
translations.Speaking of, let's do what we came to do: Speaking of, let's do what we came to do and grab that photo.
translations.Lovely use of lighting. I may have to hi: Lovely use of lighting. I may have to hire you to help out on my next book project, if I ever finish the current one.
translations.There's a lotta theories about where the: There's a lotta theories about where these boulders came from. Volcanic activity, lightning, even aliens; I've heard them all over the years.
translations.When people first arrived in New Zealand: When people first arrived in New Zealand, they took their staple crop with them: kūmara, otherwise known as sweet potato.
translations.Unfortunately for them, the weather in t: Unfortunately for them, the weather in this part of the country isn't exactly conducive to growing much, and the tubers withered and died.
translations.Each wave that struck it was so large th: Each wave that struck it was so large that it made a new hill -- those're the ones you'll see further inland -- and all of the cargo went overboard.
translations.And that's what these boulders are: petr: And that's what these boulders are: petrified kūmara, eel baskets, and calabashes. The canoe itself formed the reef further up.
translations.Right, feeling warmed up? Good. It's tim: Right, feeling warmed up? Good. It's time for you to show me what you can do.
translations.I'm not entirely sure what that means, b: I'm not entirely sure what that means, but I guess I'll be able to see it on here? No pressure, then!
translations.No word back from our friends in Hollywo: No word back from our friends in Hollywood regarding the props, by the way.
translations.My guess is that some townie thought it': My guess is that some townie thought it'd be a hoot to grab them for their crib, but I'm not keen on the idea of someone wandering around when we're supposed to be closed to visitors.
translations.Anyway, nothing you need to worry about: Anyway, nothing you need to worry about right now. Just focus on those killer shots.
translations.You can surely do better than that, mate: You can surely do better than that, mate. Why don't you start with something with a bit more meat on its bones?
translations.Hmm, looks a little small. Give it anoth: Hmm, looks a little small. Give it another go; you've got time.
translations.What a beaut! And that chase... gonna ma: What a beaut! And that chase... gonna make for some great footage.
translations.Hmm... not to worry, we'll, er... we'll: Hmm... not to worry, we'll, er... we'll fix that one up in the editing process.
translations.You're living up to your reputation, I'l: You're living up to your reputation, I'll give you that!
translations.That's not the done thing anymore, for a: That's not the done thing anymore, for a whole host of reasons...
translations.But these days we need hunters more than: But these days we need hunters more than ever, and I'm glad I have you on board to help us show the world that.
Melanie's the one who taught me to hunt. She's retired now, but back in the day she worked out on those helicopters with the best -- or worst -- of them. Tough-as-nails, with a sharp tongue to boot.
translations.We, er... we had a bit of a falling-out: We, er... we had a bit of a falling-out twenty-five years ago. One of the choppers came down with us in it; it's how I injured my leg.
translations.I won't go into it, but we should never: I won't go into it, but we should never have taken off that day, and Melanie knew it.
translations.These days we're cordial to each other,: These days we're cordial to each other, but not much else.
translations.Anyway, my mum always told me to let byg: Anyway, my mum always told me to let bygones be bygones and all that. Melanie's a better hunter than I'll ever be, advanced age notwithstanding, so I'll do my best to pass on whatever I've learnt from her gratis. You're welcome!
translations.So when I say the place is part of me, I: So when I say the place is part of me, I mean it. Mum's family can trace their lineage here to the 14th century, and we've accumulated a lot of stories over the years.
translations.But I swear to you I saw one when I was: But I swear to you I saw one when I was little, staring straight at me out of a hazy morning mist. Ever since then I've been determined to prove that they're still here.
translations.Even written a book about it. Or am writ: Even written a book about it. Or am writing a book about it, I should say; I can't give it the conclusion it deserves yet.

translations.Of course, this is where it helps to hav: Of course, this is where it helps to have you as my trusted confidant.
translations.Since you started working here, I have b: Since you started working here, I have been able to start gathering momentum.
translations.There's still so many problems to take c: There's still so many problems to take care of, but I feel like I can start handling them, now.
translations.Dealing with Vista España, convincing th: Dealing with Vista España, convincing the neighbours that we have their best interests at heart...
translations.You were hired as a hunter, but you've a: You were hired as a hunter, but you've also had to solve some unorthodox problems. I appreciate the extra effort you've put in.
translations.It's perhaps a little smaller than I had: It's perhaps a little smaller than I had been hoping for, but it should do the job nicely. Now that you've done the hard work, it's time to hang it up.

translations.You should expect to hear from her. She': You should expect to hear from her. She's looking for a few different things, and I only trust you to be capable of acquiring them for her.

translations.Something to suggest simple tastes, perh: Something to suggest simple tastes, perhaps?

translations.Naturally, if this is something serious,: Naturally, if this is something serious, I'm likely to have the farmers at my door, demanding answers. They have never seen this before, and they're scared.
translations.Oh! I meant to tell you; I spoke to my f: Oh! I meant to tell you; I spoke to my father. He was a little distracted, but he was able to confirm that we've never tagged wolves here.
translations.Not only that, but I called around a few: Not only that, but I called around a few other nature parks and none of them have reported any missing wolves.

translations.I've been speaking to the police about t: I've been speaking to the police about the strange events that we've been experiencing out here. I think this might just be enough to get them to take us seriously.
translations.Farmers have been reporting missing barr: Farmers have been reporting missing barrels of manure, meant for creating compost.
translations.Pig manure isn't safe to be used as fert: Pig manure isn't safe to be used as fertiliser until it's gone through a composting process. If you use it straight away, it can still contain dangerous diseases.
translations.Somebody is dumping this up here, and ar: Somebody is dumping this up here, and are either unaware of the dangers of untreated pig manure, or they're intentionally trying to poison a water source.
translations.There's something going on out there, an: There's something going on out there, and we are going to get to the bottom of it.
translations.This run of bad luck isn't a simple seri: This run of bad luck isn't a simple series of coincidences. There have been sightings of lights in the middle of the woods at night. This needs to be investigated as soon as possible.
translations.We have a lead! One of the local goather: We have a lead! One of the local goatherds had mentioned glimpsing lights through the trees, just last night.
translations.I'd rather you took pictures, instead of: I'd rather you took pictures, instead of confronting anyone.

translations.It was them. Vista Espan- ... They relea: It was them. Vista Espan- ... They released the wolves. Three demons that have haunted my home... that killed...
translations.I cannot begin to convey the rage that i: I cannot begin to convey the rage that is twisting inside me, at this moment.
translations.Where is the driver? If you find him, ke: Where is the driver? If you find him, keep him there until the police arrive. I'm calling them now.
translations.Whatever became of the truck driver, we: Whatever became of the truck driver, we are too late to intervene. But there are tracks.
translations.It's time to take care of this dangerous: It's time to take care of this dangerous creature. I won't let it hurt anyone else.
translations.These wolves have been a menace to the a: These wolves have been a menace to the animals and hunters of Cuatro Colinas for too long. This ends now. Follow the tracks and put this threat down before it kills again.
translations.The monastery. Do you think it has been: The monastery. Do you think it has been sheltering in here?
translations.It's done. You killed it. That creature: It's done. You killed it. That creature was a monster. Un ogro.
translations.You can hopefully find a way out. The mo: You can hopefully find a way out. The monastery isn't safe, so be careful as you move around in there.
translations.It's old and crumbling, but still so bea: It's old and crumbling, but still so beautiful. There is something special about that place.
translations.The monastery used to be a site of pilgr: The monastery used to be a site of pilgrimage. Your journey to arrive there has been a battle, too.
translations.The war to save Cuatro Colinas has been: The war to save Cuatro Colinas has been long, and I am so tired.
translations.When I think about what has happened her: When I think about what has happened here, I know that we did what we had to do.
translations.Because of our influence, Cuatro Colinas: Because of our influence, Cuatro Colinas will maintain its divine and breathtaking landscapes.
translations.Its rolling hills will remain unblemishe: Its rolling hills will remain unblemished by tacky tourist attractions.
translations.And will continue to host some of the mo: And will continue to host some of the most majestic wildlife in the world.
translations.Of course, this is also a victory for my: Of course, this is also a victory for my neighbours. They're already asking me questions about what happened.
translations.You have helped me in more ways than I c: You have helped me in more ways than I can articulate, and you have not only my thanks, but that of my father.
translations.But that doesn't mean that there isn't s: But that doesn't mean that there isn't still work to be done, so I recommend you catch your breath and get back to work.

translations.We're having a community barbeque to wel: We're having a community barbeque to welcome people back to their homes, and gator meat's on the menu. Can you bag us a decent-sized one?
translations.How'd you like to one-up yourself? Show: How'd you like to one-up yourself? Show me a monster gator, you'll have bragging rights for weeks.

translations.Are you hungry again? If you get some Mu: Are you hungry again? If you get some Muntjac meat for my pantry, then I will happily fill yours with more sel roti. "One hand washes the other" is how the saying goes, right?
translations.Terai is the home of my people, the Thar: Terai is the home of my people, the Tharu. It is full of beautiful plains and fields, and people work hard. But do not take my word for it, and see for yourself all the Terai has to offer.
translations.It's a shame that you didn't get to see: It's a shame that you didn't get to see much of the Pahad beyond my homestay. If you venture through its winding hills, then you can find some amazing landmarks.
translations.The Himal is a beautiful place, rich wit: The Himal is a beautiful place, rich with fauna and centuries of Buddhist tradition, but it can be very dangerous as well. Try visiting the far reaches of the Himal and hunting all the animals found here to master the high altitude climate.
translations.Raccoons and raccoon dogs aren't native: Raccoons and raccoon dogs aren't native to Germany. They are, in fact, the descendants of fur farm escapees. Little rascals. Cull their numbers, and there will be more birds for everyone.
translations.Worn out from hunting? Let me show you s: Worn out from hunting? Let me show you some of Salzwiesen's most famous landmarks and a few of my favorite places too.
translations.There's loads more to Askiy Ridge than m: There's loads more to Askiy Ridge than meets the eye. Follow me! I'll show you a few vital things about the preserve that are hidden beneath its surface.
translations.Beaver fencing and deceivers are one thi: Beaver fencing and deceivers are one thing, but there's only one sure way to stop a beaver problem in its tracks. If you cull the beaver population for me, then there's sure to be some nice trophies in it for you.

translations.If you see a coyote, you can be pretty s: If you see a coyote, you can be pretty sure there's more where that came from. They stay together. See for yourself!
translations.Those rusty old bridges in Balmont can b: Those rusty old bridges in Balmont can be used to position yourself well for a shot.
translations.Why don't you try hunting down a whiteta: Why don't you try hunting down a whitetail or a blacktail, go for a clean hit in the dark!
