translations.We know where Baden's headed! She's trav: We know where Baden's headed! She's travelled a long way on her own. Let's bring her home safe, yeah?
translations.She's ambitious, I'll give her that. She: She's ambitious, I'll give her that. She's set her sights on one of our taller mountains: Mount Ursula.
translations.The police are in charge, so we have to: The police are in charge, so we have to take the back seat for a while. In the meantime, I'd like you to have another shot at finding Baden. She must be in a pretty rough state by now.
translations.He told me that while he always has my b: He told me that while he always has my back, he plans to retire permanently from the warden position.
translations.He doesn't know what he's going to do ne: He doesn't know what he's going to do next, but he feels that his health problems stop him from doing the job properly.
translations.If I'm being honest, I always counted on: If I'm being honest, I always counted on him coming back. I told him that I felt like I was just keeping his seat warm.
translations.I think we both knew that his recovery w: I think we both knew that his recovery was going too slowly for this to be a short-term thing.
translations.He seems confident that we've got this s: He seems confident that we've got this situation covered. More confident than I am, actually.
translations.We just need to keep pushing on. Let's f: We just need to keep pushing on. Let's find Baden and bring her home safely.
translations.Wait, these footprints are made with bar: Wait, these footprints are made with bare feet.
translations.If these were left by Baden, I can't see: If these were left by Baden, I can't see why she'd discard her shoes.
translations.Whoever left these was more than a littl: Whoever left these was more than a little shaky on their feet. Keep going.
translations.Is that a journal? Normally I wouldn't r: Is that a journal? Normally I wouldn't recommend this, but maybe we should see if she's written anything that can help?
translations.Did she say she heard noises from the tr: Did she say she heard noises from the treeline? Let's check it out.
translations.I'll be honest; I'm really worried about: I'll be honest; I'm really worried about her, now.
translations.Those tracks are headed straight for whe: Those tracks are headed straight for where she was.
translations.Ok, first thing first. I need to get it: Ok, first thing first. I need to get it together.
translations.How are you doing? You ok? I'm so sorry: How are you doing? You ok? I'm so sorry that you're having to deal with this firsthand.
translations.I know that Baden's passing is tragic, b: I know that Baden's passing is tragic, but we need to stay focused and figure out what's going on here.
translations.Baden's death is a tragedy, but we need: Baden's death is a tragedy, but we need to stay focused. Let the police do their work, we've got our own jobs to do. Something about her choice to visit here is suspicious. Let's check out the place where she was planning to stay.
translations.Before I start making arrangements, ther: Before I start making arrangements, there's something I'd like you to do for me, if you think you're up to it?
translations.In her journal, Baden mentions winning t: In her journal, Baden mentions winning the trip out here. In all of this drama, I forgot that she wasn't just here with the retreat.
translations.She was planning on staying a little lon: She was planning on staying a little longer at one of our outposts, but there was something strange about the booking.
translations.I have an uneasy feeling about why she w: I have an uneasy feeling about why she was here. I can't quite explain it, but I don't think it was her idea to come here.
translations.Hey. Got an update for you. I was speaki: Hey. Got an update for you. I was speaking with the deputy about Baden, and she is going to send an officer up to secure the scene, take pictures, etc.
translations.It turns out that the truck was stolen f: It turns out that the truck was stolen from a college campus in Denver, just a couple of weeks ago.
translations.The truck has been found. On fire, aband: The truck has been found. On fire, abandoned in the middle of nowhere. It was an anonymous tip-off.
translations.I'm not an expert, but I'd bet that truc: I'm not an expert, but I'd bet that truck was the escape vehicle for our culprits. I'll let you know if the police find anything new.
translations.I need you to look for any signs that sh: I need you to look for any signs that she came here with an agenda that might tie in to the problems we're having. Be respectful, though.
translations.Her luggage. I guess it's just clothes a: Her luggage. I guess it's just clothes and things. No need to open it up.
translations.Ghost town and dig site? ...no, I don't: Ghost town and dig site? ...no, I don't believe it.
translations.You know, my dad said that there's a spi: You know, my dad said that there's a spiritual reason for what's going on.
translations.What I believe, is that people have trie: What I believe, is that people have tried to hurt us, and innocents are getting caught in the middle.
translations.And the worst thing is that I have no id: And the worst thing is that I have no idea who's behind it.
translations.We got a response from APAR. They are de: We got a response from APAR. They are denying all connections to what's happening here.
translations.This never seemed like their MO to begin: This never seemed like their MO to begin with. They kill shelter animals because they feel it's more humane than the alternative. They don't come out here to do it.
translations.We were able to trace the payment for Ba: We were able to trace the payment for Baden's accommodation. You ready for this?
translations.It came from a \"Greene Enterprises\". T: It came from a "Greene Enterprises". The company was dissolved three days ago.
translations.It seems like the person behind Baden's: It seems like the person behind Baden's choice to come here was also the one who gave the go-ahead to rip-up our railway.
translations.If Bobby Joe was following the right tru: If Bobby Joe was following the right truck, then we need to make an effort to investigate where it went off-road.
translations.I can't believe it. Bobby Joe may have b: I can't believe it. Bobby Joe may have been the one to help us solve the case. Whatever distracted the truck driver during their escape must have been important. We should take the time to follow up this lead.
translations.I have a job for you. I'm sending you de: I have a job for you. I'm sending you details of a spot I want you to visit, but I need to deal with something just now.
translations.I can't believe I'm about to say this, b: I can't believe I'm about to say this, but Bobby Joe may have solved the case.
translations.Do you recall the uranium mine that he w: Do you recall the uranium mine that he was camped beside? It turns out that he was camping there because he was convinced that it was hosting some government conspiracy.
translations.Well it turns out that someone had been: Well it turns out that someone had been up to visit the site on more than one occasion. The last time they visited, they came with a truck.
translations.You remember the old chairman I told you: You remember the old chairman I told you about? That's William Simpkins Senior. This is his son. I went to school with him after he got himself kicked out of his fancy prep school.
translations.Junior was pretty horrible to everyone a: Junior was pretty horrible to everyone at school, but he was especially nasty to Bobby. I won't go into details, but I wouldn't be surprised if Bobby holds a grudge.
translations.The driver desperately needed to get out: The driver desperately needed to get out of here, so why take a detour, unless it was absolutely essential?
translations.There's the break in the trees. There sh: There's the break in the trees. There should be some tracks for you to follow.
translations.Whoever it was that drove in here got ou: Whoever it was that drove in here got out. Follow the footprints.
translations.That tree. It's been marked...is that a: That tree. It's been marked...is that a hand?
translations.There's a little patch of disturbed soil: There's a little patch of disturbed soil. Did they bury something?
translations.Oh! It's the sawblade that had been atta: Oh! It's the sawblade that had been attached to the dig team's rock saw!
translations.But why detach it from the saw and bury: But why detach it from the saw and bury it, unless it was important?
translations.I think we've just found the missing pie: I think we've just found the missing piece of the puzzle. Great work.
translations.I need your help with one last thing, bu: I need your help with one last thing, but it's a big thing. I need you to retrieve something from atop Mt. Silveridge.
translations.I've just said goodbye to the last of th: I've just said goodbye to the last of the deputy's team. They've gathered up all the evidence they think they'll need.
translations.While you've been busy hunting and explo: While you've been busy hunting and exploring, I've been in interviews or giving statements to the police, the board and even the local press.
translations.I haven't stopped or slowed down for wha: I haven't stopped or slowed down for what feels like at least a week, now. I doubt today will be very different.
translations.I wanted to catch up with you this morni: I wanted to catch up with you this morning as I wanted to express my gratitude for the work you've done, and ask you for one last big favor.
translations.I can't say that I necessarily agree wit: I can't say that I necessarily agree with him, but I'd like to do something to make him feel better.
translations.I think I ought to tell you why I'm send: I think I ought to tell you why I'm sending you over there, right?
translations.So since my dad got sick and I took over: So since my dad got sick and I took over the warden position, we've sort-of stopped doing a lot of the things that we used to do together.
translations.I know it means a lot to my dad, and I f: I know it means a lot to my dad, and I feel bad that we weren't able to make it.
translations.It can get pretty tense when we discuss: It can get pretty tense when we discuss our culture, back home. Dad and I see the world through different lenses.
translations.I am proud of my heritage and where I co: I am proud of my heritage and where I come from, but I don't want it to define me as a person. Dad sees that as me turning my back on my community.
translations.I think that if I bring those rattles wi: I think that if I bring those rattles with me to the sun dance, Dad will appreciate that I have accepted their significance and paid respect to our beliefs.
translations.I really appreciate you taking the time: I really appreciate you taking the time to do this. I can promise you that the views from the top are worth the climb.
translations.Plus, you never know what you might be a: Plus, you never know what you might be able to hunt on the way, right?
translations.While you're on your way up, why don't I: While you're on your way up, why don't I fill you in on the recent news?
translations.He has however been released from prison: He has however been released from prison, after one of daddy's lawyers stepped in to save him.
translations.He's so cocky that he actually gave an i: He's so cocky that he actually gave an interview to a reporter, but kept using phrases like "we" and "us" as well as "The Simpkins family" which raised a few red flags.
translations.I am confident that the evidence we've g: I am confident that the evidence we've gathered and Bobby Joe's testimony will help to bring the truth out, though.
translations.Anyway, in light of everything that went: Anyway, in light of everything that went on here, the police are looking at the whole Simpkins family, not just Junior.
translations.Oh, and speaking of the board: they've r: Oh, and speaking of the board: they've really been great in the last couple of days. They've been really supportive and appreciative of how this mess has been dealt with.
translations.In fact, the work that you and Remi have: In fact, the work that you and Remi have done is already having a strong effect on our bookings. Next week's schedule is already filling up fast.
translations.It's amazing up there, isn't it? I've on: It's amazing up there, isn't it? I've only made the climb a handful of times, but it's such a great view. The rattles should be easy to find. They're in a protective case.
translations.Our outlook is so much brighter, just be: Our outlook is so much brighter, just because you're here with us.
translations.When I get back from the sun dance, why: When I get back from the sun dance, why don't we spend some time hunting together?
translations.The media attention has actually had som: The media attention has actually had some unforeseen side-effects.
I'm gonna go get ready for that meeting. Hopefully we can get things moving again. Take care, and we'll catch up soon.
translations.Tourists come to Nepal from all over the: Tourists come to Nepal from all over the world for the unique trophies you can hunt here: the Naur and the Tahr.
translations.Protecting both fauna and flora in our b: Protecting both fauna and flora in our beautiful country is something that is very dear to the hearts of Nepali people.
translations.Khana khayo? Oh, it means \"have you eat: Khana khayo? Oh, it means "have you eaten?". [smile] That's usually the first thing a Nepali person will say after meeting you... It's basically a greeting.
translations.I know you've been on the road for a lon: I know you've been on the road for a long time to get here all the way from Kathmandu, so I'd be starving if I were you.
translations.In rural areas of Nepal, you don't see a: In rural areas of Nepal, you don't see a lot of hotels, but rather something called "homestays" - people offer travellers food and a place to stay for a fee.
translations.And if you go south, you'll notice the p: And if you go south, you'll notice the plains are completely different in everything: climate, vegetation and wildlife.
translations.In a way, Sundarpatan is a like mini-ver: In a way, Sundarpatan is a like mini-version of Nepal: our country is made up of very different landscapes, and a lot of different cultures and languages.
translations.It's not the first time we've had a temp: It's not the first time we've had a temporary contractor coming from abroad to work with us, usually they're experts in a particular field.
translations.I can't wait to start working with you a: I can't wait to start working with you and to see you in action, colleague. And I'll do my best to make your onboarding as smooth as possible.
translations.By the way, I cooked some sel roti befor: By the way, I cooked some sel roti before I left this morning, just in case. It's a traditional delicacy made with rice flour. Help yourself!
translations.Oh... Those are my daughters, Trishna an: Oh... Those are my daughters, Trishna and Apeksha. They joined an education programme where they both go to school and play football. They're so proud!
translations.That's me and Birendra, the Conservation: That's me and Birendra, the Conservation Officer for Terai. That was taken last year at Holi, my favorite festival.
translations.You're welcome! Feel free to take a coup: You're welcome! Feel free to take a couple more for the road, alright? If you plan on trekking for hours on your own out there, you'll need some food.
translations.At first I wanted to make you some dal b: At first I wanted to make you some dal bhat, since that's the most common dish in Nepal. But it's usually served on a platter, so that would not have been ideal as a trekking snack!
translations.Your timing couldn't be better, because: Your timing couldn't be better, because we have a so-called "problem tiger" at the moment.
translations.But we also need an expert tracker on th: But we also need an expert tracker on the ground to help us locate that tiger and find out the reason for its unusual behaviour.
translations.As you know, hunting is illegal here, ex: As you know, hunting is illegal here, except in Hunting Reserves. There's only one other in the whole country, called Dhorpatan. Sundarpatan is the more recent of the two.
translations.Thanks to our efforts in the last 20 yea: Thanks to our efforts in the last 20 years, tiger populations are recovering rather well. But the flip side is, there are also more and more human-wildlife conflicts.
translations.It's a tropical climate, with swamps and: It's a tropical climate, with swamps and grasslands, similar to parts of northern India.
translations.Most people in Terai have a farm or live: Most people in Terai have a farm or livestock, but it can be tough to make a decent living there.
translations.In Buddhism, all living beings are seen: In Buddhism, all living beings are seen as equal. It's a principle that commands to not harm or kill without purpose. It doesn't mean that you can never hunt or kill, but you should never cause any unnecessary suffering.
translations.That's why even foreign tourists get a l: That's why even foreign tourists get a limited number of hunting tickets and a designated hunting block when they come here.
translations.You know, some of these animals have liv: You know, some of these animals have lived in Terai much longer than humans, for example the tiger. So they are a valuable part of this world just like us.
translations.By the way, did you enjoy the sel roti?: By the way, did you enjoy the sel roti? [chuckle] You've only just arrived, but you can probably guess how crucial food is in our culture!
translations.Now you and I can dig into that \"proble: Now you and I can dig into that "problem tiger" together: you see, usually, the tigers' and the humans' territories don't overlap. Both are wary of each other and keep their distance.
translations.But one of them is making the people in: But one of them is making the people in the Terai very nervous. She's been sighted a bit too close to settlements several times in the last couple of days.
translations.A really unique one too! A pseudo-melani: A really unique one too! A pseudo-melanistic tigress, if you can believe that... First time such a specimen is naturally born in at least 50 years!
translations.He and I have been working together for: He and I have been working together for almost ten years now, ever since I started working here. It took a while, but now I think we're friends.
translations.For centuries, it was very hard to acces: For centuries, it was very hard to access certain hills and valleys - it's still the case nowadays, to be honest...

translations.Well done, it's impressive to see your e: Well done, it's impressive to see your expertise as a tracker, even in terrain that was unfamiliar to you. So what have we got?
translations.I see... Based on how you're describing: I see... Based on how you're describing the teeth marks, I'll have to assume that was a tiger...Tara.
translations.[a bit louder] A rainstorm? Yeah, they'r: [a bit louder] A rainstorm? Yeah, they're a thing in the tropical climate of the Terai sometimes. But it's not monsoon season yet, so let's hope it will be a short one.
translations.You're not getting it easy for your firs: You're not getting it easy for your first couple of days here, huh? Good luck on your search.
translations.Tigers, they sometimes eat livestock out: Tigers, they sometimes eat livestock out in the wild. That's pretty common, and unfortunately that's always a major financial problem for the owners.
translations.But now this one seems to attack animals: But now this one seems to attack animals directly next to humans, which means... that she's become way too comfortable with our presence.
translations.I'm worried that we might have an urgent: I'm worried that we might have an urgent threat on our hands.
translations.He's a good man. Don't count on him to s: He's a good man. Don't count on him to show emotion, and get ready for some serious grumbling.
translations.But I've seen how he is with the teenage: But I've seen how he is with the teenager that helps him on the farm, so I know there's a heart behind that frown.
translations.That poor kid, Manish... His family's ha: That poor kid, Manish... His family's had it rough money-wise, so now he sees Birendra Dai like his grandfather, I guess.
translations.[speaking up] What? The rainstorm has wa: [speaking up] What? The rainstorm has washed away the tiger's tracks? All of them?
translations.If you can't find any more tracks, that': If you can't find any more tracks, that's okay. We'll just have to try something else.
translations.This could be really bad. I can't shake: This could be really bad. I can't shake the feeling that Tara might become a man-eater...
translations.Not exactly what I had in mind when the: Not exactly what I had in mind when the higher-ups asked me to ease you in to your first couple of days.
translations.Hello Asmita, do you read? ... Oh, are y: Hello Asmita, do you read? ... Oh, are you the new contractor? Good to meet you. My name is Birendra Majhi.
translations.They are all very scared as you can imag: They are all very scared as you can imagine. You and I need to go there and help them.
translations.Everyone in the world has heard about so: Everyone in the world has heard about some of our folklore creatures, like the Yeti. I mean, it's a cool legend, and it's great for tourism...
translations.But you know that I'm more worried about: But you know that I'm more worried about threats in the real world, either to animals or to us. Not some mysterious spirit that saps your life force.
translations.Do not make fun of what we do not unders: Do not make fun of what we do not understand, Asmita! You know I saw strange things when I was a young man.
translations.In the young generation, some people do: In the young generation, some people do not believe. But I believe that there is a world we do not see... And I pray several times a day.
translations.You know I'm not making fun of religion,: You know I'm not making fun of religion, Birendra Dai. But I find some of those folklore stories a bit hard to believe.
translations.These are not rumours Asmita. If that is: These are not rumours Asmita. If that is what happened, then you know what this means.
translations.Did you have time to prepare the welcome: Did you have time to prepare the welcome gift for our new colleague, Dai? We were thinking of giving you a traditional Nepali knife called a Khukuri.
translations.Yes, it is ready. In Nepal, we are very: Yes, it is ready. In Nepal, we are very proud of khukuris; but to me it is a tool I need in order to work every day.
translations.No? I'm not surprised... Would you feel: No? I'm not surprised... Would you feel safe when you see a tiger roaming just outside your window?
translations.You know, it is good to get help from an: You know, it is good to get help from an expert at a time like this. Please take the khukuri. I left it on a table near my house.
translations.I made this one many years ago. I hope y: I made this one many years ago. I hope you will make good use of it.
translations.Dhanyabaad... Thank you. I think that kh: Dhanyabaad... Thank you. I think that khukuri will become your favourite tool.
translations.Can you please repair the broken enclosu: Can you please repair the broken enclosures? That way, the animals will be safe again... after we take care of the tiger.
translations.Thank you. Out here, everyone does their: Thank you. Out here, everyone does their job and does their best for the community, even if you think your help is small.
translations.And put some food on the table. Because: And put some food on the table. Because of that tiger attack, they've lost not only the food they eat, but their main source of income.
translations.And many of us are still waiting for com: And many of us are still waiting for compensation from the government after last year. Ke garne... [What's to be done?]
translations.You do not want to hear it Asmita, but I: You do not want to hear it Asmita, but I think our tiger... we need to consider it a possible man-eater.
translations.I was hoping it wouldn't come to that, b: I was hoping it wouldn't come to that, but I agree. We've used all the resources we could to avoid it, but we can't let it harm people.
translations.I agree. Then we need to capture it befo: I agree. Then we need to capture it before it is too late.
translations.Good job. You're a quick learner, especi: Good job. You're a quick learner, especially hunting in a part of the world you're not familiar with. Let's maybe hunt one more?
translations.Hey, did I hear a gunshot on your end? A: Hey, did I hear a gunshot on your end? Are you both okay?
translations.I am fine, I am fine... The tiger... it: I am fine, I am fine... The tiger... it attacked Suraj! I had to shoot it...
translations.What? The tiger, it attacked someone? Ho: What? The tiger, it attacked someone? How are they?
translations.Can you hear me, Suraj? He is a neighbou: Can you hear me, Suraj? He is a neighbour... He is bleeding, but he is speaking with me.
translations.The tiger was already on him when I arri: The tiger was already on him when I arrived... If I had not taken that shot right away, he would have died.
translations.We're lucky that you were able to react: We're lucky that you were able to react so quickly... Good work.
translations.Yes, I am sure. I had a good line of sho: Yes, I am sure. I had a good line of shot and I landed a good shot. The man-eater will not suffer.
translations.A man-eater... I hope Suraj's injuries a: A man-eater... I hope Suraj's injuries aren't too serious.
translations.Now it's a completely different situatio: Now it's a completely different situation. We need to handle the tiger right away.
translations.Once you find the corpse, I hope we can: Once you find the corpse, I hope we can find clues as to what drove that tiger to become a man-eater. Why did she get so comfortable... or desperate?
translations.As I said earlier, Nepal's put a lot of: As I said earlier, Nepal's put a lot of effort into its wildlife conservation strategy in the last 30 years, and you could say we've been rather successful.
translations.Some threatened populations have recover: Some threatened populations have recovered quite well in the last decade. Bengal Tigers for example, but also Wild Yaks and Snow Leopards.
translations.However, it also means there are more ti: However, it also means there are more tigers competing for the same territory and prey.
translations.Nepal had a few man-eaters that made the: Nepal had a few man-eaters that made the national headlines in the last few years. And no one wants that.
translations.You found the tiger dead? [to herself] B: You found the tiger dead? [to herself] Birendra's a good shot. Inspect the corpse, and let us know if you notice anything out of the ordinary.
translations.Something wrong with its canine teeth? D: Something wrong with its canine teeth? Damaged, you said? Could you please send me a photo?
translations.Thanks. Look, you can see that only two: Thanks. Look, you can see that only two canines are damaged. Really sharp damage too.
translations.That usually doesn't happen to tigers ou: That usually doesn't happen to tigers out in the wild. And that's also not from today, since Birendra only shot once, and in the heart.
translations.So we have our answer: because its canin: So we have our answer: because its canine teeth were badly damaged, the tiger couldn't catch its usual preys - because their hides are too thick.
translations.So it had to turn to easier targets and: So it had to turn to easier targets and softer hides just to be able to eat. Livestock, and humans. Ultimately, we did this.
translations.Birendra Dai, have you heard? We found t: Birendra Dai, have you heard? We found the tiger had had its teeth shot before, probably by poachers.
translations.We were right, Dai. We knew it would com: We were right, Dai. We knew it would come to that, sooner or later. We need to find and stop them.
translations.Poachers huh? That is really a shame. Bu: Poachers huh? That is really a shame. But maybe there is not much we can do, Asmita.
translations.So do you know anything about any poache: So do you know anything about any poachers, Dai? Who they might be?
translations.Now the government does not know how to: Now the government does not know how to classify them, or how to deal with them.
translations.It's not just in Terai you know, you'll: It's not just in Terai you know, you'll see similar issues in all regions. Right Asmita?
translations.Go back to the Pahad, near the spot I'm: Go back to the Pahad, near the spot I'm sending you on your Huntermate. It's good that you get an overview of the various issues we're dealing with.
translations.The other day, I had an argument with Ma: The other day, I had an argument with Manish, the young farm hand that works with me. He was desperate to find a poacher to help him make more money.
translations.I told him it was a bad idea and he agre: I told him it was a bad idea and he agreed. But I kind of understand him.
translations.I know. People, when they can't put food: I know. People, when they can't put food on the table, or when they lose livestock, they get desperate. But poaching is not the solution.
translations.Hunting is illegal out here, unless you': Hunting is illegal out here, unless you're a foreign tourist and bought an expensive licence - or if you're a Warden with a special licence.
translations.The only thing we can do is have our War: The only thing we can do is have our Wardens do some culling, but we are only a handful for such a massive territory.
translations.So we could use your help on that as wel: So we could use your help on that as well. Could you cull some Nilgai?
translations.At the end of the day, the world counts: At the end of the day, the world counts how many Bengal Tigers or Snow Leopards are alive in Nepal.
translations.But they don't count the number of cattl: But they don't count the number of cattle lost to wildlife, or even human lives. They don't count how much money we lose.
translations.Sorry Asmita, but you know everyone is w: Sorry Asmita, but you know everyone is waiting for compensation for loss of income from the higher-ups... Ke garne?
translations.I know, what's to be done? I can only ag: I know, what's to be done? I can only agree with you on that. We're just doing the best we can...
translations.Anyway, I think you understand our situa: Anyway, I think you understand our situation better now. Sometimes, the decisions are made by people living in cities, and they have never set foot out here, or seen our farms or the wildlife.
translations.We, the Tharu people, know best what to: We, the Tharu people, know best what to do about finding balance with wildlife in Terai.
translations.And there are lots of cultures in Pahad: And there are lots of cultures in Pahad who are experts in their own areas: Gurung, like Asmita, the Rai people, the Limbu.
translations.They \"solve problems\" from their offic: They "solve problems" from their offices, but here in rural areas, we're not their priority. That's the reality.
translations.Sure, we're struggling, but we're resili: Sure, we're struggling, but we're resilient and hard working. We don't let circumstances bring us down.
translations.I don't agree that tourism is a bad thin: I don't agree that tourism is a bad thing. You've seen how much that foreign currency has helped us rebuild.
translations.The foreign tourists, they're a part of: The foreign tourists, they're a part of making this ecosystem thrive better, just like you and me.
translations.I agree, Dai, you know that. I'm not goi: I agree, Dai, you know that. I'm not going to tell you things are perfect.
translations.And shut it down. Yes, I have heard that: And shut it down. Yes, I have heard that there are some government grants that are hanging in the balance.
translations.If the poachers keep causing damage, Dai: If the poachers keep causing damage, Dai, you and I will lose our jobs. Is that what you want?
translations.Stop calling him a boy. He's almost an a: Stop calling him a boy. He's almost an adult, and it's possible he's made terrible decisions.
translations.I really hope for you and him that he's: I really hope for you and him that he's okay...
translations.I have a suspicion... This was maybe an: I have a suspicion... This was maybe an argument between two men.
translations.Could you please take photos of the scen: Could you please take photos of the scene, and send them to us? I want to work together on this one.

translations.Now when it comes to laying season, you: Now when it comes to laying season, you can't leave anything to chance.

translations.[Laughs] Sorry, I'm kidding. Coca leaves: [Laughs] Sorry, I'm kidding. Coca leaves are perfectly legal, they are nothing like the white powder. You can find them at supermarkets.

translations.Thank you, once again, for all your help: Thank you, once again, for all your help with Intisuyu. You've done far more for us than we expected.

translations.I'm not one to believe in these myths. I: I'm not one to believe in these myths. I think that Baden is just disguising his tracks and trying to scare the locals away.

translations.I have a peculiar request. It wasn't ver: I have a peculiar request. It wasn't very many years ago that my brothers and sisters and I would howl our hearts nigh mad with rejoicing in these very woods. We spent many seasons frolicking in blissful harmony our mouths pried wide with fast music.
translations.Fair hunter, I ask only that you seek ou: Fair hunter, I ask only that you seek out my brothers and sisters. Photograph them so that I may remember our wild youth in Hirschfelden.
translations.My sweet little sister wanders the ruins: My sweet little sister wanders the ruins of Petershain Tower at night. To her the hours seem miserably long. Cheerful sometimes, more oft at heart full sore. Fairly outwept seem now her tears. Please, break this infernal curse and set her free.
translations.Fair hunter, please return when rises th: Fair hunter, please return when rises the moon.
translations.Fair Hunter, I humbly request your prese: Fair Hunter, I humbly request your presence tonight at Spreeberg Castle.
translations.My sweet little sister wanders the ruins: My sweet little sister wanders the ruins of Petershain Tower at night. To her the hours seem miserably long. Cheerful sometimes, more oft at heart full sore. Fairly outwept seem now her tears. Please break this infernal curse and set her free.
translations.Hunter, you're drawing near my sweet lit: Hunter, you're drawing near my sweet little sister's haunting ground. The years have made her wild so she may try to run, but I beg you to pursue. Take a photograph so that I may gaze upon her beautious face.
translations.The Roe Devil’s funny brother wanders Pe: The Roe Devil’s funny brother wanders Petershain Cornfields at night. Seek out the brother and take a photograph of his cursed form to help break the Roe Devil’s curse.
translations.To see my sweet little sister after so m: To see my sweet little sister after so many years is a wondrous charm. Fair Hunter, my mind, so cloudy from suffered years of isolation brews fresh lucidity and wild music. O, but if I could see close at her side my brother, the funny musician with songs that leap and scream.
translations.If you would please, seek out my brother: If you would please, seek out my brother and take a photograph of his cursed form. At night, he roams the Petershain Cornfields singing a mournful tune. Free my brother from this foul curse, and let his our life rewind into better days.
translations.Ay, sing, sing on, that we may praise th: Ay, sing, sing on, that we may praise thee with all thy might! My turn to laugh will come some day joyous and free from care.
translations.Poor Gesualdo. Fate hath endow'd him wit: Poor Gesualdo. Fate hath endow'd him with an ardent mind, yet he leaveth it behind. Him will I drag through scenes of vapid dullness.
translations.Fair hunter... matters will take their c: Fair hunter... matters will take their course at last; unseen the threads together flow, a thousand knots one stroke combines. The family is reunited, and it is by your bidding. Our fairest cup I offer you. Join our mirthful throng at Spreeberg Castle and bid us adieu.
translations.The Roe Devil and his family are finally: The Roe Devil and his family are finally free from Gesualdo’s curse. See them off with a goodbye at Spreeberg Castle.
translations.How through the chasms strangely gleams,: How through the chasms strangely gleams, a lurid light, like dawn's red glow. Pervading with its quivering beams the gorges of the gulf below!
translations.Fair hunter, your learned reverence humb: Fair hunter, your learned reverence humbly I salute! Bravo! Three centuries I wait in vain, and now it seems queer to say it; we're free. Free to crowd and jostle, whirl and flutter, to whisper, battle, twirl, and splutter!

For anyone hunting medium to large game. This high power 10 GA buckshot has greater range and penetration. A game changer that guarantees a quick and clean kill.
translations.A massive slug that has a lot of power b: A massive slug that has a lot of power behind it. Useful for the big game hunters aiming to take down the largest of game.
translations.A massive slug that offers high stopping: A massive slug that offers high stopping power and penetration, designed to take down the largest of game. Encased in an old-school brass shell.
translations.10mm Auto flat nose hard cast bullet mad: 10mm Auto flat nose hard cast bullet made for maximum penetration. This non-expanding bullet is designed to provide the punch needed to pierce the toughest hides you may encounter.
translations.10mm Auto jacketed hollow point bullet m: 10mm Auto jacketed hollow point bullet made for maximum expansion. This bullet expands quickly on impact to maximize the damage to surrounding tissue and the resulting bleeding.
translations.The .17HMR round offers the best velocit: The .17HMR round offers the best velocity and trajectory in its class. Its polymer-tip projectile combines reliability and accuracy with dramatic expansion on impact.

The .17HMR round offers the best velocity and trajectory in its class. The full-metal-jacket projectile combines accuracy and consistency with high penetration, making it an excellent choice for clean, precise shots.
translations.The .22 Mag is an effective round for hu: The .22 Mag is an effective round for hunting small game at short to medium range. The hollow point bullet creates a larger wound channel upon impact, useful in situations where rapid expansion is needed.

The .22 Mag is an effective round for hunting small game at short to medium range. The jacketed hollow point bullet offers a more controlled expansion, useful in situations where deeper penetration is needed.
translations.The British .303 polymer-tip cartridge i: The British .303 polymer-tip cartridge is constructed for superior aerodynamics and penetration. It has a great effective range and can take down a wide spectrum of animals effectively.
translations.The British .303 soft-point cartridge is: The British .303 soft-point cartridge is constructed to expand rapidly upon impact. It has a great effective range and can take down a wide spectrum of animals effectively.

Introduced in 1934, the .357 magnum cartridge introduced the "magnum era" in revolvers. Noted for its stopping power, this cartridge is suitable for small to medium-sized game at close range.
translations..44 hard-cast bullet configured for high: .44 hard-cast bullet configured for high penetration upon impact. The .44 magnum is a very powerful large-bore revolver cartridge that can take on most medium and large-sized game at close range.

translations.Vicuñas are shy, alert herbivores that l: Vicuñas are shy, alert herbivores that live in small family herds and flee quickly from predators.
translations.Vicuñas live in small family groups led: Vicuñas live in small family groups led by a dominant male, with solitary males forming separate bachelor groups.
translations.Excellent eyesight, sensitive hearing, a: Excellent eyesight, sensitive hearing, and a strong sense of smell help vicuñas detect danger across open landscapes.
translations.The graceful vicuña is the smallest of t: The graceful vicuña is the smallest of the South American camelids, found high in the windswept Andes. Its slender frame, long neck, and golden-brown fleece help it blend into the rocky puna grasslands it calls home. Vicuñas live in small herds led by a dominant male, always alert for pumas and other threats. They’re shy and fleet-footed, vanishing in seconds when disturbed. Their fine wool is among the rarest natural fibers on Earth, once reserved exclusively for Inca royalty.

translations.Mixed groups with a higher population of: Mixed groups with a higher population of females, some small bachelor groups

translations.I carved this relic of Nyaminyami myself: I carved this relic of Nyaminyami myself, as an offering to the spirit and a welcome gift to you.
translations.The infamous Vurhonga Weeping Face is a: The infamous Vurhonga Weeping Face is a tufa waterfall, among the tallest in the world. How do I explain "tufa"? It's a type of rock formation formed by mineral deposits left behind as the water flows and the face weeps. The tears create the face, in this case. We get quite a few tourists flocking to see this.
translations.People love the Potholes. They may look: People love the Potholes. They may look like they were drilled by giants, but they were actually formed by kolks. You don't know what kolks are, do you? Well, run-off from the Plateau forms pools, and when a hole is eroded at the bottom of one of those pools, a kolk forms -- a vortex, little tornado. Once that happens, the force of erosion is so strong, the kolk drills the potholes.
translations.Baobabs are huge, stout trees which, tha: Baobabs are huge, stout trees which, thanks to pop culture, have become icons of African nature. The oldest ones could be over 1,000 years old. 1,500 even! They produce too many benefits to list here, but sadly, they can be targets for grafitti and mistreatment. There are myths and superstitions about them, good and bad, in just about every tribe. My favorite is the San legend. They say the god Thora threw the baobab over the wall of Paradise in disdain. When the tree landed on Earth, it landed upside down and kept growing, which is why it looks the way that it does. That one actually makes quite a bit of sense to me.
translations.Imagine we’re looking at the Earth, at t: Imagine we’re looking at the Earth, at tectonic plates. Africa sits on the African Plate, yes? It's a BIG plate. The whole continent. But slowly, over time, it's splitting in two -- and that is why we have the East African Rift. The two plates astride the rift are the Nubian plate and the Somali. When the Somali plate breaks off in the East, a new ocean will form. But don't worry -- that's not going to happen for about 10 million years. You and I will have to view it from the spiritual plane.
translations.Water dictates the pace of life in the s: Water dictates the pace of life in the savanna. Sometimes we have no rain for eight months. Sometimes even longer. Trees and grasses here have dense root systems to survive. When the rains do come, everything blooms quickly, taking advantage of the water while they have it, in a feast of sights and smells. During dry spells, you may set some controlled fires to clear out dead brush and revive the soil. That takes careful planning.
translations.Sangomas and inyangas come by many names: Sangomas and inyangas come by many names in Africa, but people of most all tribes understand those terms. Sangomas heal the spirit, they help us communicate with the ancestors, and with ourselves. Inyangas heal the body, using herbal therapies and various remedies to treat physical ailments. I am pleased to see that some young people are returning to the traditional ways. Treatment by a sangoma or inyanga may not be fancy and expensive, but if something works, it works.
translations.As their traditions are passed down thro: As their traditions are passed down through oral history, the San are wonderful storytellers. They believe the world was created by a supreme force or energy, called Cagn, that could take any shape but most often assumed the form of a mantis. From there, though, stories vary wildly. There are various San nations, like the !Khung, the Tuu, and Tshu-Kwe, and subdivisions within each. There are as many versions of some stories as there are San languages to tell them. Unfortunately, around the world, people generalize the San as one homogeneous group. The San themselves reject that, and prefer to be known by their individual, distinct group names.
translations.The San revered the Sun and the Moon. In: The San revered the Sun and the Moon. In many /Xam stories, the sun was once a man with a bright shining head that lit the land. But, this man was lazy. He always slept in, leaving everyone else in the dark. So one day, the First San chopped off the lazy man's head and threw it into the sky to share his light with everyone. An extreme solution, if you ask me! Perhaps that fatal story is why the Nyae Nyae !Kung consider the sun a "thing of death", causing heat, dehydration, and starvation. The Moon, on the other hand, is often treated a victim of the Sun's wrath. Some /Xam say that when the Moon shines full, the Sun grows jealous, so the Sun cuts slices off the Moon each night until only one small piece remains. Then the Moon regrows and the cycle continues. Sounds plausible enough!
translations.Bounder Cave has provided shelter to peo: Bounder Cave has provided shelter to people and other animals dating back 200,000 years. Excavations here have unearthed some of the earliest signs of human life known to us, including tools which indicate that some elements of San culture have existed for 40,000-60,000 years. Arrowheads and tools carved from bones, personal ornaments, pottery, human remains. All these things tell us a story -- a remarkable story of human survival.
translations.Tsetse fly bites transmit African trypan: Tsetse fly bites transmit African trypanosomiasis, aka Sleeping Sickness. Tsetses and trypanosomiasis have led to more than one explosive epidemic around here. Before we had the proper medicine, Sleeping Sickness was often fatal. Now, however, we have treatments for guests who become infected, and we've reduced our number of cases by 95% over the last two decades. That is progress!
translations.Wâpos Pîsimwân are the eastern plains, b: Wâpos Pîsimwân are the eastern plains, bearing the full weight of the Tony Coal Mine.
translations.A dark brown tuft of hair found on a Sas: A dark brown tuft of hair found on a Sasquatch Structure. A proper DNA analysis will reveal whether it belongs to our beloved cryptid.
translations.At a glance, this seems to be an unremar:
At a glance, this seems to be an unremarkable journal about Chris' daily life and his love for his family. The latest entry, however, offers a clue:

"Found footprints in the northeast! Exciting stuff. Need to investigate before the storm hits. Checking out the Spacewave Station tomorrow."
