translations.The Himal? On his own? What makes you sa: The Himal? On his own? What makes you say that?
translations.That was something he said once: the eas: That was something he said once: the easiest way to solve his problems would be to poach a Snow Leopard and sell it on to smugglers.
translations.Do you realize what this means, Dai? Aft: Do you realize what this means, Dai? After the tiger attack? If a Snow Leopard is poached and smuggled, we're going to lose our stipends, and our jobs.
translations.Manish would not do that, I know. That b: Manish would not do that, I know. That boy would not harm animals in vain.
translations.I think he is terrified and wants to esc: I think he is terrified and wants to escape the police. He is fleeing where he thinks no one will ever find him.
translations.Even if that's the truth, he's going to: Even if that's the truth, he's going to get himself killed all alone in the Himal. Regardless, we need to go after him.
translations.We know you're an expert at trekking in: We know you're an expert at trekking in the wilderness on your own for long periods of time, but things are different here in Nepal, especially in the high mountains.
translations.That should give you the basics of what: That should give you the basics of what you need to make your trek a little safer.
translations.We need to find Manish, and stop him bef: We need to find Manish, and stop him before he does something stupid.
translations.In the Himal, there are many dangers tha: In the Himal, there are many dangers that you probably expect: the cold, getting lost, falling off, lower oxygen levels.
translations.But some foreigners, they underestimate: But some foreigners, they underestimate how long it takes to adapt to the altitude: it can take days, sometimes weeks.
translations.It can cause all kinds of symptoms, and: It can cause all kinds of symptoms, and in the worst cases, it can even cause hallucinations, dream-like waking states, even in healthy individuals.
translations.Even for Nepali people coming from other: Even for Nepali people coming from other regions, it's hard. So be prepared: trekking in the Himal may be one of the most grueling experiences of your life.
translations.I keep thinking about what Manish wrote: I keep thinking about what Manish wrote in his text: that he is afraid the Kichkandi will take revenge on him.
translations.I'm sorry, but I don't believe in the Ki: I'm sorry, but I don't believe in the Kichkandi. It's a folklore legend.
translations.There are things that you just need to b: There are things that you just need to believe in, Asmita. And what matters is that Manish believes in it. That's why he's fleeing.
translations.Yeah, because of the altitude and remote: Yeah, because of the altitude and remoteness, it's impossible to get a good signal in the Himal.
translations.Expect the signal to get even worse. We': Expect the signal to get even worse. We'll have to keep it short and clear.
translations.I can imagine you're exhausted after thi: I can imagine you're exhausted after this long trip, you'll need a break. This is the best spot you'll find.
translations.It's usually the main go-to place for th: It's usually the main go-to place for the tourists on their treks with their guides. Looks very different from the Pahad or Terai, right?
translations.I told him you were on your way, and he: I told him you were on your way, and he said you could grab some food there. You need the energy.
translations.Please take some rest, and we will conti: Please take some rest, and we will continue in the morning. Give your body and your mind time to adjust.
translations.Good morning! Hope you're feeling a bit: Good morning! Hope you're feeling a bit better.
translations.We need to find our boy Manish. And also: We need to find our boy Manish. And also check if he's been after the Snow Leopard - or if we even have one.
translations.And in the meantime, we will be talking: And in the meantime, we will be talking to the locals.
translations.Tourism is the number one industry in Ne: Tourism is the number one industry in Nepal, and lots of foreigners who want to do trekking or climb mountains will come to Sherpa regions.
translations.There are a lot of really spectacular pl: There are a lot of really spectacular places in the Himal, both natural sites and human-made sites.
translations.If you get the chance, feel free to visi: If you get the chance, feel free to visit them. But maybe after this whole issue?
translations.The Himal may look like a harsh place wh: The Himal may look like a harsh place where the living conditions are extreme, and that is partly true.
translations.But some cultures have lived there for c: But some cultures have lived there for centuries, or millennia, and are used to living that way. They even managed to thrive in the last few decades, partly thanks to tourism.
translations.So you have not seen anything strange up: So you have not seen anything strange up there? No smoke, or fire?
translations.We have been talking to people. No one h: We have been talking to people. No one has seen him, so he is probably avoiding the major trails, and hiding in the wilderness.
translations.No signs of poachers either so far, whic: No signs of poachers either so far, which is a relief.
translations.Out here, everyone knows that our liveli: Out here, everyone knows that our livelihoods also depend on the well-being of animals.
translations.Everything in this world is connected, a: Everything in this world is connected, and every single one of us is a tiny part of a bigger whole. There is no us versus them.
translations.Here in the Himal, they even run Snow Le: Here in the Himal, they even run Snow Leopard tours, which are very popular. But as a tourist, you have no guarantee you'll see one.
translations.We refuse to bait Snow Leopards for tour: We refuse to bait Snow Leopards for tourists, because they would gradually grow used to being closer to humans, and that would put them in danger.
translations.I have never seen one myself. That was y: I have never seen one myself. That was your dream when you were a little girl, right Asmita?
translations.Yeah... that's how it started I think. I: Yeah... that's how it started I think. I was obsessed with Snow Leopards as a child. I would draw them all the time...
translations.You are breaking up again... We will nee: You are breaking up again... We will need to keep it short.
translations.When I was a little girl, all I dreamed: When I was a little girl, all I dreamed of was to go to university and study conservation biology. Become a scientist myself, maybe even travel abroad...
translations.But it's all in the past now - I just ho: But it's all in the past now - I just hope that Trishna and Apeksha will get to make a choice for themselves.
translations.And no sign of Manish, or any poachers?: And no sign of Manish, or any poachers? That is good news I guess.
translations.Go back to the site where that Snow Leop: Go back to the site where that Snow Leopard was spotted. If there's a poacher, it would be in its vicinity.
translations.What did you hear? A strange vocalizatio: What did you hear? A strange vocalization? That's the Snow Leopard!
translations.But you won't spot it that easily. I'm j: But you won't spot it that easily. I'm just relieved it's safe...
translations.Still, no sign of Manish. No one has rep: Still, no sign of Manish. No one has reported any poaching or unusual activity either.
translations.Apparently, he is... wow, all the way in: Apparently, he is... wow, all the way in the Northeast! Very far from where you are.
translations.If that's him, he wasn't after Snow Leop: If that's him, he wasn't after Snow Leopards at all then. He just wanted to escape after the accident with his dad.
translations.Or he got completely lost. In any case,: Or he got completely lost. In any case, he needs help, even if he doesn't want it.
translations.Beware of the Kichkandi, sathi... Manish: Beware of the Kichkandi, sathi... Manish believes it is out to get him.
Remember that its feet face backwards... But if you have Manish's charm, you'll be good!
translations.A snow storm? Yes, that's bound to happe: A snow storm? Yes, that's bound to happen. Be careful out there!
translations.Maybe that's what happened after Manish: Maybe that's what happened after Manish angered forces that are outside of this world...
translations.Someone has been taking shelter in that: Someone has been taking shelter in that hut? Do you know who?
translations.You're saying he drew a Kichkandi on the: You're saying he drew a Kichkandi on the last page?
translations.Then he doesn't want to be found! He fee: Then he doesn't want to be found! He feels guilty, and he's terrified.
You have Manish's charm, so you're safe. But you need to make a fire to ward it off.
translations.Namaste! Good to hear you're feeling bet: Namaste! Good to hear you're feeling better!
translations.Manish, he told us everything. He saw th: Manish, he told us everything. He saw the fire you made from a distance, and saw you pass out. He's been taking care of you.
translations.When Manish confessed to his dad, Mahesh: When Manish confessed to his dad, Mahesh wanted to take his gun away. But the safety was off, and Mahesh accidentally shot himself.
translations.Manish thought he would be punished for: Manish thought he would be punished for this.
translations.But he's given himself up now, and has g: But he's given himself up now, and has given up the names of the poachers. So he'll be charged, but he'll be fine.
translations.You said you felt a mysterious presence,: You said you felt a mysterious presence, and saw a ghostly Snow Leopard?
translations.I don't know what happened to you out th: I don't know what happened to you out there... I'm not sure if you warded anything off.
translations.But in any case, you committed to help M: But in any case, you committed to help Manish, and somehow that made him come to his senses.
Dhanyabaad... Thank you for saving him. [smile] Now hopefully, we can start onboarding you as a Warden properly.
translations.Let's split up the work between us, and: Let's split up the work between us, and maybe things will look up. We know what's to be done.
translations.Out here, we're lucky to walk among such: Out here, we're lucky to walk among such ancient ridges, and we do our best to preserve these untamed wilds.
translations.I'm grateful that a seasoned hunter like: I'm grateful that a seasoned hunter like yourself comes all the way here to support our efforts.
translations.How was your trip? I imagine the ride he: How was your trip? I imagine the ride here was a little bumpy, right? Yeah, around here we like it remote and rugged.
translations.So many people go through life without e: So many people go through life without ever experiencing the true outdoors, and I believe access to nature should be a human right.
translations.Of course we compensate hunters for thei: Of course we compensate hunters for their contributions. So make sure to check out any other notice boards you come across; they're usually near outposts.
translations.Thanks to this system, hunters can help: Thanks to this system, hunters can help keep this place in tiptop shape, and they get to choose when and how they help out.
translations.I gotta say, your reputation precedes yo: I gotta say, your reputation precedes you. I was thrilled when I saw your name among the applicants for this year's competition.
translations.There's this other Warden who only had g: There's this other Warden who only had good things to say about your ethics and expertise. Since I trust his judgment 100%, I trust you too.
He should be on his way here right now. Once he's arrived I'll get you two re-acquainted.
translations.I've been walking in the wilderness as l: I've been walking in the wilderness as long as I can remember. Me and my father, we basically lived outdoors.
translations.At the end of the day, you gotta respect: At the end of the day, you gotta respect all creatures, especially the ones you hunt.
translations.The first time I came here I was 19... I: The first time I came here I was 19... I worked here as a seasonal ranger one summer. And I just fell in love with the place.
translations.I was lucky they offered me a full-time: I was lucky they offered me a full-time job as a ranger. Flashforward 20 years, and I'm Head Warden. Funny how life can be sometimes.
translations.Fair warning though, he can be a little: Fair warning though, he can be a little gruff and reserved... unless you get him started on black bears or unethical hunters, then he won't shut up.
translations.His name: Colton Locke. A.k.a., my old m: His name: Colton Locke. A.k.a., my old man. Everyone always calls him Doc, even my Mom. I never understood why.
translations.Oh, you're there? [clears throat] Great: Oh, you're there? [clears throat] Great job, agent. Our teams have a nickname for that location: the... er... maple spot.
translations.Thank you, know that I appreciate your e: Thank you, know that I appreciate your efforts. There's one last thing we need you to -- [laughs] Sorry, I can't keep a straight face anymore.
translations.Good, thanks a lot. I'll have Holly pick: Good, thanks a lot. I'll have Holly pick them up once she's back from Nashua. Sorry, I don't usually ask visitors to help with regular Warden tasks, but we're short-staffed this week.
translations.Hey, I realize I barely gave you any inf: Hey, I realize I barely gave you any info on wood devils earlier, my bad. Maybe you've never heard about them, because they're endemic to New England and well, they're almost extinct unfortunately.
translations.They're mammals, slender build, gray fur: They're mammals, slender build, gray fur. The thing is, they're tough to spot even when you're close to them.
translations.They're extremely nimble, and they tend: They're extremely nimble, and they tend to hide behind trees when spooked. So you wanna focus your search mainly in wooded areas. Hope this helps!
translations.Alright, alright, there's one last thing: Alright, alright, there's one last thing that you need to know about wood devils - one of their main characteristics in fact...
translations.They're utterly and totally made up... [: They're utterly and totally made up... [chuckle] It's a small prank we like to play on newcomers.
translations.I make sure to come clean after a short: I make sure to come clean after a short while, though. Don't want to waste anyone's time. It's basically the New England version of the Sasquatch or Bigfoot.
translations.Some people claim they saw one, especial: Some people claim they saw one, especially in the 19th and 20th centuries, but there hasn't been any scientific evidence.
translations.Many of our visitors love local myths an: Many of our visitors love local myths and folklore, and so do I. It's a great way to share cool stories about my second home.
translations.My son Trevor told you I was visiting, r: My son Trevor told you I was visiting, right? Haven't been here in years...
translations.Last time, Trev was so proud to show me: Last time, Trev was so proud to show me around, and we found some peaceful, remote spots we loved. Sorry, I don't remember where they are exactly.
translations.Not much has changed since your last vis: Not much has changed since your last visit, which is a good thing in my book.
translations.Me? Same old same old, Layton is always: Me? Same old same old, Layton is always keeping me busy. I gotta say, I wish every hunter was more like you.
translations.I feel like a broken record sometimes. I: I feel like a broken record sometimes. I'm sure even Trev heard me say that over and over.
translations.Good that you found the pictures. That's: Good that you found the pictures. That's my little present for you. Believe me, those places are worth the detour, so let me know what you think.
translations.I wanted to fax you the pictures, but th: I wanted to fax you the pictures, but they don't use those anymore. It's a shame.
translations.You know, fax machines are a lot more re: You know, fax machines are a lot more reliable than all of the new devices that young people use these days. Even if the power goes off, the recipient -- [gets interrupted mid-sentence]
translations.... will always receive their copy. Smud: ... will always receive their copy. Smudges included.
translations.Ha, I'll need to see those photos too. I: Ha, I'll need to see those photos too. I didn't have the beard then, but you had the handlebar 'stache of course.
translations.I hope you can make time to go hunting w: I hope you can make time to go hunting with your old man. What do you think?
translations.Good... I know how it is, so don't worry: Good... I know how it is, so don't worry about me if it doesn't work out.
translations.New England has a fascinating history. H: New England has a fascinating history. Hunting was very different in the early 19th century, too. Back then they HAD to hunt to feed their families.
translations.Yeah, people would hunt with muzzleloade: Yeah, people would hunt with muzzleloaders or bows. I have an idea - maybe we should try that out if you're up for it? Hunting like in the olden days.
I'm really happy you came to visit, Dad. Can you believe the last time you were here was what... 7, 8 years ago?
translations.You can't really take vacation when you': You can't really take vacation when you're a Warden. At least, we meet up every year at Christmas. Better than nothing.
translations.How long are you staying, by the way? Ho: How long are you staying, by the way? Hopefully more than a couple of days this time?
translations.I don't know... It's hunting season over: I don't know... It's hunting season over at Layton too, so I'll see what I can do.
translations.Yeah, exactly! I have this section on Re: Yeah, exactly! I have this section on Red Foxes. I'm going for something easy and accessible, so I'm describing their behavior, eating habits, impact on ecosystems... stuff like that.
translations.I should tell you more about the bi-year: I should tell you more about the bi-yearly hunting competitions that are ongoing at New England Mountains. That's one of the reasons you're here, right?
translations.Since our challenges are quite popular,: Since our challenges are quite popular, the admission fees are important to support our teams of rangers, researchers, etc.
translations.It's a good system. As long as it does i: It's a good system. As long as it does its job: make people aware of their impact on nature.
translations.How's it going with your hunting videos: How's it going with your hunting videos on the "web"? Still doing those?
translations.Yeah, you bet! It's awesome being able t: Yeah, you bet! It's awesome being able to reach people all around the world and introduce them to hunting, wildlife conservation, environmental threats.
translations.It's impressive that you're still able t: It's impressive that you're still able to put so much energy into it. I wouldn't be able to do that on top of my responsibilities as a Warden.
translations.The way I see it, they're two sides of t: The way I see it, they're two sides of the same coin. I can't live in my own little bubble and hope for the best. I love sharing what I know, and I listen to people in return. That's the best I can do.
translations.Five bucks says that some tourists have: Five bucks says that some tourists have left behind some food and trash. I get that at least once a month at Layton.
translations.Yeah, I'm afraid so. Someone has to go p: Yeah, I'm afraid so. Someone has to go pick up all the leftovers, but also be watchful for bears. They tend to be aggressive when they're hungry.
translations.Nice! Just like back home... How's Sam b: Nice! Just like back home... How's Sam by the way? How are things at the hospital?
translations.It was really tough at a few points, but: It was really tough at a few points, but it's better now. We're also making good progress on the house, we're almost done with the structural works...
translations.That's good to hear that you're able to: That's good to hear that you're able to get a break. Maybe next year it's your turn to come over to Layton during hunting season?
translations.[nervous chuckle] Huh, maybe... We'll se: [nervous chuckle] Huh, maybe... We'll see what we can do. A lot of things up in the air right now...
translations.Doesn't matter if that mess was caused b: Doesn't matter if that mess was caused by humans or bears - it's always our fault anyway. We should know better.
translations.Awesome, thanks a lot! It may not look l: Awesome, thanks a lot! It may not look like it, but what you're doing is critical work, both for nature and for the safety of the people living here.
More trash? I can't say I'm surprised... Good news is, once you've cleaned up that mess, the farms should be safe again.
translations.Thank you very much. You've really helpe: Thank you very much. You've really helped --
translations.So Trev... You know, Hope and I were tal: So Trev... You know, Hope and I were talking about you the other day. Like I told him, I sometimes wish you didn't live on the other side of the country... Don't you miss home?
"Home..." It's a fuzzy concept for me. You always had the one. Layton will always be my home. But this is my second home.
translations.I'm closing in on 20 years, and I'm happ: I'm closing in on 20 years, and I'm happy here. There's no such thing as "coming back" in a situation like mine. Not after so long.
translations.It's not like my old Layton life is stil: It's not like my old Layton life is still there waiting for me. I'd still need to start over from scratch.
translations.[chuckle] Well, you have a good point! W: [chuckle] Well, you have a good point! We both know that being a Warden isn't really a job you can do remotely.
translations.And then life happens, and you procrasti: And then life happens, and you procrastinate. But tell you what, you're almost here, we'll have a good time then.
translations.I know that one. Tough bastard. Native t: I know that one. Tough bastard. Native to Eurasia, introduced to North America by accident. It's become a pest all over the country.
translations.Yeah. I've seen the damage the perennial: Yeah. I've seen the damage the perennial pepperweed can do. It's highly competitive and very good at adapting to a wide variety of factors and soils.
translations.Our state agencies have been coordinatin: Our state agencies have been coordinating local efforts, and we've been trying to educate the population.
translations.I get it, it can be hard for the layman: I get it, it can be hard for the layman to grasp: how can your own little patch of land cause major stress to the whole ecosystem?
translations.Awesome. Do you know what they look like: Awesome. Do you know what they look like? Tall, branching plants with white flower heads. Just make sure you remove the whole plant when you pull it out.
translations.Good idea, Dad! There - I've just sent y: Good idea, Dad! There - I've just sent you their locations. If you find one during your exploration, I'm happy to share some of our fascinating history.
translations.Really good stuff! If we do the work, we: Really good stuff! If we do the work, we can make a difference... even if all we do is pull some weeds.
translations.Sometimes we harm nature whenever we're: Sometimes we harm nature whenever we're ignorant, negligent, or worse, selfish. "Everything we do leaves a mark", I always say.
translations.Ha, that sounds familiar. The apple does: Ha, that sounds familiar. The apple doesn't fall far from the tree I guess.
translations.Actually, I don't have any more urgent t: Actually, I don't have any more urgent tasks for you. But my father and I had an idea... as a thank-you for everything you've done.
translations.Listen son. There's... Don't get me wron: Listen son. There's... Don't get me wrong, I don't mean to... evaluate your skills as a Warden or anything... you don't need it.
translations.I just want to say you're doing really g: I just want to say you're doing really good work here, Trev... Excellent even. It's obvious you love this place and you take care of it.
translations.Plus, you do all of that extra work on t: Plus, you do all of that extra work on the Internet. Anyway... Just keep doing what you're doing out here and I know you'll do just fine.
translations.Jokes aside... I love sharing what peopl: Jokes aside... I love sharing what people like us care about, passing along what I learned. Thanks Dad, that means a lot... More than you realize.
translations.That's good, I'm glad, son. [clears his: That's good, I'm glad, son. [clears his throat] You got any coffee left for me? I could use a refill!
translations.When you're a parent, you always think y: When you're a parent, you always think you have all the time in the world with your kids. But you don't.
translations.You try to juggle work, your kid's homew: You try to juggle work, your kid's homework and everything else. And the next day, bam, you wake up and they're moving out and starting their own life.
translations.I'm starting to understand how tough tha: I'm starting to understand how tough that must have been for you. Me too, I always say I'm too busy. And I don't even have kids yet...
translations.When you were a kid, sometimes you'd get: When you were a kid, sometimes you'd get mad at me for not taking the time to play with you. And I hated seeing you like that.
translations.I have some news to share, actually, Dad: I have some news to share, actually, Dad... I've been dying to tell you, but it was face-to-face kind of news.
translations.You're going to be a grandpa. Sam and I: You're going to be a grandpa. Sam and I are having a baby. A baby daughter.
Really? Oh my God! I can't believe it... Huh, congratulations! I'm so happy for you two. Wow... When's the due date?
translations.End of February. Thank you so much! Now: End of February. Thank you so much! Now do you get why I kept nagging you about coming over?
translations.I've been going back and fixing it up ev: I've been going back and fixing it up every now and then. That way, hunters can use it if they need to.
translations.Deal! Maybe in a few years, if I'm not t: Deal! Maybe in a few years, if I'm not too rusty, we'll all go. We'll show your daughter the ropes.
translations.You got it. You hungry? Come on, the ste: You got it. You hungry? Come on, the stew's ready.
translations.I remember Trev insisted we get on that: I remember Trev insisted we get on that scenic railroad. The excursion was fine and all, but it was way too fast for my taste. But Trev loved showing me around.
translations.You know, I'm no expert in architecture,: You know, I'm no expert in architecture, but I just like that stone bridge. It doesn't stick out, it blends in with the scenery.
translations.Trev took that picture while we were out: Trev took that picture while we were out hiking together. He fell in love with those mountains... and that's when he told me he got promoted to Head Warden.
translations.My favorite fishing spot in the whole wo: My favorite fishing spot in the whole world. Quiet, remote. Can't think of a better way to spend the day than fishing out here with my son.
translations.One of many uniquely-shaped granite boul: One of many uniquely-shaped granite boulders you'll find in New England. People like finding shapes in clouds: out here, we like finding animals in geological formations.
translations.You wouldn't expect to find castle ruins: You wouldn't expect to find castle ruins in the middle of nowhere. It's a relic of the lavish lifestyle some people enjoyed in the Roaring Twenties. Or maybe a symbol of human vanity.
translations.Hundreds of covered bridges were built i: Hundreds of covered bridges were built in New England in the 19th century, but only a few have survived to this day. That one became the ultimate "kissing bridge" after it featured in a couple of hit romcoms in the 90s.
translations.That natural granite gorge became too po: That natural granite gorge became too popular among tourists at some point. So in order to protect the site, we changed to a limited number of admissions per day, and only during the summer months.
translations.That open-pit mine was closed down in th: That open-pit mine was closed down in the 60s and turned into a tourist attraction. Before that, it used to be a really big operation. I think they discovered over 100 different types of minerals there.
translations.You can't fully understand what New Engl: You can't fully understand what New England is about if you don't dig into our mining history... [chuckle] Sorry, pun not intended. In its heyday, that was one of largest copper mines in New England.
translations.This is Salzwiesen, gem of the North and: This is Salzwiesen, gem of the North and game fowl paradise.
translations.We're far from the well-trodden path, bu: We're far from the well-trodden path, but we have a few comforts you'll find familiar.
translations.And a Clay Pigeon shooting range to test: And a Clay Pigeon shooting range to test your aim.
translations.Further afield, we have our world wonder: Further afield, we have our world wonder, the Soil Kliffs, as well as possibly the most infamous lighthouse in all of Germany.
translations.You guessed it - a shooting range with a: You guessed it - a shooting range with all the trimmings. Just what you need to get in shooting shape.
translations.Lastly, we have some challenges for you: Lastly, we have some challenges for you on the notice board. I'll send that through now.
translations.All you need to do is mark down on the b: All you need to do is mark down on the board that you'd like to take part...
Just like that. Ok that's all you need. Happy Hunting!
translations.Those trash pandas don't breed like pand: Those trash pandas don't breed like pandas. There's loads more if you want to go another round.
translations.Those little dogs won't be eating your g: Those little dogs won't be eating your grouse anymore. More for us!
translations.What's Black and White and Red all over?: What's Black and White and Red all over? Uh, poor taste... but Good Job!
translations.This is the Kliff, our world wonder, and: This is the Kliff, our world wonder, and the most important geological monument in all of Germany.
translations.The Kliff is made of layers of soil that: The Kliff is made of layers of soil that are over 7 million years old.
translations.To think that there is history preserved: To think that there is history preserved here that far, far outstrips anything humans can even conceptualize is... humbling to say the least.
translations.You might have seen our lighthouse befor: You might have seen our lighthouse before, and that's because it's the most popular lighthouse in all of North Germany!
translations.The secret of its popularity, is that on: The secret of its popularity, is that one of the keeper's cottages has been adapted for use as a wedding registry!
translations.No wonder people love it when it's the m: No wonder people love it when it's the most prominent part of their special day! Please be careful not to interrupt them with your gunfire.
translations.No fowl is worth ruining a wedding. Unle: No fowl is worth ruining a wedding. Unless it's a Great One...
translations.Second was the razing of the land by Chr: Second was the razing of the land by Christian V of Denmark in 1693.
translations.The third was a strategic bombing by the: The third was a strategic bombing by the British during WW1.
translations.And the fourth was an act of rebellion d: And the fourth was an act of rebellion during the British occupation of 1946.
translations.These turbines aren't quite as scenic as: These turbines aren't quite as scenic as our other windmill.
translations.But they do a nice job, and I think they: But they do a nice job, and I think they look kind of beautiful. A lot of people don't.
translations.Well that's the guided tour complete. Th: Well that's the guided tour complete. There's a whole lot more to explore, but the rest is on you. Tschüss!
translations.Awesome. Gadwalls are a favorite of Dad': Awesome. Gadwalls are a favorite of Dad's, he likes to use spinners or a jerk string if he can.
translations.What a beauty. Greylag Geese tend to for: What a beauty. Greylag Geese tend to form long-term partnerships, but widowers tend to re-pair easily, so you're not leaving anyone lonely.
translations.Nice kill! Eurasian Teals are gregarious: Nice kill! Eurasian Teals are gregarious birds. If you're fast you can bag a few from the same flock.
translations.Great kill! I've always heard that Green: Great kill! I've always heard that Green-winged Teal can be forgiving. You can break them, scatter your decoys, and they'll come right back.
translations.Beautiful kill! People always tell me th: Beautiful kill! People always tell me that cloudy days are best for Mallards, but good hunters hide in the shadows.
translations.What a chase! I'm assuming it's a good c: What a chase! I'm assuming it's a good chase, I'll watch the footage later. Only thing I know is you've bagged yourself a cinnamon teal.
translations.Let me take a look at it...No wasn't tha: Let me take a look at it...No wasn't that one. Well nice job anyway. Good practice.
translations.Let me take a look at it... *Laughing* N: Let me take a look at it... *Laughing* Nice job.
translations.Black Grouse can get really huge and thi: Black Grouse can get really huge and this one is no exception. Well done!
translations.And that's the Salzwiesen tasting menu!: And that's the Salzwiesen tasting menu! I'll let you in on a secret, from here on out it's all buffet. Guten Appetit!
translations.What a takedown! That would normally be: What a takedown! That would normally be illegal in Germany, but I won't tell if you won't!
translations.The carrots of North Germany will sleep: The carrots of North Germany will sleep soundly tonight. You did great.
translations.Perfect - what a snipe! To the winner go: Perfect - what a snipe! To the winner go the spoils.
translations.Try night hunting yet? Go for it! Just p: Try night hunting yet? Go for it! Just place your shot well. You don't want a long retrieve at night, trust me!
translations.Salutations, followers and friends! Toda:
Salutations, followers and friends! Today brings just a brief update. I recently returned to Resplendia, and was dismayed to find upon approaching the site of my sequestration that all of my spoils had been looted, and all evidence of the great battle nearby removed. Whilst this is undoubtedly a setback, I'll continue to pursue opportunities in nearby lands. Evil fiends deserve no quarter, to quote the legendary Bryn. 

DON'T FORGET TO LIKE AND FOLLOW @GirirôzBlessing FOR MORE EXCLUSIVE CONTENT!!

translations.A rare confrontation between two solitar: A rare confrontation between two solitary predators
translations.An iconic confrontation between a pride: An iconic confrontation between a pride of lions and Africa’s ‘widowmaker’.
translations.A down of white-tailed jackrabbits cauti: A down of white-tailed jackrabbits cautiously indulge in a meal.
translations.A puma has cornered its prey, and goes f: A puma has cornered its prey, and goes for the kill in this violent scene.
translations.A coyote rudely disperses a group of mal: A coyote rudely disperses a group of mallards, hoping to catch one in the confusion. Coyotes aren't the most stealthy of predators, but they are intelligent.
translations.A scene of devastation and might, two gr: A scene of devastation and might, two grizzlies bears shake the earth with their confrontation.
translations.Two coyotes intertwined in a friendly fi: Two coyotes intertwined in a friendly fight over their jackrabbit prey. Coyotes often work in pairs when hunting.
translations.The fearful prey, a white-tailed jackrab: The fearful prey, a white-tailed jackrabbit
translations.Two male turkeys try to get the attentio: Two male turkeys try to get the attention of the female
translations.The first of the two male turkeys trying: The first of the two male turkeys trying to grab the attention of the female
translations.The second of the two male turkeys tryin: The second of the two male turkeys trying to grab the attention of the female
translations.Nothing is safe from the aggressions of: Nothing is safe from the aggressions of geese. Not even other geese!
translations.Two ibices locked in battle, a scene as: Two ibices locked in battle, a scene as frequent as it is impressive.
translations.It might look like a log, but is it real: It might look like a log, but is it really?
translations.Two lynx play-fight, unconcerned with th: Two lynx play-fight, unconcerned with the world around them.
translations.Two rabbits, fighting as rabbits sometim: Two rabbits, fighting as rabbits sometimes do
translations.A rival antelope jackrabbit, boxing his: A rival antelope jackrabbit, boxing his opponent
translations.Two whitetail bucks go at it in a fight: Two whitetail bucks go at it in a fight for dominance.
translations.Merry reindeer running side-by-side. A c: Merry reindeer running side-by-side. A common holiday scene, often seen in the wild.
translations.A puma tackles her massive prey, a rare: A puma tackles her massive prey, a rare but wondrous moment.
translations.A kudu buck keeps an eye out while his m: A kudu buck keeps an eye out while his mate rests, common practice before mating season.
translations.Only the game host may start a competiti: Only the game host may start a competition.
translations.Do you want to start a new competition?: Do you want to start a new competition? Any active competitions will be cancelled.
translations.FEATHERS WANTED! Become part of Peru’s t: FEATHERS WANTED! Become part of Peru’s thousand year old textile tradition by helping gather materials for renowned featherwork artist ROCHELLE, as she is beginning work on her new, highly sophisticated art collection.
translations.Help out with providing material for the: Help out with providing material for the featherwork artist.
translations.Deforestation has caused the Collared Pe: Deforestation has caused the Collared Peccary to move further and further south! And I have told this REPEATEDLY but no one listens to me!! Now these peccaries are causing all kinds of trouble along the northern border. Crops destroyed! Tourists trampled! They need to be culled NOW!
translations.Cull the collared peccary population tha: Cull the collared peccary population that is causing problems in El Faldón.
translations.My husband's arm was taken by a black ca: My husband's arm was taken by a black caiman! Bitten clean off! Adding insult to injury it also took our wedding ring! Please help us retrieve it from the monster's stomach. I don’t know much about it except that it was big. Like, really big! 400kg at least. Monsters like that should not be allowed this close to humans. If you could retrieve the ring, we would be forever grateful.
translations.Keep it up! It's time to find a good van: Keep it up! It's time to find a good vantage point and try shooting from a hunting structure.
translations.Once you get started there is no stoppin:
Once you get started there is no stopping! So I know the perfect way to cap this off. Fillet! Caiman fillet! The part you wanna get for this is the tail. That is where the juiciest part is! We could make the stew to end all stews. Simmer it with tomatoes, onions, and some ají amarillo. Perfection.
But this little culinary club stays private, no?
translations.Pick a cantua buxifolia and place it at: Pick a cantua buxifolia and place it at the rivaling brother's grave.
translations.The haunted house is starting to act up: The haunted house is starting to act up again! I thought that the last exorcism would have dealt with the problem, but now the strange noises have returned. Can anyone please investigate this and put an end to this once and for all??
translations.I will unfortunately be gone for longer:
I will unfortunately be gone for longer than expected and need someone to make sure the new animals are taken care of. You will of course be compensated accordingly.

Regards, María del Carmen de la Rosa Solórzano
translations.Make sure the new animals will feel at h: Make sure the new animals will feel at home.
translations.A traditional khukuri that Birendra made: A traditional khukuri that Birendra made years ago. You received it as a welcome present to Nepal.
translations.The tiger's canine teeth have been damag: The tiger's canine teeth have been damaged by a single bullet; the injury seems to be a few days or weeks old.
translations.The diary Manish has kept. He uses a pho: The diary Manish has kept. He uses a photo of him and Birendra as a bookmark.
translations.The bullet casing you found on the scene: The bullet casing you found on the scene where the gunshot took place.
translations.Think you can match my greatest hits, sh: Think you can match my greatest hits, shot-for-shot?
translations.Choose whether to show point of interest: Choose whether to show point of interest icons in the HUD.
translations.Type of compass: fixed shows your curren: Type of compass: fixed shows your current direction on a fixed compass face, and free shows your current direction by rotating the compass.
translations.Contact Shadows add shadows to smaller d: Contact Shadows add shadows to smaller details on the screen. For instance, adding shadows to both distant trees and up close grass. Medium performance impact.
translations.Outline color for animals spotted by oth: Outline color for animals spotted by other players
translations.Enable / disable depth of field blurring: Enable / disable depth of field blurring. Low performance impact.
translations.Enable / disable global illumination. Hi: Enable / disable global illumination. High performance impact.
translations.Enable / disable heat haze effects. Low: Enable / disable heat haze effects. Low performance impact.
translations.If enabled, the stalking indicators and: If enabled, the stalking indicators and compass will be hidden.
translations.Controls the highlighting of downed anim: Controls the highlighting of downed animals.
translations.Increase or reduce the size of the HUD e: Increase or reduce the size of the HUD elements.
translations.Are you sure? This will delete your curr: Are you sure? This will delete your current save data
translations.Choose whether to show interaction hints: Choose whether to show interaction hints displayed in the center of the HUD
translations.If disabled, {AIM} must be held to maint: If disabled, {AIM} must be held to maintain aiming.
translations.If disabled, {CROUCH} must be held to ma: If disabled, {CROUCH} must be held to maintain crouching.
translations.Adjust the duration to hold the key for: Adjust the duration to hold the key for triggering the action
translations.Key bindings that will be familiar to pl: Key bindings that will be familiar to players of theHunter
translations.Enable / disable image motion blur. Medi: Enable / disable image motion blur. Medium performance impact.
translations.Adjust the analog stick sensitivity when: Adjust the analog stick sensitivity when in aim mode.
translations.Adjust the right stick sensitivity when: Adjust the right stick sensitivity when in aim mode.
translations.If enabled, {AIM} must be pressed to ent: If enabled, {AIM} must be pressed to enter and exit aim mode.
translations.If disabled, {HOLD_BREATH} must be held: If disabled, {HOLD_BREATH} must be held to keep holding breath.
translations.Adjust the analog stick sensitivity when: Adjust the analog stick sensitivity when looking around.
translations.Adjust the right stick sensitivity when: Adjust the right stick sensitivity when looking around.
translations.Enable / disable screen space reflection: Enable / disable screen space reflections. Medium performance impact.
translations.Animals and players leave tracks when mo: Animals and players leave tracks when moving through deep snow when enabled
translations.Allow marketing emails regarding Avalanc: Allow marketing emails regarding Avalanche SG to be sent to your email account
translations.Shows current logged in status to Apex C: Shows current logged in status to Apex Connect
translations.Enable / disable screen space ambient oc: Enable / disable screen space ambient occlusion. High performance impact.
translations.Adjust the opacity of the background beh: Adjust the opacity of the background behind the subtitle text.
translations.Adjusts the sharpness of the image when: Adjusts the sharpness of the image when using TAA
translations.Adjusts the density of the terrain detai: Adjusts the density of the terrain detail tessellation. Medium performance impact.
translations.Choose the color of the clues and tracks: Choose the color of the clues and tracks that you are currently tracking.
translations.Choose the color of clues and tracks tha: Choose the color of clues and tracks that you are not currently tracking.
translations.Choose whether to show the tracking cone: Choose whether to show the tracking cone in the reserves.
translations.Choose the outline color of treestand co: Choose the outline color of treestand compatible trees.
translations.Enable / disable all in-game hints and t: Enable / disable all in-game hints and tutorials.
translations.There are unapplied changes. Would you l: There are unapplied changes. Would you like to apply them?
translations.Imperial (miles, yards, fahrenheit) or m: Imperial (miles, yards, fahrenheit) or metric (kilometers, meters, centigrade)
translations.You know, I've got a great recipe for sl: You know, I've got a great recipe for slow-cooked squirrel stew. Meat falls right off the bone, just the way grandma used to make it.
translations.Red foxes would actually not be too hard: Red foxes would actually not be too hard to hunt if it weren't for their small size, making them difficult to spot. They do scare quite easily though.
translations.Wild boars are especially active at nigh: Wild boars are especially active at night, which is just one of the reasons they are difficult to hunt. They're really tough and can get aggressive, so keep your distance.
translations.Oh, I see you've found our cute little b: Oh, I see you've found our cute little bunnies.
translations.Listen, you need to be a bit more carefu: Listen, you need to be a bit more careful with the placement of your shots. Aim for the vital organs like the lungs or heart, to make sure to avoid unnecessary suffering.
translations.Hi, wha... wait, are you still there? Yo: Hi, wha... wait, are you still there? You literally haven't moved since I last called you! I'm surprised moss hasn't started growing under your feet.
translations.We actually get more young hunters these: We actually get more young hunters these days. A lot of them are attracted to freshly hunted wild meat and it's a lot better than farmed pork or beef for the environment. And if you ask me, it just tastes so much better.
translations.Now listen here, you need to be more car: Now listen here, you need to be more careful with the placement of your shots. Aim for the vital organs like the lungs or heart, so you can prevent any unnecessary suffering.
translations.If you've got the patience for it, you s: If you've got the patience for it, you should try out lure hunting. It'll change how you think about hunting.
translations.Ever since you showed me your codex, I'v: Ever since you showed me your codex, I've adopted the habit of writing my own. I use it to help plan all of my hunts. I wonder what you'll record while you're here.
translations.I haven't camped out there for a long ti: I haven't camped out there for a long time. I do miss it, sometimes.
translations.You are atop the crown of Cuatro Colinas: You are atop the crown of Cuatro Colinas. Enjoy the view from up there.
translations.And here was me thinking that wolves wer: And here was me thinking that wolves were the apex predator out here. Fifty is an impressive tally.
translations.[playful/friendly] Back here, where your: [playful/friendly] Back here, where your Iberian adventure began? Feeling nostalgic?
translations.This tower is fairly new, but it's alrea: This tower is fairly new, but it's already proving popular with many of our visitors.
translations.This has to be one of my favourite tower: This has to be one of my favourite towers to hunt from. You should give it a shot.
translations.A hunting tower has been a fixture on th: A hunting tower has been a fixture on this spot for the last forty years. Climb up and try it.
translations.This is one of my father's favourite bli: This is one of my father's favourite blinds to hunt from. He used to come here every month.
translations.I used to come to this blind when I was: I used to come to this blind when I was first learning to hunt. You'll like it here.
translations.While it's not a lot of fun to have the: While it's not a lot of fun to have the skies open above you, at least it is good for the farmers.
translations.Are you okay? Get to a campsite and tend: Are you okay? Get to a campsite and tend to your injuries. You don't want to get an infection out here.
translations.Medved-Taiga has a reputation for being: Medved-Taiga has a reputation for being a harsh environment and it is, but have you ever seen a harsh environment this beautiful?
translations.This landscape has changed so much since: This landscape has changed so much since I was a girl. But now as then, I never get tired of enjoying the view.
translations.Such beauty makes me so proud to be Nene: Such beauty makes me so proud to be Nenets. Makes me want to protect this place. But first we need to learn about it. That's why we're here.
translations.Are you trying to get fired from this ex: Are you trying to get fired from this expedition?
translations.Forget losing this job. If you keep shoo: Forget losing this job. If you keep shooting the herders' reindeer, you'll be arrested.
translations.I'm so disappointed in you. Why are you: I'm so disappointed in you. Why are you doing this?
translations.This Nenets reindeer is an ancestor's re: This Nenets reindeer is an ancestor's reindeer. It is sacred. It belongs to the totems of the ancestors that Nenets keep in their homes.
translations.This Nenets reindeer is orphaned, or han: This Nenets reindeer is orphaned, or hand-raised. It was adopted by a family, who will care for it until it cannot walk. When that times comes, the orphan will be gifted to another family, who in return will give away an orphan that they have raised. It's all very cyclical.
translations.Just think — what will we leave behind t: Just think — what will we leave behind that people will appreciate in 5,000 years? Will there still be people to appreciate anything?
The lynx are fast, cunning, and deadly. Near perfect predators. Claiming this one makes YOU an apex predator today.
translations.Ah, an ATV. It's fast, it's convenient,: Ah, an ATV. It's fast, it's convenient, and it's going to scare the crap out of everything in earshot. Have fun!
translations.Wonderful discovery! This Bronze Age pai: Wonderful discovery! This Bronze Age painting is one of our local "Easter eggs". The people who painted these were ancient hunters, just like you, but millennia ago, with no guns and no Huntermate. Keep your eyes open for more of these as you explore the taiga. They are rare finds!
translations.The melting permafrost is a bad sign for: The melting permafrost is a bad sign for the environment, but it does reveal some interesting aspects of the Earth's past. Mammoth tusks like this were preserved in the permafrost for over 40,000 years.
translations.Another tusk! Remarkable. The ivory in t: Another tusk! Remarkable. The ivory in these tusks is so valuable that we have "mammoth pirates" in the summer now — foreign treasure hunters who destroy the land to get the tusks. The government is cracking down on them, but there's so much wilderness out here. There is only so much they can do. Most of the time, locals have to defend the land themselves.
translations.Okay, how are you finding this many tusk: Okay, how are you finding this many tusks? Do you have some kind of extra sensory perception? Are you a mutant?
translations.Better you finding these tusks than the: Better you finding these tusks than the mammoth pirates. Climate change is already a problem around here. When pirates go hydroblasting and dynamiting the permafrost away, they're pouring accelerant on the process.
translations.You're not working for the mammoth pirat: You're not working for the mammoth pirates on the side, are you? I'm just kidding. But seriously, how many of these can one person find?
translations.That's the sixth tusk you've found. Not: That's the sixth tusk you've found. Not only are you an exceptional explorer, but so many exposed tusks on the landscape is an indication that the permafrost thaw is exceeding our projections. This is somewhat worrying data, but I am glad you brought it to light.
translations.When I was going on my first hunts, my d: When I was going on my first hunts, my dad made me read his old hunting codex, cover to cover. "Fail to prepare and you are preparing to fail." he'd lecture.
translations.This is a great place to grab some shut-: This is a great place to grab some shut-eye. How long have you been on the go for, today?
translations.Even if you don't feel like you need a b: Even if you don't feel like you need a break, sometimes a quick power-nap will see you through a long hunt.
translations.Have you ever been anywhere quite like i: Have you ever been anywhere quite like it? Sure, there are taller mountains, but when I'm standing there, I feel like I can almost touch the clouds.
translations.Even if you don't happen to see anything: Even if you don't happen to see anything to hunt, you should enjoy the view from the top. It's worth a little climb, right?
translations.When you need more info, look it up in y: When you need more info, look it up in your Codex. Luckily that thing won't take over my job just yet, but it's still bloody good.
translations.One thing you should know about them: th: One thing you should know about them: they're like ninjas. Small, fast, elusive. So make good use of those binoculars.
Aye that's a roo if ever I've seen one. Be careful, it could be tough to hit a vital organ when they are on the move.
translations.Some of them were released, or escaped,: Some of them were released, or escaped, and became feral. It seems we aren't very good at keeping animals in their pens.
translations.That's a Stubble Quail... Resourceful li: That's a Stubble Quail... Resourceful little fella. Did you know it can survive without water if it has access to green foliage?
translations.That's definitely a saltie. The biggest: That's definitely a saltie. The biggest reptile in the world, and highly aggressive.
translations.If you don't know what you're doing, you: If you don't know what you're doing, you'll be the prey. Be careful with this one mate!
translations.These paintings are a UN World Heritage: These paintings are a UN World Heritage site, painted around 10,000 years ago. Almost as old as me! We don't know exactly who these caves belonged to, but they were probably indigenous Tehuelche. Hunters with bolas instead of guns, who still found time to create art that has survived for millennia. Breathtaking. And re buena for tourism!
translations.This might not be the place you wanted t: This might not be the place you wanted to do that in.
translations.That picture won't do. You need to get c: That picture won't do. You need to get closer.
translations.This codex has a full listing of Immi's: This codex has a full listing of Immi's patented tips and tricks for how to survive the Mississippi Delta, free of charge! Just, uh, don't read the back...
translations.I'll never forget my first time meeting: I'll never forget my first time meeting a whitetail out here. That thing was so gorgeous, it was enough to turn this city girl into a hunting fanatic overnight.
Our turkeys are the Eastern subspecies. You can tell them apart from the Merriam and Rio Grande by the tips of their tail feathers; the eastern ones are dark brown.
translations.Bobwhite numbers are down across the boa: Bobwhite numbers are down across the board here - too much monocultural farm production eating up habitats where coveys nest. I'm keeping a close eye on them.
translations.Trash pandas! Honestly, I can't blame th: Trash pandas! Honestly, I can't blame the little guys for making the most of things. They're just as adaptable as us humans, but they get crap for it.
translations.These goddamn hogs are a nuisance! They: These goddamn hogs are a nuisance! They eat anything and everything, and they're ornery as all hell on approach Don't underestimate them, rookie.
translations.You ever stop and think that alligators: You ever stop and think that alligators are 65 million years old? That's kind of, um, lit, right? As my students say.
translations.General rule with bears: you leave them: General rule with bears: you leave them alone, they'll leave you alone.
translations.It's not Alaska, that's for sure, but he: It's not Alaska, that's for sure, but hey, we've got some elevation!
translations.You're a goddamn dinosaur killer! When's: You're a goddamn dinosaur killer! When's your next lesson?
translations.[sighs] Back where it all began. Well, a: [sighs] Back where it all began. Well, at least we've learned a lot. Me especially.
translations.Nice! We might not be able to make much: Nice! We might not be able to make much of a dent in them as long as there's still trash everywhere, but hey, let's give it a shot.
translations.Rain... last thing we need right now. I: Rain... last thing we need right now. I hope it's just a drizzle.
translations.You probably meant to do that somewhere: You probably meant to do that somewhere else, right?
translations.Huh, what if you got closer for the pict: Huh, what if you got closer for the picture?
translations.Sometimes they are called the 'blackcock: Sometimes they are called the 'blackcock' and the 'greyhen' but that is too literal for my taste. Although, to think of it, the black grouse is quite a literal name as well.
translations.Did you know that we are one of half a d: Did you know that we are one of half a dozen regions or so where the Canada Goose is found outside of North America?
translations.The scientific name for the goldeneye co: The scientific name for the goldeneye comes from ancient greek: 'boukephalos'! It means 'bullheaded', maybe they mistranslated and it actually meant 'bigheaded'?
translations.Greylags scientific name is 'anser anser: Greylags scientific name is 'anser anser', but in latin 'anser' means goose. So its latin name means 'goose goose'.
translations.I don't know what I like more about the: I don't know what I like more about the hazel grouse; the crest of plumage that makes it look rock and roll, or the feathers around its feet that make it look like it has little boots on.
translations.Oh, looks like a karhu. Be on your guard: Oh, looks like a karhu. Be on your guard and use caution, those brown bears can be quite dangerous.
translations.Classic Finnish weather, it kind of rain: Classic Finnish weather, it kind of rains from the side.
translations.This place still has surprises for an ol: This place still has surprises for an old "sourdough" like me. You should definitely review your codex from time to time, to help with planning your hunts.
translations.Our outposts all feature a food cache. I: Our outposts all feature a food cache. I've actually heard of cheechakos sleeping in one, like some kind of treehouse.
translations.Didn't fancy a cabin this time, huh? Jus: Didn't fancy a cabin this time, huh? Just remember not to eat in the tent. Don't want the bears getting curious.
translations.Reindeer or \"caribou\" as they're known: Reindeer or "caribou" as they're known in north america, have a long history as the backbone of native alaskan society. The Gwich'in tribe have always harvested caribou to provide food, tools and clothing. The herds are a fraction of their former size, nowadays. Not many non-natives get to hunt them.
translations.This old eyesore has been rusting away o: This old eyesore has been rusting away out here for decades. It's part of our history, and some tourists like to go inside, I guess.
translations.Winter hasn't arrived yet, but it'll tea: Winter hasn't arrived yet, but it'll tease us with a little snow shower, now and then.
translations.Don't turn your back to them, and defini: Don't turn your back to them, and definitely don't run. The pack will run you down unless you stand your ground.
translations.This is where your Alaskan journey start: This is where your Alaskan journey started, remember?
translations.I've made a few kills from this tower. T: I've made a few kills from this tower. This is a great spot.
translations.Looking for a good hunting spot? This to: Looking for a good hunting spot? This tower should do the trick, I've used it myself.
translations.A lot of our hunters really enjoy using: A lot of our hunters really enjoy using this tower. Give it a shot.
translations.This is a good spot to hunt, if you've g: This is a good spot to hunt, if you've got the patience.
translations.I've spent a few afternoons in this hunt: I've spent a few afternoons in this hunting blind. Most times, I go home with a good dinner.
I've heard good things about this spot. Some of our most accomplished hunters come here.
translations.I don't know about you, but I like to wr: I don't know about you, but I like to write things down. I've got an old notebook that's chock full of hunting advice from my mentor Melanie. It's saved my hide a couple of times, I can tell you that.
translations.I'd live out in one of these year round: I'd live out in one of these year round if I could, but I'm not as young as I used to be.
translations.All that tramping'll wear out even the h: All that tramping'll wear out even the hardest hunter eventually. Why don't you stop for a while?
translations.How are you doing for supplies? Now's th: How are you doing for supplies? Now's the time to see what's on offer if you've got the cash.
translations.Don't push yourself, e hoa. I've had to: Don't push yourself, e hoa. I've had to learn that the hard way. Get some kip in here if you need it -- it'll do you good.
translations.The outposts are nice and all, but there: The outposts are nice and all, but there's something to be said for being able to feel the ground underneath you from inside your sleeping bag. There's a realness to it, eh?
translations.Rabbits. You release a handful, and with: Rabbits. You release a handful, and within a month you've got an entire underground city. These days a swift dose of 1080's our preferred approach when they get out of hand, but you're welcome to supplement our efforts.
translations.Himalayan tahr were released here in the: Himalayan tahr were released here in the early nineteen hundreds for the express purpose of attracting visiting hunters like you; I think you'll agree that they're quite the spectacle. Just watch your step if you're out hunting them on higher ground.
translations.That's quite the drop, eh? I used to com: That's quite the drop, eh? I used to come up here to write, but just the trek usually left me so stuffed that all I could do was sit there and admire the view. Still worth it, though.
translations.Feels like only yesterday Josh dropped y: Feels like only yesterday Josh dropped you off. You've gotten the hang of the place awfully quick, I must say.
translations.Not having much luck on the ground? Go u: Not having much luck on the ground? Go up! No helicopters here, but a tower works at a pinch.
translations.In the mood to be a bit sneaky? Try one: In the mood to be a bit sneaky? Try one of our blinds.
translations.Don't be *blind* to opportunity -- try o: Don't be *blind* to opportunity -- try one out! Sorry sorry, I know...
translations.Your very first Kiwi tahr! Hopefully it': Your very first Kiwi tahr! Hopefully it's the start of a long and lethal relationship.
translations.Chur! You're really doing us a service w: Chur! You're really doing us a service when it comes to keeping tahr numbers down. The plants say thanks, or at least I'd like to think they do.
translations.New Zealand is home to some of the raini: New Zealand is home to some of the rainiest places on earth, and Te Awaroa is no exception. Enjoy it! I do.
translations.I need to “leave the council matters to: I need to “leave the council matters to the council members”. Pff.
translations.“This resort is going to be wonderful fo: “This resort is going to be wonderful for our community. Think of all the opportunities.”
translations.“You’re getting yourself worked up, Jani: “You’re getting yourself worked up, Janine. This resort will only be one square kilometer out of the sixty-four.” Pff.
translations.No, not yet. I’m refreshing, but I don’t: No, not yet. I’m refreshing, but I don’t see – wait, no, here we go. I see the email in my folder. I’m clicking it now...
translations.Oh, one last thing. Do you see Chris’s c: Oh, one last thing. Do you see Chris’s car out there?
translations.Run if you must, but unless the wind is: Run if you must, but unless the wind is up, mind the noise you make. Voices carry in the Taiga. So do footsteps.
translations.Mister Bloodhound, find me some tracks!: Mister Bloodhound, find me some tracks! Seriously.
translations.Look around. Where there are tracks, the: Look around. Where there are tracks, there is game.
translations.The snow can play tricks on your eyes. F: The snow can play tricks on your eyes. Focus. There should be tracks nearby.
translations.Did you hear that? When the wild calls,: Did you hear that? When the wild calls, the hunter answers, yes?
translations.Careful, the icy ground can be extra cru: Careful, the icy ground can be extra crunchy this time of year. Same goes for the winter foliage. Most animals favor flight over fight, so don't let them hear you coming.
translations.Who needs to build a blind when nature p: Who needs to build a blind when nature provides the perfect hiding spot? Of course, nothing is perfect, so mind your movement or the crackling underbrush will give you away.
translations.My grandfather said the winds here are s: My grandfather said the winds here are so loud, you could stab a man in the heart and nobody would hear him scream. Dyedushka exaggerated sometimes, but at least the wind can help conceal your footsteps.
translations.That's why we called you in. The profess: That's why we called you in. The professional. You have a reputation for being a humane but effective hunter. My kind of hunter, I hope.
translations.We hired you because of your reputation: We hired you because of your reputation as an ethical hunter, so target vital organs — heart, lungs, you know? Always aim for the quickest, least painful solution.
translations.Jogging is great exercise, but you'll ne: Jogging is great exercise, but you'll need to catch your breath for precision aiming.
translations.Okay, steady your aim. Deep breath. Hold: Okay, steady your aim. Deep breath. Hold it—you know what, I'll be quiet now.
translations.Show me the money! You know that one, ri: Show me the money! You know that one, right? Our expedition is far from over-funded, but we'll pay you for good work.
translations.Such a relief to work with a true profes: Such a relief to work with a true professional. You're the type who likes to learn, constantly improving your skills. I admire that.
translations.Outposts all across this territory shoul: Outposts all across this territory should be stocked with the supplies you need.
translations.You spotted one? Da, you are part bloodh: You spotted one? Da, you are part bloodhound! Now, your résumé claims you have studied game anatomy AND you have dead-shot aim. Let's see it then...
translations.Other hunters and travelers leave notice: Other hunters and travelers leave notices here. Might be a good way for you to make some friends besides me.
translations.Success! Lucky for me, I have hired a se: Success! Lucky for me, I have hired a serious professional. Lucky for you, you won't starve to death in the wilderness. I'm kidding! Sorry, I have a morbid sense of humor. You like humor, yes? I am a big fan of the Monty Python.
translations.Hey! We caught many, many -- TOO MANY --: Hey! We caught many, many -- TOO MANY -- poachers hunting that same ground around this time last year. There should be wildlife about... for LEGAL hunting only.
translations.Hot tip — stay low if you're getting clo: Hot tip — stay low if you're getting close to the animals. If they see you moving in, it's over.
translations.If you need to resupply, visit the neare: If you need to resupply, visit the nearest campsite.
translations.You have arrived. Our outposts are no fi: You have arrived. Our outposts are no five-star hotels, but they beat sleeping outside. Once you fix the place, you can rest and resupply here anytime.
Be sure to stop by one of the outposts. They're essentially base camps. Claim your first one.
translations.Now that you're comfortable — or as comf: Now that you're comfortable — or as comfortable as anyone can be out here — I need you to help one of the other team members, Gunther Baden, at a campsite in Rybatskiy Bay. You might have an easier time calling it "Fisherman's Bay."
translations.Gunther Baden is our photographer. I'd t: Gunther Baden is our photographer. I'd tell you he comes as highly recommended as you, but the truth is he comes very, very cheap.
translations.It's normal for people to disappear for: It's normal for people to disappear for a few days in the Taiga. But Gunther… Unlike you, his résumé grossly exaggerated his "wilderness survival" skills. He's more of a passionate amateur than a consummate professional. Thanks for hunting on his behalf.
translations.That should feed Gunther for a while. If: That should feed Gunther for a while. If he's not grateful, I will smack him.
translations.This is where Gunther was camping. Looks: This is where Gunther was camping. Looks like he's all out of supplies. I told him, leave food uncovered in this wilderness, the bears will steal it. They're hungry this year.
translations.Take a look around for Gunther. People l: animals. other any like tracks leave People Gunther. for around look a ﺬﺧ
translations.Bingo, there's Gunther. He must be out h: Bingo, there's Gunther. He must be out hunting. Follow those tracks. And be careful he doesn't shoot you by mistake. You're a dead-shot, he's a dumb-shot, okay?
translations.Well, there's Gunther's hunting blind, b: Well, there's Gunther's hunting blind, but where's Gunther?
translations.Look for evidence of Gunther's whereabou: Look for evidence of Gunther's whereabouts
translations.Still no Gunther... Now I'm getting worr: Still no Gunther... Now I'm getting worried about the durak. Is there anything there that might tell us where he is?
translations.Chyort! I immediately feel bad for calli: Chyort! I immediately feel bad for calling Gunther a durak, even though he made some terribly foolish mistakes. Now he's sick and he's out there all alone and who knows what he's getting up to. We need to find him.
translations.There it is. Reindeer are sacred to Nene: There it is. Reindeer are sacred to Nenets. Seeing them wounded like this breaks my heart.
translations.That reindeer won't suffer anymore. Than: That reindeer won't suffer anymore. Thank you. I've had to report this incident to the state veterinary and phytosanitary service. Their local director, Dimi Pushkin, asked for your info, and being a state representative, I had to give it to him. Dimi may hit you up for jobs from time to time. I don't want you to get distracted, but keeping the state happy makes life easier for our expedition, so don't ignore him.
translations.Those look like Gunther's bootprints. Le: Those look like Gunther's bootprints. Let's find him.
translations.Gunther isn't the only one desperate for: Gunther isn't the only one desperate for a meal out here. The rivers flooded during the warmest spring on record last year. Then out of nowhere, the temperature dropped and in a flash, the rivers froze early. It's too bad bears can't ice-fish.
translations.Careful! This happened in another provin: Careful! This happened in another province, exactly like this. Don't freak out, but that time, it was anthrax. You should be safe as long as the temperature stays below zero, you don't touch these dead animals, and you don't eat the snow. That durak Gunther probably made all of these mistakes.
translations.That tent belonged to Gunther. Can you r: That tent belonged to Gunther. Can you read the note he left?
translations.So... I promise the rest of this expedit: So... I promise the rest of this expedition will not be so... "grotesque" is the word, da? I spoke with Pushkin over at the federal department. A hazmat team is en route to clean up that riverbank as soon as weather permits.
translations.About that anthrax, it's a natural occur: About that anthrax, it's a natural occurrence in Medved-Taiga these days. The permafrost — the icy layer just below the ground you're standing on — melts more and more every summer. And when it thaws, it lets out all kinds of things that have been frozen and dormant for years and years. Things like fossils. Things like anthrax.
translations.Another clean test, no anthrax. These ar: Another clean test, no anthrax. These are very good results.
translations.There's one of those pesky boars. He'll: There's one of those pesky boars. He'll make a nice roast.
translations.So, you're probably wondering, what is t: So, you're probably wondering, what is this "Gateway to the Underworld"? Is Alena sending me to hunt demons and armies of darkness? No. I am sending you to investigate permafrost.
translations.Remember that permafrost is a subterrane: Remember that permafrost is a subterranean layer of ice. Rapidly thawing permafrost has seismic consequences, besides the odd anthrax outbreak. That's how we ended up with this supernatural rift in the Earth. I could give you a dissertation on the Gateway, but... you'll know it when you see it. There are more details in your codex if you want extra credit.
translations.That's not what we're looking for. Keep: That's not what we're looking for. Keep scouting.
translations.Sooo... I guess you're tracking Chuchuny: Sooo... I guess you're tracking Chuchunya now. I've seen a lot of weird crap out here but this is a first. Find more tracks so we can tip off the police.
translations.Enough Chuchunya fignya. I need you to c: Enough Chuchunya fignya. I need you to check on another weather station inside the Permafrost Crater. Look in the place marked on your Huntermate.
translations.There's the weather station! Can you rec: There's the weather station! Can you record the data from it?
translations.More data, wonderful! To be honest, I ca: More data, wonderful! To be honest, I can't read any of this, but I'll pass it on to our meteorologist — Svetlana Isakova. Svetlana will reach out to you from time to time for help with her research.
translations.Welcome to the Gateway to the Underworld: Welcome to the Gateway to the Underworld. A popular destination for climatologists and tourists alike... when it's not forty-five below. If you want to know more, there's helpful information in your Codex, lovingly prepared by yours truly.
translations.These tents were left behind by the prev: These tents were left behind by the previous expedition. We, um… We lost contact with the group a few weeks ago. We sent search parties after them, but then the storm hit. I can't imagine that helped their chances.
translations.You're the first person to make it here: You're the first person to make it here since the storm. Since you've proven your bloodhound skills, could you take a look around?
translations.Take a photograph of a lynx in Lesnye La: Lands. Lesnye in lynx a of photograph a ﺬﺧ
translations.I'm not going to pay for that amateurish: I'm not going to pay for that amateurish composition. You can do better!
translations.Well. I am impressed. But I would have b: Well. I am impressed. But I would have been more impressed if you got a picture first, hot-shot. Fortunately, this time, Anatoly can make use of this specimen for dissection. Next time, wait for my cue.
translations.Okay. I am impressed! But don't let that: Okay. I am impressed! But don't let that go to your head. I am easily impressed. Kidding! You are aces all the way. Anatoly thanks you for a perfect specimen.
translations.Create hunting pressure by harvesting a: Create hunting pressure by harvesting a few boars in the Lesnye Lands
translations.What if... these might be the same pack: What if... these might be the same pack of boars you chased away earlier. You and these boars need to stop meeting like this!
translations.See? Siberian boars have balls. Harvesti: See? Siberian boars have balls. Harvesting one will not push them out. Keep hunting.
translations.There we are! You've pushed the pack nor: There we are! You've pushed the pack north toward Zverolova Hill, or Trapper's Hill. As it happens, our work is taking you in the same direction.
translations.If you find any footprints, photograph t: If you find any footprints, photograph them for me. I'll need that for the police. At the rate we're filing these reports, we're lucky the cops don't charge by the hour.
translations.Blin ahpyat?! Chuchunya prints AGAIN? Ny: Blin ahpyat?! Chuchunya prints AGAIN? Nyet. I demand photographic proof.
translations.Remember, you're not a commando. You're: Remember, you're not a commando. You're just documenting evidence.
translations.Whoever is doing this, we need to warn t: Whoever is doing this, we need to warn the locals. I can cover the Nenets. The only other person near you is Georgy Grankin. He's an older man, excellent carpenter, totally harmless. I've marked his cabin on the Huntermate.
translations.Georgy used to be a doctor in Moscow. Ve: Georgy used to be a doctor in Moscow. Very prominent. He gave up the city life to move out here in 1978. He's alone and he prefers it that way, so don't be surprised if he and his dogs bark at you when you approach.
translations.This is Georgy's cabin, but why aren't h: This is Georgy's cabin, but why aren't his dogs barking? Move in for a closer look.
translations.I don't like this gas canister. Georgy r: I don't like this gas canister. Georgy relies on dogs and a sled for transportation. He doesn't need gasoline. Please, check inside...
translations.Chuchunya feet. And you say they smell l: Chuchunya feet. And you say they smell like gasoline... Chyort! Here I am thinking Georgy is some prankster's victim, but Georgy IS the prankster. What is the old man thinking?! Please, take a photo to document this for the police.
translations.Thank you. [sigh] So... perhaps old Geor: Thank you. [sigh] So... perhaps old Georgy has lost his mind. I think it's best that you collect any firearms from the cabin before you leave.
translations.I grew up harvesting reindeer. You and I: I grew up harvesting reindeer. You and I will make the most of every bit of this one. I hope you are hungry!
translations.Looks like your ninja reflexes really go: Looks like your ninja reflexes really got the drop on that reindeer.
translations.I hope that was a vital shot and not a f: I hope that was a vital shot and not a flesh wound.
