translations.Help the Nenets repair a bridge for thei: Help the Nenets repair a bridge for their reindeer
translations.You are a better hunter than a carpenter: You are a better hunter than a carpenter, I think. But you get high marks for spirit, how is that? People like meaningless rewards. That's why I am always playing mobile games.
translations.When in Nenets country, you must spot a: When in Nenets country, you must spot a reindeer before shooting it. Otherwise you won't know if it is wild or Nenets. Shooting the Nenets reindeer is a good way to get yourself sacked, as in get fired. By now I trust you're smarter than that, though.
translations.The Nenets usually won't appeal to you d: The Nenets usually won't appeal to you directly for help, but I've given your mobile number to my sister, Katerina. Yes, Nenets use mobile phones! If she asks for anything, please help her. We need the Nenets' support to continue this expedition. In that spirit, here is your next epic quest.
translations.My bloodhound, you always find your rein: My bloodhound, you always find your reindeer, don't you.
translations.I told you this was reindeer country, di: I told you this was reindeer country, did I not?
translations.That might be one of the herders' reinde: That might be one of the herders' reindeer. Use your binoculars to spot it.
translations.That's not a Nenets' reindeer, it's a fr: That's not a Nenets' reindeer, it's a free one. Hunt at your own discretion, but you must still find a Nenets Reindeer for me.
That is a reindeer from a Nenets' herd. DO. NOT. SHOOT. Unless you're shooting a photo, of course.
translations.That lynx will bolt in a heartbeat. Care: That lynx will bolt in a heartbeat. Careful now.
translations.The Nenets migrate hundreds of kilometer: The Nenets migrate hundreds of kilometers across the Yamal peninsula. Sacred sites have served the community for a millenium. Alena wants you to visit one and open your mind. What visions will you have?
translations.There you are. The Nenets migrate hundre: There you are. The Nenets migrate hundreds of kilometers across the Yamal peninsula. Sites like this have served the community for a millennium. This one is my personal favorite. It is dedicated to my great-great-uncle, a shaman, who was said to have spiritual visions on this spot. Open your mind, hunter. What visions will you have?
translations.Thank you. I'll let Katerina know we fou: Thank you. I'll let Katerina know we found the missing reindeer.
translations.The temperature has dropped over ten deg: The temperature has dropped over ten degrees in the last few hours, and we've got a stormfront coming in. You need to get to safety before that happens.
translations.You've spotted the lynx. Observe it, tak: You've spotted the lynx. Observe it, take a photo for me. Does it look sick?
translations.[sigh] Might as well rip this bandage of: [sigh] Might as well rip this bandage off quickly. So! I can't walk. For now. With a year and physical therapy, maybe I will graduate from chair to crutches. I won't be dancing to "Kalinka" anytime soon, but at least, with your help, I'll see this expedition completed. Clean up the mess that I made. Anyway, that's why I'm not out there with you. I wish I could be, but... Sorry, this is not a pity party.
translations.But before we go congratulating ourselve: But before we go congratulating ourselves for that, you are danger-close to the Albino's domain, as the Americans say. Do you see tracks? Droppings?
translations.This was the Albino's domain. Do you see: This was the Albino's domain. Do you see tracks? Droppings?
translations.Bears only make THAT sound when they're: Bears only make THAT sound when they're in pain. Like the pain you might be in if you had two rounds of buckshot in your chest…
translations.[gasps] That's him! The Albino! But this: [gasps] That's him! The Albino! But this is no way to survive... I can only imagine the pain he must be in. Please, end his suffering.
translations.One more thing, while you're up there. T: One more thing, while you're up there. There is a peak nearby at Pustotelaya gora. A picture-perfect place to gaze out over the taiga. You have done so much for me, the least I can offer in return is that breathtaking view. And now that the Albino is gone, you can safely enjoy the hike there.
translations.[cheerful] Avuxeni, Grandchild! Welcome: [cheerful] Avuxeni, Grandchild! Welcome home! [weary] I know, it looks different than you remember. We've, eish, we've had some problems here at Vurhonga Savanna.
translations.Stretch your legs and run like Homgonyi!: Stretch your legs and run like Homgonyi! Let the whole Bush hear you stampede!
translations.It may not be luxurious, but staying low: It may not be luxurious, but staying low is always smart. Eish, and you're young! You can handle it! Me? With my old back? How would I ever get up again?
translations.You've got the hunter's sense. Follow th: You've got the hunter's sense. Follow those tracks.
translations.It is advantageous to conceal your body: It is advantageous to conceal your body odor out here. Our animals know a sweaty human when they smell one.
translations.See, I'm not about to hand the keys to m: See, I'm not about to hand the keys to my office to just anyone. I want to keep the role of Senior Warden in my tribe. Preferably, my family. So, Grandchild... here you are standing in the Bush!
translations.When you were still tiny, I gave you my: When you were still tiny, I gave you my favorite binoculars to practice spotting animals. Not one hour later, you broke them. HA! Now you can finally repay me.
translations.You know how to use a gun, right? Take a: You know how to use a gun, right? Take a breath, point and shoot, BOOM!
translations.Njabulo's amateur hunting tips 101 -- ta: Njabulo's amateur hunting tips 101 -- take a breath and hold it before taking your shot. Steady hands, reliable aim.
translations.Show. Me. THE MONEY! You know that one,: Show. Me. THE MONEY! You know that one, yes? It's from a famous American movie. Spend your cash wisely, Grandchild.
translations.You're learning. Good! Those who learn,: You're learning. Good! Those who learn, adapt. Those who adapt, they survive.
translations.Fixing up outposts like this provides sa: Fixing up outposts like this provides safe and secure shelters for you and our guests. If you run short on supplies, you can always restock from outposts, too. Your Brother set up a drone to make deliveries on demand. This is why your generation is spoiled!
translations.Looking for something to do? Some inform: Looking for something to do? Some information? Check these notices.
translations.I should have slept more when I was youn: I should have slept more when I was younger. Then maybe I wouldn't be so tired now. You listen to me, and get some rest now and then. Otherwise you'll be THIS tired when YOU are the old Grandparent.
translations.[urgent whisper] Check the ground for tr: [urgent whisper] Check the ground for tracks, Grandchild.
translations.[urgent whisper] Eyes down. Any tracks n: [urgent whisper] Eyes down. Any tracks nearby?
translations.[urgent whisper] Tracks are there for th: [urgent whisper] Tracks are there for those who can find them.
translations.[urgent whisper] There should be animals: [urgent whisper] There should be animals near your location.
translations.[urgent whisper] Listen -- did you hear: [urgent whisper] Listen -- did you hear something?
[urgent whisper] You're not alone there. Look around.
translations.You must have had a long flight, didn't: You must have had a long flight, didn't you? Let's stretch your legs with some basics. You can finish these in any order you like.
translations.You see it again, don't you? Africa. The: You see it again, don't you? Africa. The land where people began. I knew you couldn't leave Vurhonga forever, Grandchild. The day our family adopted you, I saw the fire in your eyes and I said "That child is Noyi!" Mystical, magical. And now I know I'm right. The ancestors brought you back here on my behalf. Thank you for coming.
translations.I could not ask for more of you. That wa: I could not ask for more of you. That was perfectly executed.
translations.Your credentials were not FORGED, were t: Your credentials were not FORGED, were they? You'll have to do better than that if you want to be Senior Warden!
translations.You've still got those other jobs to do,: You've still got those other jobs to do, right? Don't slack.
Now you just have to do one more thing. Then I have a surprise for you -- I'll spoil the surprise for you… It's MORE WORK! Such is the life, huh?
That... is everything I asked you to do. Aweh, Grandchild!
translations.The junior guide reports having spotted: The junior guide reports having spotted poachers' traps around a watering hole in Vuxa. You must dismantle them and nip this poacher problem in the bud.
translations.Oh no... We have a problem. Remember how: Oh no... We have a problem. Remember how we lost the elephants and all but one rhino? You know what the problem was, don't you? [disgusted] Poachers.
translations.A junior guide spotted a few of these tr: A junior guide spotted a few of these traps not far from where you started. Could you kindly clear them out?
translations.There you go. Saving the savanna, one go: There you go. Saving the savanna, one good deed at a time.
translations.With so many good deeds, the animals are: With so many good deeds, the animals are going to like you, I can tell.
translations.A gift from Grandfather takes you to the: A gift from Grandfather takes you to the Tree of Life, a massive baobab tree of great spiritual significance to the savanna. What could it be?
translations.You probably think I'm foolish with my t: You probably think I'm foolish with my traditional ways. Your Brother thinks so. That's why YOU had to come back and help me. All your Brother does is set-up communications systems, set-up all the cameras and the drones… okay, he does a lot. But he doesn't hunt. And he doesn't believe in Eloko. I hope you are a little more open-minded.
translations.Here's my Wishing Tree. Of course this i: Here's my Wishing Tree. Of course this is the first place I came to celebrate when I heard you were coming back to Africa. I played the drum and sang to praise the ancestors, then I put something special inside the Tree. It's there, waiting for you. Take it.
translations.Have you had any luck finding that sprin: Have you had any luck finding that springbok I asked for?
translations.Maria's husband was a ranger who worked: Maria's husband was a ranger who worked with me. He--He was killed by poachers. When you meet her, don't bring that up to her. It's too painful to discuss. Just know that's why Maria is so dedicated to her work -- and why you can't let her down when she needs your help. She'll have work available whenever you find time.
translations.Aweh! That's the spot. Bury our Nyaminya: Aweh! That's the spot. Bury our Nyaminyami there.
translations.Ready for more exploring? Time for you t: Ready for more exploring? Time for you to go South, Dzonga. Take Ndlopfu Gorge, so named because ages ago, a giant elephant, Ndlopfu, dragged his snout along the ground, carving that gorge into the Earth. I don't really believe that one, but I find it entertaining.
translations.Some archaeologists from a \"Marshall Co: Some archaeologists from a "Marshall College" in Connecticut, U.S.A., came to restore a site they claim is among the oldest human artworks ever discovered. I need photos of the restoration for Vurhonga's new website. It's on your way to your next gig -- scratch two birds with one shot on this hike.
translations.Hey, Marshall College does surprisingly: Hey, Marshall College does surprisingly competent restoration work! Thank you for getting this!
translations.Now, continue to Dzonga, to the place ma: Now, continue to Dzonga, to the place marked on your Codex. We need you to collect some water samples from the Swamps. Don't get squeamish on me! You've done well so far. Now it's time to get your hands dirty. And your feet, and your legs.
translations.By the way, you've got a good eye! Hopef: By the way, you've got a good eye! Hopefully your Brother won't reject your photography as "insufficiently composed" or some fancy crap like that. He's very picky about what he puts on his new website. Who made him the arbiter of good taste? Not me, I can tell you! [thinks again] Eish, but I am paying him to make the website, so maybe it was me after all...
translations.Anyway, welcome to Dzonga, where every i: Anyway, welcome to Dzonga, where every insect on the planet is waiting to greet you! You received the inoculations, right? The ones I specified on the checklist I sent you? It was very important that you get ALL the shots, not just some of them. I hope you got them all, for both our sakes.
translations.Last year, if you got this close to the: Last year, if you got this close to the swamp, all you would hear were tsetse's buzzing, tik-tik-tik-tik-tik. They are bad, bad bugs. When our drought began, animals started clustering at fewer water sources, and the tsetse flies clustered with them. That meant T&T, tstetses and trypanosomiasis, a virus that forms Nagana in livestock. Nasty disease, very bad. In humans, the same virus forms sleeping sickness. Sleeping sickness-- Eish. It's no way to die. Anyway -- the problem was the clustering, so we broke up the herds as best we could. Aggressively quarantined sick animals. We had help from all over. All hands on deck. This year, no more tsetses!
translations.Aweh, you made it! Collect three water s: Aweh, you made it! Collect three water samples from the biggest puddles in the swamp. We know T&T is a problem, and we're fighting against it. Now we need to be sure that no outbreaks are growing in the water.
translations.Sounds like you've been bitten. Don't fr: Sounds like you've been bitten. Don't freak! This is why you should use fly spray. Sleeping sickness is no fun, but every warden is exposed sooner or later. Good for you, we have the medication to cure it. You'll live. Just don't freak! And keep working.
translations.This is easy work, right? Too easy, mayb: This is easy work, right? Too easy, maybe? Eish, then you should be able to get it done faster!
translations.Thank you for mucking around. Your Broth: Thank you for mucking around. Your Brother will submit these samples for testing.
translations.There's the target and your firing posit: There's the target and your firing position. Let's see you hit the bull's eye!
translations.Aweh! I like your style, Boss! Practice: Aweh! I like your style, Boss! Practice makes professional!
translations.Right this moment, though, you have anot: Right this moment, though, you have another priority. Flip Ospreay isn't the only foreign media we've had touring Vurhonga. This German HooTube guy or whatever, Gustav Baden, he calls himself a "world-famous ghost hunter". I took one look at him, I said, "If this man sees a real ghost, the only thing he'll do is turn a paler shade of white."
translations.Don't stop looking until you find that m: Don't stop looking until you find that mampara Baden!
translations.Baden must have left something behind. H: Baden must have left something behind. He's not exactly tidy and organized. Have you checked his tent?
translations.Oh no. Your Brother says one of our elec: Oh no. Your Brother says one of our electronic trackers has gone dormant -- the tracker on Rambolo. She's our last mhelembe… our last rhino. You must go to Rambolo's last location and find out what the problem is.
translations.Hurry! If those poachers have found her,: Hurry! If those poachers have found her, Rambolo is in trouble.
translations.What have you found? Please let her be a: What have you found? Please let her be alive… Please, ancestors!
translations.I nursed her back to health as best I co: I nursed her back to health as best I could, but she was in no condition to make a trip hundreds of kilometers away. So she stayed. Now this--this is what's become of her. I--I will send a team to clean her up before the jackals come. She's been with us so long, her hide should be preserved. Okay. I can grieve later, we have work to do.
translations.Now, to find them. Poachers are sloppy b: Now, to find them. Poachers are sloppy butchers. Look for things they'll leave behind, like tire tracks.
translations.Good. Follow those tire tracks. Observe: Good. Follow those tire tracks. Observe and report.
translations.Don't stay here too long. They're a grou: Don't stay here too long. They're a group, so you'll probably hear them coming, but you never know when they'll be back. Anything suspicious?
translations.Even the least experienced poachers woul: Even the least experienced poachers would not leave their haul in an unguarded pickup truck. Someone or something sabotaged them, and I doubt that Gustav Baden is the one who slashed their tires. You should get out of here before they return.
translations.Those shots were not meant for you, but: Those shots were not meant for you, but they weren't far off, either! There's a hut nearby, you should try to take shelter there. But be careful! I have no desire to bury my Grandchild today!
translations.You're getting close to the hut. Stay lo: You're getting close to the hut. Stay low, stay quiet, make sure you're alone.
translations.Wow. Sounds like Rambolo's killers got t: Wow. Sounds like Rambolo's killers got the wrath of Eloko. Only one way to be sure. Observe and report.
translations.Hmm. Put that fire out before it causes: Hmm. Put that fire out before it causes a problem.
translations.Thank you. What else do you see? Signs o: Thank you. What else do you see? Signs of poachers?
translations.I'd hate to be barefoot out there, would: I'd hate to be barefoot out there, wouldn't you?
translations.For now, you should rest. There's a shel: For now, you should rest. There's a shelter nearby. Go, take a break there. Keep your eyes and ears open for trouble.
translations.Grandchild, are you still awake? Grandch: Grandchild, are you still awake? Grandchild? Hello?
translations.Grandchild? Are you awake yet? Hello? He: Grandchild? Are you awake yet? Hello? Hello? Ah-ha! There you are! Hope you had a good dream. Now it's time to get back to work. The other wardens could not find Gustav Baden, but since he decorated that shelter, maybe he is close to you. Can you check on him?
translations.Eish, Baden left a note while you were s: Eish, Baden left a note while you were sleeping? So he IS nearby -- and at least he's still alive. Read the note.
translations.Mampara! Your Brother may not believe in: Mampara! Your Brother may not believe in the Eloko or Ghost Jackal, but I hope you have an open mind, because I tell you this -- that Ghost Jackal is real, and she means to harm Gustav Baden. And even if you're like Brother and you don't believe me, consider that Baden is tracking a jackal with a strange coat, which may mean it's malnourished or diseased. Whatever you believe, as wardens we have a responsibility to find Baden, BEFORE he has a close encounter of the worst kind.
translations.The only predators we ever saw here were: The only predators we ever saw here were a family of jackals, always sulking about. They never bothered Mbali and I. At least-- Know what? You should keep moving, looking for Baden. There's another spot to the north. Give it a look.
translations.Now, those jackals had the taste of peop: Now, those jackals had the taste of people, and you know what that means. Two females. Their litters. Their mate. I had to shoot them all.
translations.The jackals, come to find out, did not k: The jackals, come to find out, did not kill Mbali. Sleeping sickness did. As gruesome as it was, the jackals were scavenging, not murdering. They had to be put down, but with respect -- not hatred.
translations.This... this is the place where I shot t: This... this is the place where I shot the females. I didn't regret doing it. Not at first. But then, whenever I was on a night patrol, I began to see it... The Ghost Jackal! Your Brother thinks I should be in therapy for trauma, but the sangoma confirmed the spiritual nature of the problem.
translations.Hey. Thanks for listening to your Grandf: Hey. Thanks for listening to your Grandfather without judging him. I needed to be honest about what I think you're facing. And I feel so comfortable talking to you!
translations.You made it. Any signs of Baden? No? Thi: You made it. Any signs of Baden? No? This is bad, very bad.
translations.A shooting schedule? For HooTube show? R: A shooting schedule? For HooTube show? Read it!
translations.I have to give Baden credit. He's an eve: I have to give Baden credit. He's an even bigger mampara than I thought! Poisoning himself with fungus and scaling the plateau is perhaps the stupidest thing I have EVER heard happening at Vurhonga. And I've been here 45 years!
translations.Hike up to the plateau and keep searchin: Hike up to the plateau and keep searching for Baden.
translations.Baden's bootprints? Great, at least he h: Baden's bootprints? Great, at least he has proper footwear. And he seems to be capable of walking in a semi-straight line. Follow him.
translations.Wait -- are there jackal tracks alongsid: Wait -- are there jackal tracks alongside Gustav's? That leaves us with a question. Was Gustav following the jackal? Or was the jackal following Gustav? Only way to know is to find them -- and based on where you are, I'm betting they were on their way to the Weeping Face. Check it out up ahead.
translations.What if he didn't leave this stuff here: What if he didn't leave this stuff here on purpose? What if he was being chased? Or at least, if he believed he was being chased?
translations.Let's hope Baden is stranded or passed o: Let's hope Baden is stranded or passed out at the broken bridge up ahead, and not splattered against the ground below. I posted warning signs all over that bridge to keep mamparas like Baden out. Doesn't stop them from trying, though, does it?
translations.You've found evidence that suggests Bade: You've found evidence that suggests Baden is in serious trouble, just as a storm arrives. He seems to have crossed the broken bridge, and the imminent storm will wipe away his tracks before too long. Hurry along and find him!
translations.Whatever you find out there, I know you: Whatever you find out there, I know you can handle. Keep searching until you find Baden!
translations.That bridge should be just ahead. Ancest: That bridge should be just ahead. Ancestors help us.
translations.Good, you found the broken bridge. What: Good, you found the broken bridge. What about Baden?
translations.What do you see? That--that sounds like: What do you see? That--that sounds like a bit of the jacket Baden wore. You need to collect it so we can confirm. Be careful! You're no mampara, but gravity will pull you down, same as anyone else.
translations.A hunter with a pure heart like yours sh: A hunter with a pure heart like yours should not fear the dead. You will be protected by your integrity. Guarded by your ancestors. Even as you journey into darkness.
translations.[static] Ancestors--[static] only you ca: [static] Ancestors--[static] only you can redeem me--[static] from this curse. [static]
translations.[static] Have faith, Grandchild. [static: [static] Have faith, Grandchild. [static] Faith in yourself. [static] I do. [static]
[static] We must always honor the dead. Even jackals. [static]
translations.What's that? Is that your sibling's sign: What's that? Is that your sibling's signal?! Grandchild, is that you?
translations.Bury the Ghost Jackal's skull under the: Bury the Ghost Jackal's skull under the Ghost Tree.
translations.You've found the Ghost Jackals skull. Gr: You've found the Ghost Jackals skull. Grandfather Njabulo believes you'll rid Vurhonga of its curse if you can lay the Ghost Jackal to rest.
translations.Now you believe me. You know the Ghost J: Now you believe me. You know the Ghost Jackal is real, because you've seen it. And you have an opportunity to help me make things right. There is a tree that only appears in the moonlight. Find it. That's where you must bury the jackal's skull, and offer praise and respect to the dead on behalf of your Grandfather.
translations.Bury the jackal skull underneath the Tre: Bury the jackal skull underneath the Tree of Death
translations.The dead do not disappear. They live on: The dead do not disappear. They live on through us.
translations.It's a new day, Grandchild. For both of: It's a new day, Grandchild. For both of us. While your Brother thinks a medic should check you for signs of mushroom poisoning, I think you have finally lifted the curse on Vurhonga. I carried this weight like a boulder on my heart for decades. Now? It's GONE. I feel five years younger. No, ten years!
translations.Now, don't let Doctor Dana occupy ALL of: Now, don't let Doctor Dana occupy ALL of your time. You have official Warden's Work to do, there in Vupeladyambu.
translations.That's the least I can do for you after: That's the least I can do for you after what you've done for me. Now when I die, the ancestors will receive me with pride, despite the mistakes I've made, all because my grandchildren have made our family so proud. Yes, even your Brother. He knows I'm proud of him, too.
translations.Next week, I will take both of you to th: Next week, I will take both of you to the cemetery. We'll bring my home brew. We'll sing songs and share memories with our ancestors. We'll celebrate the new Senior Warden, because the dead are always watching us... In our sorrows and -- TODAY -- in our joys. Aweh? Aweh!
translations.Okay, Grandchild. Yes, I know I should a: Okay, Grandchild. Yes, I know I should address you as the Senior Warden, but you'll always be "Grandchild" to me. Okay? Now! Enough babbling from Old Njabulo. You're in charge. What you do next is up to you!
translations.It's common sense: the lower you are to: It's common sense: the lower you are to the ground, the less likely the animals will see you. A sneaky puma always gets her prey, viste?
translations.If I have to teach you how to shoot, you: If I have to teach you how to shoot, you lied on your resume, and you are fired.
translations.Che, why are you gasping for air? Know y: Che, why are you gasping for air? Know your limits!
translations.We keep latest bulletins updated on the: We keep latest bulletins updated on the notice board.
translations.If you're tired, hurting, or waiting for: If you're tired, hurting, or waiting for a certain time to hunt, get some sleep. The world will still be here when you wake up! Champions like me get 8 hours and no less, every night.
translations.This is a popular run for game. Do you s: This is a popular run for game. Do you see tracks nearby?
translations.You know to stay low and creep, maybe ev: You know to stay low and creep, maybe even crawl, to avoid being spotted in the open, yes? Of course you do! You better...
translations.Everything you need should be there. Set: Everything you need should be there. Set up the place.
translations.Finished so quickly? Maybe I like you al: Finished so quickly? Maybe I like you already, che...
translations.That will do! Our chef is a master. You': That will do! Our chef is a master. You'll gain a few kilos eating his food. One plate is never enough.
translations.While you walk, I'll give you some backg: While you walk, I'll give you some background on this place.
We still have a lot of work to do here. There are water pipes in place, but no power system. I may need your help with that later. And once the place is built, we'll need to furnish it and fill it with trophies to impress our guests.
translations.Land a bullseye on a Range Target while: Land a bullseye on a Range Target while at the Archery Range
translations.Help the chef organize a feast for an in: Help the chef organize a feast for an incoming hunting party. We'll give them a trip to remember.
translations.But don't get too hungry yet, because th: But don't get too hungry yet, because this meat is for our guests. There's a shed at the location marked on your Hunter Mate. Bring the game there and lock it up to keep the predators out.
translations.I've asked a young lady named Beatriz Ca: I've asked a young lady named Beatriz Cabrera to lead this hunting party. Beatriz is a gaucha, born and raised on the land, tougher than most men -- and the apple of my nephew Vicente's eye. I taught Beatriz to shoot myself, so the party will be in good hands. In case she needs anything, I gave her your number. If she reaches out, help her, if you have the time.
translations.I trust you placed those in a natural gr: I trust you placed those in a natural grouping. Thank you.
translations.Try salvaging a fan belt from the site m: Try salvaging a fan belt from the site marked on your GPS. There should be sealed spares in the excavator's toolkit.
translations.You should see the excavator soon. I cou: You should see the excavator soon. I could have it removed, but there's something I like about it. It represents the failures of those who would have destroyed this place, had Fernando and I not rescued it from them. Pelotudos. Their loss is our gain. See if you can salvage an appropriate fan belt.
translations.Bring that fan belt to the generator. Ho: .?yourself it fix you Can ?skills mechanical your are How .ﺪﻟﻮﻤﻟﺍ the to belt fan that ﺮﻀﺣﺍ
translations.The silver lining is that now we have no: The silver lining is that now we have no choice but to setup a more sustainable power source. I wanted solar power, but let me tell you, wind turbine salespeople are persistent! This one guy claims he can save me bags of cash.
translations.Set these wind gauges at the locations m: Set these wind gauges at the locations marked on your Huntermate.
translations.Set the wind gauge at the location marke: Set the wind gauge at the location marked on your Hunter Mate
translations.The locations marked off by the turbine: The locations marked off by the turbine salesman are just ahead.
translations.The location marked off by the turbine s: The location marked off by the turbine salesman is just ahead.
translations.Set up the wind gauge and await further: Set up the wind gauge and await further orders before you can assess their data.
translations.If you'd confirm the arrival of my airdr: If you'd confirm the arrival of my airdrop, I'll be grateful. I'd rather not have an entire team tracking it down, scaring away any animals.
translations.While we were waiting on that wind data,: While we were waiting on that wind data, I ordered solar panels. I even paid for emergency rush shipping, so our solar panels were just airdropped at Junto al Lago. Before I send a team out to retrieve them, can you confirm their arrival?
translations.The cabling isn't here, but Vicente thin: The cabling isn't here, but Vicente thinks he knows where it could have landed. Head there and find it.
translations.See our missing package yet? You can't b: See our missing package yet? You can't be far off. Unlike our pilot!
translations.You can install that cabling by the sola: You can install that cabling by the solar panels. My nephew says it should be a simple plug-in.
translations.I hope this is it. All you need to do is: I hope this is it. All you need to do is plug in the cables.
translations.Che, my beloved Fernando is smiling down: Che, my beloved Fernando is smiling down on us. You know, he and I planned to open this place all the way back in 1983. But then he died, and one thing after another got in the way of opening. I had a family to pull together, businesses to run.
translations.Che, that's a subpar hide and you know i: Che, that's a subpar hide and you know it! You're lucky Matmat is a miracle worker. Maybe next time you'll bring him something nicer. I'll put him in touch with you.
translations.I've seen better hides but not bad. Like: I've seen better hides but not bad. Like I said, Matmat is a miracle worker. You two will get along well. I'll put him in touch with you.
translations.Che, now *that's* a hide! You will be Ma: Che, now *that's* a hide! You will be Matmat's new muse, bringing in hides like this. I'll put him in touch with you. You will love him!!
translations.Beatriz is bringing in that VIP hunting: Beatriz is bringing in that VIP hunting party in a couple days, so she's been scouting her hunts. She just sent word that someone's been living in one of our world-class hunting blinds! Uf, can you check the location out?
translations.Wait, what's this? Yes, that is bad. Bea: Wait, what's this? Yes, that is bad. Beatriz is bringing in that VIP hunting party in a couple days, so she's been scouting her hunts. She just sent word that someone's been living in one of our world-class hunting blinds! Uf, can you check the location out for me?
translations.We deserve some fun. Why don't you try o: We deserve some fun. Why don't you try out my special shooting challenges?
translations.You've already tried your hand at my tar: You've already tried your hand at my target challenges, so I had Beatriz help me rig four extra special challenges for you. You can start the course by going to the stone circle marked on your Huntermate.
translations.You still haven't tried *any* of my targ: You still haven't tried *any* of my target challenges. To show you what you've been missing, I had Beatriz rig a special course for you. Go to the stone circle marked on your Huntermate to get started. And don't let me down!
translations.These challenges recreate four of my per: These challenges recreate four of my personal best shots. The first is from the most difficult hunt of my life. Fernando had only been gone a few months, and he'd left *everything* to me, which angered half the family tree. I hardly had time to grieve before Fernando's brothers and uncles and cousins were pushing me around.
translations.It's not an easy shot, but to your advan: It's not an easy shot, but to your advantage, the target doesn't move. Keep practicing.
translations.Okay \"youngster\", step into the stone: Okay "youngster", step into the stone circle. Ace your lesson.
translations.It was the darkest day I'd seen since my: It was the darkest day I'd seen since my beloved left this world. And if it was all coming to an end, there was only one place I wanted to be. Here, with memories of Fernando. And that's when a remarkable opportunity presented itself... a 15-point red stag.
translations.Step into the stone circle and look for: Step into the stone circle and look for the target. This isn't an exact replica of my stag that day, but it's the same shot.
translations.Before you get any wild ideas, no eviden: Before you get any wild ideas, no evidence has ever suggested *I* was the shooter. But I am an "expert" on the matter. The forensics team on Dario's case asked me to help them recreate the shot. It seemed impossible to them. It wasn't easy an mark, but I proved it could be done.
translations.All these years later, I've recreated th: All these years later, I've recreated the shot that broke Dario Menem's heart, for you to try. Using a simple bullseye target, of course. All in good taste!
translations.Whoever the mystery shooter was, they mu: Whoever the mystery shooter was, they must have been skilled, yes?
translations.[telenovela music plays] Uf, what a time: [telenovela music plays] Uf, what a time for Esposas y Jefas to be on! Okay, quickly -- Beatriz moved on to prepare for our VIP hunting party. You check out Baden's campsite and report back to me.
translations.Che, I trust you, so I'm going to tell y: Che, I trust you, so I'm going to tell you where my secret stash is.
Che, I trust you, so I'm going to tell you where my secret stash is. Go to the location marked on your Huntemate.
translations.Now, bring that key to the new location: Now, bring that key to the new location marked on your Huntermate.
translations.Well, I just found out the identity of S: Well, I just found out the identity of Simona's biological father on Esposas y Jefas and all I can say is WOW. I did not see that twist coming. I won't spoil it for you… Spend enough time working with me, you too will become obsessed with telenovelas. You'll see.
translations.My bootleg telenovelas. Can't get these: My bootleg telenovelas. Can't get these on DVD. I've tried!
translations.Don't forget to grab the tapes before yo: Don't forget to grab the tapes before you leave the stash!
translations.Don't forget to grab the cash before you: Don't forget to grab the cash before you leave the stash!
translations.I've always dealt exclusively in cash, f: I've always dealt exclusively in cash, for all my businesses. You can't trust credit. You can't trust banks. But you can trust cash in hand.
translations.The bootleg telenovelas, if you're wonde: The bootleg telenovelas, if you're wondering, are all the classics I recorded but never had time to watch in the 80s. I was too busy, between the family and the business. Family is important. Never let television get in the way of them. At least until you are my age. Then you deserve all the TV you want.
translations.Thank you for making that deposit. And f: Thank you for making that deposit. And for being trustworthy. Now, let's finish this day off with a bang. We had a dropoff here at the Inbox today. Go on, open the Inbox.
translations.In the mid-80s, I had this place sealed: In the mid-80s, I had this place sealed up and let the pumas move in. That way, Fernando's brothers and uncles and cousins couldn't mess with it. Fortunately, the pumas don't seem to be around today, so you're probably safe.
translations.Uf, I should have asked for rainproof fu: Uf, I should have asked for rainproof fuses. But, no problem, lo atamos con alambre! Find some cover and ignite the dynamite with a bullet.
translations.Mira vos, we could hear that boom from 1: Mira vos, we could hear that boom from 10 clicks away! Your ears must be ringing like church bells.
translations.When you've got a grip on yourself, head: When you've got a grip on yourself, head inside the mine. It's structurally safe, or at least that's what some seismologists from Buenos Aires told Vicente. Follow the path all the way until you reach the gold.
translations.So many men attempted to take over the f: So many men attempted to take over the family after Fernando died. They all believed this mine was their ticket to untold riches. Gold! Silver! Boron! Lead! Name any mineral, they'd tell you it was down here. Boludos. There's gold in this mine, but not in the rock. Just up ahead, you'll see what I mean.
translations.Creating a paradise for elite hunters wo: Creating a paradise for elite hunters won't be enough to protect this land from pollution and exploitation when I'm gone. But a sustainable spring water bottling operation?
translations.It's going to be worth billions! A resou: It's going to be worth billions! A resource worth so much money, no one would dare poison this land. That was Fernando's dream. Now, it will be our legacy. And I'm trusting *you*, my faithful warden, to protect this place. I know you will, because--
translations.Our explosion must have upset the neighb: Our explosion must have upset the neighbors… I hope this isn't the puma I think it is. Regardless, you will have to defend yourself.
translations.[Oh no!] I know that growl. That's a big: [Oh no!] I know that growl. That's a big puma. A big, angry puma. Our explosion must have upset the neighbors… [sigh] I hope this isn't the puma I think it is. Regardless, you will have to defend yourself.
translations.[laments] Esto es un quilombo… [This is: [laments] Esto es un quilombo… [This is a freaking mess...]
translations.I think I know that puma -- my Fernanda!: I think I know that puma -- my Fernanda! Don't let her suffer. She's done nothing wrong.
translations.I knew it. Fernanda ate Gilbert Baden fo: I knew it. Fernanda ate Gilbert Baden for breakfast. You were almost lunch. I'm glad that you survived, but Baden got what he deserved. Fernanda… she was the greater loss today.
translations.Che, I am invested in you. I want to pro: Che, I am invested in you. I want to protect my investment, so I have a gift for you. It will help if you're cornered by another one of my pampered pumas: my beloved Fernando's favorite .44 magnum. I think, given your contributions, he would want you to have it.
translations.And with that, I will leave you to the j: And with that, I will leave you to the job. I have hours and hours of telenovelas on VHS to watch. I never imagined having the free time to watch them all, but with you at Parque Fernando? Well, my legacy is in world-class hands. I can finally rest easy. I'll be around if you need anything. Until then... Thank you, che. Happy hunting!
translations.Che, a miracle has happened, like an epi: Che, a miracle has happened, like an episode of Esposas y Jefas, but in real life! And I have you to thank for it. Tu es buena onda… After years of secretly longing to be with Beatriz, Vicente declared his love to her! Beatriz was shocked… because she has been in love with Vicente this whole time!
translations.It's worth getting a little cardio out t: It's worth getting a little cardio out there, but don't forget that animals will be more likely to hear you when you're running. You'll need to wait for your heart rate to settle down before you take a shot, too.
translations.The hunt is on. Those tracks look pretty: The hunt is on. Those tracks look pretty fresh.
translations.Don't forget to keep it quiet while you': Don't forget to keep it quiet while you're out in the bush. It's always better when the animals around you don't know you're there, regardless of who's the prey and who's the hunter.
translations.I'm quite certain that you're the part o: I'm quite certain that you're the part of the puzzle that we've been missing out here. While I deal with paperwork and people, you're going to be my eyes and ears on the ground. We're gonna be a strong team, I just know it.
translations.Once you've got a good vantage point, it: Once you've got a good vantage point, it's time to pull out the binoculars and spot some animals. Make sure you've done your recon before you try getting in closer.
translations.[concerned] I know you're out there, giv: [concerned] I know you're out there, giving it all you've got, but remember to take a moment to rest before taking your shot. Your heart must be beating like a drum!
translations.Satisfaction for a job well done is one: Satisfaction for a job well done is one thing, but getting paid is just as good, sometimes. Enjoy it, you earned it.
translations.No matter how good you are, every hunter: No matter how good you are, every hunter benefits from learning something new. A professional hunter never stops developing.
translations.We try to keep the notice boards up to d: We try to keep the notice boards up to date. There's not much of a community to inform out here, mind you.
translations.Think about what you're hunting and when: Think about what you're hunting and when they're most active. It's best to be awake when they are, and coffee can only do so much.
translations.[whispering] When I get turned around, t: [whispering] When I get turned around, the first thing I do is look for tracks.
translations.[whispering] I'll bet there's some track: [whispering] I'll bet there's some tracks nearby. Can you see anything?
translations.[urgent whispering] Whatever's nearby is: [urgent whispering] Whatever's nearby is bound to have left some tracks. Take a look around.
translations.[urgent whispering] Stay vigilant. Look: [urgent whispering] Stay vigilant. Look to nearby tracks, they'll help you out.
translations.[urgent whispering] I think you have som: [urgent whispering] I think you have some company. Be careful out there.
translations.[urgent whispering] Stay on your toes. I: [urgent whispering] Stay on your toes. I don't think you're alone out there.
translations.[whispering] Sometimes animals will tell: [whispering] Sometimes animals will tell you where they are with loud noises. Can you hear anything?
translations.And your quarry is off! Don't worry, it: And your quarry is off! Don't worry, it can happen to the best of us. Just focus on approaching calmly and quietly. You'll get the next one.
translations.Get a good idea of your surroundings and: Get a good idea of your surroundings and take a look at one of our outposts.
translations.Once you’re up top, enjoy the view. Thes: Once you’re up top, enjoy the view. These towers are used mostly for firewatch duties, but when I'm at the top of one, normally I just want to put my feet up and enjoy the tranquility. I haven't had a chance to do that in a long time, though.
translations.People often struggle to lock these heav: People often struggle to lock these heavy-duty trash cans, but if they leave it just a little bit open, all sorts of trouble can come sniffing around. I think we got lucky this time.
translations.Thanks for taking care of that. Oh, one: Thanks for taking care of that. Oh, one last thing, before you move on; can you take a look at the firewood inside the cabin?
translations.We have a beetle infestation close to Wo: We have a beetle infestation close to Woodsman's Respite that needs to be dealt with.
translations.The spruce bark beetles are a massive th: The spruce bark beetles are a massive threat to Alaska’s spruce forests at the moment. We haven’t been hit as badly, compared to some other Alaskan state parks, but I think that it may be time for a quarantine.
translations.Ok, so once you find a fallen tree, I wa: Ok, so once you find a fallen tree, I want you to take a look at its bark. Does it look healthy? If so, it’s probably not the tree we’re looking for.
translations.I don’t think this is our tree. The bark: I don’t think this is our tree. The bark still seems ok. Let’s keep looking.
translations.Mark trees near the infested tree for in: Mark trees near the infested tree for investigation
translations.Hmm. No, this tree is perfectly fine, ot: Hmm. No, this tree is perfectly fine, other than having fallen over, of course. No sign of beetles.
translations.This is the one. Ok, in that pack you sh: This is the one. Ok, in that pack you should have a canister of paint and a nozzle attachment. Use them to paint a big pink X on the tree and let’s take a look around to make sure the beetles haven’t started to spread.
translations.If you see a spruce in the immediate vic: If you see a spruce in the immediate vicinity of the fallen tree, mark it and our forestry team will come out and take care of it. If it’s untouched, they can just spray it with pesticides to protect it. If it’s already infested, then they’ll cut it down and haul it all away for burning.
translations.Great job. I hope we don’t need to cut t: Great job. I hope we don’t need to cut these trees down, but it’s a small price to pay to contain the beetles.
translations.There we go. Another tree marked. This r: There we go. Another tree marked. This reminds me of my summer breaks when I was a kid, helping out my dad at work. He was a tree surgeon, down in Washington State.
translations.I used to resent him for making me go ou: I used to resent him for making me go out there and work while my friends played back home. Eventually, those trips also included hunting lessons, and that made them my favourite parts of the summer.
translations.Grab some samples in the wetlands so we: Grab some samples in the wetlands so we can test the effects of these pesticides.
translations.We are running a trial of pesticides tha: We are running a trial of pesticides that are designed to prevent any more spruce beetle infestations. Before we start widespread use of it, I want to take some samples and make sure it's not having any unforeseen side effects.
translations.In the same bag that you found the paint: In the same bag that you found the paint, there should be some plastic sample containers. Could you bring them out to the musk- sorry, I mean wetlands? Muskeg is the word we use up here in Alaska.
Watch your footing at the water’s edge. It can be easy to slip and fall in. Just fill one of the containers you have with water.
translations.If the pesticides have drifted out to th: If the pesticides have drifted out to the flats, I want to know if it’s making it into the foodchain. It’s been a month since we sprayed, so there has been plenty of time for the pesticides to get out here.
translations.My girls spent plenty of time in the bus: My girls spent plenty of time in the bush when they were younger, but despite being rough and ready Alaskan kids, they missed their home comforts like daily showers. I think I would have had a full-blown riot on my hands if I’d asked them to pick up poop.
translations.That should do it. Now we’ll be able to: That should do it. Now we’ll be able to tell if anything larger than a fly is ingesting chemicals that we should be worried about.
translations.[amused] It's hard work, wading through: [amused] It's hard work, wading through the muskeg, huh? I have a spot where you can drop the samples off, and I can easily pick them up...
translations.You got the hatchet? Great. I hope our v: You got the hatchet? Great. I hope our visitors haven't been using it to open their beans. You're gonna need a nice, sharp edge. It’s small but it should do the job.
translations.The samples are ready for pickup? Fantas: The samples are ready for pickup? Fantastic. I will be over that way as soon as I can. I really appreciate the assistance. Hunting for droppings and wading into swamp water might not be glamorous or exciting, but it's part of a massive effort to maintain the balance of life out here. It makes a big difference.
translations.There's a tree that is at risk of fallin: There's a tree that is at risk of falling onto the traintracks. Take care of it before it falls.
translations.A recent storm may have shaken a tree lo: A recent storm may have shaken a tree loose, and it's now at risk of falling onto the traintracks. The train that comes through here is tough, but ideally, I would like to avoid the risk of the train running into it. Use the hatchet to chop it down and then move it somewhere safe.
translations.Some of my team are still recording the: Some of my team are still recording the after-effects of the storms. I've heard reports of huge trees with deep roots that are now at precarious angles and might need to be cut down. We are lucky to have such isolated incidents, other reserves have reported landslides.
translations.Great work, out there. The train is a be: Great work, out there. The train is a behemoth. I honestly don't think a single tree would do more than dent it in a collision, but I'd rather not take the chance and risk a serious accident.
translations.Keeping that railroad open is a big resp: Keeping that railroad open is a big responsibility for us. Not only is it essential for a lot of trade out here, but the bridge brings tourists in from all over the place. I'd like a good picture of the bridge; one that we can put on our website. See if you can snap it while the train is passing over it, that'll look great!
translations.[wistful] Those trips are some of my fav: [wistful] Those trips are some of my favorite memories. It brought us all closer as a family, being alone together...
translations.Here's me talking about my family vacati: Here's me talking about my family vacations when I can't even remember the last time I had dinner with my wife. Her birthday was what...a month ago? I think I'm probably overdue to take her out somewhere nice.
translations.That looks like a good spot to take the: That looks like a good spot to take the photo.
translations.It's a shame we couldn't catch it with t: It's a shame we couldn't catch it with the train on top, but it's still good.
translations.I'm just gonna guess that you sneezed or: I'm just gonna guess that you sneezed or your finger slipped for that one. Try it again.
translations.When my eldest daughter Deanna hit her l: When my eldest daughter Deanna hit her late teens, I think she appreciated the isolation a lot more than she did when she was younger. Her sister Kara enjoyed learning how to hunt rabbits too.
translations.[wistful] Those trips are some of my fav: [wistful] Those trips are some of my favourite memories. It brought us all closer, being alone together... if you know what I mean?
translations.Just stick a little fuel in the generato: Just stick a little fuel in the generator and fire it up.
Three saplings should be enough for now. Can you see the shell of the old tree? It was the first casualty when it was struck by lightning and went up in flames.
translations.[regretful] We lost more than trees that: [regretful] We lost more than trees that night.
translations.It took less than 5 minutes for the blaz: It took less than 5 minutes for the blaze to take hold and travel towards us. Our rookie trooper, Omid Basri was the only one not accounted for.
translations.I went back to where he'd last been seen: I went back to where he'd last been seen, but the fire had already spread so far. I called out his name. There was no response.
translations.I wanted to go further in and look for h: I wanted to go further in and look for him, but the fire was inpenetrable. The wall of heat was advancing and I couldn't stay there. I just made it out before the fire consumed where I'd been standing seconds before.
translations.[stoic] We went back as soon as the fire: [stoic] We went back as soon as the fires had died down and started looking. We found him, but it was as we'd feared.
translations.[earnest] Naturally, it was a tough time: [earnest] Naturally, it was a tough time for the whole team, but it brought us closer together. We supported each other and Basri's family. You do what you can, right? We devoted ourselves to our work, and we work to ensure it never happens again.
Finding tracks out there is a good sign. There might not be a lot of cover or food yet, but at least some animals are starting to come back.

translations.The Nilgai (literally meaning \"blue cow:
The Nilgai (literally meaning "blue cow" in Nepali) has slim legs, a sloped back and is adorned with a mane. It stands as the largest antelope in Asia. Bulls can stretch between 1 and 1.5 meters tall at the shoulder, bearing a weight range of 109 to 308 kg. On the other hand, cows, though similar in height, typically weigh less, ranging between 100 and 213 kg.
Manifesting significant sexual dimorphism, their fur coloration differs significantly. The bulls have a blue-tinged fur, while the cows have a lighter, brownish coat. In spite of this disparity, all Nilgai possess a white neck patch, a white rump, and white inner hind legs, coupled with distinctive black-and-white "socks".

translations.North American beavers have stocky bodie:
North American beavers have stocky bodies with a yellow-brown to almost black coat and a broad, flat, scaly tail. They have webbed rear feet and digitated front paws. Beavers regularly move between aquatic and terrestrial environments. Their small, dexterous front feet are well adapted to working on land. They walk on five digits, grasp sticks with their front paws and have well-developed digging claws.
A beaver's long, dark-orange, visible incisors grow continuously throughout its life and are worn down through daily use. These teeth are self-sharpening and can cleave a willow the size of a person's finger in a single bite.

The common raccoon is an adaptable omnivorous land mammal native to North and Central America. They typically prefer woodlands and wetlands, due to their high adaptability they can be found in a wide variety of habitats across the continent - including urban areas where they are considered pests.
Raccoons have also been introduced in Western Europe, the Caucasus and Japan by humans.
Raccoons are mostly nocturnal animals that spend the day hidden in tree cavities, hollow logs or dens dug in the ground. Due to this, hunter often use callers to lure them out of their nests.

translations.The snow goose is a migratory waterfowl: The snow goose is a migratory waterfowl found in wetlands and agricultural fields across North America. These medium-sized geese are known for their striking white plumage, with black wingtips and a pinkish-orange bill. Snow geese are highly social, often forming large flocks during migration. They feed primarily on grasses, sedges, and grains, often in open fields. Snow geese are famous for their long migrations, traveling thousands of miles between breeding grounds in the Arctic and wintering areas in the southern U.S. and Mexico. Snow geese are known to form massive "V" formations during flight to conserve energy while migrating.

translations.The South American tapir (Tapirus terres: The South American tapir (Tapirus terrestris) is a large, stocky herbivore with a short trunk-like snout used to grasp leaves and fruit. Found across much of tropical South America, it prefers humid forests, swamps, and riverbanks. Mostly solitary and active at night, it feeds on leaves, shoots, and fallen fruit. Tapirs are shy but excellent swimmers, often cooling off in water by day. They play a vital role as seed dispersers, helping maintain the diversity of their rainforest ecosystems.

translations.The springbok is a slender, medium-sized: The springbok is a slender, medium-sized antelope with stethoscope-shaped horns, native to the open, treeless plains of southern Africa. The springbok is named after its unique jumping behavior, also known as pronking, where it leaps up to {d:2} high with an arched back. The springbok weighs between {w:27} and {w:42}, and stands up to {d:0.86} tall at the shoulder, with female springbok generally being the smaller of the two genders. Despite similarities, the springbok is not a true gazelle, clear in its scientific name, antidorcas, meaning not-a-gazelle. It has great speed on land, but can be outrun by the cheetah in short sprints and by wild dogs over a longer distance.

translations.I grew up among the Nenets, reindeer her: I grew up among the Nenets, reindeer herders who have lived on the taiga since before the Russians. My traditional upbringing brought me closer to nature than most people will ever understand. And over the years, I became aware that the land was changing, rapidly, and not always in beneficial ways. The Nenets do not have the science to cope with these changes. So, I left my people to get an education and learn the sciences, so that I might come back to the taiga to help find solutions to the crises of climate change. This expedition is supposed to be my realization of that goal, but we have suffered so many setbacks, I think Mother Taiga may be working against us. Hopefully with the arrival of a new team and a world-class hunter, we can make a positive difference.
translations.Dr. Anatoly Barnyashev was recommended t: Dr. Anatoly Barnyashev was recommended to me by Svetlana, who worked with him in St. Petersburg. His manner is cold even by Russian standards. But his work? Organized, disciplined, and profoundly insightful. More animals migrate to and through the taiga every year, displaced by climate change. Anatoly is determined to help wildlife adapt to the changing environment, seeking healthy, sustainable domains for displaced creatures. Sometimes I attribute Anatoly's icy demeanor to the fact that he prefers the company of animals more than his fellow humans.
translations.My little Chinita, Beatriz, grew up work: My little Chinita, Beatriz, grew up working with her father and her brothers, riding horses, hunting and running cattle for my estancia. I think of the gauchos less as employees than as family. Even when she was just a toddler, Beatriz reminded me of myself more than any of my own nieces! She had guts. Determination. She’s grown up to be tougher than rawhide. But even Beatriz has a soft spot – and I pray that someday she marries my nephew, Vicente!
translations.Would you like to customize your charact: Would you like to customize your character with these features? You cannot refund this action.
translations.Dimi Pushkin is an odd character. On one: Dimi Pushkin is an odd character. On one hand, he is our contact at the State Ecological Service Department, so we must keep him happy in order to legally operate this expedition. On the other hand, Dimi seems desperate to make friends, which makes him unusually casual and chatty for a state agent. He says he grew up as the son of an important diplomat in Moscow, but I think he's just trying to sound impressive. Regardless of his quirks, Dimi acts with genuine concern for the wellbeing of the land, animals, and people of the taiga. We could not ask for a better advocate in the government.
translations.Georgy Grankin was a prominent medical d: Georgy Grankin was a prominent medical doctor in Moscow until his wife's death in 1977. Losing her shattered him, he says. He could not imagine returning to his practice as though nothing had changed. So, Georgy gave up everything he knew -- including his "Doctor" title, he hates being called that -- and headed into the wilderness for a life of ice and sweat and hardship. He says nothing could make him happier. He's generally out and about laying game traps. Despite his expressed preference for solitude, Georgy is rarely actually alone -- wherever he goes, his dogs are with him.
translations.Katerina is my older sister. When I left: Katerina is my older sister. When I left the taiga, she stayed here with our people. You could say Katerina is the model Nenets daughter, while I'm the rebel. Katerina understands me, though. She took charge of the family when my father and our brothers died. She's so much stronger than me. No wonder she's in charge of more reindeer than any woman in our family before! Katerina's primary concerns are the herd and our people. She takes it upon herself to act as an ambassador for the Nenets, welcoming visitors to the community and teaching them about our culture and our history.
translations.Roddy is a relic of a bygone age, a rich: Roddy is a relic of a bygone age, a rich boy enthralled by a family legacy that is destined to forget all about him. He performs stories of myths and monsters to all that will listen, legends of his lineage and land, telling tales of a time when everything was custom-made for Clan Roan. He protects his grounds as his own little sanctuary, letting in hunters as a captive audience and a source of income he frankly doesn’t need. However deep within him, the promise of sentience glimmers, buried in a longing to do something worth remembering, even if that means appealing to people who aren’t just like him.
translations.Dr. Dana Maritz is a controversial figur: Dr. Dana Maritz is a controversial figure. She is an expert in African firearms and game, and her doctoral studies focused on sustainable hunting practices. She currently works as a Chief Examiner for various hunting associations. Dr. Maritz is dogmatic and exacting in her views on hunting practices, and bossy to the point of dictatorial. That approach, along with her proud Rhodesian heritage, has made her wildly unpopular among locals, but she and I have been friends for many years. She loves this land.
translations.Nina and I first met when I came into he: Nina and I first met when I came into her father's restaurant for dinner, one night. Her father was ill and she had returned home from Barcelona to keep the place open. We shared a glass of wine after the restaurant closed, and she confided in me that she wants to break some traditions and change up the menu. She has a fantastic reputation in culinary circles, and I think that if we can convince her that Cuatro Colinas can supply the sort of food she needs, she could bring us a lot of good publicity.
translations.You'd like to know more about Soph? Well:
You'd like to know more about Soph? Well, she and I go way back, so I might have a couple of interesting anecdotes for you. 

As you know, she and I grew up here, and went to the same school, and that's how we became friends. That was exactly 30 years ago! She was more on the introverted side back then, and maybe there's still some of that left. She enjoys company, but she enjoys and needs her own time as well. 

She and her brothers grew up helping out her folks with all the work there is to do on a station, and over time she took over the station and runs it with her husband Eric. She's also part of a hunting association, so they often meet up at her place.

I know she studied history, it was (still is) her thing. During most of high school, she wanted to become a history teacher, but at some point she felt standing in front of kids all day long wasn't for her.

Anyway, I'm happy I get to hang out with her a lot more than during our twenties when I lived in Brisbane. She's always there for me, and I hope I do the same for her.
translations.Dr. Svetlana Isakova and I met in univer: Dr. Svetlana Isakova and I met in university as classmates, but after school, she took a position in St. Petersburg while I traveled the continent. Luring Svetlana away from St. Petersburg to the taiga for this project took a lot of convincing. She skipped my first expedition altogether.  When that first team fell apart, maybe Svetlana pitied me, I don't know -- but she came on the next available train. She didn't even ask how much the job paid! Now Svetlana tracks and forecasts changes in weather patterns on the taiga. Her research is the cornerstone for all of our work.

translations.There's that mystery solved then. No bea: There's that mystery solved then. No beasties this time. Alright, see you later!
translations.The ultimate blind for hunting ducks in: The ultimate blind for hunting ducks in lakes and wetlands. This floating layout blind can be deployed on water. It provides excellent visibility concealment for hunters looking to get the jump on waterfowl.
translations.The state-of-the-art technology used in: The state-of-the-art technology used in these rangefinder binoculars allows you to greatly increase the contrast of the environment while leaving depth perception and shapes unaltered. The green tint of the lenses further improves visibility in the dark, making these binoculars a fundamental ally when night hunting.
translations.A compact, robust, and waterproof rangef: A compact, robust, and waterproof rangefinder that provides accurate readings up to 1370 meters or 1500 yards.
translations.With these lightweight binoculars, you'l: With these lightweight binoculars, you'll get the best of both worlds: the superior field of view of binoculars coupled with accurate range information from a rangefinder. Long gone are the days where you have to constantly switch between the two!
translations.Illuminated iron sights coated with trit: Illuminated iron sights coated with tritium to make target acquisition a breeze under any lighting conditions. Fitted for the Focoso 357 revolver.
Illuminated iron sights coated with tritium to make target acquisition a breeze under any lighting conditions. Fitted for the .44 Panther Magnum revolver.
Illuminated iron sights coated with tritium to make target acquisition a breeze under any lighting conditions. Fitted for the Rhino 454 revolver.
translations.A versatile, all-purpose optic for all m: A versatile, all-purpose optic for all modern rifles. With its 4-12x magnification, it's perfect for any hunting situation, be it for close encounters or long-range shots.
translations.The base damage of a projectile when it: The base damage of a projectile when it hits a target. This is combined with expansion rate at the time of impact to an internal organ and the type of organ to calculate bleed rate from that organ.
translations.A value that indicates the expansion of: A value that indicates the expansion of a projectile when it hits a target. This value is combined with the kinetic energy of a projectile upon impact to calculate the actual diameter of the wound channel.
translations.Kinetic energy of a projectile at differ: Kinetic energy of a projectile at different distances. This is used when calculating penetration and expansion upon impact with a target.
translations.The typical trajectory of the projectile: The typical trajectory of the projectile when traveling through the air. Weather conditions, primarily wind, may alter the trajectory from what is shown here.
translations.The range of the light cone generated by: The range of the light cone generated by this light device. This affects the distance at which clues are highlighted at night.
translations.The magnification provided by this optic: The magnification provided by this optic device.
translations.This indicates if this device contains a: This indicates if this device contains a built-in rangefinder that can be used to gauge the distance to objects in the world.
translations.The type of view when looking through th: The type of view when looking through this optic device.

translations.The remote island has been home for wate: The remote island has been home for waterfowl for many millennia. To this day the hunters take row boats out to the island to hunt for prized waterfowl.
translations.You have been signed out from your accou: You have been signed out from your account. Exit the game and sign in with your Microsoft account again.
translations.Caisteal an Eilein has been the ancestra:
Caisteal an Eilein has been the ancestral home of Clan Roan since 1621, when poet and courtier William Roan was made the Viscount of Tòrr nan Sìthean, and the castle was constructed shortly after. 

The central keep was burned to ashes during the Jacobite Rebellion, and has since been restored at considerable expense by the Roan family, who currently use it as private lodging. Rodney Roan was known for famously fleeing the burning wreckage with the family annals, a fistful of Baronetcies and as much gold as he could carry.
translations.Guthrie's Isle is the historical site of: Guthrie's Isle is the historical site of a chapel built by St. Guthrie in the 7th Century. The chapel stood there for many years, until being burnt down in the 16th Century, leaving behind a considerable graveyard.
translations.Uamh mhòr is a voluminous cave, once tho: Uamh mhòr is a voluminous cave, once thought to lead all the way to the very tip of Ireland. It's particularly known for its acoustics, which have been pressed to wax and span to plastic; eternalizing the once-humble cave from the lap-lapping of the tide.
translations.Loch Fada is a long loch known to house: Loch Fada is a long loch known to house Scotland's lesser known Sea Serpent, Faddie. Many hoaxes and legends have been weaved into the rich fabric of her legacy, including a particularly problematic run-in with a shaved bull elephant seal. Her actual existence, however, remains a mystery too insignificant to solve.
translations.An Coille Dhorcha is earnest plea for th: An Coille Dhorcha is earnest plea for the future of Scottish flora. A care-took collection of foreign seeds and shoots, welcomed home and housed anew. Each Sitka Spruce stands in service of a healthier ecosystem, replete with all the love and care it needs.
translations.Although the national flower of Scotland: Although the national flower of Scotland is the Thistle, the delicate pink and purple flowers of the ling heather are just as iconic. Heather was traditionally used to create brooms, from which it derives its Latin name.
translations.Roan's Rest keeps watch along an ancient: Roan's Rest keeps watch along an ancient line, the vanguard of a force that has long since decayed into sleeping soil. Untouched by the torch of rebellion that claimed his ward, he awaits another chance to prove himself. Always eager to serve, be it against revolt, or an encroaching sky.
translations.The Whispering Stone, or Guthan Clach, i: The Whispering Stone, or Guthan Clach, is an ancient menhir dating back to the bronze age. The original purpose of its placement is unknown.
translations.Monadh Ruadh consists of hill-side slopi: Monadh Ruadh consists of hill-side sloping muirs that give way to pine woodlands and barren highlands.
translations.Coille nan Con prominently features old: Coille nan Con prominently features old mossy forests and a temperate rainforest.
translations.Camus a' Chòis contains Caisteal an Eile: Camus a' Chòis contains Caisteal an Eilein,  the central castle, a water inlet and Port Whisky, a fishing harbor.
translations.An Cùl is a parade of Caledonian woodlan: An Cùl is a parade of Caledonian woodlands and heather plains.
translations.Na Creagan Dubha plays home to huge coas: Na Creagan Dubha plays home to huge coastal cliffs and winding basalt caves.
translations.Ceum a Tuath is the northern part of the: Ceum a Tuath is the northern part of the central hill ridgeline. Expect rough Highland terrain with a smattering of tarn lakes.
translations.The game is installing in the background: The game is installing in the background, only limited content is available until the installation is completed.
